english: These are fucked up times, dude. Remember to get T and C to help you if shit gets tough.
zh: 现在的日子不好过啊，老兄。出状况了记得叫T和C来支援你。

english: I enjoyed the race, even if it nearly killed me. Call me soon, brother.
zh: 我很享受这场赛车，虽然我被揍了个半死。有空再联系，兄弟。

english: Johnny man. You're the friendliest biker I know. Get aggressive in the next race.
zh: 强尼老兄，你是我见过的最友好的飞车党。下场比赛凶一点吧。

english: We need a rematch. I wanna see if you're just as cold next time we race.
zh: 还是得重赛一场。我倒要看看下次比赛你是不是还是这么冷酷。

english: I've got some more bikes that need getting. We got to keep making money, man. Call me.
zh: 我需要的摩托还有很多。钱还是要继续赚的，兄弟。有空联系。

english: Press ~INPUT_PHONE_TAKE_OUT~ to activate the phone.
Press ~INPUT_PHONE_ACCEPT~ to select a menu item.
~z~~x~We'll send a basically trained paramedic as soon as we can, sir.
zh: ~z~~x~我们会尽快派出一支训练有素的医疗小组，先生。

english: Jim has left a SMG with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的冲锋枪。

english: The Uptown Riders are a group of urban riding enthusiasts based out of Northwood in Liberty City.
zh: 「上城骑士」热爱在都市中骑行，以自由城的北伍德为活动范围。

english: Dude, you ever need some help, Terry and Clay can back you up. Just call one of em.
zh: 老兄，要是需要支援，特里和科雷都能帮你。需要支援就找他们。

english: Now that you're chapter leader you should take advantage. Get Terry and Clay up off their asses and make em help you.
zh: 现在你是分会会长了，多用点权力。叫特里和科雷过来帮你忙吧。

english: You're like my fucking ex wife, always standing me up. Screw you, man.
zh: 你他妈怎么跟我前妻一个德性，老是放我鸽子。去你妈的，哥们。

english: Johnny K, smacks his own brother in the face to try and beat him in a race. Let's hang out soon.
zh: 强尼 K，给兄弟脸上一棍，还想往冠军席混。以后一起出去吧。

english: You call that a hit, man? My little sister can hit harder than that. Let's race again soon.
zh: 你管这叫比赛，老兄？我妹妹水平都比你高了。改天再比一次吧。

english: Oh, Johnny. You're an easy target. If you ain't scared, let's race again soon.
zh: 哦，强尼。你太好对付了。没吓出阴影的话，就择日再赛一场吧。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Jim. You have already taken him on 3 additional activities. Take him home.
zh: 你已完成了与吉姆的预定安排。你已追加了三项活动。送他回家。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Terry. You have already taken him on 3 additional activities. Take him home.
zh: 你已完成了与特里的预定安排。你已追加了三项活动。送他回家。

english: You have completed the arranged activity with Clay. You have already taken him on 3 additional activities. Take him home.
zh: 你已完成了与科雷的预定安排。你已追加了三项活动。送他回家。

english: ~z~~x~I dunno. Ain't it enough that I'm calling for help? Fucking bureaucrats.
zh: ~z~~x~不知道。光打过来求救还不管用吗？傻逼官僚主义。

english: ~z~It don't matter what the world thinks of America, at least we can still buy guns here.
zh: ~z~世界上其他人怎么评价美国不重要，至少我们还能买到枪。

english: Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to arm wrestle.~n~$100 wager.
Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to arm wrestle.~n~$200 wager.
Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to arm wrestle.~n~$300 wager.
Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to play hi-lo cards.~n~$10 per hand.
~s~When in this camera mode, use ~MOUSE~ left and right to see from another biker's point of view.
zh: ~s~在这一视角下，用~MOUSE~左右查看其他骑手的视角。

english: Reinforce positive playtime, family values and gender roles with the Gender Role Doll.
zh: 寓教于乐，玩性别角色娃娃的同时，还能学习家庭观念和性别角色。

english: You ever need some firepower, let me know. I might just be able to drop off what you're looking for in the House.
zh: 需要火力了就跟我说一声。说不定我能帮你弄来，扔在会所的桌上。

english: Me and Clay are here to help out on Club business, Prez. Just call one of us.
zh: 我和科雷加入失落帮就是为了给帮会做事的，头儿。有事打个电话。

english: Johnny, man. You ever need to replenish your weapons supply, call me and I'll bring round the War Wagon.
zh: 强尼，兄弟。需要补充武器了就给我打个电话，我会开战车过来的。

english: ~s~For a quick online game select the Instant Play option in the phone menu.
zh: ~s~若想快速加入一局多人游戏，请选择手机菜单中的即刻加入。

english: You have arranged to do an activity with Jim. Meet him by going towards the ~BLIP_106~ on the radar.
zh: 你已和吉姆安排了活动，去小地图上的~BLIP_106~找他。

english: You have arranged to do an activity with Terry. Meet him by going towards the ~BLIP_118~ on the radar.
zh: 你已和特里安排了活动，去小地图上的~BLIP_118~找他。

english: You have arranged to do an activity with Clay. Meet him by going towards the ~BLIP_119~ on the radar.
zh: 你已和科雷安排了活动，去小地图上的~BLIP_119~找他。

english: ~z~~x~Hello, this is the LCPD, where would you like us to send an officer?
zh: ~z~~x~您好，这里是LCPD，请问您想让我们向哪里出警？

english: Jim has left a 9mm Pistol with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的9mm手枪。

english: Jim has left a Micro SMG with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的微型冲锋枪。

english: Jim has left a Sawn-Off Shotgun with ~1~ rounds of ammunition for you at The Lost clubhouse.
zh: 吉姆已在失落帮会所为你准备了一把配有~1~发子弹的短管霰弹枪。

english: Terry will sell you weapons at discounted prices. Meet Terry at the ~BLIP_118~ icon to purchase weapons.
zh: 特里会向你低价出售武器。去~BLIP_118~向特里购买武器。

english: ~b~Jim~s~, ~b~Terry~s~, and ~b~Clay~s~ have been left behind.
zh: 你把~b~吉姆~s~、~b~特里~s~和~b~科雷~s~落下了。

english: ~z~~x~I'm sorry, but all our peacekeepers are currently busy filling quotas and dealing with paper work.
zh: ~z~~x~很抱歉，但目前我们的干员都忙于完成指标以及书面工作。

english: ~z~Sorry, man. I had to cut down spending on firearms. This fucking economic downturn...
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟。武器这块只能消费降级了。都他妈怪经济衰退...

english: Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to play hi-lo cards with Jim.~n~$10 per hand.
zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~与吉姆参加猜大小。~n~$10一局。

english: Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to play hi-lo cards with Terry.~n~$10 per hand.
zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~与特里参加猜大小。~n~$10一局。

english: Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to play hi-lo cards with Clay.~n~$10 per hand.
zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~与科雷参加猜大小。~n~$10一局。

english: ~z~~x~Dude. I didn't think I'd get given the third degree. I'll call you back with a locate.
zh: ~z~~x~老兄，我好像连三等学位都没拿到。知道地名了我再打给你。

english: ~z~~x~Hello, you're through to the MS Paramedics. In which area is your medical emergency?
zh: ~z~~x~您好，您呼叫的是医疗服务中心，您需要在哪里的医疗应急？

english: Clay is on his way to deliver a bike to you. It is indicated by the ~BLIP_126~ on the radar.
zh: 科雷正在为你送车的途中，小地图上的~BLIP_126~表示他的位置。

english: Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to challenge Jim to an arm wrestle.~n~$20 wager.
zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~向吉姆挑战掰手腕。~n~赌注 $20。

english: Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to challenge Terry to an arm wrestle.~n~$20 wager.

zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~向科雷挑战掰手腕。~n~赌注 $20。

Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to play hi-lo cards with Jim and Terry.~n~$10 per hand.

zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~与特里和科雷参加猜大小。~n~$10一局。

english: ~z~~x~Hold tight and please be advised that the FDLC takes no responsibility for damage to property.
zh: ~z~~x~请坚持住。注意，FDLC不对过程中造成的财产损失负任何责任。

english: Hold ~INPUT_AIM~ to lock onto enemies. Press ~INPUT_ATTACK~ to fire your weapon.
zh: 按住~INPUT_AIM~锁定敌人。按下~INPUT_ATTACK~开火。

english: Hold ~INPUT_SPRINT~ to run. Tap ~INPUT_SPRINT~ repeatedly to sprint.
Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to play hi-lo cards with Jim, Terry and Clay.~n~$10 per hand.
zh: 按~INPUT_PICKUP~与吉姆、特里和科雷参加猜大小。~n~$10一局。

english: ~s~Use ~INPUT_KB_UP~ and ~INPUT_KB_DOWN~ to navigate the phone menu.
Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to quit. ~n~Press ~INPUT_MOUSE_LMB~ to go back to the game.
Press ~INPUT_PICKUP~ to quit. ~n~Press ~INPUT_MOUSE_LMB~ to play again.
Half hold ~PAD_LT~ to free aim. Use ~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~ to aim (Standard controls).
zh: 半按~PAD_LT~可以自由瞄准。使用~PAD_RSTICK_ALL~瞄准。(标准键位下)

english: Compete with Jim at Arm Wrestling ~BLIP_110~ or Cards ~BLIP_112~ one floor up. Leave the Clubhouse to quit hanging out with Jim.
zh: 上楼向吉姆挑战掰手腕~BLIP_110~或纸牌~BLIP_112~。离开会所可以结束与吉姆的约会。

zh: ~z~打高尔夫球都没空，那你有空干啥？

english: ~z~Northwood's son, Downtown's bitch. What's happening?
zh: ~z~北伍德之子，城里的狗逼。你好吗？

english: ~z~Coño, mano. Okay, bro. Call me soon.
zh: ~z~妈的，就这样吧，兄弟。以后再约。

english: ~z~Them pucks move too fast for a man in my state. Shit's a blur.
zh: ~z~我刚才都看不清球在哪里，太糊了儿。

english: ~z~I wish we could hit them balls around the city.

zh: ~z~恩里克被落下了。快回去找他，兄弟。

zh: ~z~没空休闲，兄弟。还要赚钱呢。改天吧。

zh: ~z~喂，阿曼多，我需要点家伙。你有空吗？

english: ~z~Fuck, bro. We left H. I hope he alright.

zh: ~z~休闲一下吧，兄弟。叫上H一起出去玩吧。

english: ~z~Why'd we go through this charade at all. You weren't never gonna show.
zh: ~z~我们别再演戏了好不好，反正你也不会来。

english: ~z~You want me to turn one them pieces on you, bro. I will.
zh: ~z~你是想让我拿你试枪是吧，兄弟。我会的。

english: ~z~Earth to Downtown motherfucker! You gonna hang with me and H or what?
zh: ~z~呼叫城里的鳖孙！要不要跟我和H一起去玩？

english: ~z~Coño, monstruo. I got this really important thing to handle. Another time.
zh: ~z~妈的，猛男。我有很重要的事要忙。改天吧。

english: ~z~Bigshot's got something more important than bowling to handle.
zh: ~z~大明星还有比打保龄球更重要的事情要忙呢。

english: ~z~You fucking joking. You the rich bitch. Ain't giving you shit for free.
zh: ~z~你他妈搞笑呢。你这么有钱，别想白嫖老子。

english: ~z~I bet you don't pull out half way when you looking after the boss, L.
zh: ~z~保护老板的时候你一定不会中途跑路吧，L。

english: ~z~All them golfing and fucking holidays you must go on with the queen, no wonder you won.
zh: ~z~你他妈一放假就去和基佬打高尔夫，不赢才怪。

english: ~z~Oye, you a lifesaver, A. I mean literally.
zh: ~z~你这是救命恩人啊，A。字面意思的救命恩人。

zh: ~z~好的，兄弟。那就来吧。我两小时内来接你们。

zh: ~z~操，L。我没打过高尔夫都把你打得屁滚尿流。

zh: ~z~我不在乎我到底醉了没醉，反正都能让球进洞。

zh: ~z~要不要向我们介绍下你在大力神夜店的男朋友？

zh: ~z~这主意不错，A。你先溜达会儿，我马上过来。

english: ~z~Armando, what's up? You got some shit in that van of yours? I need to restock.
zh: ~z~阿曼多，你好吗？你车里有家伙吗？我要补点货。

zh: ~z~恩里克想和L玩一会儿，兄弟。咱们带他出去吧。

zh: ~z~要么去9号豪宅给咱介绍介绍你上流社会的朋友？

zh: ~z~好的，兄弟。H肯定闲着，我也能排出时间。来接咱们吧。

zh: ~z~城里人光芒不再了，嗯？好吧，两小时内来接你的老朋友吧。

english: ~z~Mando, sorry loco. But I can't hang with you no more. Tell H.
zh: ~z~阿曼多，不好意思啊。但我没法陪你们出去了。跟H说下吧。

english: ~z~Mira bro. I need something that's gonna help me win a fight. Can you come by in your van?
zh: ~z~听着兄弟，我需要能让我打胜仗的东西。你能开那辆车过来吗？

zh: ~z~下次又想装逼的时候，你记好了，咱们的水平可是不相上下的。

zh: ~z~身为恩里克的老板，我可以给他放会儿假。两小时内来接咱们吧。

zh: ~z~谢了，A。现在世道不太平，这会很有用的。有需要了我就找你。

zh: ~z~附近是不是有家吃得饱汉堡来着？你不会已经高贵到不吃这些垃圾了吧。

zh: ~z~真会挑时候。我和恩里克的日程刚好空着个大洞。两小时内来接我们吧。

zh: ~z~不了，哥们。H和我还是要赚钱的，兄弟。我们又不是你这种高端人士。

zh: ~z~恩里克肯定不相信我接到了你的电话，兄弟。他以为你已经死了。两小时内来接我们吧。

zh: ~z~我很想帮求助于我的朋友，但还有更重要的事需要我关注。过段时间我可能有空，到时候你再问我吧。

zh: ~z~你死了？我想不到别的理由能解释你抛弃朋友的行为了。能不能来帮我和恩里克回忆一下我们咋喜欢上你的？

zh: ~z~他绝对掏不出两百万，只能靠借。哪来的钱？

english: ~z~I just see you guys come and then disappear and the world keeps turning and the clubs keep running.
zh: ~z~我就看着你们来来去去，地球照转，夜店照开。

english: ~z~I guess we doing this. And thanks for the warning, T. really appreciated.
zh: ~z~看来必须动手了。多谢你提醒，T。非常感谢。

english: ~z~Shit, limos. I know I had a big night when there's one of these stupid things waiting.
zh: ~z~操，礼车。看见它我就知道昨晚玩得有多大了。

english: ~z~Yes, you are! And the last thing a club owner needs is to stop being fun.
zh: ~z~是，没错！夜店老板最不需要的就是停止作乐。

english: ~z~Please tell me this is over. I'll never look at a guy in leather in the same way.
zh: ~z~请告诉我完事了。我再也没法直视穿皮衣的人了。

english: ~z~Really? I mean, how much information are you privy to? You're just the fucking driver, after all.
zh: ~z~可以吗？我说，你配知道多少？就一开车的而已。

english: ~z~I, on the other hand, am the fucking idiot who keeps him alive and out of jail.
zh: ~z~我就不一样了，忙着帮他擦屁股保命，省得坐牢。

english: ~z~Fuck. Blow them up with these, Luis. I really don't want to die today.
zh: ~z~操。用这个炸飞他们，路易斯。我今天真不想死。

english: ~z~Thinking about becoming a partner in the club business, too. Tony needs all the help he can get.
zh: ~z~我还想当夜店生意的合伙人。托尼需要更多帮手。

english: ~z~You can get Tony fucked up like no one else can, Evan. That nice enough?
zh: ~z~你干翻托尼的本事无人能比，埃文。这样够不够？

english: ~z~Fraid not, Lou Lou. I got a hike as part of my getting back together deal.
zh: ~z~还真没有，卢･卢。涨零花钱是复合的条件之一。

english: ~z~I was looking forward to him upgrading. You know, to a newer, less annoying model.
zh: ~z~我还盼着他找个新欢呢。找个没那么烦人的模特。

english: ~z~I forgot about ordering these limos. Coke makes me real classy, don't it?
zh: ~z~我还雇了礼车吗？可卡因让我挥金如土啊，是吧？

english: ~z~I mean, he's always in such a mood when he sees you. Whinge. Whinge. Whinge.
zh: ~z~真的，见到你他就没好心情了。惨啊，惨啊，惨啊。

english: ~z~I'll go with the driver and try to rebuild my psyche. Luis, you take Evan.
zh: ~z~我坐司机的车，好好缓一缓。路易斯，你来载埃文。

english: ~z~I deserve that allowance hike and more! I should be on the payroll, just like you.
zh: ~z~我的零花钱可不是白涨的！就该像你一样有工资拿。

english: ~z~That what you thinking about, you piece of shit. Get out of my face. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~你就想着这些是吧，你这人渣。从我面前消失。再见。

english: ~z~I'll go with the driver, Lou. I need a bit of peace. Take Evan for me.
zh: ~z~我跟司机一块，卢。需要清净一会儿。你负责带埃文。

english: ~z~Jesus, the amount of time it takes to turn him back into the Gay Tony people pay to hang out with,
zh: ~z~天，费了多少工夫才把他变回那个人见人爱的基佬托尼，

english: ~z~Listen, Luis, no offense, but I don't know how much I'm allowed to tell you.
zh: ~z~听着，路易斯，无意冒犯，但我不知道能跟你透露多少。

english: ~z~You're fucking jealous, Luis. Pent up because you are not getting your hands on my man.
zh: ~z~你他妈就是嫉妒，路易斯。抢不到我的男友就只能抱怨。

english: ~z~Ughh, that attitude's not gonna get you anywhere, sweetie. You better say something nice to me.
zh: ~z~唉，这可不是求人办事的态度啊，宝贝。嘴要放甜一点。

english: ~z~His driver's getting far too far ahead of himself, huh. Delusions of adequacy, I suppose.
zh: ~z~他的司机太把自己当回事了，呵。自我意识过剩了属于是。

english: ~z~who's using Tony, and you only gonna be hanging around for two to three months, before Tony moves on to another chump.
zh: ~z~只想利用托尼。顶多再跳两三个月，托尼就会另寻新欢了。

english: ~z~Oh yeah, I forgot. You just snort the money, you don't know where it comes from.
zh: ~z~哦对，差点忘了。你不在乎钱的来头，能买到可卡因就行。

english: ~z~"We've got no money left. They're going to repossess everything. Ughh, my life is shit."
zh: ~z~「我们没钱了。这些都要被收走了。啊，我的人生完了。」

zh: ~z~是你让他彻夜狂欢，用药喂得他神经兮兮。他不需要这些。

english: ~z~It's just you and me left, Luis. Huh huh. Let's split it all - fifty fifty?
zh: ~z~就剩咱俩了，路易斯。 *抽泣* 把钱分了吧，五五开？

english: ~z~What's this? Why is the driver talking to me? Hello! I don't speak to the help.
zh: ~z~什么情况？车夫在跟我说话吗？听好！我不跟下人说话的。

english: ~z~No, Evan, they fuck up when you're involved. Now get out of my face. So long, asshole.
zh: ~z~不，埃文，有你在才会搞砸的。从我面前消失。再见，混蛋。

english: ~z~I've got to warn you Luis, I'm going to be very hands-on and you're not going to like all of my changes.
zh: ~z~我警告你，路易斯，到时候我事必躬亲，你不会喜欢那些变化的。

english: ~z~I'm also privy to the fact that you gonna be some fat trailer park queen back in the Midwest before you hit thirty.
zh: ~z~我更知道不到三十岁你就会流落中西部，活成拖车公园里的黄脸婆。

english: ~z~I ain't no downer, you fucking moron, I'm just trying to stop Tony from throwing his life and our business away.
zh: ~z~我才不是来扫兴的，蠢货。我是在阻止托尼搞砸自己的生活和事业。

english: ~z~I ain't jealous. I feel bad for you. If you weren't so damn creepy, I'd feel pity.
zh: ~z~我不是嫉妒，兄弟，是替你悲哀。要不是你太恶心，我还挺同情你的。

english: ~z~You see, Luis. This is why I need to play a bigger role in the organisation. Things fuck up when you're involved.
zh: ~z~你看吧，路易斯。所以才需要我来接手一切。你参与的事情总会搞砸。

english: ~z~Aww, sweet. Thank you, Luis. Tony is more fun when I'm around. What do you want to know?
zh: ~z~噢，过奖。谢谢你，路易斯。我在的时候托尼更开心。你想知道什么？

english: ~z~On, off, off, on. What can I say, that pathetic sack of shit needs me, and I need amusement.
zh: ~z~分，分，合，合。我能说啥，那可悲的窝囊废需要我，而我也需要乐子。

english: ~z~The money could be Rocco's, it could be Gracie's, who cares? We're getting some ice, baby.
zh: ~z~钱可能是罗科的，也可能是格雷西的，重要吗？我们要换的可是钻石，宝贝。

zh: ~z~哪一架，兄弟？有一整支机队呢。

zh: ~z~在博物馆帮你拿回钻石。记得不？

zh: ~z~钻石都在这了。这次再别弄丢了。

zh: ~z~你是赢不了的，我们都经过了训练。

~z~If I were you, I'd chase down some less heavily armed criminals.
zh: ~z~换做是我，就会去找好捏的柿子了。

zh: ~z~不知道你开的是什么，但请立刻降落。

zh: ~z~奇怪直升机里的家伙，请你立刻降落。

zh: ~z~兄弟，但你每晚都在这个位置站岗啊。

zh: ~z~秃鹰吗？没问题，兄弟。它也算是你的。

zh: ~z~哪个狗逼不想活命，就给我动一下试试！

~z~This chopper's a motherfucking get outta jail free card.

english: ~z~Lesson learned: the guy in the golden chopper ain't fucking around.
zh: ~z~一个教训：开金色直升机的人你们惹不起。

zh: ~z~谁能想到自己会被金闪闪的直升机打爆呢。

zh: ~z~我喜欢你弄的涂装。非常低调，便于偷袭。

zh: ~z~我知道，兄弟。我再帮你去弄一架吧。回见。

english: ~z~Yeah, man, I learnt the ancient art of understatement from you.
zh: ~z~是啊，老兄，跟你学的朴实无华的古老智慧。

english: ~z~I might not be able to hide in this gold monstrosity, but I can sure as shit fight.
zh: ~z~这架金色的怪兽虽然躲不了，但是打就能赢。

english: ~z~I thought we could go down there, put in a low ball bid and take them for ourselves, huh?
zh: ~z~我们可以过去蹲点，恶意压价把货带走，嗯？

english: ~z~When I stick my tongue in you, you've know you've been poisoned.
zh: ~z~舌头触碰到你的那一刻，你就知道自己中毒了。

zh: ~z~是，当然。就在备用可卡因旁边。再见了，T。

zh: ~z~你会喜欢我的改装的。她就在我西河的停机坪上。

zh: ~z~开着大金鹅肯定甩不掉他们，最好还是火力全开。

zh: ~z~还不错，兄弟。西河的停机坪上碰头。我很快就到。

zh: ~z~喂，尤瑟夫，现在没空聊天。直升机能借我用下吗？

zh: ~z~别吧，就一小会儿，哥。我真的需要你去跟托尼谈谈。

english: ~z~Oh, ha! A lot of people. A lot of people. And where the fuck is Gracie? Huh?
zh: ~z~噢，哈！一大堆人，一大堆人。格雷西他妈哪去了？嗯？

english: ~z~Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, since we're having a little show and tell let's see some money.
zh: ~z~喔，喔，喔，喔。要我们给你验货可以，先把钱拿出来。

english: ~z~Man, what went wrong? In my day, gay guys used to be lonely, needy and lost.
zh: ~z~天，怎么搞的？想当年，同性恋都还是孤独、缺爱又迷茫。

english: ~z~Shit, Yusuf, that's the thing. She don't fly no more. The Buzzard had an accident.
zh: ~z~妈的，尤瑟夫，问题就在这儿。飞不起来了。秃鹰坠落了。

english: ~z~I'm a cobra. I'm a cobra in the sky, flying with my cobra wings.
zh: ~z~我是眼镜蛇。我是会飞的眼镜蛇，张开眼镜蛇翅膀驰骋八方。

english: ~z~Those diamonds, I heard they're being sold soon. At the Libertonian, of all places.
zh: ~z~那些钻石，马上就要被转手了。自由城博物馆，在那儿交易。

english: ~z~Now they're all in relationships, learning how to cook. Man, therapy has got a lot to answer for, huh?
zh: ~z~现在，他们都有伴了，学会了调情。天，心理医生有得忙了，嗯？

english: ~z~Wait, wait, wait, wait listen...If you get me out of here, I promise I'll split this with you.
zh: ~z~等下，等下，等下。听着...带我活着出去，我保证把钻石分给你。

english: ~z~That's what I do, motherfucker. Sneak up on them bitches. Hide in the fucking sand, then pow!

english: ~z~I'm sure, and it sounds all like fantastic entertainment. Now, if you'll excuse me, I've got to get back down to earth.
zh: ~z~对对对，听上去就很有节目效果。那个，不介意的话，我要回归现实了。

english: ~z~No, no, no, no, man not that. Not that. Guess what? I'm going to be famous. Seriously.
zh: ~z~不不不不，哥们。不是这事，不是这事。想不到吧，我要出名了。真的。

english: ~z~Oh, we're getting rich here - look at this place - so many rich, happy queens spending their hard earned money, huh?

english: ~z~How are we going to get out of this, Tone?
zh: ~z~我们怎么解决这些事呢，托尼？

english: ~z~Okay, bro. Let's hope for the best.
~z~He's holding us responsible for the whole fucking mess.
zh: ~z~整件事他都怪罪到我们头上了。

english: ~z~Strangely enough, that's exactly what we need to be.
zh: ~z~不得不说，我们现在就需要暴富。

english: ~z~The heat would be on us as well, Lou.
zh: ~z~然而我们也要被全城追杀了，卢。

english: ~z~The place we're checking out is over in Cerveza Heights.
zh: ~z~我们要去的地方是塞尔维萨高地。

english: ~z~Don't doubt the imagination of a man on the brink.
zh: ~z~不要怀疑狗急跳墙的人的想象力。

english: ~z~He's got every reason to believe some of the most unpleasant cats on the Eastern Seaboard.
zh: ~z~完全有理由怀疑东海岸最难缠的家伙

english: ~z~Fuck, might just be heading down the block for a slice of pie.
zh: ~z~操，甚至只是去哪个区买水果派吃。

english: ~z~Aint we being held responsible for this shit anyway?
zh: ~z~我们不是横竖都要背上这口黑锅吗？

english: ~z~So let's hope he ain't as stupid as we've been lead to believe.
zh: ~z~只能希望他没有我们想的那么傻了。

english: ~z~"Self-indulgent cry for help", you mean.
zh: ~z~你的意思是「超大声地哭着求救」。

english: ~z~It's the diamonds, Lou. Rocco's had a word with him.
zh: ~z~是因为钻石，卢。罗科跟他汇报的。

english: ~z~Sir, yes, sir. Observe and report.
zh: ~z~好的，长官。仔细观察，小心汇报。

english: ~z~Okay, alright. But which way do you think he's heading?
zh: ~z~好吧，行。但你觉得他可能去哪儿？

english: ~z~Okay, bro. Where we looking for this girl then?
zh: ~z~好了，兄弟。我们一会儿去哪找她？

english: ~z~I can see he's going west. Where west?
zh: ~z~我看得到他在往西走。西边什么地方？

english: ~z~Okay. It's a shot in the dark, but it might work.
zh: ~z~好吧。跟摸瞎差不多，说不定就成了。

english: ~z~What? We've got to get her back, alright.
zh: ~z~什么？我们一定要救她回来的，好吧。

english: ~z~What he going back through the park for? He onto us?
zh: ~z~他怎么开回中央公园了？被他发现了？

english: ~z~Her old man said something interesting to me, by the way.
zh: ~z~她老爹还跟我说了一些有意思的东西。

english: ~z~Being tangentially blamed for an abduction I can just about handle.
zh: ~z~如果只是一个绑架，那我还能够摆平。

english: ~z~What do you mean? If we're going to get Gracie back?
zh: ~z~你什么意思？我们不是要去救格雷西吗？

english: ~z~Or she could be driving some son of a bitch kidnapper crazy.
zh: ~z~也可能她已经把那个王八蛋绑匪气疯了。

english: ~z~Yes. This is a purely selfish act. Are you happy now?
zh: ~z~是的，完全是出于自私。你现在高兴了？

english: ~z~He's cutting back on himself. I thought he was heading west.
zh: ~z~他怎么往回开了。我还以为他要去西边。

english: ~z~He ain't gonna think this chopper's got anything to do with him.
zh: ~z~他不会认为我们的直升机是冲着他来的。

english: ~z~Here's the Ancelotti chopper. Let's not screw it up as well.
zh: ~z~这就是安切洛蒂的直升机。别把它撞坏了。

english: ~z~He ain't trying to lose us, Tone. We're in a chopper.
zh: ~z~他别想甩掉我们，托尼。我们在直升机上。

english: ~z~I wouldn't wish that nasal whining voice on the worst guy out there.
zh: ~z~我可不想听她用那个哼唧哼唧的鼻音骂人。

english: ~z~Take us over to Cerveza Heights. Their house is over there.
zh: ~z~我们去塞尔维萨高地。他们的房子在那儿。

english: ~z~I wish I had your principles, genius.
zh: ~z~我倒是希望我能像你那么有原则，聪明鬼。

english: ~z~Oh, they'll "cap" her will they, Mr Streetwise Dangerous Motherfucker?
zh: ~z~噢，他们会「撕票」是吧，街头卧龙先生？

english: ~z~That? Oh yeah. I'm cool. Mellow.
zh: ~z~那个啊？噢，是的。我挺好的，自在得很。

english: ~z~We could start an outsourcing company. We'd be rich overnight.
zh: ~z~我们开个公司接这种活。一夜之间就能暴富。

english: ~z~You're the one who wants to start some armed offensive on the kidnappers of a mob skipper's daughter.
zh: ~z~是你说要跟绑架黑帮千金的犯人正面冲突的。

english: ~z~Nothing as stupid as ordering a hit on poor little Gracie Ancelotti.
zh: ~z~再蠢也蠢不过袭击可怜的格雷西･安切洛蒂。

english: ~z~You should have shared your anti-anxiety pills with the Celebinator.
zh: ~z~当时你咋不给名人终结者分两粒抗焦虑药啊。

english: ~z~Gracie's got my backing over some chump hood from Dukes.
zh: ~z~有我从公爵区的三脚猫暴徒手里保护格雷西。

english: ~z~What do you think we're doing on this outing? We're looking for Gracie.
zh: ~z~那你觉得我们出来干什么？我们要去找格雷西。

english: ~z~I dont know, you did just point a gun at me. You nearly just shot yourself.
zh: ~z~不知道，你刚才还拿枪指我。还差点开枪自杀。

english: ~z~What's the first thing they're gonna do? You've seen the movies. They'll cap her.
zh: ~z~他们会怎么做？你看过电影的，当然是撕票了。

english: ~z~I don't know. I'm sorry. I'm stressed alright.
zh: ~z~我也不知道。对不起。我现在压力很大，好吧？

english: ~z~Is he going faster. I think he's going faster. He's trying to lose us.
zh: ~z~他是在加速吗？他好像在加速。他想甩掉我们。

english: ~z~You got any ideas where we might start doing that? It's a big city, Tone.
zh: ~z~想好从里哪开始找了吗？自由城很大的，托尼。

english: ~z~I don't know where he's going, you idiot. That's why we're following him.
zh: ~z~我哪知道他去哪，你个傻瓜。所以我们才跟着他。

english: ~z~You'll see him stopping too, bro. You ain't going to sleep on me are you.
zh: ~z~你也能看到他停车啊，兄弟。你不会是想睡觉吧？

english: ~z~I may be semi-suicidal, but I'm not completely stupid, Luis.
zh: ~z~我是有点自杀倾向，但是我还没那么傻，路易斯。

english: ~z~Good. Because we're going to need to really hold shit together for a while if we want to survive this shit.
zh: ~z~很好。如果我们还想活命，接下来最好团结起来。

english: ~z~You could marry a billionairess. That might get us out of our problems.
zh: ~z~要么你去傍个富婆，这样我们的问题就都解决了。

english: ~z~I think that's their car, Lou. The red one. Let's follow it.
zh: ~z~应该就是那辆车，卢。红色的那辆。咱们跟上去。

english: ~z~You'll throw a guy out a chopper but you won't go for a ride in one?
zh: ~z~你能把人从直升机上扔下去，自己却不敢坐飞机？

english: ~z~Well, now he's heading east. We won't lose him, man. We're cool.
zh: ~z~现在他往东边去了。我们不会跟丢的，没问题的。

english: ~z~We just got to follow them. See if they take us anywhere interesting.
zh: ~z~我们要跟踪他们。看看会不会找到什么有趣的地方。

english: ~z~Of course I'm calm. I'm really calm. Why wouldn't I be calm?
zh: ~z~我当然很冷静。我超冷静的。有什么理由不冷静吗？

english: ~z~I don't know. We could play the lottery, start a little ponzi scheme,
zh: ~z~我不知道啊。我们可以去买彩票、搞一个庞氏骗局、

english: ~z~Who knows what they could have done to that girl? She could be dead at the bottom of the West River now.
zh: ~z~谁知道他们会对她做什么？没准她已经被沉尸西河了。

english: ~z~Don't fuck with the Tony Prince empire baby. That's what's up!
zh: ~z~别和托尼･普林斯帝国做对，宝贝。那就是你的下场！

english: ~z~So, this isn't about Gracie, it's about saving our own asses?
zh: ~z~所以，这不是为了格雷西，而是为了救我们自己的小命？

english: ~z~He's blaming us for this whole thing. Either we get her back or we're dead.
zh: ~z~他认为这件事我们全责。救不回他女儿，我们就没命了。

english: ~z~Fair point. I'll get a post-it note for the next time. "Disengage before suicide attempt."
zh: ~z~有道理。下次我就先贴个便签：「自杀之前解除保险」。

english: ~z~This is Liberty City man. There must be twenty helicopters in this airspace at any given time.
zh: ~z~这可是自由城啊。随时都有二十多架直升机在天上盘旋。

english: ~z~If we could throw every fucking blogger out a chopper, bro. Keep them fools in line.
zh: ~z~真想把这些臭写博客的都扔下去，兄弟。让他们不乱说话。

english: ~z~She gets a coup de grace after some half-cocked rescue attempt, and we're well and truly assfucked.
zh: ~z~万一她因为你个莽夫而一命呜呼，我们就等着菊花盛开吧。

english: ~z~Shit. Okay. Okay. I take your point. If you see him stopping let me know.
zh: ~z~操，好吧，好吧。你说的都对。他停下来了你跟我说一声。

english: ~z~Then he's probably going to see us, isn't he? The first thing a paranoid man looks for is a chopper.
zh: ~z~那不就要被他发现了吗？多疑的人肯定会注意到直升机的。

english: ~z~And not in a good way - prison style! Not gang-bang with a boy band style.
zh: ~z~而且会很粗暴，监狱里那种！不是和男子乐队开淫趴那种。

english: ~z~We should go and get the Ancelottis' chopper. It's just on the other side of the Booth Tunnel.
zh: ~z~我们去开安切洛蒂家族的直升机。它在布斯隧道的另一边。

english: ~z~That's definitely interesting. How the fuck did he get that in his head? I barely know the girl.
zh: ~z~那还挺有意思的。他他妈是怎么想的？我跟他女儿又不熟。

english: ~z~All this shit piling down on top of us. How are we going to get out? Have we got a plan?
zh: ~z~压在我们头上的这么多破事。要怎么解决？有什么计划吗？

english: ~z~You'd think you'd know enough with all the shit we been in to take the safety off a gun before you use it.
zh: ~z~经历了这么多你觉得你行了，结果开枪之前还是上着保险？

english: ~z~We've been in enough shit recently for me to carry something a little bit more dangerous than a prop gun.
zh: ~z~最近经历了这么多事，总得带点比道具枪有用的真家伙吧。

english: ~z~Oh yeah, I've already been pimped off once, T, and I nearly got killed because of it.
zh: ~z~是吗，上次你就让我出卖色相了，T。我差点还因此出事。

english: ~z~What about that fucking greasy cabrone Rocco? he should be taking the shit for this, it aint us T.
zh: ~z~那那个臭傻逼罗科呢？他才该背上这口大锅，不是我们，T。

english: ~z~My pleasure. Now no hero shit, Lou. Promise me. This is just a reconnaissance mission.
zh: ~z~不客气。现在不要逞英雄，卢。答应我。这只是个侦察行动。

english: ~z~Who cares about us? Gracie's safety has got to be our priority; she's an innocent.
zh: ~z~谁在乎我们啊？格雷西的安全是我们的首要任务。她是无辜的。

english: ~z~He might not be going west at all, might be heading over to the East Borough Bridge so he can get himself up to Bohan.
zh: ~z~也可能根本不是西边，说不定是去东区大桥，要去的地方在波汉。

english: ~z~No. I don't actually. I didn't even take an anti-anxiety and you know how I feel about flying.
zh: ~z~没，我真没带。我连抗焦虑药都没带，你也知道我坐飞机很慌的。

english: ~z~The diamonds. He says it's got something to do with the diamonds and Gracie hanging out with us.
zh: ~z~那些钻石。他说事情和钻石有关，而且格雷西经常和我们一块出去。

english: ~z~Even after half a nostril full of blow I'm hearing rotor blades and squinting at the sky.
zh: ~z~就算是吸了一鼻子白粉，我也能听到螺旋桨的声音，然后抬头看天。

english: ~z~The Ancelottis said I should use their chopper. It's at the heliport on top of the entrance of the Booth Tunnel.
zh: ~z~安切洛蒂家族的人让我们用直升机，就停在布斯隧道出口的正上方。

english: ~z~buy some cheap diamonds and try to sell them on at a profit. Oh wait, we've tried that and it's not going so well.
zh: ~z~买点便宜钻石去投机倒把。噢，等下，钻石买过了，结果不太顺利。

english: ~z~I'm serious Lou, most of the girls in this city have fallen in love with you at least once, how come you can't manage to find a rich one.
zh: ~z~我认真的，卢。城里有几个姑娘没被你迷住过，怎么会找不到富婆呢？

english: ~z~If he thinks he's paranoid now, it's nothing in comparison to the heat he'd feel if you ordered the death of a bosses girl.
zh: ~z~如果他是个多疑的人，那什么威胁都比不上绑架黑道千金而被全城追杀。

english: ~z~She comes back with ten fingers, ten toes, a smile on her face and a curse on her lips then we'll be fine.
zh: ~z~只要她没有缺胳膊少腿，活着回来还能骂上两句脏话，我们就不会有事。

english: ~z~are about to knock down his door and rip out his tongue. If he ain't fucking paranoid then he's fucking stupid.
zh: ~z~会冲进他的家门，割掉他的舌头。这都不怀疑一下，那他就是脑子进水了。

english: ~z~Yeah, strangely I am. Now that I've realized I'm being blackmailed into doing this, it's become a lot clearer.
zh: ~z~是，这样是高兴了。现在我知道自己是被逼着做这种事的，一下子清楚多了。

english: ~z~Okay, bro. He might suspect we're chasing him. Let's hope he starts panicking and does something stupid.
zh: ~z~好吧，兄弟。他可能会怀疑我们在追他。希望他已经慌了，然后再干点蠢事吧。

english: ~z~Okay. I need your help, Luis. You're all I've got left. You happy now? I said it.
zh: ~z~好吧。我需要你的帮助，路易斯。你是我所剩的一切了。满意了吧？我承认了。

english: ~z~There's a lot of shit west of Dukes. Could be Algonquin. Could head all the way over to Alderney.
zh: ~z~公爵区西边的东西可太多了。也许是阿尔冈琴，也没准他一路开到了奥尔德尼。

english: ~z~Okay. So we head over there and do what? Land on the roof and ask them where they got Gracie?
zh: ~z~好吧。那我们去了以后干什么？降落到屋顶，然后问他们格雷西被关在哪儿了？

english: ~z~So, T, hypothetically, what would happen if we did find Gracie? We going to storm in there and make these kidnappers pay?
zh: ~z~那个，T，问个问题，找到格雷西以后要干什么？直接冲进去，教训一顿绑匪吗？

english: ~z~You ain't even semi-suicidal, T. You're just over-dramatic. I wouldn't be surprised if that gun was just a movie prop.
zh: ~z~你都不是有自杀倾向，T。你是太过浮夸了。你说刚才那把枪是电影道具我都信。

english: ~z~At least you'll have a nice message on your gravestone. Mine will just say "Here lies unpopular fag."
zh: ~z~至少你的墓碑上还能写得漂亮点。我的可能只有一句「讨人厌的死基佬安眠于此」。

english: ~z~We got debts, who knows how many people want us dead. At some point we're gonna have to start getting selfish...
zh: ~z~我们欠了债，谁知道有多少人想让我们死。某种意义上，我们必须要自私一点...

english: ~z~An innocent? Come on T. Her dad's one of the biggest mobsters in the city. He runs a family, can't he handle this?
zh: ~z~无辜？别傻了，T。她老爸是全城最大的黑帮头子之一，搞黑道家族的，摆平不了吗？

english: ~z~There are some punks in Dukes that might have a link to this thing. We're going to follow them and see if they lead us to our girl.
zh: ~z~有几个在公爵区的逼崽子可能和绑架有关。我们要跟踪他们，看看能不能找到格雷西。

english: ~z~All I'm saying is there are bigger problems we got to deal with. If Gracie came back tomorrow, we'd still be looking down the gun.
zh: ~z~总而言之，我们还有更大的问题要解决。就算格雷西明天回来了，我们的危机依然存在。

english: ~z~I wasn't talking about that. I mean, I really want to get Gracie back, but at the end of the day that ain't our main problem.
zh: ~z~我说的不是这个。我是说，我也想把格雷西救回来，但是说到底，那不是我们的主要问题。

english: ~z~There's some lowlifes in Dukes who might be involved. Losers even by current mob standards, which is saying something.
zh: ~z~这事可能和公爵区那边的穷鬼有关系。几个以黑帮标准都算失败的穷鬼，这就能说明问题了。

english: ~z~Okay.
~z~What's that mean?
~z~Damn. Go away.
~z~This is totally killing my vibe.
~z~Get out my way.
~z~Leave us alone!
~z~You can't see me.
~z~No problem, boss.
~z~Whatever, bro.
~z~The big guy's back there.
~z~I am not going to prison.
~z~Don't hang around. Move it!
~z~We're business partners.
~z~If that's what you say was going on, that's what was going on.
~z~I'm starting to feel nauseous here.
~z~I'm coming through, motherfucker.
~z~Oye, I think we're in the clear.
~z~We lost those photographers, man.
~z~This my club. Move out the way.
~z~Sensitive, but not too sensitive?
~z~Chill out, bro. I'm doing my best.
~z~I'm here to save your ass, Clay. Open up.
~z~I work for Tony, man. Let me in.
~z~Tell Clay I love that new joint.
~z~I'm not who you think I am!
~z~You want them to take a picture? Go!
~z~You got the touch, boss. We'll see you another time.
~z~Boring. When is this going to be over?
~z~This is a long way from chilled, Clayton.
~z~Hope Hercules is cool, boss.
~z~Seems the Pain Giver needs a fast extraction.
~z~So, you and Tony are friends, huh?
~z~Your loss. These kicks are the shit, man.
~z~Coño. I knew I shouldn't have gone on that run, bro.
zh: ~z~妈的，我就知道不该跑这趟的。

english: ~z~Move it, man. They're gonna snap us.
~z~Too bad about your car, PG. That's fucked up.
~z~Lose these paparrazzi pricks, will you?
zh: ~z~甩掉这帮狗仔队的傻逼，好吗？

english: ~z~I don't wanna be no cover boy. Fucking hustle.
zh: ~z~我可不想上头条。你他妈快点。

english: ~z~Captain Hetero's having himself some good clean fun, boss.
zh: ~z~异性恋大佬玩的很正常，老板。

english: ~z~You got the magic touch, boss. Come back to Maisonette.
zh: ~z~你真行啊，老板。回豪宅这来吧。

english: ~z~I'll leave you two to it. That ain't really my scene.
zh: ~z~你们二位自己留着吧，我就算了。

english: ~z~I hope it's nothing serious, boss. You take care.
zh: ~z~希望没出大事，老板。你多保重。

english: ~z~Shit, L. Okay. I'll get on damage control.
~z~We ain't posing for the weeklies. Get us out of here.
zh: ~z~现在没在做写真模特。快点走啊。

english: ~z~You gonna rap about this shit, man?
zh: ~z~你要不要写首歌说说这事，哥们？

english: ~z~Fuck it! Streets ain't nothing nice, homie.
zh: ~z~操了！街头可没那么好混啊，伙计。

english: ~z~Clayton, you have got enough money. Get us out of this.
zh: ~z~科雷顿，你钱拿够了。带我们走吧。

english: ~z~I doubt that, but whatever man.
zh: ~z~我不太相信，但是无所谓了，哥们。

english: ~z~Damn! Poor bastard. I'll see what I can do.
zh: ~z~妈的！真惨啊。我看看我能干点啥。

english: ~z~What is it, bro? Can't Troy handle this?
zh: ~z~怎么回事，兄弟？特洛伊处理不了吗？

english: ~z~This thing ain't happening, D . We ran into an issue.
zh: ~z~事情解决不了了，D。这里出问题了。

english: ~z~You fine, bro. I'm getting you out of there.
zh: ~z~没事的，兄弟。我会帮你甩掉他们的。

english: ~z~Okay, bro. If that's what makes you comfortable. Sure you haven't.
zh: ~z~好吧，兄弟。你高兴就好。当然没去过。

english: ~z~Things ain't exactly gone to plan here, Dess. You know what I mean?
zh: ~z~这边事情不太顺利，德西。懂我意思吧？

english: ~z~Yo valet, this the Pain Giver's car. Look after it.
zh: ~z~哟，服务员，这可是PG的车，小心点。

english: ~z~Dump these motherfucking paps! They always misconstrue things!

zh: ~z~搞什么啊，阿尔？没有帮你拿货的助理吗？

english: ~z~Okay, boss. Anyone asks, I ain't seen you.
zh: ~z~好的，老板。有人问起来我就说没见过你。

english: ~z~I'm a nominee. Al Di Napoli is somebody.
zh: ~z~我是候选人。阿尔･迪纳波利是个大人物。

english: ~z~I've walked that road. Al Di Napoli knows pain.
zh: ~z~我也是这样的。阿尔･迪纳波利懂你的难处。

english: ~z~Who you take me for, L? Bruce Spade or someone?
zh: ~z~你以为我谁啊，L？布鲁斯･斯佩德还是谁？

english: ~z~What the producers gonna think if you get arrested on a school night?
zh: ~z~要是你在工作前一天被捕，制片人会怎么想？

english: ~z~Yo, I'm getting some crank off an asshole up here. Can you help me out?
zh: ~z~哟，我跟人约好在这儿取货。你能帮帮我吗？

english: ~z~That we do. What was it, boss? Crisis of sexuality?
zh: ~z~你回来吧。都干啥了，老板？遇到性危机了？

english: ~z~No, I'm joking. You look okay... just about.
zh: ~z~没，我开玩笑的。你看起来还好...挺好的。

english: ~z~Nah, bro. Of course I ain't. I'm implying that you fall into both.
zh: ~z~啊，兄弟。当然没有了。我是说你两个都占了。

english: ~z~Don't run on my account, L. I can handle some time on the inside.
zh: ~z~没必要带我逃跑，L。我不介意蹲几年牢房的。

english: ~z~I don't need looking after, bro. I'm just here to get fucked up with the homos.
zh: ~z~没必要关照我，兄弟。我就是来跟男同喝酒的。

english: ~z~I went for tax reasons and stayed for my sanity.
zh: ~z~我因为税务原因过去的，在那儿还能保持清醒。

english: ~z~You a characterful dude, Al. You don't need to do that to your face.
zh: ~z~你这人很有特色，阿尔。没必要在脸上动刀子。

english: ~z~When's the last time you were alowed to buy poppers and a beer at 9am?
zh: ~z~上次能白天九点出来买毒品和酒是多久以前了？

english: ~z~I don't know what he's doing. But he wants you to be doing it with him.
zh: ~z~我也不知道他来干啥，但他就是叫你过去找他。

english: ~z~Come on, brother. I wouldn't be here if I had self-restraint.
zh: ~z~得了吧，兄弟。我要是有自制力就不会有今天。

english: ~z~It's true. Well, was true, at least. I don't take it too serious now.
zh: ~z~是有这事。打过一段时间。现在不那么上心了。

english: ~z~Don't worry, man. I'll take the heat for this if we go down. You won't see any of it.
zh: ~z~没事，哥们。被抓了我来担责。保证把你撇干净。

english: ~z~Yeah, well... I was, but we had these two Italian dudes in our class.
zh: ~z~对，呃...确实是，但我们班有两个意大利人。

english: ~z~Sanity, bro? I'd hate to think what you'd be like somewhere else.
zh: ~z~保持清醒，兄弟？很难想象你在其他地方的情况。

english: ~z~No, man, a crisis of just about everything else. I'll tell you about it some other time. Guy is deranged.
zh: ~z~不是，是别的危机。改天再告诉你吧，这人疯了。

english: ~z~You start doing weird shit when you get old, bro. Real weird shit.
zh: ~z~年纪大了就会做一些奇怪的事，兄弟。真的很怪。

english: ~z~Hey bro, things got weird on that thing I was dealing with. I'm gonna lay low for a while.
zh: ~z~嘿兄弟。这次的事不太对劲。我要避会儿风头了。

english: ~z~Lopez! What you doing here, bitch? I thought you was out the game.
zh: ~z~洛佩兹！你这逼咋在这儿呢？你不是洗手不干了吗。

english: ~z~What you doing in here, bro? I didn't think this was your scene.
zh: ~z~你在大力神干啥呢，兄弟？这不是你会来的地方吧。

english: ~z~Bro, when are you and Tony gonna expand the operation to Vice? We need you down there.
zh: ~z~兄弟，你跟托尼啥时候到罪城开店？那里需要你们。

english: ~z~We having enough trouble maintaining the operation here, Al. I don't think we ready to expand things.
zh: ~z~现在保住自由城的店都够呛，阿尔。不太可能开新店。

english: ~z~That's real nice of you, Al, but my priors are gonna give these guys plenty of shit to throw at me.
zh: ~z~你真好，阿尔。但我有前科，条子不会轻易放过我的。

english: ~z~Blood suckin' cocksuckers and their eight shows a week. Slaves work less than me.
zh: ~z~不当人的吸血鬼，一周要演八场戏。我比奴隶还辛苦。

english: ~z~Think of this as research, bro. You can use this the next time you play a criminal.
zh: ~z~今天就当是采风了，兄弟。作为以后扮演罪犯的经验。

english: ~z~Thank you very much, my brother. There's a comp on the door whenever you want it.
zh: ~z~太谢谢你了，好兄弟。给你张入场券，随时可以来看。

english: ~z~I'd heard you were over here doing a play or something? We thought we might see you at Maisonette.
zh: ~z~听说你是来自由城演戏的？我还以为你会来9号豪宅。

english: ~z~None of the Los Santos bullshit, or the Liberty neuroses. It's fucking pure.
zh: ~z~没洛圣都那么扯淡，也没自由城这么神经。巨他妈纯。

english: ~z~I'm sorry, bro. Theater ain't usually my thing. This play any good?
zh: ~z~不好意思，兄弟。我不怎么去剧院的。这场戏好看吗？

english: ~z~Yo, D. Shit kinda fucked up here, man. Can you cover for me?
zh: ~z~哟，D。事情有点搞砸了，哥们。你能帮我瞒过去吗？

english: ~z~Sweet. Take me to the Amdram, bro? I got people to entertain.
zh: ~z~好哇。带我去阿姆德拉姆剧院吧，兄弟。观众等着我呢。

english: ~z~I'd be a fucking train wreck, bro. Vice is the only city in the US worth sticking in.
zh: ~z~我就是个废物，兄弟。罪城是美国唯一值得去的城市了。

english: ~z~What the fuck do you know, man? That shit is hard. And no one said nothing about meth. Fuck you.
zh: ~z~你他妈懂个屁？这可难了。谁跟你提吸毒了。操你妈的。

english: ~z~Sometimes it keeps me up at night thinking about them bloody faces, and broken bones I caused.
zh: ~z~想到对手血淋淋的脸和被我打断的骨头，我就睡不好觉。

english: ~z~Shit boss, I take it things didn't go too good. Go chill out. We'll talk soon.
zh: ~z~妈的，老板，这事不对劲啊。最近避避风头，咱晚点聊。

english: ~z~It's all part of the passage of life, my brother. You'll see. It's kind of beautiful.
zh: ~z~这都是人生的一部分，好兄弟。你会懂的。也是一种美。

english: ~z~Fucking she-males to see what it feels like, taking apart hotel room TVs to see where pay-per-view comes from,
zh: ~z~出于好奇去操人妖，拆开酒店的电视研究收费节目的原理，

english: ~z~I'm on the path, motherfucker. And Al Di Napoli will beat the monkey off his back.
zh: ~z~我都在路上了，操你妈的。阿尔･迪纳波利会摆脱困境的。

english: ~z~Yeah, but they're a lot more honest about their drug habits. And the motherfucker don't close!
zh: ~z~是有，但他们对自己的吸毒史就实诚多了。他们还不躲藏！

english: ~z~Fuck the producers, man. They can stick my "scale" paycheck up their asses.
zh: ~z~操他妈的制片人。他们可以把我的底薪支票贴自己屁股上。

english: ~z~The days of assistants are long gone for me. I'm a fighter, man. I'll die on the streets.
zh: ~z~我早没有助理了。我现在是战士，哥们。死也要死在街头。

english: ~z~Shit. There was a time police wouldn't go above Topaz Street. What's happened to LC?
zh: ~z~妈的，当年警察不会来托佩斯街以北的啊。自由城怎么了？

english: ~z~You should tell me if you coming down to Herc, bro. I could have you looked after.
zh: ~z~你来大力神咋不跟我说一声呢，兄弟。我还能过来关照你。

english: ~z~Boss, you mind heading over to Hercules? Al Di Napoli is asking for you specifically.
zh: ~z~老板，介意跑一趟大力神吗？阿尔･迪纳波利点名叫你过去。

english: ~z~Then fuck it. I ain't ever gonna come back to this town. I don't care what my agent promises me.
zh: ~z~滚他妈的。我也不会回来了，也不在乎经纪人跟我保证啥了。

english: ~z~Shit, man. I thought this work was subtle - I paid for the "natural look".
zh: ~z~妈的，哥们。我藏得不够深吗？专门花钱做的「自然造型」。

english: ~z~I do my best work when I'm three days into a bender. You don't wanna see this shit sober. Believe me.
zh: ~z~大了以后再上台效果才好。清醒了反而演得没意思，相信我。

english: ~z~fisting yourself, dammit. Al's done his time in Hotel Batshit Crazy.
zh: ~z~甚至给自己一拳，妈的。阿尔一直都是这种疯疯癫癫的状态。

english: ~z~Gimme a gun, bro. I wanna pop some of these motherfuckers. I've done it in lots of films.
zh: ~z~给我把枪，兄弟。我一枪一个傻逼条子。电影里我经常这么干。

english: ~z~People paid a hundred dollars to see me, they gonna be pissed if I pass out on stage.
zh: ~z~大家花一百块钱看我演出，我要是上台就晕了，他们会生气的。

english: ~z~I can't tell no more what's true and what stuff I made up in my head. Man, I am fried right now.
zh: ~z~我已经分不清哪些是真的，哪些是臆想的了。天哪，我要炸了。

english: ~z~you go to a doctor and tell him you'll pay him anything to make you look like you did two decades ago.
zh: ~z~你还会去找医生，让他把你整成年轻二十岁的脸，多少钱都行。

english: ~z~One of them's a Police Chief, and the other guy did time for tax evasion. I was lucky to get out.
zh: ~z~其中一个当了警长，另一个因为逃税去蹲监狱了。我运气还不错。

english: ~z~Five years at the top of my game - any girl, any guy, any cat, any dog, all the drugs I could take.
zh: ~z~我在业内风光了五年，妹子、兄弟、阿猫、阿狗，还有各种毒品。

english: ~z~That what I look like? Motherfucker! I'm gonna kill that doctor when I see him next.
zh: ~z~我看起来是那样的吗？操你妈的！下次再见到这医生我就杀了他。

english: ~z~No offence, L, but that place ain't my scene no more. Fucking stuck up pieces of shit in there.
zh: ~z~恕我直言，L，但我已经厌倦豪宅了。净是些自以为是的臭傻逼。

english: ~z~Your chances of lasting a round in the cage after a week long meth binge are slim to none. Stick to acting.
zh: ~z~嗑药嗨上一周之后，你都没机会跟别人斗上一回合。老实当演员吧。

english: ~z~Thanks a lot, bro. I'll call you in a few days in advance so you can sober up for the performance.
zh: ~z~那多谢了，兄弟。过几天我提前给你打电话，好让你清醒下准备演出。

english: ~z~It ain't the first time I've run from the cops, L. Fuckers been on me forever. Watching me sleep and stuff.
zh: ~z~我也不是头一次被条子追了，L。条子一直都盯着我，睡觉都要监视。

english: ~z~Yeah. It's a good thing that mixed arts martial shit wasn't popular in my time. I woulda gone pro, man. I woulda.
zh: ~z~对。还好我那个时候不流行综合格斗。否则我就是职业选手了，职业的。

english: ~z~You're the motherfuckers who keep the club open 24. What's a man meant to do if he don't get kicked out a place?
zh: ~z~你们夜店24小时不打烊怪我喽。不把我赶出来，我不待在店里还去哪？

english: ~z~So am I. But Al Di Napoli he's a street fighter. That's his thing. Fighting the streets.
zh: ~z~我也觉得。但阿尔･迪纳波利是个街头战士。在街头战斗，那是他的事业。

english: ~z~I feel you, bro. The Italian kids I grew up with became cops or ended up in the big house.
zh: ~z~我懂你，兄弟。和我一起长大的意大利孩子不是成了警察就是住上了大别墅。

english: ~z~Everyone gotta do this shit now. First step on the comeback road. Make the motherfuckers think you serious.
zh: ~z~也是不得已而为之啊。这是复出之路的第一步，必须让大家看见你是认真的。

english: ~z~Day before the day before yesterday I was banging some girl then I'm here and, shit, I don't know.
zh: ~z~大前天我跟哪个姑娘干了一炮，然后去了夜店，然后...妈的，不记得了。

english: ~z~They don't get special treatment, I don't want it neither. Man of the fucking people. That's Al Di Napoli for you.
zh: ~z~他们没有特殊待遇，我也不想要。与大众打成一片。这就是我阿尔･迪纳波利。

english: ~z~No, I ain't got the "hook up". I grew up round here and it's a small place. You tend to know some bad dudes.
zh: ~z~没，有啥「往来」啊。我就在这长大的，大家都是邻居。认识些坏人在所难免。

english: ~z~Oscar Gomez! That you, motherfucker? Shit, bro, I'd love to stay and catch up, but we need to pick up and go.
zh: ~z~奥斯卡･戈麦斯！是你啊，你妈逼的？妈的，兄弟，我也想跟你多聊几句，但咱得赶紧拿货走人。

english: ~z~This is more like it.
~z~Sure it will.
~z~I can't look!
~z~Okay. Okay.
~z~I'm freaking out!
~z~That's better.
~z~Chill out with the height.
~z~I'm going to faint.
~z~No problem, boss.
~z~Fuck off, D.
~z~Isn't this more comfortable?
~z~Chill out, bro.
~z~Help me! Help me!
~z~So much better, thank you.
~z~Freaking out ain't gonna help nothing.
~z~Don't annoy the pilot, bro.
~z~Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!
~z~We're gonna be there soon, man.
~z~Just shut up and we'll get there.
~z~Here we are. Enjoy your night.
~z~You in good hands. It's cool.
~z~It's been a real pleasure to meet you, pal.
~z~Utilize completeness and all that stuff.
~z~We're too high, I'm feeling somewhat uncomfortable.
~z~Go lower! That's an order, pal.
~z~I've been working on a credit card commercial.
~z~We're going to die. We're going to crash and die.
~z~This is not cool. Not cool at all.
~z~I really love what Tony's done at Maisonette.
~z~It ain't that much further, Mr. Spade.
~z~and integrity. A lot of integrity.
~z~So you're making commercials, but you're not selling out?
~z~Ignore the others and find meaning.
~z~Bruce Spade demands to be taken down.
~z~Coño. I knew I shouldn't have gone on that run, bro.
zh: ~z~妈的，我就知道不该跑这趟的。

english: ~z~You're pushing it now. I cannot be this far off the ground.
zh: ~z~这样太过了。这么高我不行的。

english: ~z~Can you please lower your altitude. I'm getting a little dizzy.
zh: ~z~能不能降点高度。我有点晕了。

english: ~z~I knew they'd come around and bite me in the ass one day.
zh: ~z~就知道这张驾驶证不是白拿的。

english: ~z~It's actually safer to be up away from things we could hit.
zh: ~z~飞高点撞不到东西反而更安全。

english: ~z~Fuck D, why can't we just send a driver?
~z~I hope it's nothing serious, boss. You take care.
zh: ~z~希望没出大事，老板。你多保重。

english: ~z~Shit, L. Okay. I'll get on damage control.
~z~If you got a problem with heights, don't worry, I'll stay close to the ground.
zh: ~z~没事，你要真的恐高，我就飞低点。

english: ~z~And he said that you were the only one he got flying lessons for.
zh: ~z~而且他说学过开飞机的就你一个人。

english: ~z~Maybe you should campaign for stricter regulation, bro.
zh: ~z~那你去争取更严格的监管吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~Yo, I'm sure the shingle is the answer to all their problems.
zh: ~z~哟，你的理想国一定能解决所有问题。

english: ~z~I never asked for a helicopter. I seriously cannot abide heights.
zh: ~z~我没说要直升机接送啊。我非常恐高。

english: ~z~but I'm so busy with peace in the Middle East, and world hunger.
zh: ~z~但我忙着关注中东和平以及世界饥饿。

english: ~z~This thing ain't happening, D . We ran into an issue.
zh: ~z~事情解决不了了，D。这里出问题了。

english: ~z~Exactly. Not at all. It's all about the work and the art,
zh: ~z~对。这有啥，都是为了工作和艺术嘛，

english: ~z~If we all keep doing our part, the world's gonna become a better place.
zh: ~z~要是人人都出一份力，世界将会更美好。

english: ~z~This wasn't the deal. I thought you were flying low.
zh: ~z~跟说好的不一样啊。你不是要飞低点吗。

english: ~z~Things ain't exactly gone to plan here, Dess. You know what I mean?
zh: ~z~这边事情不太顺利，德西。懂我意思吧？

english: ~z~Okay, boss. Anyone asks, I ain't seen you.
zh: ~z~好的，老板。有人问起来我就说没见过你。

english: ~z~I cannot abide heights, I told you that. You're going to have to take this thing down a bit.
zh: ~z~我都说了我恐高的。麻烦你把直升机飞低点。

english: ~z~Be careful, man. He's the biggest movie star in the country.
zh: ~z~注意点，哥们。他可是最有排面的国民影星。

english: ~z~Man, people just need faith. Not be normal cynics.
zh: ~z~天哪，大家都要有信仰，不应该那么自私的。

english: ~z~Yo! Mr. Spade. I'm from Maisonette 9. Jump in.
zh: ~z~哟！斯佩德先生，我是9号豪宅的人，上来吧。

english: ~z~You mind my asking what you doing up in the middle of nowhere?
zh: ~z~介意我问一下你在这鸟不拉屎的空地上干嘛吗？

english: ~z~Maisonette's a total oasis from the camera's glare. Shelter from the media maelstrom.
zh: ~z~豪宅是远离闪光灯的净土，媒体漩涡外的庇护所。

english: ~z~Hey bro, things got weird on that thing I was dealing with. I'm gonna lay low for a while.
zh: ~z~嘿兄弟。这次的事不太对劲。我要避会儿风头了。

english: ~z~Tony wants to send the helicopter 'cause Spade's such a big shot.
zh: ~z~托尼想派直升机去接，因为他觉得斯佩德够大牌。

english: ~z~That's fine. I'm sure that's great. I really care about the environment. It's my passion.
zh: ~z~那就好。那没事了。我很注重环保的，志向所在。

english: ~z~Mr. Spade, I'm here to take you to Maisonette 9. Get in!
zh: ~z~斯佩德先生，我是来接你去9号豪宅的。上来吧！

english: ~z~There's so much crime here in Liberty City. I really wish I had more time to raise awareness,
zh: ~z~自由城的犯罪率太高了。我真想找时间劝勉大家，

english: ~z~Mr. Spade. It's a great honor to have you here. Enjoy your night.
zh: ~z~斯佩德先生，很高兴您能来。祝您晚上玩得开心。

english: ~z~It's so precious for people like me to have somewhere they can feel normal.
zh: ~z~能有这种让我体验常人生活的地方真是太难得了。

english: ~z~This is a green chopper, right? I only travel in carbon neutral vehicles now.
zh: ~z~这直升机够环保吧？我现在只通过绿色方式出行。

english: ~z~I'd go if I was a qualified pilot. You know that, man.
zh: ~z~我要是有飞行驾照的话就去了。你也知道，哥们。

english: ~z~Yeah? It must be great to be surrounded by those with similar levels of self obsession.
zh: ~z~是嘛？被那些一样自我陶醉的人包围一定很不错吧。

english: ~z~It looks like they cordoned off the street for you, man. Life ain't all bad.
zh: ~z~看来他们为你把路封了，哥们。人生也会有惊喜啊。

english: ~z~If someone can make a difference, it's you. Have a good time.
zh: ~z~要是有谁能改变规则的话，那就是你了。祝你开心。

english: ~z~There's this amazing young director shooting it. He's truly one of our greatest talents.
zh: ~z~是一位很有想法的年轻导演负责拍摄的，他老厉害了。

english: ~z~That's a shame, bro. I'm sure your grand-standing could make a real difference here.
zh: ~z~可惜啊，兄弟。我觉得你的行动一定能带来正面影响。

english: ~z~Yo, D. Shit kinda fucked up here, man. Can you cover for me?
zh: ~z~哟，D。事情有点搞砸了，哥们。你能帮我瞒过去吗？

english: ~z~I can talk to people about real issues and my art. People really listen there.
zh: ~z~我可以跟大家聊干货和我的作品。大家都在听我说话。

english: ~z~Totally. Maybe I'll set up an urban shingle through my Canyon deal.

zh: ~z~死胖子怎么会从我们两个年轻壮汉手里逃掉的？

zh: ~z~欧洲基佬多，兄弟。所以他们都穿紧身牛仔裤。

english: ~z~Yeah this has got to be kind of awkward, man. I'm going to slip off. Peace.

english: ~z~Yeah this has got to be kind of awkward, man. I'm going to slip off. Peace.

english: ~z~How do you like Bohan, Mr. Bellic? Some pals are waiting for you there.
zh: ~z~你喜欢波汉吗，贝利克先生？有人在那里等你。

english: ~z~We'll try to contact Mr. Bellic and have him come as soon as possible.
zh: ~z~我们会联系贝利克先生，让他尽快过来接送的。

english: ~z~Well, in that case I'll... I mean, ah...
zh: ~z~行啊，这样的话我马上...我是说，呃...

english: ~z~Okay. Okay. My cousin, he has money. He will pay you.
zh: ~z~好的，好的。我堂弟，他有钱。他会给你们钱。

zh: ~z~但他经常去一家地下赌场，在舒特勒的迪隆街。

zh: ~z~－现在需要你帮我们一个忙。~n~－什么忙？

zh: ~z~他们会杀了我的。我不知道该怎么办了。妈的。

zh: ~z~啊啊啊，救命啊！来人啊！我还不想死啊！拜托！

english: ~z~I knew you were a fucking racist. I fucking knew it. Stop the car.
zh: ~z~就知道你是个种族主义者，我就知道。给我停车。

zh: ~z~你还是先为自己的臭味道歉吧。你是拉裤子了吗？

zh: ~z~你是存心侮辱我们吗，罗曼･贝利克？希望不是。

~z~-The name of the man we want is Roman Bellic.~n~-Yeah.
zh: ~z~－我们想要的人名叫罗曼･贝利克。~n~－好。

english: ~z~Where you off to, Johnny boy? We kind of in the middle of something right here, man.
zh: ~z~你要去哪儿，强尼仔？我们还有事要办呢，哥们。

english: ~z~If you want Wingit Presentation before every job you do, you're running with the wrong crowd.
zh: ~z~做什么事之前都要长篇大论，我又不是那种领导。

english: ~z~Why are all you bikers racist, just like the Angels of Death?
zh: ~z~就说死亡天使吧，你们飞车党怎么都搞种族歧视？

english: ~z~Bellic, I wanted to kidnap you, now I might kill ya.
zh: ~z~贝利克，本来我只是绑架你，现在我都想杀你了。

english: ~z~I think I'm having a heart attack. I feel numb. Oh God, oh God.
zh: ~z~好像要犯心脏病了，我有点麻了。噢天哪，噢天哪。

english: ~z~If he only knew how close he came though. Thanks, Malc.
zh: ~z~可惜他不知道自己离危险有多近。谢了，马尔科姆。

english: ~z~So, yeah this guy we're snatching isn't the only European-type dude I've come across recently.
zh: ~z~其实，在这次绑架之前我已经遇到过一个欧洲人了。

english: ~z~You know, Malc, I think you've got unresolved women issues.
zh: ~z~知道吗，马尔科姆，我觉得你有没解决的女性情结。

english: ~z~I don't know. Both maybe. Fuck it. Shut up for a second.
zh: ~z~我不知道，都有可能吧。无所谓了。闭上你的嘴吧。

english: ~z~I need to snatch some guy name of uhh, Roman Bellic. Runs a cab firm,
zh: ~z~我要绑架一个叫罗曼･贝利克的人。开出租车行的，

english: ~z~Oh, wait. You hate me because where I'm from? Man, that's cold.
zh: ~z~啥玩意？你居然因为我的出身鄙视我？天，真恶心。

english: ~z~If I close my eyes they can't see me, if I close my eyes they can't see me.
zh: ~z~闭上眼睛他们就看不见我，闭上眼睛他们就看不见我。

english: ~z~Hey there, babe. Something went wrong. This job isn't happening. Stay safe.
zh: ~z~你好啊，宝贝。出了点岔子。绑架失败了。注意安全。

english: ~z~Hell no, I don't wanna get my hands all dirty and shit. Get gravy all on my new manicured fingers.
zh: ~z~不干，我才不想脏了自己的手。刚修过指甲不想沾油。

english: ~z~If it was a box of donuts you'd get your fat ass in there.
zh: ~z~要是有一盒甜甜圈，你肯定会自己进来。快点，胖子。

english: ~z~Ashley, you need to tell your Russian loan shark that the guy they're after is dead.
zh: ~z~阿什莉，麻烦你转告你的俄国债主，他们要的人死了。

english: ~z~who preferred rusty oil dripping junk to hi-tech precision machinery.
zh: ~z~比起高科技精密机械，他更喜欢生锈漏油的破铜烂铁。

english: ~z~Oh shit, Johnny. Shit. What happened? I thought you were looking out for me.
zh: ~z~噢，天哪，强尼。妈的，什么情况？你不是会帮我的吗？

english: ~z~We snatch this guy, deliver him to some other guys, then we pat ourselves on the back for doing a great job.
zh: ~z~先抓住他，再把他送过去，然后互相拍拍后背大功告成。

english: ~z~I told you, I like this gun. I ain't getting no bodies on it. Not today.
zh: ~z~哟，我说了，我喜欢这枪。暂时不想沾上血，现在不行。

english: ~z~And this here job - smells like a bitch to me. It got bitch-stink all over it, son.
zh: ~z~这次的活儿，闻着就像是臭娘们。一股子骚味儿，小子。

english: ~z~Sure, sure she ain't. Thats why you running all over town trying to snatch a fool up, huh? Please.
zh: ~z~对，当然不是。所以才要大老远地去绑架一个傻逼？别吧。

english: ~z~Yeah we just stole this guy, too. But I guess we gotta let him go. I'll be seeing the both of you.
zh: ~z~这哥们也是刚绑来的。不过只能放过他了。两位以后再见。

english: ~z~Those Russians have got their guy. You got lucky, but you got to control yourself, Ashley.
zh: ~z~人质交给俄国人了。算你走运，麻烦你管住自己，阿什莉。

english: ~z~We're more like equal opportunity haters - we hate assholes and fools, wherever they're from.
zh: ~z~我们倒不如说是一视同仁。~n~不问出身，都他妈傻逼。

english: ~z~You and your boys might ride, but you don't know nothing about brotherhood.
zh: ~z~你们帮的人确实在骑车，但根本就不了解什么是兄弟情谊。

english: ~z~For future reference, Malc, it might be worth locking your hostages into a car.
zh: ~z~留供日后参考，马尔科姆，绑架别人的时候最好锁住车门。

english: ~z~Yeah, that's what I said. Maybe Italian or Rome or some shit.
zh: ~z~对，就是这个意思。~n~也可能是意大利或者罗马那边的。

english: ~z~The Lost aren't like those Deadbeats. Take a look at my brothers, man.
zh: ~z~失落帮可跟死妈天使不一样。~n~瞧瞧我那些弟兄，伙计。

english: ~z~Malc, tell this gentlemen what my kind of people do to guys who try to buy their way out.
zh: ~z~马尔科姆，告诉这位先生，我会怎么对待想花钱走后门的人。

english: ~z~Hello, this is Bellic and Bellic Enterprises. What can I assist you with?
zh: ~z~您好，这里是 贝利克&贝利克 集团。有什么我能帮您的吗？

english: ~z~It's easy. You grab him and deliver him to warehouse, off Lompoc in Bohan Industrial.
zh: ~z~很简单。绑架他，然后送到波汉工业区隆波克大道那里的仓库。

english: ~z~-Your woman here owes Dimitri Rascalov a lot of money.~n~-Okay.
zh: ~z~－你的女人欠了迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫一笔巨款。~n~－好。

english: ~z~Damn, Johnny. I thought you cared about me. You can't leave me like this. Johnny...
zh: ~z~妈的，强尼。我还以为你在乎我。你怎么能这样对我，强尼...

english: ~z~Worked with this other guy, he could handle himself. Maybe this guy will be the same.
zh: ~z~之前跟我合作的人，他就很能打。~n~这家伙估计也有两下子。

english: ~z~Just pop the fucker. And you can get the bullets outta him afterwards and no one's gonna trace that shit back to you.
zh: ~z~赶紧崩了他。待会儿把子弹掏出来就行了，条子查不到你身上的。

english: ~z~Ummm, Johnny, my dude, we're going to do this or what? What the fuck is wrong with you?
zh: ~z~呃...强尼，好兄弟，我们还办不办事了？你他妈犯病了是吧？

english: ~z~I'll take you through the bright lights of Star Junction, past the glamorous shops of Middle Park West,
zh: ~z~我会带你们穿越星汇广场的灯火辉煌，看遍中央公园西的繁荣市场。

english: ~z~We let him go and he'll come back with a bag full of unmarked twenties, right?
zh: ~z~我们把他放走，以后他就会给我们一麻袋没被标记的20块，对吧？

english: ~z~they're in need of a Limo'. And I'm told this Bellic guy's the man for that kind of work.
zh: ~z~她们需要一辆豪华轿车。~n~别人跟我说这种事得找这位贝利克。

english: ~z~She's a friend and she's in trouble. I believe in looking out for people you've been close to.
zh: ~z~她是我的朋友，现在陷入了麻烦。~n~我向来都会照顾身边的人的。

english: ~z~you might end the tour with a look at the finest specimen of manhood in the entire metropolitan area.
zh: ~z~你们还可以在旅途结束前见识到~n~整个大都会最有男子气概的人。

english: ~z~I know I am, Johnny. And you know what's the best thing about me? You. Call me, okay?
zh: ~z~我也知道，强尼。你知道我最大的幸运是什么吗？是你。多联系，好吗？

english: ~z~Hey now listen, I do mean motherfucker in the most literal sense. Serious incest motherfucker.
zh: ~z~你听好了，这个「日妈」可是~n~字面意思的日妈。日了自己的亲妈。

english: ~z~Dude, you busy? I got something and I don't need it getting round the clubhouse. I'll owe you, brother.
zh: ~z~老兄，有空吗？我有点事，不能让帮里的兄弟知道。算我欠你的，兄弟。

english: ~z~I'm hoping he ain't too good at poker. Hell, if we're here because of his debts, he can't exactly be the Buffet Car.
zh: ~z~希望他牌技没那么好。妈的，他都欠债到要被人绑架了，总不能是赌神吧。

english: ~z~Oh, it's like that, is it, now? She like your girlfriend or something? Nah, nah, that's cool. I'm feeling that.
zh: ~z~噢，我差不多能猜到了。就是你的女友之类的吧？这又没关系的。可以理解。

english: ~z~Ummm.... ahhhh... I... Mr. Bellic is very busy man. An important and busy man.
zh: ~z~呃...啊...我...贝利克先生是个大忙人。~n~是一位重要的大忙人。

english: ~z~Yeah, this biker dude is twisted as all hell, man. By the way how many guys you killed, son?
zh: ~z~没错，这位飞车党可是坏得一批，伙计。~n~问一下，你杀了多少人了，小子？

english: ~z~Just so you know who you dealing with, Mr. Bellic. This is one screwed up dumb redneck motherfucker.
zh: ~z~先告诉你你面前的人是谁，贝利克先生。~n~这可是一位不好惹的日妈红脖子。

english: ~z~Damn you better not be right. What's wrong with you, man? We was only joshing you. Tell him, Johnny.
zh: ~z~妈的，希望你说错了。你他妈有病吧，哥们？~n~我们是开玩笑的。告诉他，强尼。

english: ~z~We ain't kidnapping nobody because of my mamma, Johnny. It's your lady friend getting us to do this. Think on that, son.
zh: ~z~我们不是因为我妈才来绑架别人的，强尼。~n~都是因为你的女性朋友。动动脑子，小子。

english: ~z~Make this one messy.
~z~Jack the transporter and bring it to the House.
~z~Show 'em how un-patriotic they're being.
zh: ~z~让他们瞧瞧自己有多不爱国。

zh: ~z~一帮废物帮正骑过咱们的地盘。

english: ~z~Get hold of some new ones and we'll change up the parts.
zh: ~z~弄几台新的来，咱们把零件换上。

english: ~z~That rodent Garrity is getting moved out of state.
zh: ~z~加里蒂那个鼠辈要被转移到州外了。

english: ~z~It's good old fashioned gang war time, gentlemen.
zh: ~z~先生们，传统帮派火并的时刻到了。

english: ~z~Load up the product and take it somewhere where the sniffer dogs won't find it.
zh: ~z~把货装上，藏到警犬闻不着的地方去。

zh: ~z~银行要转移现金储备了，懂我意思吗？

zh: ~z~趁这还没变成一场复仇行动，赶紧进去。

zh: ~z~虽然可惜，墨菲在会里已经名声扫地了。

zh: ~z~LCPD 刚以冰毒案子抓了卡尔的老婆。

zh: ~z~会所外面那堆破车看着就该进他妈的坟场。

zh: ~z~止损吧，趁咱们还没吃牢饭之前把它们烧了。

zh: ~z~趁那些牙买加黑帮还没报复，把他带到这儿来。

english: ~z~They could get taught a little geography lesson before they leave, don't you think?
zh: ~z~他们走之前，可以给他们上一堂地理课，你说呢？

zh: ~z~让那个西海岸的蠢货瞧瞧，自由城的底章归失落帮。

zh: ~z~会里有令，要为举步维艰的美国汽车工业出一份力。

zh: ~z~我们本要把一批军火卖给萨尔瓦多人，结果交易黄了。

english: ~z~The Deadbeats just jumped some brothers at Honkers.
zh: ~z~废物帮刚在 Honkers 夜店偷袭了几个兄弟。

zh: ~z~我说你们把上城骑士那些日本破烂和意裔火箭全砸了。

zh: ~z~几个兄弟刚被死亡天使偷袭了。有架要打了，小子们！

zh: ~z~现在那些装满枪的货车成了 FIB 眼里的特大目标。

english: ~z~We gotta raise bail for Otis and fuck me if we're putting our hands in our own pockets.
zh: ~z~我们得给奥蒂斯筹保释金，要咱们自己掏钱那就见鬼了。

english: ~z~I just heard that the Deadbeats' San Fierro Road Captain is in town to meet with Joe Jon.
zh: ~z~我刚听说废物帮的圣菲耶罗车队队长进城来见乔･乔恩了。

english: ~z~He ain't worthy to wear his Lost MC patch no more. Get his colors and bring 'em back here now.
zh: ~z~他不配再戴失落帮的会徽了。收了他的行头，马上带回来。

english: ~z~The fuck you idiots do? Every cop in Liberty's out there looking for you.
zh: ~z~你们这帮蠢货干了什么？自由城所有警察都在外面找你们。

english: ~z~Someone take Arnie Lester's bike and bring it back here. See how the Deadbeats like that.
zh: ~z~谁去把阿尼･莱斯特的车弄回来。看看废物帮受不受得了。

english: ~z~They flip her, a lot of brothers go down for a long time. You break her out and take her to the safehouse.
zh: ~z~她要是反水，很多兄弟得蹲上大牢。你把她劫出来，送到安全屋。

english: ~z~The new Nightblades are getting delivered to shops today. And us being such good customers, we deserve a free sample.
zh: ~z~新款夜刃今天就要送到车行了。咱们是这么好的客户，理应拿个免费试用。

english: ~z~I just got the heads up our stash is gonna be raided. Sometimes a corrupt police department can work in our favor.
zh: ~z~我刚得到风声，咱们的货要被突查了。有时候腐败的警察局也能为咱们所用。

english: ~z~Keep the heat off whoever N.O.O.S.E have got a hard-on for until I can call in a favor.
zh: ~z~N.O.O.S.E. 正死咬着某个人，你先帮我顶着风头，直到我能动用关系。

english: ~z~It's your last chance to pay him back for all the brothers he jammed up before he disappears into WITSEC.
zh: ~z~这是你最后一次收拾他的机会，他为害的兄弟那么多，之后他就要进证人保护计划消失了。
