english: ~z~Fuck him, man. He'll deal with it. Later on, Bro.
zh: ~z~去他妈的，兄弟。他会处理的。回见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Would somebody tell the Deadbeats that possession is nine tenths of the law.
zh: ~z~死妈天使都不知道占有人在诉讼中有优势吗。

english: ~z~These inbred biker rednecks get smarter every year.
zh: ~z~这些近亲繁殖的红脖子骑手一年比一年聪明。

english: ~z~Ain't we a little too old for stealing bikes and clubhouse flags and crap like that?
zh: ~z~我们都多大了，还干这种偷鸡摸狗的勾当啊？

english: ~z~No one will fuck with our bikes on Lost MC turf.
zh: ~z~没人敢在失落帮的地盘上对我们的摩托下手。

english: ~z~She'll be begging us for another fucking interrogation in no fucking time.
zh: ~z~不用多久她就会哭着求我们再拷问她一次的。

english: ~z~But I think long and hard about what I'm gonna order at Burger Shot as well,
zh: ~z~不过我去汉堡店点餐的时候也需要深思熟虑。

english: ~z~Absolutely. Got to keep active, brother. Keep on moving.
zh: ~z~当然了。还是要保持心态，兄弟。继续前进吧。

english: ~z~Hey man, get your asses over here now. Jim and I are in the shit!
zh: ~z~喂，老兄，快他妈过来。吉姆和我遇到麻烦了！

english: ~z~This is getting too hot, my brother. Why don't you call the boys in to help.
zh: ~z~事情变得棘手了，兄弟。快打电话叫些支援吧。

english: ~z~Not really, at least not since Billy got back. Shit's been too crazy.
zh: ~z~没有，比利回来后就没怎么聊了。屁事太多了。

english: ~z~Clay, dude, Me and Jim need some assistance with the AOD.
zh: ~z~科雷，老兄，我和吉姆需要对付死亡天使的帮手。

english: ~z~Luck's a perverse thing ain't it? How are Jackie and the kid?
zh: ~z~运气就是这么反复无常啊。杰基和孩子最近好吗？

english: ~z~These assholes don't have the balls to follow us to the clubhouse. We're in the clear, man.
zh: ~z~这些傻逼不敢跟着我们去会所。我们安全了，兄弟。

english: ~z~I was riding bikes before your momma rode your daddy, Jonathan.
zh: ~z~你妈还在骑你爸的时候我就在骑摩托车了，乔纳森。

english: ~z~It ain't as fast as your bike, but this is our ride, Johnny boy.
zh: ~z~卡车是没你的摩托快，但就是这次的坐骑，强尼仔。

english: ~z~It's too bad, my brother. I was looking forward to screwing with those Deadbeats.
zh: ~z~太糟了，好兄弟。我本来想干这群死妈天使一炮的。

english: ~z~Jackie and the baby, yeah it's nice and all. And shit, I mean I love them and stuff,
zh: ~z~杰基和孩子，这样是不错。我是说，我确实很爱他们，

english: ~z~Screw it, my brother. Money's just another thing to worry about. See ya, Johnny boy.
zh: ~z~算了吧，好兄弟。担心钱又是另一回事了。再见，强尼仔。

english: ~z~Get the brothers on the wire, Johnny. We need us some help if we're gonna get home.
zh: ~z~打电话叫些弟兄来，强尼。这次想活着回去必须叫点支援。

english: ~z~We're cool, Johnny. The AOD won't come this far into Lost territory.
zh: ~z~我们安全了，强尼。死亡天使不会贸然踏入失落帮的地盘的。

english: ~z~I guess you gotta tell your contact he ain't getting those bikes and his truck is screwed.
zh: ~z~我想你该跟买家说一声他拿不到摩托了，而且他的卡车也毁了。

english: ~z~Hey man, Jackie can handle herself but it ain't exactly a family friendly environment at the moment, is it?
zh: ~z~我说，杰基能照顾好自己，但现在的会所不适合带家人来，懂吧？

english: ~z~Well, you could save me and Jim's hides from some angry Deadbeats. We need your help.
zh: ~z~你可以从暴怒的死妈天使手里保护我和吉姆。我们需要你的帮助。

english: ~z~Yeah Johnny, I take your point. I'd have to think long and hard on it, okay?
zh: ~z~确实，强尼，我懂你意思。这种情况我就需要深思熟虑了，好吧？

english: ~z~They got these bikes at their place near Honkers. Drive us, will ya?
zh: ~z~他们把摩托停在Honkers俱乐部旁边的据点。你开车，好吗？

english: ~z~You should call them, man. They're still cool. Their heads are probably in the same kind of place as yours.
zh: ~z~多联系他们吧，兄弟。他俩还是你哥们儿，估计想法也跟你差不多。

english: ~z~Feels good to be doing something like this. Not just breaking heads 'cause Billy feels like it.
zh: ~z~做这种事的感觉真好。比起因为比利一时兴起就打得头破血流好多了。

english: ~z~Man, we're only meant to stand up on the Chapter leader's say so, but who gives a fuck? We'll be there.
zh: ~z~兄弟，原则上只有会长才能叫我们支援，不过去他妈的。我们马上就到。

english: ~z~Now, you know only a Chapter Head like Billy can ask for that kind of help. So don't go telling him we're coming to ya.
zh: ~z~先说好，你也知道只有比利这样的分会会长才能呼叫武力支援。别告诉他我们来帮你了。

english: ~z~Or?
~z~I figured.
~z~What happened?
~z~What's the trouble?
~z~Stupid pigs.
~z~There ya go!
~z~Case fucking closed.
~z~Wait here a minute.
~z~Come on, man.
~z~Take a guess, bro.
~z~Mommy. Boo hoo hoo.
~z~Get back here, Johnny.
~z~That'll show 'em.
~z~The bulls are seeing red.
~z~You chose the wrong boys to put the squeeze on.
~z~Fuck you very much.
~z~You tryin' to get us killed?
~z~Stop screwing around, Johnny.
~z~Lead on, James!
~z~This is just like the old days.
~z~Write me a speeding ticket.
~z~Whoa, man. Easy.
~z~Or, we head over to the clubhouse,
~z~Here's as good a place as any.
~z~So long, coppers.
~z~I figured you'd say that.
~z~You're going to hell for that, shit head.
~z~Get your hands dirty, brothers!
~z~Here's where we end it.
~z~They're gonna get us.
~z~Either, we buy a big tub of grease
~z~You been drinking, Johnny?
~z~That was easier than paying a bribe.
~z~Think I ruptured something.
~z~Ah, exactly what you asked for.
~z~They're right on us, Johnny.
~z~It's nearly retirement time, fuckers.
~z~Great, here come the rest of them.
~z~Come on, man. Get on!
~z~Get back on the bike, brother.
~z~Fuck me sideways, you're right.
~z~Where the hell are you going, man?
~z~Time's almost up, you dirty bastards.
~z~Come on, Johnny. What the fuck?
~z~The way I see it we got two choices.
~z~The Lost forever, boys.
~z~We don't have time for this, man.
~z~That's the last of them.
~z~What you got for us, mope?
~z~What is wrong with you man?
~z~You're getting too old for this, Johnny.
~z~Welcome to the party, brothers!
~z~And here are their buddies. Just great.
~z~Another one goes on the take.
~z~Don't let 'em catch you now, Jim.
~z~This is where we deal with this bullshit.
~z~Only they're just hypocrites as well.
~z~Maybe I should do the driving, man.
~z~Yeah, dude, you're right.
~z~... balls the size of mangoes.
~z~Hey, officers, how you doin?
~z~Couple of therapy sessions and he's free as a bird?
~z~Hey Jim, good to see ya man.
~z~Ha, ha! Bet that shut him up.
~z~This is the fucking end for all you Lost bikers.
~z~We're gonna break your necks, you scum.
~z~More of Liberty's least fine. Just what we need.
~z~The second I start thinking maybe the law is okay.
zh: ~z~我刚开始觉得法律没有问题。

english: ~z~We're looking forward to kicking the shit out of you, mopes.
~z~We ain't the pussies you thought we were.
zh: ~z~我们没有你们想的那么懦弱。

english: ~z~Yeah, just the ones in Liberty City.
~z~Pull over so we can beat the shit out of you.
~z~You shouldn't have played dirty, coppers.
~z~ It's about time someone beat back on the LCPD.
~z~Hey man, can you shake this bacon?
~z~We got to lose this heat, man.
~z~Johnny, man, they're right on top of us.
~z~Looks like you're outnumbered, friends!
zh: ~z~看来你们寡不敌众了，朋友们！

english: ~z~McCornish - dammit. Bastard nearly had his twenty.
~z~You know, I forgot how stupid lookin' this guy was, Matthews.
zh: ~z~这家伙好像很蠢来着，马修斯。

english: ~z~I'm gonna go undercover in your asses, dickheads.
zh: ~z~老子冲进你菊花当卧底，傻逼。

english: ~z~Hey, brother, this is about to get real unpleasant.
~z~There'll be another chance to deal with them. Don't you worry about that.
zh: ~z~总有机会对付他们的。别担心。

english: ~z~Poor assholes don't know what they're in for.
zh: ~z~俩傻逼还不知道自己在往哪走。

english: ~z~No commemorative gold watch and nice little bribe for you, man.
zh: ~z~没给二位准备大金链子小金表。

english: ~z~There'll be another chance to deal with them. Don't you worry about that.
zh: ~z~总有机会对付他们的。别担心。

english: ~z~Jim, Johnny, we're here for you brothers.
~z~and prepare to take it from these fat pigs for the rest of our lives.
zh: ~z~然后被这两个条子压榨一辈子。

english: ~z~Brother, those cops have almost got us.
zh: ~z~兄弟，那俩条子快追上咱们了。

english: ~z~Age before beauty, my man. Age before beauty.
~z~Maybe you should have stolen his lunch money.
zh: ~z~我看你应该把他的午饭钱也抢来。

english: ~z~Always plant a gun, always. What did I tell you?
zh: ~z~给他塞把枪，懂吧。我教过你吧？

english: ~z~I know, but they can't all be all bad.
zh: ~z~我知道，但他们不可能都是坏人。

english: ~z~close to where I happen to know they got themselves set up,
zh: ~z~那两个混蛋正好在会所附近蹲点。

english: ~z~Yeah, I know man, I know. Look after yourself.
~z~Oh, Man. I'm getting to old for this shit.
zh: ~z~噢，兄弟。我这年纪快干不动了。

english: ~z~Didn't even save me any, you fat fuck. Thanks a lot.
zh: ~z~是没什么好处，你这肥猪。多谢了。

english: ~z~Throw him in holding and let a pack of meatheads break them fucking potatoes for us.
zh: ~z~关进大牢，让那些瘾君子收拾他们。

english: ~z~Now you owe us the cash and your necks, biker boys.
zh: ~z~现在你们既欠钱又欠命了，摩托仔。

english: ~z~and we show them that we're not quite the bitches they think we are.
zh: ~z~让他们知道我们不是那么好欺负的。

english: ~z~Johnny, they're calling in for reinforcements. Shut 'em up.
zh: ~z~强尼，他们在呼叫增援。阻止他们。

english: ~z~They're calling for backup, Johnny. Cut 'em off.
zh: ~z~他们要叫支援了，强尼。干掉他们。

english: ~z~Now you know we ain't going out like that, Jim. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~这下就不会了，吉姆。我们之后见。

english: ~z~ ... no, no, Mommy. Mommy, no.
~z~Worse; at least we ain't pretending to respect the law.
zh: ~z~他们更糟，我们至少不用装作守法。

english: ~z~We don't want to piss 'em off too much. Not yet, at least.
zh: ~z~我们不能做得太过。至少现在不行。

english: ~z~Shit, Jim, you should think about retiring with moves like that.
zh: ~z~妈的，吉姆，你这老寒腿该退休了。

english: ~z~Is someone screwing with our brothers? Fuck you.
zh: ~z~有人找我兄弟们的麻烦吗？操你妈。

english: ~z~I guess it's that lawyer he knows - Grossman.
zh: ~z~多半是他认识的那个律师，格罗斯曼。

english: ~z~How do I look from behind, man? You like looking at my patch?
zh: ~z~我的背影怎样？我后背的布章好看吗？

english: ~z~Maybe you should be on the fucking stage with jokes like that.
zh: ~z~真会开玩笑，我看你应该改行说相声。

english: ~z~Shit, Johnny. We're about to get fucked by those pigs.
zh: ~z~操，强尼。我们要被那俩条子逮住了。

english: ~z~I always thought you biker losers were moronic.
zh: ~z~我就知道你们这些摩托屌丝都是白痴。

english: ~z~You know, cheap sarcasm should be beneath you, Johnny.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，阴阳怪气没好处的，强尼。

english: ~z~You still know a few tricks, old man. I'll give you that.
zh: ~z~不得不说，你这老家伙还真有两下子。

english: ~z~Those cops are angry, man. Get back on the bike.
zh: ~z~那俩条子很生气，兄弟。快上摩托车。

english: ~z~You pigs chose to play dirty, didn't you?
zh: ~z~你们这些条子选择了耍手段，不是吗？

english: ~z~It might have something to do with those cops that pulled one over on us.
zh: ~z~可能跟上次拦下我们的那对条子有关。

english: ~z~You think he's smart enough to realise that we got expensive tastes?
zh: ~z~你说他知不知道我们不是好伺候的主啊？

english: ~z~Hey McCornish, this fat perp's brought us a present.
zh: ~z~喂，麦科尼什，这肥仔给我们送礼来了。

english: ~z~Don't this badge mean nothing to you, fuck ups?
zh: ~z~你们是不把我的警徽放在眼里吗，傻逼？

english: ~z~We can't let 'em call for backup, Johnny boy. Close 'em down.
zh: ~z~不能让他们呼叫支援，强尼。干掉他们。

english: ~z~We got the whole LCPD behind us, you fucking shit birds.
zh: ~z~我们有整个LCPD当靠山，傻逼鸟人。

english: ~z~... three heads in the West River and not a body in sight.
zh: ~z~...三颗人头漂在西河上，却没有身体。

english: ~z~You got no idea the shit storm that's going to come down on you, you fucking pricks.
zh: ~z~马上你们就要面临血雨腥风了，一群猪头。

english: ~z~You're going to pay for that coffee and donut fat man.
zh: ~z~毁了我的咖啡跟甜甜圈就别想跑了，肥猪。

english: ~z~Ha! You are fucking killing me man. What'd you eat funny pills today or what?
zh: ~z~哈！你是想笑死我啊。你今天吃错药了吧？

english: ~z~Sure. How the hell did Billy managed to get off with rehab, anyway?
zh: ~z~确实。对了，比利到底是怎么被放出来了？

english: ~z~Gave him the wrong badge number, thank God. Fucking dickhead!
zh: ~z~随口编了个警号给他，谢天谢地。傻逼东西！

english: ~z~Hey fatty, you can't fit on that bike. Why don't you pull over?
zh: ~z~嘿，肥仔，你那摩托要散架了，早点停车吧？

english: ~z~You guys are the dumbest fucking mopes I've ever seen in all of my years of service.
zh: ~z~当警察这么多年，你们是我见过最蠢的二逼。

english: ~z~Well, tempted as I am by your first option, I'm gonna have to go with the second.
zh: ~z~好吧，虽然我更喜欢前者，但我还是得选后者。

english: ~z~Learn to tune your bike, man. Those cops are gonna be on us for good now.
zh: ~z~把车调整好吧，这下条子要通缉我们一辈子了。

english: ~z~The rest of your fucking biker buddies are gonna pay for this, too. You fucking hump.
zh: ~z~你们整个摩托帮都会为此付出代价，两个傻逼。

english: ~z~Ha ha ha! Turned out to be a sociology professor at Vespucci University.
zh: ~z~哈哈哈！结果他是韦斯普奇大学的社会学教授。

english: ~z~Alright then James, that's a few less dirty cops polluting this fine city.
zh: ~z~好吧，杰姆斯，这座城市又少了几匹害群之马。

english: ~z~Nothing like the feel of a fully automatic pistol in your hand, you son of a bitch.
zh: ~z~再爽也爽不过手握全自动手枪了，妈了个逼的。

english: ~z~We gotta finish this bullshit off, get us to Trinity in Acter Industrial.
zh: ~z~我们要一劳永逸，去阿克特工业园的特里尼蒂路。

english: ~z~Round up the boys. We got a cop killer on our hands! Man down!
zh: ~z~集合人员。杀害警员的凶手就在眼前！友军伤亡！

english: ~z~Come on. I give up, alright, I give up. Come on, tell me.
zh: ~z~好啦。我投降，好吧，我投降。好了，告诉我吧。

english: ~z~Johnny man, we can't have the cops catching us now. Lose this heat.
zh: ~z~强尼兄弟，现在还不能让条子抓到我们。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~No, no, no. It was the Humboldt. They found those left feet in the West River.
zh: ~z~不不不，你那是洪堡河。在西河发现的是几只左脚。

english: ~z~Man, I want the old Billy back, the one before the heroin.
zh: ~z~老兄，我更想要以前的比利，没沾上海洛因的比利。

english: ~z~Send in the wrecking crew, Sarge. We got a couple of bikers need to be taught a fucking lesson.
zh: ~z~请求紧急支援，警长。我们要好好教训下这帮飞车党。

english: ~z~You fucking mopes. McCornish was the best bad cop I knew.
zh: ~z~你们这群混蛋。麦科尼什是我认识的最牛逼的坏警察。

english: ~z~They should get treated like the rest of us as well. Law of the streets.
zh: ~z~他们也该像我们帮的其他人一样，用街头的规矩对待。

english: ~z~Mommy. He's crying like a little fucking bitch. Matthews you kill me you prick.
zh: ~z~妈咪。他像婆娘一样哭个不停。马修斯，我快笑死了。

english: ~z~Yeah, paying taxes and declaring incomes. And all the while taking the kickbacks.
zh: ~z~是啊，老老实实纳税、申报收入。然后私下拿着回扣。

english: ~z~You stole his donut and spilled his coffee. Real mature, man.
zh: ~z~你抢了他的甜甜圈，泼了他的咖啡。够爷们儿，兄弟。

english: ~z~Tell some of the boys to get their nightsticks out, Sarge. We got a couple of bikers need to be broken.
zh: ~z~长官，告诉兄弟们拿好装备。我们得对付一帮飞车党。

english: ~z~Oh yeah. You messed with a dirty cop's donut. You're one badass biker.
zh: ~z~哦，没错。你抢了臭条子的甜甜圈，真是一个大坏蛋。

english: ~z~Make tracks to Trinity Road, John. Come on. I got some brothers coming to meet us.
zh: ~z~赶紧去特里尼蒂路，约翰。快点。我在那里安排了弟兄。

english: ~z~We got lucky there, Johnny boy. I thought we'd be shovelling shit for those dudes 'til God knows when.
zh: ~z~我们很走运，强尼仔。我还以为要给他们当一辈子孙子。

english: ~z~A dirty cop's just like a Deadbeat or a Triad or any other crook in this town.
zh: ~z~腐败警察跟死妈天使、三合会这样的坏人之流没有区别。

english: ~z~Officer down. Officer down. We need fucking back up ten minutes ago!
zh: ~z~有警察倒下了。有警察倒下了。早十分钟就该派支援了！

english: ~z~How you feeling, Jim? Billy, man. I hope he handles his shit.
zh: ~z~感觉如何，吉姆？比利，天，我希望他能处理好他的事。

english: ~z~You know what, I can't wait to get them down the precinct so we can really stomp on those fuckers.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，我等不及想把他们抓进局子，好爆踹他们一顿。

english: ~z~You know, there's some people on the LCPD who'd thank us for what we're about to do.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，LCPD里会有人感谢我们接下来要做的事的。

english: ~z~Head to Trinity in Acter Industrial, alright? The boys are gonna meet us there.
zh: ~z~去阿克特工业园的特里尼蒂路，好吧？弟兄们埋伏在那里。

english: ~z~I don't like people having a hold on me like this. People ask me why I dislike cops...
zh: ~z~我不喜欢被别人这样束缚。有人问我为什么讨厌警察...

english: ~z~How bout we race over to those fucking dirty cops, old man? Think you can handle it?
zh: ~z~我们比比谁先骑到臭条子那里吧，老家伙？你有信心赢吗？

english: ~z~A hooker being picked up by the chief on a Saturday night and let off with a special caution.
zh: ~z~周六晚上，局长带走了一个妓女，口头警告一下就放人了。

english: ~z~I know, I know, it's just there's only so many you can carry. Who'd think there'd be five of them.
zh: ~z~我懂，我懂。可是我没这么多枪啊，谁知道他们有五个人。

english: ~z~Yeah, they spend the kickbacks on getting high and getting hole - just like the rest of us.
zh: ~z~是啊，他们把回扣花在吸毒和嫖娼上，就像我们帮的那些人。

english: ~z~The second they shook us down for money, man, they came down to our level.
zh: ~z~在他们向我们索取贿赂的那一刻，他们就和我们没有差别了。

english: ~z~Back up! Back up! Some perps have just got a hard on for killing cops. We got a man down!
zh: ~z~呼叫支援！呼叫支援！有罪犯在屠杀警察。我们有人倒下了！

english: ~z~... I.A.D. and the Sarge taking turns to screw me like it's my fucking quinceañera.
zh: ~z~...内务部和警长轮番折磨我，搞得跟给我办成人礼一样。

english: ~z~so I said, "But racial profiling works, motherfucker. Now give up the product."
zh: ~z~于是我说：「依肤色断案就是管用，傻逼玩意。把货交出来。」

english: ~z~We run this city, mopes. We are your Gods and we will crush you.
zh: ~z~我们管理这座城市，二逼。我们是你们的神，我们会毁灭你们。

english: ~z~Hey Sarge, me and Matthews need a hand. Send out some boys who ain't afraid to break some fucking heads.
zh: ~z~喂，警长，我和马修斯需要支援。派一些不怕死的弟兄们过来。

english: ~z~Hey, Billy's Billy. They had him cooped up in that place for a while. He's just blowin' off some steam.
zh: ~z~嘿，比利就是比利。他被关了一段时间，现在只是要发泄一下。

english: ~z~We just couldn't take 'em out in the open like that. They're still cops. See you soon, man.
zh: ~z~我们不能大摇大摆地干掉他们。他们可是警察。之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Yeah? Can't think of what I'd prefer, time in the joint or hanging with some sleazeball lawyer.
zh: ~z~是吗？我都不知道哪个更好，是去蹲号子，还是跟混球律师厮混。

english: ~z~Let's see if you still got it, old man. Let's drop the fuckin' hammer on this run to those assholes.
zh: ~z~看看你的车技有没有退步吧，老家伙。比比谁先开到那俩混蛋那儿。

english: ~z~Fuck me man, the whole LCPD are gonna be after us now. You can't just do that to a cop.
zh: ~z~他奶奶的，现在整个LCPD都要盯上我们了。条子不是随便就能杀的。

english: ~z~Something tells me they weren't the only ones in the LCPD, Johnny. Back to the house, my man.
zh: ~z~我觉得LCPD里不会只有他们两个坏警察，强尼。回会所吧，好兄弟。

english: ~z~Man that shit was heavy. I feel bad for them bastards. Once upon a time, they must have wanted to do good.
zh: ~z~天哪，真是难受。我替这些混蛋感到难过。从前，他们一定也想做个好人。

english: ~z~Cool.
~z~Hey.
~z~All good.
~z~Brother.
~z~On it.
~z~What's up?
~z~Why hello.
~z~Let's do this.
~z~Rock and roll.
~z~Jonathan?
~z~Good as done.
~z~It's yours.
~z~Heading there now.
~z~Hey, man.
~z~Yo, brother.
~z~Fuck it, we're on.
~z~Don't worry about it. Stay safe.
~z~Let's get this done.
~z~All cool, Johnny. Later on.
~z~Guy's riding it round Chinatown.
~z~I'm taking a bike. Don't be a jackass.
~z~No problem. See you, man.
~z~The bike's all parked up and waiting, man.
~z~If it ain't my true brother.
~z~ I'm glad we got you to do the acquiring.
~z~Hellfury delivered, my brother.
~z~That's cool, brother. Look after yourself.
~z~Stop jacking up my new ride, fuckhole.
~z~It's in that multi-storey car park in Purgatory.
~z~Get a fucking room, kids.
~z~That bike ain't AOD property no more.
zh: ~z~那辆摩托不再属于死妈天使了。

english: ~z~Hey, asshole, you're fucking up my new bike!
~z~Hey, Deadbeats, I like your bike.
~z~One Wolfsbane ready and waiting for you, my brother.
zh: ~z~这辆恶狼克星等着你呢，好兄弟。

english: ~z~Brother man, we're going to get paid. Don't get too fucked up.
zh: ~z~兄弟，又有钱进账了。别乱挥霍。

english: ~z~Angus, man. She's parked up outside the House.
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟。车在会所外面了。

english: ~z~The bike's there, man. The bike's fucking there.
zh: ~z~摩托有了，兄弟。要的摩托有了。

english: ~z~Nice one, brother. We got ourselves a payday.
zh: ~z~干得漂亮，兄弟。我们赚大发了。

english: ~z~ You and your man have now got yourselves a PCJ, man.
zh: ~z~你和你老板要的PCJ已经拿到了。

english: ~z~I'm here for the bike, not your life, so be cool.
zh: ~z~我要的是车，不是你的命，老实点。

english: ~z~Fuck it, man. It ain't like that was the only bike in the city.
zh: ~z~操他妈的。反正城里多的是摩托车。

english: ~z~Smoochy time's over, guys. Give up the ride.
zh: ~z~甜蜜时光结束了，各位。交出摩托。

english: ~z~I ordered a bike, shithead. Give it up.
zh: ~z~这辆摩托我要了，傻蛋。交出车子。

english: ~z~Alright, man. Your dude's got his bike.
zh: ~z~好了，兄弟。你的人已经拿到车了。

english: ~z~Bike's outside the house where you wanted it, man.
zh: ~z~摩托按你说的停在会所外面了，兄弟。

english: ~z~That's cool, Brother. The man will just have to wait.
zh: ~z~没事的，兄弟。就让老板多等会儿吧。

english: ~z~I'll pass on the good news, Johnny. Later on.
zh: ~z~我会转达这个好消息的，强尼。再见。

english: ~z~Some Deadbeats are taking it over the East Borough Bridge.
zh: ~z~一些死妈天使正骑着它通过东区大桥。

english: ~z~The bike's right there for you, brother. No problem.
zh: ~z~你要的摩托已经备好了，兄弟。没问题。

english: ~z~Angus, I got a feeling there might be a bike you're looking for.
zh: ~z~安格斯，你是不是又看上了哪辆摩托啊？

english: ~z~Tell me where I can find a bike and it's yours, Angus.
zh: ~z~告诉我车在哪里，我帮你弄来，安格斯。

english: ~z~You ain't perfect, Johnny. None of us are. Don't worry about it.
zh: ~z~人无完人，强尼。我们都一样。别担心。

english: ~z~Got the NRG 900, man. Do what you will.
~z~Man, oh, man, that's what I wanted to hear. Stay safe.
zh: ~z~兄弟啊，兄弟，就知道你靠得住。保重。

english: ~z~You always were the most reliable brother, Johnny. Too cool.
zh: ~z~不愧是我最可靠的兄弟，强尼。太棒了。

english: ~z~They got it outside that showroom on Percell in Westdyke.
zh: ~z~车子在韦斯代克区佩塞尔路的展厅门口。

english: ~z~I might take that bike off your hands, Deadbeats.
zh: ~z~你们手里的那辆摩托我要了，死妈天使。

english: ~z~Too bad, brother, but that guy won't be getting his hands on that bike today.
zh: ~z~太糟了，兄弟，但你老板今天见不到车了。

english: ~z~Your paper route's over, man. Get off the bike.
zh: ~z~你的送报工作该下班了，老兄。快滚下来。

english: ~z~Hey man, I can't do that delivery anymore. Hope that's okay?
zh: ~z~嘿，兄弟，我现在没法弄车了。没问题吧？

english: ~z~Cool, Johnny, cool. I'll let the man know what went down.
zh: ~z~没事，强尼，没事的。我会跟他说明情况的。

english: ~z~Johnny boy. This import export guy - he's got a long shopping list.
zh: ~z~强尼仔。这位进出口商的采购清单还挺长的。

english: ~z~Hey, Angus. Know any bikes that need to be liberated from their owners?
zh: ~z~嘿，安格斯。有没有需要脱离车主魔爪的摩托？

english: ~z~Some Deadbeats left it outside that liquor store on Dillon Street.
zh: ~z~几个死妈天使把车停在迪隆街的酒水商店门外。

english: ~z~I'm cracking open a celebratory Piswasser already. Too cool, brother man.
zh: ~z~我已经开好尿汤啤庆祝了。干得漂亮，好兄弟。

english: ~z~That last one's in the container heading east and we've lined up another.
zh: ~z~上次的车已经装箱去往远东了。这是新的目标。

english: ~z~Nothing right now, man. Sorry. Call back, okay?
zh: ~z~什么活都没有，兄弟。抱歉。以后再问，好吗？

english: ~z~Angus, dude, I gotta postpone getting that bike. Hope that's cool?
zh: ~z~安格斯兄弟，车子我得晚点去弄了。没关系吧？

english: ~z~Assholes don't know how much it's worth. They're screwing it up on the beach at Firefly.
zh: ~z~有一群不识货的臭傻逼，在萤火虫的海滩上瞎搞。

english: ~z~Angus, man, I'm sorry but shit got fucked up and I couldn't get that bike.
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟，很抱歉事情搞砸了，我没弄到车。

english: ~z~Hey, your contact better still want that bike 'cause I got it for him.
zh: ~z~嘿，你的上家最好不要跑单，因为我已经得手了。

english: ~z~Brother man, tell me where I can find a bike and I'll bring it right to you.
zh: ~z~好兄弟，告诉我哪里能找到摩托，我给你搞过来。

english: ~z~There's an Angel motorcycle ready for export, man. That was my end of the deal.
zh: ~z~这辆天使摩托已经准备好出口了。我这边完成了。

english: ~z~You got your Daemon, man. Put a stamp on it and ship that mother.
zh: ~z~恶魔到手了，兄弟。贴好邮票以后就装箱发货吧。

english: ~z~The guy's happy with the last one and he's hungry for another, man.
zh: ~z~老板对上次的车很满意，急着要下一辆呢，兄弟。

english: ~z~How 'bout that, man? I happened to come across a Nightblade right where you said.
zh: ~z~怎么样，兄弟？我碰巧在你说的地方看到一辆夜刃。

english: ~z~Big group of Deadbeats are taking it for a run down the old Alderney freeway.
zh: ~z~一大群死妈天使正骑着车在奥尔德尼的高速上兜风。

english: ~z~Looks like I'll be able to afford that hardware I was after. You did good, my brother.
zh: ~z~这下有钱买一直想要的大件了。干得漂亮，好兄弟。

english: ~z~Hey dude, your man isn't going to get his ride. Let him down easy.
zh: ~z~嘿，哥们。你老板拿不到摩托车了。让他放宽心吧。

english: ~z~Brother, Man, something's come up. I can't get the bike for you. Another time.
zh: ~z~兄弟，出了点意外。我没法替你弄车了。下次再说吧。

english: ~z~After delivering like you did before, this dude is happy to be in business with us, man.
zh: ~z~上次你完美交差，现在老板很乐意跟我们合作，兄弟。

english: ~z~Your man's gonna get some bad news, Angus. Tell him for me, will you?
zh: ~z~有一个坏消息要跟你老板说，安格斯。替我转告他好吗？

english: ~z~There's too many assholes in this city on bikes, my man. Which one can I deprive of his ride?
zh: ~z~城里骑摩托车的傻逼太多了，老兄。我该抢哪个人的车？

english: ~z~Shit, Angus, I'm in the bike stealing mood. Where am I gonna be able to find one?
zh: ~z~妈的，安格斯，我想偷摩托车了。你说去哪儿偷一辆好？

english: ~z~I've got something, Johnny. Please, for me, can you make sure it gets here?
zh: ~z~是有目标，强尼。给兄弟个面子，这次能保证弄到手吗？

english: ~z~How about that? You just keep knocking 'em out. And you know what? We got another bike lined up.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，你继续保持就行了。知道吗？又有新订单了。

english: ~z~Fuck if I can pronounce it, but a Ha-ha-coochie-koo is now in your possession, Angus.
zh: ~z~这名儿真念不来，那辆哈哈库奇库现在是你的了，安格斯。

english: ~z~Shit man, you could have told me I'd be driving a dirt bike. Anyways, I got that Sanchez for you.
zh: ~z~妈的，你早点说这次是山地车啊。总之，我拿到桑切斯了。

english: ~z~Bike's outside of the clubhouse, now all you need to do is get it out the country, Angus.
zh: ~z~车已经在会所外面了，接下来只需要出口国外了，安格斯。

english: ~z~I hate to split up a pair of lovebirds, but there's a couple taking it for a spin round Middle Park.
zh: ~z~我讨厌棒打鸳鸯，但是有对情侣正骑着它在中央公园兜风。

english: ~z~There's nothing available right now, Johnny. Call back soon and we'll see if we can find one.
zh: ~z~现在什么活都没有，强尼。过会儿再来问问有没有目标吧。

english: ~z~It's outside the Triangle Club in Bohan. Just bring it back to the House, OK?
zh: ~z~车在波汉的三角俱乐部外面。到手了就送回会所，懂了吗？

english: ~z~Angus, man, you and your contact are now the proud owners of a second hand bike.
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟，你和你的上家现在是二手车的荣誉车主了。

english: ~z~If I could use my legs, I'd jump for joy Johnny boy. Later on, Brother.
zh: ~z~要不是腿瘸了，我就高兴得跳起来了，强尼。之后见，兄弟。

english: ~z~Well, you didn't get the last one, but who cares, right? There's another one lined up for you.
zh: ~z~上次你就失手了，但也没关系。新的目标已经给你安排好了。

english: ~z~How about that, man. We haven't been able to find what we need. Call again soon and they'll be one.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，兄弟。我们还没找到目标。过段时间应该就有了。

english: ~z~Angus, brother. If you were going to export a bike to Japan, where might I be able to find it?
zh: ~z~安格斯，兄弟。假如你要向日本出口摩托，我得去哪儿找车？

english: ~z~We've got one for you, old friend. Just try to save me the hassle and deliver it this time.
zh: ~z~之前也找过你了，老朋友。这次就让我省点心，把车弄到手吧。

english: ~z~Hey Angus, hate to do this to a brother, but I can't go get you that bike. Sorry.
zh: ~z~嘿，安格斯，虽然不想这样，但我不能你搞到那辆摩托了。抱歉。

english: ~z~Johnny, man. We haven't been able to source any. It's only a matter of time though so call back.
zh: ~z~强尼兄弟，暂时没有看中的车。但早晚会找到目标的，有空再聊。

english: ~z~There's a guy detailing it like he knows it's for sale or something. Outside the tattoo guy in Alderney City.
zh: ~z~车主正在洗车，这不正好要帮他卖车吗。车在奥尔德尼市的纹身店外面。

english: ~z~We got one, man. This guy gets mad when they're not delivered, but fuck him, man, you're my brother.
zh: ~z~上次就找过你，兄弟。老板没拿到车气得暴跳如雷。但是去他妈的，你才是我兄弟。

zh: ~z~这不是失落帮的期货死人吗。

zh: ~z~用得着这样吗？太他妈危险了。

zh: ~z~和这个废物拉开些距离，行不？

zh: ~z~那你还不听老人言，马尔科姆。

english: ~z~The truce is dead, Loser. You're going down.

~z~Didn't your daddy teach you how to use fireworks? Shit!

zh: ~z~但是记住，万一出事，跟我无关。

zh: ~z~搞什么鬼，伙计？你他妈疯了吧？

english: ~z~Put the hammer down, alright. This Loser might be making a play.
zh: ~z~油门往下踩。这个废物可不是善茬。

english: ~z~Man, this war is fuckin' with my head. I can't take anymore of this shit.
zh: ~z~帮派战争搞得我头疼。我受不了了。

zh: ~z~是啊，我懂。你年纪大了，老爷爷，

english: ~z~I'm just an American - I like an American bike.
zh: ~z~我只是个美国人，更喜欢美式摩托。

english: ~z~With that it looks like we could take the whole fucking town out of business.
zh: ~z~我看拿它干烂整座城市都不是问题。

english: ~z~Malc's got us a connection Johnny.
zh: ~z~马尔科姆帮我们找了条路子，强尼。

english: ~z~Malc, DeSean, Johnny. Brother of mine.
zh: ~z~马尔科姆，德肖恩，强尼。我的兄弟。

english: ~z~Malc, I don't know where you got that shit man,
zh: ~z~马尔科姆，我不知道你从哪弄来的炸弹，

english: ~z~but one things for sure, we will have fun.
zh: ~z~但有一点可以确定，我们会玩得开心的。

english: ~z~I'm not in the mood to take another Lost MC scalp right now, let's move out.
zh: ~z~老子现在没心情给失落帮开瓢，我们走。

english: ~z~Man, I think the Losers are trying to pull something. We're heading back.
zh: ~z~失败帮的废物可能要耍花招。战术撤退。

english: ~z~Malc's got us a connection that ain't got nothing to do with bikes.
zh: ~z~马尔科姆给我们找的不是弄摩托的路子。

english: ~z~We got some Deadbeat vans to look after, boys.
zh: ~z~有几辆死妈天使的货车要解决，兄弟们。

english: ~z~Fuck the Losers. Show this asshole what the AOD can do.
zh: ~z~傻逼废物帮。让他见识下死亡天使的厉害。

english: ~z~Might even do them some good to get off their asses. Later on.
zh: ~z~偶尔给他们找点正事干也不错。一会儿见。

english: ~z~Is it me, or does that Loser look like he's in need of having his neck broken
zh: ~z~我看错了吗，那个废物是不是在自寻死路？

english: ~z~Let's make this Loser chase us some before we kick his ass. Come on.
zh: ~z~先遛会儿狗，待会儿再收拾这个废物。加速。

english: ~z~With this, we could take the Angels of Death out of business
zh: ~z~有了这个，我们就能把死亡天使干到不省人事，

english: ~z~Jim. Those Deadbeats got away from me, man. That's the way it goes.
zh: ~z~吉姆，我跟丢那群死妈天使了。事情就是这样。

english: ~z~There's some A.O.D. wagons that ain't gonna be round tomorrow, men.
zh: ~z~死亡天使的货车见不到明天的太阳了，兄弟们。

english: ~z~I'm good man - I don't need one of them hairdryers.
zh: ~z~我很好，兄弟。不需要他们的日系「吹风机」。

english: ~z~Deadbeats we're after are in vans, boys. Come on!
zh: ~z~我们要找的死妈天使在面包车上，兄弟们。上吧！

english: ~z~Give Terry or Clay a call if you ever need some help on club business.
zh: ~z~帮会的事哪里需要帮助，就给特里或科雷打个电话。

english: ~z~We're at war again, boys. That means we get to kill this Lost motherfucker.
zh: ~z~现在又开战了，兄弟们。不要放过失落帮的傻逼玩意。

~z~I'm not really dressed for this and you said it was urgent.

english: ~z~There are some bad people in here, sir. Please stand back.
zh: ~z~现在里面有坏人，先生。请勿靠近。

english: ~z~The bulls are gonna be real pissed if they catch us.

english: ~z~I'm guessing it wasn't you I got paid to bail out anyways.

english: ~z~Do me a favor and don't fucking eat me, back there.

zh: ~z~精明的政治家都知道什么时候止损。

english: ~z~A man's organs ain't meant to look like that. Come on.

zh: ~z~整天泡在铜臭味里面，你真的开心吗？

english: ~z~Get them out of there and we will make it worth your while.
zh: ~z~把他们救出来，报酬不会让你后悔的。

english: ~z~Cars, bikes... we are all machines.

zh: ~z~你爱咋学咋学，等我拿到钱再说，先生。

~z~You ain't talking your way outta this, Billy.
~z~Yeah it is. How the fuck did that happen?
~z~Tell the Warden this prison's gonna burn.
~z~The club's whole arsenal is an upsetting casualty.
~z~You can lock this place down now.
~z~My brothers, this is the last time.
~z~How many of you assholes are on the take, huh?
~z~Get the fuck out of here, you sadistic pricks.
~z~What? You waiting for a speech or something?
~z~Let the laundry guys out with the dirty uniforms.
zh: ~z~让这帮洗衣工把脏衣服带走。

english: ~z~We're just here to perform some capital punishment, people.
~z~Let's get in there, boys. Move. Move.
~z~Well I don't doubt that, Mr. Stubbs.
~z~Ain't you got rioting prisoners to worry about?
zh: ~z~你们不用担心暴动的犯人了？

english: ~z~Thinks he's going into the Witness Protection Program,
zh: ~z~然后自己加入证人保护计划。

english: ~z~Where the fuck is Billy Grey?
~z~Thinks he can help pin a major drug dealing ring on you
zh: ~z~准备给你和坐轮椅的兄弟扣上

english: ~z~The guy on the roof is down. We're cool.
~z~Treacherous fucking bastard. He went insane.
~z~You don't need to worry about that sniper no more.
zh: ~z~用不着再担心那个狙击手了。

english: ~z~Shit, if only Jim was with us now.
~z~Hey one more thing Stubbs...
~z~Clay, man. You're a good brother.
~z~Sorry screws, you ain't stopping us now.
~z~You screws are gonna die in this shithole.
zh: ~z~狗杂种就死在这个鬼地方吧。

english: ~z~We're the bosses here now. Get out.
~z~This place is about to descend into anarchy.
zh: ~z~这里就要陷入无政府状态了。

english: ~z~Johnny the jew. Come on, man.
~z~You're gonna have to comp these weapons. They're needed.
zh: ~z~这些武器就别收钱了，征用了。

english: ~z~we also had to be outlaws, to be maniacs,
zh: ~z~还要做法外狂徒，做危险人物，

english: ~z~If you get into trouble, you call me when you get there,
zh: ~z~要是遇到麻烦，打个电话给我，

english: ~z~Jonathan Klebitz, my brother.
~z~Dude, I'm sorry for spoiling the party.
zh: ~z~老哥，我很抱歉我打断了聚会。

english: ~z~and if he collars you, you'll do fifteen years
zh: ~z~万一被他得逞，你坐十五年牢，

english: ~z~Give up William Grey and we'll clear off!
zh: ~z~交出威廉 格雷，我们就撤退！

english: ~z~We got what we came for, thank you.
zh: ~z~咱要来拿的东西到手了，谢谢。

english: ~z~Alright, man. I'll take a look around.
~z~What the fuck is left of our chapter, boys?
zh: ~z~咱们分会他妈还有啥，兄弟们？

english: ~z~Best thing you can do - stay away from him.
~z~Shit, Terry. Bring my a first aid kit or something.
~z~Let's find this asshole and get outta here.
zh: ~z~找到这个混蛋，然后离开这里。

english: ~z~The laundry van is back. Open up.
zh: ~z~洗衣房的货车回来了，开下门。

english: ~z~Sniper on the roof, boys. Be careful.
~z~Clear this area. It's the first of many.
zh: ~z~清空这片区域，这只是第一步。

english: ~z~Funny joke, dude. You're no cop.
zh: ~z~真的搞笑，老哥。你又不是警察。

english: ~z~I'm not gonna ask how you got in here, brother.
zh: ~z~我不会问你是怎么进来的，兄弟。

english: ~z~Jim would tear through these bitches in a second.
zh: ~z~吉姆一眨眼就能把这些贱逼干翻。

english: ~z~We need to get more organised. Later on.
zh: ~z~咱们干活得更有条理点。再见了。

english: ~z~Warning. Security breach: that is not the laundry guy.
zh: ~z~警告。安保问题：那不是洗衣工。

english: ~z~Billy Grey sure does have a way of making mayhem.
zh: ~z~比利･格雷制造混乱的确有一套。

english: ~z~I think so. You've certainly seen me naked.
zh: ~z~我觉得是。我都对你坦诚相待了。

english: ~z~Yes. Well you've got a bit of a problem there sport.
zh: ~z~对。这才是你的麻烦所在，哥们。

english: ~z~Ten bucks says this asshole don't last the week.
zh: ~z~赌十块钱，这混蛋活不过一星期。

english: ~z~Shit. What happened to those fucking bikes, man.
zh: ~z~妈的，摩托车他妈的咋了，哥们。

english: ~z~I couldn't get at Billy. He's locked down too tight.
zh: ~z~我没逮到比利。他被看得死死的。

english: ~z~Rush them, you fearless motherfuckes. Come on.
zh: ~z~干翻他们，不怕死的弟兄们。来吧。

english: ~z~I'll go find Billy, boys. You get the bikes.
zh: ~z~我去找比利，伙计们。你们去拿车。

english: ~z~I'm gonna use this rocket launcher to blow the gate. Get ready!
zh: ~z~我要用火箭弹炸开大门了，准备好！

english: ~z~Get away from the entrance or you will be moved.
zh: ~z~离入口远点，不然你们就会被抬走。

english: ~z~There's one prisoner you don't gotta worry about now.
zh: ~z~现在这有个囚犯你们不用操心他了。

english: ~z~Terry, man. I need some help here. Gimme first aid.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们。救救我，我需要抢救。

english: ~z~Stay the fuck away. I just wanna kill Billy Grey.
zh: ~z~都滚一边去。我只想杀比利･格雷。

english: ~z~They'll either be dead or inside within a month or so.
zh: ~z~不出一个月就都下地狱坐大牢去了。

english: ~z~I'm cracking the gate with a grenade, keep back boys.
zh: ~z~我要用手雷把门炸开，伙计们后退。

english: ~z~We gotta get the uniforms cleaned. Open the gates for the laundry guys.
zh: ~z~我们有衣服要洗，给洗衣工开开门。

english: ~z~Let's go back to the house. There's one more thing we gotta do.
zh: ~z~回帮会所吧。还有最后一件事要做。

english: ~z~Good luck, man. You'll certainly need it.
zh: ~z~祝你好运，哥们。你肯定会用到的。

english: ~z~Intruder alert. That guy is not here for dirty laundry.
zh: ~z~入侵警告。那帮人不是洗衣房来的。

english: ~z~Get in position. I'm cracking the door with the grenade launcher.
zh: ~z~各就位。我用榴弹发射器把门炸开。

english: ~z~You never got it, did you? You never understood.
zh: ~z~你就没明白过，对吧？你从未明白过。

english: ~z~Dude, what the fuck, man? You're not even a cop.
zh: ~z~老哥，什么鬼，哥们？你又不是警察。

english: ~z~I appreciate this, man. It ain't gonna be easy.
zh: ~z~多谢了，哥们。这次不会那么容易的。

english: ~z~I thought it might come to this. Wait for us, brother.
zh: ~z~我就寻思会发生这事。等我们，兄弟。

english: ~z~Go ahead... let's put this place out of it's misery.
zh: ~z~走吧...给这片伤心地一个解脱吧。

english: ~z~Brotherhood don't mean nothing to you, Johnny.
zh: ~z~兄弟情谊对你来说屁都不是吗，强尼。

english: ~z~You're getting outta here, man? Aww haven't you enjoyed your time in the State's care?
zh: ~z~你要出狱了？吃国家住国家的不香吗？

english: ~z~I guess I just got too amped up before getting on in there. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~可能是我进去之前太激动了。再见了。

english: ~z~That is not the laundry guy, boys. We have an intruder.
zh: ~z~那人不是洗衣工，伙计们。有人闯入。

english: ~z~Open the gate. We got the guard uniforms going out for cleaning.
zh: ~z~把门开开，有警卫的制服要送出去洗。

english: ~z~Your brothers are here, William. Come and say 'hi'.
zh: ~z~兄弟们都来了，威廉。过来问个好吧。

english: ~z~Terry, Clay. Thanks for rolling with me.
zh: ~z~特里，科雷，感谢你们和我并肩战斗。

english: ~z~It ain't worth dying for the prisoners of Alderney State.
zh: ~z~为了奥尔德尼监狱的囚犯去死不值得。

english: ~z~I don't care what happens to me as long as we get Billy. Come on.
zh: ~z~只要能抓到比利，我在所不惜。来吧。

english: ~z~You're a waste of space, dude. Get out of there.
zh: ~z~你活着真是浪费资源，老哥。滚吧你。

english: ~z~Keep your heads, boys. We might just survive this.
zh: ~z~冷静点，兄弟们。说不定能扛过这波。

english: ~z~Hey, you two get the bikes. I'll finish things with Billy.
zh: ~z~喂，你俩去拿车。我跟比利做个了结。

english: ~z~Good to see you. Thanks for bringing these through.
zh: ~z~很高兴见到你。谢谢你把这些带过来。

english: ~z~We're here for a prisoner. Not you, guards.
zh: ~z~我们是来找囚犯的，不是你们，警卫。

english: ~z~Can everyone welcome our newest recruit? Open the gates.
zh: ~z~有人能迎接下我们的新人吗？把门开开。

english: ~z~You boys ready? I'm about to bust this open with the rocket launcher.
zh: ~z~准备好了吗？我要用火箭弹轰开大门了。

english: ~z~Yeah, well. You're a smart guy, you'll figure something out.
zh: ~z~这个嘛，你可是聪明人，会想到办法的。

english: ~z~Apparently he and a lot of his associates are under some serious observation.
zh: ~z~因为他和他的同伙都受到了严密的监视。

english: ~z~Lost MC, yeah. I'm glad I got you two with me.
zh: ~z~失落帮，好啊。很高兴和你俩并肩作战。

english: ~z~Dead bodies, burnt out brothers, and a clubhouse like a mausoleum.
zh: ~z~死的死，废的废，会所跟他妈灵堂一样。

english: ~z~You're not getting cash for these weapons, man. Blame Billy.
zh: ~z~这批家伙你回不了本了，哥们。都怪比利。

english: ~z~to be psychos and to be greedy. You know...
zh: ~z~变成疯子，变得越来越贪婪。你懂的...

english: ~z~Terry, Clay, come with me. You boys hold the gate.
zh: ~z~特里，科雷，跟我来。你们几个把门守住。

english: ~z~I'm about to introduce a pipe bomb to that gate. I hope you're all ready.
zh: ~z~我给大门来一发土制炸弹，你们准备好了。

english: ~z~We ain't paying for this stuff, Terry. It's being used for the Club.
zh: ~z~这批货就不给钱了，特里。失落帮征用了。

english: ~z~Fuck if I want it standing. It stands for bullshit, nothing more.
zh: ~z~还不如直接解散。屁意思没有，留着干嘛。

english: ~z~Something's happened to the laundry van. Someone go check it out.
zh: ~z~洗衣房的货车有情况，来个人去检查一下。

english: ~z~The laundry van doesn't look right. Get to the main gate.
zh: ~z~洗衣房的货车看起来不太对劲。到正门来。

english: ~z~Looks like the laundry guys forgot something. Open the gates.
zh: ~z~看起来这帮洗衣工忘记些啥了。把门开开。

english: ~z~That shit needed to be done. Billy needed to be shut up.
zh: ~z~攻打监狱是迫不得已，比利必须保持沉默。

english: ~z~If these assholes kill me, promise you'll get Billy, okay?
zh: ~z~就算我战死了，你们也要干掉比利，好吗？

english: ~z~You've thrown it all away, Johnny. Everything I built.
zh: ~z~强尼，你把我一手建立起的东西都败光了。

english: ~z~Okay, brother, let's go to church one last time then.
zh: ~z~好了，兄弟们，那让我们最后去一次教堂吧。

english: ~z~Terry, dude. You got some first aid or something? Bring it here.
zh: ~z~特里，老哥，你有急救用品啥的吗？拿过来。

english: ~z~Man, am I happy to see you boys and these bikes.
zh: ~z~哥们，见到大伙们和这些摩托车，我很高兴。

english: ~z~Right, okay, so you're there. Use your imagination.
zh: ~z~对，好的，那你在这了。开动你的想象力吧。

english: ~z~We should regroup and hit that shit again. Sorry man, later on.
zh: ~z~咱得重整旗鼓再搞一波，打扰了哥们，再见。

english: ~z~We're just here for William Grey. Save your fucking selves.
zh: ~z~我们只是来找威廉 格雷的。你们好自为之。

english: ~z~You won't find salvation here, my friend. It's too late for that.
zh: ~z~你无法在此得到救赎，我的朋友。为时已晚。

english: ~z~We got to clear these screws outta here or they'll take us from behind.
zh: ~z~必须干掉这帮杂种，不然就等着腹背受敌吧。

english: ~z~There's a chance we might make it outta here boys. Let's fuckin' do it.
zh: ~z~说不定我们能活着出去，兄弟们。加油干吧。

english: ~z~Well here you are, you fork-tongued bastard. I've been looking for you.
zh: ~z~找到你了，狼心狗肺的混蛋。我一直在找你。

english: ~z~And there's currently very large walls and armed guards between me and him.
zh: ~z~我和他之间可是隔了铜墙铁壁和真枪实弹啊。

english: ~z~Bad luck. You guards are standing between me and a sonofabitch I wanna kill.
zh: ~z~太衰了。你们这帮警卫碍着我杀那个贱逼了。

english: ~z~I'm gonna take out Billy. Bring the bikes around so we can get outta here.
zh: ~z~我去干掉比利。你们把车骑来，完事我们就走。

english: ~z~I hate that bastard more and more every day. So long.
zh: ~z~我一天天的越来越讨厌这些混账东西了。再见。

english: ~z~Is there a ramp you can use? Can you get hold of a guard's uniform?
zh: ~z~你有没有好使的小技俩，能骗来件警卫的制服？

english: ~z~We're in the safest place in the city. Providin' there ain't a riot, that is.
zh: ~z~我们在城里最安全的地方，如果没有暴乱的话。

english: ~z~Sure, man. Let me get a look at what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~可以的，哥们。咱们去看看你说的是啥东西吧。

english: ~z~Society's forgotten about these guys. We can do what we like to 'em.
zh: ~z~社会早就把这群人遗忘了。咱们想干啥就干啥。

english: ~z~Someone get to the main gate. The laundry van looks suspicious.
zh: ~z~来人去一下正门。洗衣房的货车看起来很可疑。

english: ~z~You could have just come in visiting hours like all my other friends, Jonathan.
zh: ~z~你可以像其他人一样在拜访时间来的，乔纳森。

english: ~z~Billy may have helped to build our club, but he sure as shit ripped it apart.
zh: ~z~比利对帮派建设有所贡献，但毁也是毁在他手里。

english: ~z~Step away from the gates.You're not on the visitor's list, you're not coming in.
zh: ~z~离大门远点。来访名单上没见着你，你不能进来。

english: ~z~Clay wouldn't be dead if Billy had just taken his time like a man.
zh: ~z~要是比利该爷们的时候不娘们，科雷就不会死了。

english: ~z~I'll forgive him the insults and injuries, but I can't forgive him that.
zh: ~z~我可以原谅他的冒犯中伤，但破坏帮派无法原谅。

english: ~z~Stay away from the gate, brothers. I'm about to blow it open with a grenade launcher.
zh: ~z~离门远点，兄弟们。我准备用榴弹发射器把门轰开。

english: ~z~Let's meet Angus at the house, guys. This thing is nearly finished.
zh: ~z~咱们去帮会所找安格斯吧，伙计们。这事快结束了。

english: ~z~Terry, man, I'm sorry. Things got too much for me in there - I fuckin' bailed.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，我很抱歉。说来话长，我他妈开溜了。

english: ~z~You brothers hold this position. Me, Terry, and Clay are gonna go get this asshole.
zh: ~z~你们几个守住这里。我、特里和科雷进去找那个混蛋。

english: ~z~Oh, man. I'm thinking you're thinking we don't have a choice. We'll come meet you.
zh: ~z~哦哥们，我就知道你觉得咱们没得选。咱们见个面吧。

english: ~z~Fuck, but that van was bound to be volatile, wasn't it? Later, man.
zh: ~z~操，但那货车早晚会出问题，不是吗？再见吧，哥们。

english: ~z~You know, I'm really lost as to what that's got to do with me, sport. I did all I could for you.
zh: ~z~你懂的，我真不懂这和我有啥关系，老兄。我尽力了。

english: ~z~Jesus, come on. This is meant to be your field of expertise. Best of luck, sport.
zh: ~z~天哪，来吧。这是你大显身手的地方。祝你好运，老哥。

english: ~z~There's no sanctuary here William. The rules don't apply to your kind.
zh: ~z~这里可不是庇护所，威廉。那些规则在你身上并不适用。

english: ~z~Brothers, don't let anyone in or out. Terry, Clay, we're going in.
zh: ~z~兄弟们，别让任何人进出大门。特里，科雷，咱们进去。

english: ~z~Terry, man, we got to pay our friend Billy a visit. He's been talking.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，得去拜访下咱们的朋友比利了。他在告发。

english: ~z~He's dead, brothers. Now all we need to worry about is getting out of here alive.
zh: ~z~他死了，兄弟们。现在我们该操心的是怎样活着离开这。

english: ~z~Funny thing is, five years ago he woulda lead the charge into Alderney State himself.
zh: ~z~可笑的是，放五年前他还会亲自带队杀进监狱灭口叛徒。

english: ~z~Terry, man, I've had some bad news. Billy's been singing from his cellblock.
zh: ~z~特里，哥们，有个坏消息。比利还在牢房里活蹦乱跳的。

english: ~z~Clay, dude, we got some hard work to do. We got to pay Billy a visit in the pen.
zh: ~z~科雷，老哥，我们要干些重活了。咱去监狱拜访下比利吧。

english: ~z~This gang is fucked all to hell right now, but I'll love you brothers until I die.
zh: ~z~虽然现在帮派彻底完了，但我会爱你们几个兄弟一辈子的。

english: ~z~Welcome to Hell, rookie. Keep your back to the wall and your finger on the trigger.
zh: ~z~欢迎来到地狱，菜鸡们。背部保持靠墙，手指搭在扳机上。

english: ~z~Man, I miss Jim. He was one princely son of a bitch. The best thing this gang ever had.
zh: ~z~天，我想吉姆了。帮里就属他最高洁，他是失落帮的宝物。

english: ~z~Angus, Billy's gone, man. Our chapter's dead. We got to give it a funeral.
zh: ~z~安格斯，比利死了，哥们。咱们帮也完了。我们办场葬礼吧。

english: ~z~Let's get outta here, boys. Billy stopped talking bullshit for good.
zh: ~z~咱们走吧，伙计们。比利再也不会为了得到好处开口扯淡了。

english: ~z~Maybe there's a disguise somewhere, or maybe you can get him from your side of the fence,
zh: ~z~也许你可以在某处躲起来，或者也可以从你这边过去拿下他，

english: ~z~If you've learned anything at all from me, I hope it's how to cope with a crisis.
zh: ~z~要是你从我身上学到了啥的话，我希望是如何应对一场危机。

english: ~z~Killing everyone around me isn't an option, Mr. Congressman. Goodbye and thank you.
zh: ~z~杀死我身边的人这事不是我能选的，议员先生。再见，谢谢你。

english: ~z~hell, maybe you can jump the wall on that bike of yours. Good luck, sport.
zh: ~z~见鬼了，也许你可以骑你的摩托车跳墙出去。祝你好运，老兄。

english: ~z~So, ummm, Stubbs. Billy's in a maximum security institution, how am I meant to do this?
zh: ~z~那，呃，斯塔布斯。比利可是在守卫森严的监狱啊，我该咋办？

english: ~z~I'm amazed there are still sickos loose in this town when I look at all these freaks.
zh: ~z~当我看到这些奇葩的时候，我很惊讶这城里居然还有这么些怪胎。

english: ~z~I ain't been smugglin' nothin' into Alderney State, officer. It's all for personal consumption, man.
zh: ~z~警官，我可没走私东西进奥尔德尼州，这些都是我自用的，哥们。

english: ~z~Well, Billy isn't going to be talking to anyone about us. We can clear on outta here.
zh: ~z~好了，比利再也不会开口提到我们任何人了。咱们收拾收拾走吧。

english: ~z~Bring Clay, bring all the fucking firepower you got, and meet me at the Alderney State Correctional.
zh: ~z~叫上科雷，手头的家伙全他妈带上。立刻来奥尔德尼州立监狱找我。

english: ~z~This is a zoo, newbie. Don't feed the animals, don't rattle the cage. You should be fine.
zh: ~z~这是个动物园，新来的。不要投喂动物，不要触碰笼子，否则罚款。

english: ~z~Well, we lost Terry. Another fucking casualty to Billy Grey's junkie ego bullshit.

zh: ~z~勉强维持温饱，突然间我有了一大笔钱。

zh: ~z~不是。问题是，你会发现怎么着都一样，

zh: ~z~我知道。实在荒唐，瞧瞧我现在的样子。

english: ~z~He was like my kid brother - he was like my family.
zh: ~z~他就像是我的弟弟，他就像是我的家人。

zh: ~z~只有一台老电视，一些旧衣服，没有书，

english: ~z~No need to explain to me. I am a long way from a virtuous man.
zh: ~z~没必要跟我解释。我也离道德高地远着呢。

english: ~z~Let me tell you man, I never wanted to be no drug dealer.
zh: ~z~我告诉你，兄弟，我从来没想过要当毒贩。

english: ~z~You know what, Niko, I always thought of myself as a good person.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，尼克，我一直觉得自己是好人。

english: ~z~Man, we gonna have some fun... at least we better.
zh: ~z~兄弟，我们去快活快活吧...最好能快活。

english: ~z~I guess I don't believe in second chances, in redemption.
zh: ~z~我想我不相信有第二次机会，也不相信救赎。

english: ~z~But at the time, fifteen years ago or more now, shit was crazy.
zh: ~z~但在当时，少说十五年前吧，一切都很疯狂。

english: ~z~My childhood, I saw my dad beat my mom. I saw her try so hard.
zh: ~z~我小时候，看着我爸打我妈。看着我妈硬撑。

english: ~z~but I could add up and I could scare people, so I started slinging dope.
zh: ~z~但我会算数，也会威胁别人，就开始倒货了。

english: ~z~My pop's dead, and I didn't feel a damn thing. Shit is fucked up.
zh: ~z~我爸死了，我什么感觉都没有。真他妈糟糕。

english: ~z~You realize that life don't mean shit man. You teach yourself to stop caring.
zh: ~z~你会发现生活没有意义。会让自己漠不关心。

english: ~z~Everyone. People only out for one thing - themselves.
zh: ~z~所有人。人们只为一件事考虑——他们自己。

english: ~z~The world's tough, you lived hard... it's always the same shit with you.
zh: ~z~人世不公，生活不易...你一直都是这样的。

english: ~z~Made me fucking miserable, paranoid, angry, and I wasn't even smoking the shit!
zh: ~z~反而让我痛苦、猜疑、愤怒，没嗑药都这样了！

english: ~z~It's strange man, you start off worrying about all the usual shit.
zh: ~z~很奇怪，兄弟，进去后会担心各种平常的事情。

english: ~z~about the awful food, then that shit ceases to matter.
zh: ~z~担心恶劣的伙食，之后这些担忧就不复存在了。

english: ~z~"Expect the worst, then you can only be pleasantly surprised.",
zh: ~z~「做最坏的打算，就不会有令人失望的结果。」

english: ~z~When I got arrested, they offered me all kinds of deals -
zh: ~z~我被抓到的时候，他们给了我各种各样的诱惑：

english: ~z~Man I'm lost, prison really messes you up, man.
zh: ~z~兄弟，我很迷茫。监狱真的会让人迷茫，兄弟。

english: ~z~This is twenty years ago - they didn't encourage black policemen back then...
zh: ~z~这是二十年前了，那会儿还不兴黑人警察...

english: ~z~I've seen a lot of friends kill each other. You're not so very different.
zh: ~z~我见过许多自相残杀的朋友。你俩不是唯一一对。

english: ~z~He broke them over her back. Fucking animal. I was glad when he died.
zh: ~z~抄起来就往妈背上打。这畜生死的时候我很高兴。

english: ~z~with money, broke, happy, unhappy, it don't mean shit.
zh: ~z~大富大贵、两手空空，幸福与否，全都没有意义。

english: ~z~About some maniac trying to fuck you up the ass, about some other maniac who wants to slash your throat,
zh: ~z~担心这个疯子想爆你菊花，那个疯子想让你断气，

english: ~z~And after a while, you stop hurting, and that ain't the problem at all.
zh: ~z~再然后，就没有了烦恼，而这完全不是问题所在。

english: ~z~I never did it. If I had done, life wouldn't have made sense.
zh: ~z~我从没接受过。如果我告密了，人生就没有意义了。

english: ~z~Nothing to eat, nowhere to live, and suddenly I was clearing fifty Gs a week.
zh: ~z~没东西吃，没地方住，突然我一星期就能赚五万块。

english: ~z~But I know somebody talked to send me down. Guess people gotta live with theirselves.
zh: ~z~但我知道有人把我供出来了。做人还是要讲义气的。

english: ~z~In prison they had me doing all this therapy bullshit. Discuss your childhood, you know?
zh: ~z~我在监狱里接受了各种心理治疗。比如讨论我的童年。

english: ~z~Yeah, no, I know, man, I know. But they do.
zh: ~z~是的，不会，我知道，兄弟，我知道。但是有人这样。

english: ~z~Felt good, for a while. Because I came from nothing. We didn't have shit.
zh: ~z~让我很爽，爽了好久。因为我白手起家，什么都没有。

english: ~z~Yeah, you learn to cope with the environment, make the best of it, learn to scare people away from you,
zh: ~z~对，你要学会适应环境、利用环境，学会吓退那些人，

english: ~z~I mean you, we, did what had to be done, but it's a shame.
zh: ~z~我是说你、我们，做了不得不做的事，但实在是耻辱。

english: ~z~I know. It's ridiculous. I need some medication or some shit. Take the edge off.
zh: ~z~我知道。这很可笑。我可能需要药物治疗，减轻痛苦。

english: ~z~I missed my chance when I started slinging them drugs. Life got too complicated.
zh: ~z~从我开始贩毒的那时起就没有机会了。人生太复杂了。

english: ~z~I know. You have high moral standards. For a crack dealer and killer, I mean.
zh: ~z~我知道。你的道德标准很高，对于一个毒贩兼杀手来说。

english: ~z~I can't decide if all the people whose lives was ruined by crack were my fault,
zh: ~z~我不知道。我说不清那些吸毒者家破人亡是不是我的错，

english: ~z~He tried to rip off some local dealers. I remember the night they killed him.
zh: ~z~他居然会去骗本地的毒贩。我还记得他遇害的那个晚上。

english: ~z~I remember once she got pops some golf clubs, 'cause his friend had some,
zh: ~z~我记得因为爸的朋友有高尔夫球杆，妈也给爸弄了一袋，

english: ~z~I didn't pay any attention at school, never, apart from fighting and beating kids up -
zh: ~z~我在学校就没怎么学过，从没学过。一直都在跟别人打架。

english: ~z~the reading bit left me cold, now I can't go for no job because I can't fucking read.
zh: ~z~阅读能力就离我而去了，现在我不识字，根本找不到工作。

english: ~z~And look where that ended me up. A long stretch, no family, nothing.
zh: ~z~瞧我现在什么样子。刚蹲完监狱，没有家庭，什么都没有。

english: ~z~No, I said let's hang out. If we have fun, it is up to you as much as me.
zh: ~z~没有，我说的是出去转转。真想要快活，不止看我还得看你。

english: ~z~Things shouldn't fucking change. Things hurt man. They hurt. Why you so cold?
zh: ~z~世道不该变的。这世道很伤人，太伤人了。你怎么这么冷血？

english: ~z~He wanted to be in the game, but he didn't know the rules. We was closer than brothers.

zh: ~z~兄弟，我最想要的不是什么工作，而是家庭。我想当一个父亲。

english: ~z~I remember when I met him - he was always a bright kid, but he had no street knowledge.
zh: ~z~我还记得刚见到他的时候，这孩子向来聪明，但不懂道上的规矩。

english: ~z~I always tried to live by a code. To be a man who could look at his self in the mirror.
zh: ~z~我一直想做一个有原则的人，做一个能够正视镜子中的自己的人。

english: ~z~I saw eight of my best friends killed in a ditch. You are not the only man to have seen bad things.
zh: ~z~我眼睁睁看着八个好朋友在沟里被杀。你不是唯一经历过痛苦的人。

english: ~z~I may be fucking nothing in this life, but there is one thing I ain't, I ain't a fucking snitch.
zh: ~z~我这辈子可能什么都不是，但有一点我敢肯定，我他妈的不是告密者。

english: ~z~There was knock at the door. My mom cried, but I don't think she meant it, I hope she didn't.
zh: ~z~有人在外面敲门。我妈在里面哭，但我想她不是故意的，但愿她不是。

english: ~z~No. I wanted to be... shit, this'll make you laugh... you know what I wanted to be?
zh: ~z~没有。我其实想当...妈的，你听了别笑啊...知道我想当什么吗？

english: ~z~But it's hard, man. I don't know how to fix that shit. I don't know how to care no more.
zh: ~z~但这很难，兄弟。我不知道要怎么恢复正常。我不知道怎么拾起关心了。

zh: ~z~当然了，兄弟。我不会让任何人不给我好脸色看的。

zh: ~z~你相信罗曼赌博上瘾了吗？你觉得他的问题很大吗？

zh: ~z~他还没对我做什么，但迟早啊。真的，迟早啊...

english: ~z~Him speak de truth, man, him know de way, him understand tings properly, you know?
zh: ~z~他述说真理，兄弟，他通晓方向，他对事物理解到位。

zh: ~z~或许是个问题，也许他只需要清掉脑子内的一些东西。

english: ~z~Boy, him back a Jam Dung. Cotching a de sun, man. Couldn't take de city no more.
zh: ~z~兄弟，他回牙买加了。明早之前就到，受不了自由城了。

english: ~z~It's his paranoia, man. He's smoking too much of that shit. You got to tell him to calm it down.
zh: ~z~他又犯妄想症了吧。他哈草哈过头了，你得劝他冷静啊。

english: ~z~That could be de best ting, you know, Niko. Best ting for all of us, seen?
zh: ~z~这可能是最好的解决方案了，尼克。我们最好的方案，懂？

english: ~z~Being a dread, being a rasta, is all about getting respect and ting, you know?
zh: ~z~就比如我们牙买加人，一切都离不开获得别人的尊重懂吧？

english: ~z~Jah know him, he can throw his money to dem con men, you know, star. Him a real idiot, you know?
zh: ~z~主知道，他真的会把所有钱都赌掉的。他真的白痴，懂吧？

english: ~z~Seen, seen. There's always people around fe lend de money to a man, especially if de man have a habit like Roman.
zh: ~z~懂了懂了。放债的人到处都是，最喜欢找罗曼这种赌鬼下手。

english: ~z~Grandad was here back inna the days. Him tell Badman, no badda bawl, don't be feisty.
zh: ~z~爷爷前几天来过这里。他告诉巴德曼，别再吸了，不要再反抗了。

zh: ~z~是啊。Bobby Konders太棒了懂吧。他的选曲超赞。

zh: ~z~尼克，尼克，我那哥们罗曼近况如何？还是把所有的钱都拿去赌吗？

english: ~z~The herb make Badman's head work in all type of ways it shouldn't be working. He think his friends are after him.
zh: ~z~那种草对巴德曼的作用全是预料之外的。他觉得他的朋友都想杀他。

english: ~z~Any money I get I, you know me spend upon sisters or sensemillia. I don't throw my money away, you know.
zh: ~z~反正我赚到的钱不是拿去泡妹就是拿来哈草了，我可不会拿钱打水漂。

english: ~z~Sometimes I think he would put her on the table if he had the chance. He doesn't hold onto much for long.
zh: ~z~有时候我觉得如果有机会，他真的会把她押上去。他这人管不住手的。

english: ~z~I ain't saying nothing to him face. You no call no alligator long mouth til you pass him, bredren.
zh: ~z~我放弃跟他当面沟通了。没见到鳄鱼你都不知道鳄鱼嘴到底多长，兄弟。

english: ~z~Blacking up don't affect I and I de same way, you know. I an' I a chill dread. I don't like that kass kass in the way Badman do.
zh: ~z~哈草对我的作用不一样懂吧。我还很清醒。我不想像巴德曼那样精神失常。

english: ~z~Don't nobody treat you wit de respect you know you deserve, you know, Niko. All of life be about is respect, sight?
zh: ~z~没人能在你有头有脸的时候不尊重你，尼克。生活的本质就是尊重，明白吧？

english: ~z~The hydroponic and artificial and made with chemicals and produced with chemicals. Covered with pesticides... it's wrong.
zh: ~z~水培的，人工的，化工合成的，添加化学成分的。沾满农药的...这样错了。

english: ~z~Make you tink that tings matter, when all that matter is that the sun come up and we have good time and laughter and ting, seen?
zh: ~z~让你觉得某些事很重要，但最重要的是太阳升起时我们还能照常谈笑风生，懂？

english: ~z~Mallorie a fine daughta, an him lucky fe have her, you know? Hopefully he won't gamble her away as well.
zh: ~z~玛洛丽是个好姑娘，遇上她是罗曼的福气。希望他不会把她也当成赌注押出去。

english: ~z~Not all work, work, work, y'know? We got to ease up from time to time, to see how the world turns, you know what I'm saying?

zh: ~z~像咱俩这样的疯子兄弟，我们不听条子的。

zh: ~z~确实，雅各布，是这样的。依我来看也是。

zh: ~z~你来到自由城以后，有见过不疯狂的人吗？

zh: ~z~你为什么要背井离乡，是被什么给毁了吗？

zh: ~z~我们应该一起跟条子对着干，而不是自己内部掐架。

zh: ~z~我觉得既然他们的年岁停止了，那我也不配继续下去。

zh: ~z~条子查我们，黑帮杀我们，生活不容易，这是肯定的。

english: ~z~It us a keep de world moving and jamming. Is us, and we make de world I-tal.
zh: ~z~是我们让世界运作、停止。是我们，我们让世界存在。

zh: ~z~整个牙买加都为这可卡因钱贪红了眼。变成了互相内斗。

english: ~z~No - cocaine is a bad business, but this whole life is a bad business.
zh: ~z~对，可卡因不是什么好东西，但这种人生也不是好东西。

english: ~z~People say it be the rules, the laws that make the world work, you know? But maybe it ain't dat way.
zh: ~z~人们说是规则、法律让世界运作。不过可能不是那样的。

english: ~z~Maybe it's this madness, this crazy shit, that make de world go round.
zh: ~z~也许就是这种疯狂、这种病态狂热，维持了世界的运转。

zh: ~z~我倒希望我的祖国是因为可卡因这样的好理由才发动战争。

english: ~z~I mean, I'm trying not to worry too much about the things that are messed up. Relax, you know, have some fun.

english: ~z~That's just dem downpressors in grey suits, making us waste our life filling out forms and ting.
zh: ~z~就是那些穿灰衣的压迫者，让我们浪费生命去填表啥的的。

english: ~z~Rum is I-tal. It made from the earth and it put you in tune with it. It's a natural ting.
zh: ~z~朗姆酒就是了。它源于大地，让你回归大地。是自然的东西。

english: ~z~Seen, Niko. you, me, Badman, we all crazy living de life we live.
zh: ~z~你看，尼克。你、我、巴德曼，我们都疯狂地过着疯狂的日子。

english: ~z~We gonna have a whole heap of relaxation. A whole bunch of chilling it out. Of silence, yes? Seen?

english: ~z~Rastas be fighting one another, when they should be cotching and smoking de herb together. Badman included.
zh: ~z~好兄弟们互相干架，本来他们应该在一起哈草的，巴德曼也是。

english: ~z~All good, Jacob, all good. Or at least, I'm trying not to think too much about things.
zh: ~z~挺好，雅各布，挺好。不过至少，我尽量不在各种事情上想太多。

english: ~z~Man me right hand man, but him big inna de cocaine ting and him want bring it in from jam dung, seen? And it no good.
zh: ~z~我是副手，但他沉迷可卡因，还想从牙买加弄过来，懂？这样不好。

english: ~z~Herb be the most spiritual, y'know, messa man. You smoke it, it open your mind to be what's going on in the earth.
zh: ~z~大麻是最精神的，很劲。抽一口，思维就开阔了，与大地融为一体。

english: ~z~You tink things like dat, but, you don't smoke trees. You need a spiritual edge, you know. You take anything?

english: ~z~No one I liked. I might have robbed some sane people, but I did not stick around for conversation.

english: ~z~I look at Badman and tink what could be turning him into the man he's becoming. He's being ruined, you know, Niko?
zh: ~z~我看着巴德曼在想，他为什么会变成现在这样。他已经被毁了懂吧，尼克。

english: ~z~Alright, Rum be a spiritual ting. It wake up your senses and point dem out to de world around you.
zh: ~z~好吧，朗姆酒是精神上的好东西。能唤醒你的感觉，让你感知周围的世界。

english: ~z~Him want to be inna de mafia business, big time rude boy, all de time want mash up de place and broke down de place, seen?

zh: ~z~懂了。伏特加也是源于大地。在牙买加我们喝朗姆酒，在你老家你喝伏特加。

zh: ~z~是啊，我懂。我们是得找点乐子，应该享受小小的宁静，趁着地球还在转多享受一会儿。

zh: ~z~尼克堂弟，怎么了？开我的出租也行。我不开车。

english: ~z~That was fun NB. Hit me up if you want to hang out again soon.
zh: ~z~玩得很开心，NB。你要是还想出来玩就打给我。

english: ~z~Niko, you lazy bastard. All your screwing around has made us miss the show.
zh: ~z~尼克，你个懒鬼。到处乱转转得我们错过演出了。

english: ~z~Niko, why you so impatient? We could have stayed until the end.
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么这么急？我们可以待到表演结束的。

english: ~z~Get ready to watch a master at work. I am to darts what Perseus is to clothing.
zh: ~z~等着看大师级技术吧。我就是飞镖界的神之子服饰。

english: ~z~American fast-food. Just think we could have the exact same meal in the Old Country.
zh: ~z~美式快餐。要是在故国也能吃到一样的饭菜就好了。

english: ~z~This is a good idea. It will remind us how lucky we are to have gotten out of the Old Country.
zh: ~z~这是个好主意，好让我们知道能离开故国有多幸运。

english: ~z~Niko, I could suck a Bleeder Burger dry. This is my favorite.
zh: ~z~尼克，我能把一整个吸血鬼堡吸干。这是我的最爱。

english: ~z~I did not expect an opportunity to kick your ass at darts. How could I refuse?
zh: ~z~没想到还有机会在飞镖上把你干爆。我怎么会拒绝呢？

english: ~z~We are the perfect match, cousin. A tie. That is unheard of, no?
zh: ~z~我们是完美的对手，堂弟。平局了。闻所未闻不是吗？

english: ~z~Late NB, not acceptable. Make it up by driving me in one of my cabs.
zh: ~z~迟到了，NB，不能这样。开我的出租车将功补过吧。

english: ~z~Niko, I love that place. Is hard to believe but man cannot live on titties alone.
zh: ~z~尼克，我爱这地方。不过男人居然不能只靠奶子生存。

english: ~z~Oh cousin, I salivate at the thought of all the naked flesh in there. Let's go.
zh: ~z~噢，堂弟，光是想到里面赤裸的肉体我就垂涎欲滴了。

english: ~z~Fucking Vlad. I cannot help but think of that scumbag in that place.
zh: ~z~狗逼弗拉德。我在这儿不由自主地就会想到那个小人。

english: ~z~What amazing burgers, I feel another chin growing on my face. Do you see it?
zh: ~z~汉堡太棒了，觉得自己又长了一层下巴。你看见了吗？

english: ~z~Niko, why you want to leave, cousin? We could have at least seen the end.
zh: ~z~尼克，你为什么想走了，堂弟？我们至少可以看完的。

english: ~z~Nothing hits the spot like a Burger Shot, cousin. My fifth chin is all thanks to these guys.
zh: ~z~吃得饱汉堡我喜欢吃，堂弟。我的五层下巴多亏了他们。

english: ~z~Niko, we are evenly matched. There can clearly be no winner when two cousins such as us compete.
zh: ~z~尼克，我们打平了。果然我们兄弟二人是分不出胜负的。

english: ~z~Niko, this is just the place. I hear it is filled with girls with low self esteem.
zh: ~z~尼克，我就想来这里。听说这里有很多不知廉耻的女孩。

english: ~z~You see, aren't you pleased you are not in Old Country where that is all that is on.
zh: ~z~你看，只要不是在故国演出，你不就能看得很开心了吗。

english: ~z~Niko. You had lost before we even got here. Darts is about having the mental edge
zh: ~z~尼克，来美国前你也老输给我。飞镖需要的是心理优势。

english: ~z~Niko, how could you expect to beat someone as supremely skilled as me? It was foolish
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么可能打赢我这样球技精湛的人呢？太蠢了。

english: ~z~You keep your cousin waiting, is a disgrace NB. Now, we must find a car.
zh: ~z~让你堂兄一直等着，太可耻了，NB。现在先找辆车吧。

english: ~z~You must be in a hurry, Niko. It does not take long to finish a game of darts with your cousin.
zh: ~z~你是有急事吧，尼克。陪堂兄投完一局飞镖又花不了多久。

english: ~z~Hey, NB. We can take one of the cabs if you like. You mind driving?
zh: ~z~嘿，NB。需要的话我可以把出租车借你开。你来开车吧？

english: ~z~What a nice place this is. If I didn't know better I would have thought you were trying to fuck me.
zh: ~z~这家店好啊。要不是我更懂行，我就要以为你是想睡我了。

english: ~z~I could have beaten you with my eyes closed, cousin. I'm sorry but I'm that much better.
zh: ~z~我闭着眼睛都能打败你，堂弟。不好意思，我就是比你强。

english: ~z~That was quick, Niko. You would almost think you didn't want to sit down and converse with your cousin.
zh: ~z~太快了，尼克。感觉都来不及和自己的兄弟坐下来聊上几句。

english: ~z~Niko, how could you want to leave so early. You haven't been hanging out at Hercules Nightclub or something have you?
zh: ~z~尼克，怎么这么快就走了。你该不会是大力神夜店的常客吧？

english: ~z~Old Vlad's bar. We shall see if he can add our drinks to the rest of my debt.
zh: ~z~老弗拉德开的酒吧。应该问他能不能把喝的酒记在我的账上。

english: ~z~It was a great restaurant but do not expect me to sleep with you now, cousin. I am not one of your girlfriends.
zh: ~z~餐馆很不错，不过别指望我跟你睡，堂弟。我不是你女朋友。

english: ~z~I'm sorry for beating you cousin, but I'm the better player. That is it.
zh: ~z~很遗憾，我打赢你了，堂弟，我才是更强的选手。就是这样。

english: ~z~Ahh, Comrades. We shall raise our glasses to the late Vlad while we're here.
zh: ~z~啊，Comrades酒吧。在店里的时候得敬弗拉德一杯。

english: ~z~Niko, this is meant to be a very funny man. Anything you do not understand, you ask me and I will explain.
zh: ~z~尼克，他说的其实都很有趣。哪里没听懂尽管问，我会解释的。

english: ~z~We have truly made it, Niko. The cousins Bellic eating in the finest dining rooms in Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我们真的成功了，尼克。贝利克兄弟在自由城最好的餐厅吃饭。

english: ~z~Niko, I don't like to stop things half way though. Ask any lady, I always satisfy.
zh: ~z~尼克，我不喜欢半途而废。找个女人问问，我总是能满足她们。

english: ~z~I have been wanting to see this act, cousin. My friend saw this and he pissed in his pants.
zh: ~z~我一直都很想看这场演出，堂弟。我朋友看过，看得他笑尿了。

english: ~z~Bowling, Niko. This is a surprise. You know that I like to beat you though. Let's do it.
zh: ~z~保龄球，尼克。这倒是个惊喜，你也知道我喜欢打败你。来吧。

english: ~z~Niko. Were you afraid of playing out the game for fear that I would beat you? Do not be scared of defeat, cousin.
zh: ~z~尼克，你是不是怕被我击败才中途退出的？别害怕失败，堂弟。

english: ~z~Niko, you call yourself a criminal but the real crime would be coming home without a lady tonight. Let's go.
zh: ~z~尼克，你自称是罪犯，但今晚不带个女人回家才是罪过。走吧。

english: ~z~You must have happy memories of your time here with the late Mr. Faustin. Isn't that right, cousin?
zh: ~z~你在这儿肯定有和福斯汀先生一起的美好回忆，对不对，堂弟？

english: ~z~Niko, when will you learn? Your cousin is better than you at pool. You are no match.
zh: ~z~尼克，你什么时候才能明白？你堂兄比你更擅长台球，你太弱了。

english: ~z~It is a shame that Mr. Faustin your Russian gangster friend, is dead. The place is going to pot.
zh: ~z~可惜你的俄国黑帮朋友福斯汀先生已经死了。这地方也要衰败了。

english: ~z~Niko, we have left now but those titties will inhabit my dreams for many nights to come.
zh: ~z~尼克，虽然我们出来了，但那些奶子会在我的梦里住很多晚上的。

english: ~z~NB, you are making an important business owner wait for you. I am generous though. You can drive me in one of my cabs.
zh: ~z~NB，你居然让大老板等你，不过我原谅你。你可以开我的出租车。

english: ~z~Niko, you are good with a pool cue. You can teach me about that while I teach you about women.
zh: ~z~尼克，你拿上台球杆还挺行的嘛。我教你泡女人，你教我打台球吧。

english: ~z~Cousin, you are late. For that you are driving. I will let you use a cab if you want to though.
zh: ~z~堂弟，你迟到了，所以你来开车。需要的话我可以把出租车借给你。

english: ~z~I like that place, now that Vlad is gone I can really appreciate the atmosphere.
zh: ~z~我喜欢这家酒吧，现在弗拉德不在了，我才能真正享受店里的氛围。

english: ~z~Niko, that was fun. I was at a place belonging to Mikhail Faustin and I was not even shot.
zh: ~z~尼克，玩得很开心。我在米哈伊尔･福斯汀的地盘，还没有挨枪子儿。

english: ~z~This is real entertainment, cousin. It's hard to find performances of this premium quality, even on Burlesque.
zh: ~z~这是真的好看，堂弟。这种质量的表演就算在滑稽剧场也是只此一家。

english: ~z~You see that girl who was eyeing me, I would have sealed that deal if I didn't have to see Mallorie later.
zh: ~z~看见那个偷瞄我的妹子了吗？要不是跟玛洛丽有约会，我就去泡她了。

english: ~z~We must settle this some other way. Maybe we should compete over a woman. Clearly not Mallorie though.
zh: ~z~我们想法子决出胜负吧。比如说比赛泡妞，不过我不会用玛洛丽比的。

english: ~z~We shall drink and remember the old days. I'll buy the first round. That's if I remembered my wallet.
zh: ~z~我们该喝几杯，回忆下过去。前两杯我请。如果我还找得到钱包的话。

english: ~z~It is a shame we did not meet Vlad in there. I wanted to tell him what a good loanshark he is.
zh: ~z~没在这儿见到弗拉德真是可惜。我还想告诉他他这个放贷的有多好呢。

english: ~z~Niko, you are really moving up in the world, no? I tell you we are going to the top when you arrive.
zh: ~z~尼克，你这越来越高端了啊。你刚来的时候我就说过我们会走上顶峰。

english: ~z~I wait and I wait and now you come without even a car. Well, let us find one.
zh: ~z~我等啊等等啊等，结果现在你连辆车都没有就来了。算了，找辆车吧。

english: ~z~You are taking me to Perestroika. I hope that Mr. Faustin gives you an employee discount?
zh: ~z~你带我来Perestroika啊。福斯汀先生会不会给你员工特价？

english: ~z~Niko, good game. You are good at bowling and I'm good with the ladies. We both have skills.
zh: ~z~尼克，打得不错。你很擅长保龄球，我很擅长对付女人，都有一技之长。

english: ~z~Niko, you're pretty good. It's clearly those Bellic genes you've got. If we were a team we'd be unstoppable.
zh: ~z~尼克，你真棒，完全表现了你的贝利克家基因。我们组队就无人能敌了。

english: ~z~Oh cousin, I wish I could get angry at you for being late but you're too loveable. Let's go.
zh: ~z~噢，堂弟，你实在是太可爱了，就算迟到我也生不了你的气。我们走吧。

english: ~z~Faustin's Club, eh? So this is where he hangs out when he's not shooting innocent men in their stomachs.
zh: ~z~福斯汀的俱乐部，嗯？这就是他没往无辜平民肚子上开洞时候待的地方吗。

english: ~z~Niko, you said you'd be here earlier. No matter, you will drive us. If you like you can use a cab.
zh: ~z~尼克，说好了你来这儿等我的。算了，你来开车。需要的话可以开我的车。

english: ~z~Ok we can fill up with good American food. I'm in the mood for a hormone and chemical hit
zh: ~z~好了，可以享用美味的美国食物了。我现在就想来一顿激素和添加剂套餐。

english: ~z~Do you see... do you see something in my eye. I am not seeing so good. Must be how you beat me.
zh: ~z~你看见...看见我眼睛里的东西了吗？我看得不太清楚，这才被你捡漏了。

english: ~z~That would have been even more fun if I hadn't been fearing for my life. Your Russian gangster friends are scary.
zh: ~z~要不是担心自己的人身安全，我会更享受一点的。你的俄国黑帮朋友太可怕了。

english: ~z~There is only one thing I'm better at than playing pool, Niko. And, as a man, you won't get to see me in action.
zh: ~z~我只有一件事是比打台球更擅长的，尼克。但是身为男人，你是无福亲眼见到了。

english: ~z~I worry for you, cousin. How could any red blooded male want to leave all those lovely titties so soon?
zh: ~z~我很替你担心啊，堂弟。血气方刚的男人怎么会这么快就离开那些可爱的奶子呢？

english: ~z~There are better things to do on a pool table than play pool. I could show you the things I'd do to a bored housewife on one.
zh: ~z~台球桌上比起打台球还有更好的事情能做。我可以让你见识下我会对寂寞人妻做的事情。

english: ~z~Thanks, Niko. See you then.
~z~Alright then, I might get cab or something.
~z~Roman, it's Niko. I need a cab.
~z~Okay cousin, if you have no time you have no time.
~z~Sure Roman, I'll come and get you in the next hour.
zh: ~z~当然，罗曼，我一小时内来接你。

english: ~z~Niko, you are just fooling with me. Thanks a lot.
zh: ~z~尼克，你是存心耍我吧。多谢了。

english: ~z~Thank you, cousin. That could be very useful in this city.
zh: ~z~谢了，堂兄。在这里会很有用的。

english: ~z~That is cool, cousin. We do this on another occasion.
zh: ~z~没关系，堂弟。我们可以改天再约。

english: ~z~Wait right there, NB. I'm dispatching one now.
~z~Roman, is your cousin. Any chance of getting a cab?
zh: ~z~罗曼，是你堂弟。能不能派辆车过来？

english: ~z~Thank you for picking me up, cousin. Will you take me home?
zh: ~z~感谢你来接我，堂弟。能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. We shall do this another time. Later on.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。我们改天再约吧。回见。

english: ~z~Sure, Niko. We can always do this another time. I see you then.
zh: ~z~好的，尼克。总会有机会的。之后见。

english: ~z~That's cool, cousin. Call again if you actually do need one.
zh: ~z~没关系，堂弟。下次需要了记得找我。

english: ~z~Cousin, I am no longer able to do darts with you. Sorry.
zh: ~z~堂兄，我没法来跟你玩飞镖了。抱歉。

english: ~z~Cousin, our drunkenness will have to wait. Something has happened.
zh: ~z~堂兄，我们的酒虫该等等了。突然有事。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. We shall rain check this for a different occasion.
zh: ~z~好的，尼克。我们就推迟到别的时间吧。

english: ~z~You are a life saver, cousin. I'll see you soon.
zh: ~z~你真是我的救星，堂弟。我们一会儿见。

english: ~z~Cousin, I can't play no games with you just now. Sorry.
zh: ~z~老兄，我现在真没法陪你打游戏。抱歉。

english: ~z~Anything for you, NB. It should be there soon.
zh: ~z~有需要你就直说，NB。应该马上就到。

english: ~z~Hey Roman, you couldn't send a cab for a cousin in need could you?
zh: ~z~嘿，罗曼，能不能给你堂弟派辆车过来？

english: ~z~Niko, I am too sick to walk. Please get me a car.
zh: ~z~尼克，我现在走不了路。拜托给我弄辆车。

english: ~z~I am sorry, cousin, but I must cancel our bowling.
zh: ~z~很抱歉，堂兄，但我们不能去打保龄球了。

english: ~z~Roman, you need to play a single player game. I can not hang out.
zh: ~z~罗曼，你只能自己去玩了，我陪不了你了。

english: ~z~You need walk no longer. There's a cab coming to you.
zh: ~z~你用不着再徒步了，有辆车往你这儿来了。

english: ~z~Cousin, you must dine alone. I can no longer join you.
zh: ~z~堂兄，你只能自己吃饭了。我不能陪你了。

english: ~z~Cousin, I'm getting out of hospital. You couldn't pick me up could you?
zh: ~z~堂弟，我出院了。能麻烦你来接我一趟吗？

english: ~z~I am sorry cousin, but I have no time. I'll see you soon though.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂兄，但我没空。还是改天再见吧。

english: ~z~Thanks for the ride, Niko. Call me soon, yes.
zh: ~z~谢谢你送我回家，尼克。记得联系，好吗。

english: ~z~You will leave your own cousin to walk home sick. Okay, Niko.
zh: ~z~你居然让刚出院的堂兄走回家。行吧，尼克。

english: ~z~Alright, cousin. Maybe another time you will feel like being part of the family.
zh: ~z~好吧，堂弟。下次想和家人团聚了记得找我。

english: ~z~Niko, I'm being discharged from the hospital. Would you mind picking me up?
zh: ~z~尼克，医院让我出院了。你介意来接我一趟吗？

english: ~z~Roman, my cousin, I'd really like a cab if you could send one to me.
zh: ~z~罗曼，好堂兄，我很希望你能给我派辆出租车。

english: ~z~I can do that for my cousin, I shouldn't take longer than an hour to get there.
zh: ~z~自家兄弟怎么不接，应该不用一个小时就能到。

english: ~z~You are a good cousin. Thank you for collecting me. I need to go home now.
zh: ~z~真是个好堂弟，感谢你来接我。我现在要回家了。

english: ~z~Roman, I cannot go look at titties with you. I have to do something else.
zh: ~z~罗曼，我不能陪你去看奶子了。有别的事情要做。

english: ~z~Sorry, cousin. I cannot see the show with you no more. Hope that's cool.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂兄，我不能和你去看表演了。希望没事。

english: ~z~Cousin, you will be shooting pool alone today. Do not place bets, okay?
zh: ~z~堂兄，今天你只能自己打台球了。不要赌钱，好吧？

english: ~z~Roman, sorry but I cannot bowl with you anymore. Another time.
zh: ~z~罗曼，很抱歉，但我不能陪你打保龄球了。改天吧。

english: ~z~Don't worry cousin, I have hot bitches that are begging me for my company, see you soon.
zh: ~z~别担心，堂弟，很多性感的贱人求我陪呢，之后见。

english: ~z~Sorry, Roman. Something has come up. I cannot throw darts with you now.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼。突然有点急事，没法跟你去玩飞镖了。

english: ~z~Niko, get your invalid cousin a car. He cannot walk in this state.
zh: ~z~尼克，给你行动不便的堂兄找辆车。他现在没法走路。

english: ~z~Sorry, Roman. I cannot play pool with you anymore. I have another plan.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼。我没法来跟你打台球了。有别的事要做。

english: ~z~Sorry Roman, you may have to drink alone. I can no longer join you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼，你可能要一个人喝酒了。我没法陪你了。

english: ~z~Hey Roman, sorry to fuck you round but I don't need no cab no more.
zh: ~z~嘿，罗曼，很抱歉给你添麻烦了，但我不需要打车了。

english: ~z~Sorry, Roman. I can't do it right now. Can't you get Mallorie to do it?
zh: ~z~抱歉，罗曼，我现在来不了。你就不能让玛洛丽来接吗？

english: ~z~Roman. I can't eat with you. This may help you lose some weight.
zh: ~z~罗曼，我没法和你一起吃饭了。说不定还能帮你减减肥。

english: ~z~Cousin, I hope you are not forgetting your family in this city? We do this on different occasion.
zh: ~z~堂弟，你应该没忘了自由城的家人吧？我们以后再约吧。

english: ~z~Roman, I'm sorry but something has come up and I can no longer pick you up from the hospital.
zh: ~z~罗曼，很对不起，但我突然有急事，不能来医院接你了。

english: ~z~Niko, I am sorry but nothing is available. You must call back another time.
zh: ~z~尼克，很抱歉，但是现在没车了。你还是过会儿再打过来吧。

english: ~z~Sorry, cousin. I cannot join you at the tittie bar. You can still go by yourself though.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂兄。我没法陪你去奶子吧了。不过你还是能自己去。

english: ~z~You are kind for giving me a lift, Niko. Call your sick cousin soon, okay?
zh: ~z~你能来接我真好，尼克。记得给你体弱的堂兄打电话，好吧？

english: ~z~Sorry cousin, but I don't have no cabs right now. You must call again later.
zh: ~z~抱歉，堂弟，但我现在也没车可派了。你得待会儿再打过来了。

zh: ~z~如果说雷很狡猾的话，迪米特里是另一个境界。

zh: ~z~狗逼迪米特里，没骨气的玩意儿。他耍了我们。

english: ~z~I did not kill those men to have this stuff stop me getting the cash.
zh: ~z~我都杀到这儿了，哪会让这种东西阻止我拿钱。

english: ~z~If I was you, I'd go and get the money off them. It has to be on the site.
zh: ~z~要我说，就去把他们的钱抢过来。钱肯定备好了。

english: ~z~You think you can get in this work for an easy buck but you end up in deep shit every time.
zh: ~z~你以为能轻轻松松赚大钱，结果每次都是一团糟。

english: ~z~How come everything we get into starts off simple and ends up real complicated?

zh: ~z~没有什么是不能试试的，我们就要抓住他了，快来。

zh: ~z~需要你拿上那些H，我联络到俄国人了，他们有下家。

zh: ~z~都不敢想迪米特里那边会怎么样。我给吉米打个电话。

zh: ~z~嗯，吉米 P安排这次交易的时候我见过他。我不太信任这个人。

english: ~z~They will have to. I am not a slave.
zh: ~z~他们必须得放我走。我可不是谁的奴隶。

english: ~z~Good people like you. That has to count for something.
zh: ~z~比如你这样的好人。这肯定是有意义的。

english: ~z~Do you think that the men you've been dealing with will let you walk off into the sunset?
zh: ~z~你真觉得之前的雇主会让你安然隐退吗？

english: ~z~I feel like it's time to move on, start living my life right.
zh: ~z~也差不多该向前进了，开始好好过日子。

english: ~z~Will you fire a gun into the air as your cousin walks down the aisle?
zh: ~z~你会不会在你堂兄走下红毯时朝天开枪？

english: ~z~I might steal the collection box if the mood takes me though.
zh: ~z~要是想的话，我可能会把募捐箱给偷走。

english: ~z~Yeah. How are you about that? Do you miss him?
zh: ~z~记得。那次之后你还好吗？你想念他吗？

english: ~z~A gift from Dimitri Rascalov.
zh: ~z~迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫要送你一份礼物。

english: ~z~I want to surround myself with good people, not bad ones.
zh: ~z~我想和好人处在一起，不想和坏人一起。

english: ~z~No, there won't be any gunfire at this wedding.
zh: ~z~不会的，这场婚礼一定不会有任何硝烟。

english: ~z~The problem is that it's difficult to tell which one the man you are with is.
zh: ~z~但难就难在区分不了身边的人是哪一种。

english: ~z~Gotta get you outta here now, police dem soon come.
zh: ~z~你现在最好赶紧离开，警察很快就要来了。

english: ~z~But, do you think the men you've dealt with will just let you leave and walk into the sunset?
zh: ~z~但你真觉得之前的雇主会让你安然隐退吗？

english: ~z~So, how do sociopaths behave at weddings?
zh: ~z~那，反社会分子参加婚礼时会有什么表现？

english: ~z~The rational half of me says get away from him - protect yourself.
zh: ~z~理性的一面告诉我要远离他，保护好自己。

english: ~z~but this was the church where we had my brother's funeral.
zh: ~z~而且我哥哥的葬礼就是在这个教堂举行的。

english: ~z~Because... no matter how stupid I think this is, I'm willing to take a chance on you.
zh: ~z~虽然我觉得这样做很蠢，但我愿意试一试。

english: ~z~But the other half says he's good, he can be redeemed.
zh: ~z~感性的一面说他是好人，还有救赎的机会。

english: ~z~Somebody call an ambulance! Call a fucking ambulance!
zh: ~z~谁去叫辆救护车啊！妈逼的叫辆救护车啊！

english: ~z~Willing to take a chance on the possibility that you can walk away from the craziness.
zh: ~z~愿意搏一搏你离开这种疯狂生活的可能性。

english: ~z~I'll look after you, Kate. I promise I'll protect you.
zh: ~z~我会照顾好你的，凯特。我保证会保护你的。

english: ~z~I've had some trouble telling right and wrong apart before.
zh: ~z~我之前就有过一段难以区分人的好坏的经历。

english: ~z~Yeah? Do you think that that is the answer for everyone then?
zh: ~z~是吗？你不觉得对所有人都可以这么回答吗？

english: ~z~Yeah, I'll mug any nuns that are hanging around the church as well.
zh: ~z~是的，我还会把教堂周边的修女给打劫一通。

english: ~z~Well it was the right thing to do. Are you coming to Roman's wedding?
zh: ~z~不过这是正确的事。你来参加罗曼的婚礼吗？

english: ~z~Good luck, Niko. I really hope you can walk away.
zh: ~z~祝你好运，尼克。我真的希望你能就此脱身。

english: ~z~After the war, I was involved in a life I felt was not for me.
zh: ~z~战争结束后，我被迫过着一种不适合我的生活。

english: ~z~I thought that when you do the work that you do, that people get their hooks into you.
zh: ~z~我觉得一旦干了这行，就会被那些人牢牢栓住。

english: ~z~When I think about him I just wish that he'd been happy in his life.
zh: ~z~想到他的时候，我只能希望他这辈子有快乐过。

english: ~z~I am lucky that he is still happy to be part of my family.
zh: ~z~我已经很走运了，他还为自己是我的家人而高兴。

english: ~z~I have tried to separate myself from it. I am ready to try to be good.
zh: ~z~我已经和过去划清界限了。我准备好做个好人了。

english: ~z~I'll wait for you here, Niko. I'd like to get to know the groom.
zh: ~z~我就在这儿等你，尼克。我挺想跟新郎认识认识。

english: ~z~Thanks for coming to get me. You're looking really nice. Shall we go to the church?
zh: ~z~谢谢你能来接我，你看起来很帅。我们去教堂吧？

english: ~z~Don't be stupid. I'm not coming to this wedding for the free nibbles.
zh: ~z~别傻了，我又不是为了蹭吃蹭喝才来参加婚礼的。

english: ~z~You know, it's not that weird to think that there might be some shooting at this wedding,
zh: ~z~说真的，会认为这场婚礼可能不太平静也很正常。

english: ~z~You're talking about your criminal exploits as if they are a thing of the past.
zh: ~z~你这话说的跟自己的案底都是很久以前留下的一样。

english: ~z~Hey, Kate. I took your advice. I cut my connections with that man.
zh: ~z~喂，凯特。我听取了你的建议。和那个人切断了联系。

english: ~z~Well maybe they are. I don't want to be involved with the men I have been involved with.
zh: ~z~的确是很久以前吧。我不想再和之前那些人扯上关系。

english: ~z~Are you prepared to say goodbye to the fast cars, the drugs, the violence, the cheap women?
zh: ~z~那你有准备好向跑车、毒品、暴力和骚货们告别了吗？

english: ~z~Someone without his good naturedness and optimism would have been broken by what has happened to him.
zh: ~z~换一个没他那么积极乐观的人，早被这些遭遇搞崩溃了。

english: ~z~How do I know that you're right for me? How do I know that I won't get hurt?
zh: ~z~我怎么知道你是不是那个他？我怎么知道自己不会受伤？

english: ~z~Don't worry, man, me find Dimitri me call you. Leave!
zh: ~z~别担心，兄弟，一找到迪米特里我就给你打电话。快走！

english: ~z~You won't regret this, Kate. I'll look after you. I'll protect you.
zh: ~z~你不会后悔的，凯特。我会照顾你的，我会保护好你的。

english: ~z~-Ah man, yes I did it! ~n~-Wonderful, wonderful...
zh: ~z~－啊，各位，我做到了！~n~－太好了，太好了...

english: ~z~Oh, I didn't realize it was going to be such a casual service. Shall we go to the church?
zh: ~z~哦，没想到你会穿得这么随意。我们是不是该去教堂了？

english: ~z~It would be easier to be happy if I was with the right person though.
zh: ~z~不过要是跟对的人在一起的话，我应该更容易得到幸福。

english: ~z~Because I'm going to the wedding of a couple I've never met with a man I barely know.
zh: ~z~我要和一个不太熟悉的男人一起，去参加陌生人的婚礼。

english: ~z~Tell me, have these good people been hurt by what you've had to do?
zh: ~z~告诉我，这些好人有没有因为你不得不做的事情受到伤害？

english: ~z~I now pronounce you husband and wife, you may kiss the bride.
zh: ~z~现在，我正式宣布你们二位结为夫妻，你可以亲吻新娘了。

english: ~z~He might be your only family, but he's not the only one who cares about you, Niko.
zh: ~z~或许他确实是你唯一的家人，但不是唯一关心你的人，尼克。

english: ~z~She told me to leave it. I thought I had. I thought it was over!
zh: ~z~她告诉我要放下过去，我以为我放下了。我以为都已经结束了！

english: ~z~I was good once, I was a normal kid who got sucked into a war he didn't believe in
zh: ~z~我也曾是个好人，是一个被自己不认同的战争吞噬的普通孩子，

english: ~z~I'm really proud of you, Niko. It must have been really hard to turn down the money and stick to your principles.
zh: ~z~我真的很为你骄傲，尼克。拒绝那笔钱的诱惑坚持原则一定很不容易。

english: ~z~Easy, easy, easy... I your brother, man, easy. Calm down, man, calm down.
zh: ~z~放松，放松，放松...你兄弟我在，老兄，放松。冷静，老兄，冷静。

english: ~z~-Get out of here! Go!~n~-Go on, we take care of this, man. Leave!
zh: ~z~－快离开这儿！走啊！~n~－走吧，这里我们会解决的，兄弟。快走！

english: ~z~I'm Irish, Niko. We're a people known for strong whiskey, mystics and Catholicism.
zh: ~z~我可是爱尔兰人，尼克。我们民族以够劲的威士忌、秘传仪式和天主教著称。

english: ~z~Yo, yo, yo... Niko, Niko, Niko. Calm down man, calm down man. Easy, easy.
zh: ~z~哟，哟，哟... 尼克，尼克，尼克。冷静兄弟，冷静兄弟。放松，放松。

english: ~z~Niko, what are you doing? I told you to dress up. We will wait. Go and change, quickly.
zh: ~z~尼克，你搞什么啊？跟你说了要穿好点吧。我们等你，赶紧去换套衣服，快点。

english: ~z~-Niko, Niko, get up man, get up man, get up.~n~-Ohh... oh, man!
zh: ~z~－尼克，尼克，快起来兄弟，兄弟快起来，起来啊。~n~－哦...哦，老哥！

english: ~z~Maybe. The right person can make your life wonderful in the same way that the wrong one can ruin it.
zh: ~z~也许吧，对的那个人能让你的生活有多美好，错的那个人就能让你的生活有多糟糕。

english: ~z~This is a good idea. I think you'll look so much better in a suit or something. It's Roman's big day.
zh: ~z~这是一个好主意。我觉得你穿正装之类的看起来会帅很多。今天是罗曼大喜的日子。

english: ~z~-Yes, go on man go on. We have to leave man, just leave.~n~-You have to go...
zh: ~z~－对，走吧，老兄，走吧。我们都得离开，老兄，赶紧走人。~n~－你必须得走了...

english: ~z~Look at you in those fancy clothes, Niko. Trying to upstage the groom on his wedding day? Let's get me married.
zh: ~z~瞧瞧你穿的这套花哨衣服，尼克。你是想在婚礼上抢我这个新郎的风头吗？进去开始婚礼吧。

english: ~z~Yay!... Yeah!... Congratulations cousin!... Mwah!... Alright!... Yes... Thank you... Thank you all for coming!... Yes!... Okay!
zh: ~z~耶诶！ 耶！ 恭喜你，堂兄！ 么！ 好啦！ 好了 谢谢 感谢各位的到来 好！ 好的！

english: ~z~Hey!... Yes!.... Yeah!... Congratulations cousin!... Thanks for coming!... Alright, yes, okay!... Yes, we are married!... Niko, mwah, mwah...
zh: ~z~嘿！ 好！ 耶！ 恭喜你，堂兄！ 感谢你的到来！ 好的，好呀，好啊！ 对，我们结婚了！ 尼克，么么...
