zh: ~z~有一天我发现了这个博客网站。

english: ~z~Tell me about it, I walk down the street.
zh: ~z~这还用你说。我经常出去逛街，

english: ~z~Doesn't your father pick up your credit card tabs?
zh: ~z~你的信用卡不还是你爸在还吗？

english: ~z~Fuck easy. I'm an artist.
zh: ~z~太他妈容易了。我可是艺术家。

english: ~z~I won't let consequences hold me back from the moment.
zh: ~z~后果是无法阻止我活在当下的。

english: ~z~And that's because my life has so much in it and it's so much
zh: ~z~因为我的人生非常丰富，比任何人

english: ~z~Yeah, and I couldn't stand to be away from Liberty either.
zh: ~z~对，而且我的生活也离不开自由城。

english: ~z~You live! You don't think! And that's beautiful.
zh: ~z~你活着！还不思考！实在太美妙了。

english: ~z~I don't think I'd get let into a college party or Maisonette 9.
zh: ~z~大学派对和9号豪宅我好像都去不了。

english: ~z~It's as much a part of me as an arm or a leg.
zh: ~z~现在它已经是我如同手足的一部分了。

english: ~z~I'm going to be famous. But not just for no reason, seriously.
zh: ~z~我会出名的，但不是无故出名，真的。

english: ~z~I mean, I will go out and order the most expensive thing on the menu. And I'll buy
zh: ~z~出门吃饭我会点最贵的菜，还会给自己

english: ~z~City life is weird, you know? Well, tell me about yourself.
zh: ~z~都市生活很怪，对吧？你介绍下自己吧。

english: ~z~Niko, if you had to classify yourself, what would you be?
zh: ~z~尼克，如果要给自己归类，你是哪种人？

english: ~z~I'm writing a novel which is going to be so much deeper than the stuff on the blog.
zh: ~z~我正在写小说，比我写的博客还要深刻。

english: ~z~Letting them see pieces of your life but not the whole picture.
zh: ~z~只让他们窥探你生活的局部而不是全部。

english: ~z~I'm sorry. Man, we're going to have the best time.
zh: ~z~对不起。天。还是继续享受欢乐时光吧。

english: ~z~I mean, some people from here have a tough time getting work too.
zh: ~z~我是说，就连美国本地人都有就业危机。

english: ~z~Okay well that's sick. You don't get what I'm saying. I mean -
zh: ~z~那可太糟了。你没听懂我的意思，我是说，

english: ~z~Really amazing thoughts, about people and the world and stuff.
zh: ~z~真的是很奇妙的想法，关于人与世界之类的。

english: ~z~I'm from Middle Park West, I've never thought about leaving Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我来自中央公园西，从没想过要离开自由城。

english: ~z~everything myself at Anna Rex spring/summer collection.
zh: ~z~买下Anna Rex店里春夏款的所有衣服。

english: ~z~Because I have these thoughts, yep, and I know they're important.
zh: ~z~因为我有各种想法，对，而且这些想法很重要。

english: ~z~Have you been reading my blog? It was really funny this week.
zh: ~z~你有没有在看我的博客？这周的更新超有趣的。

english: ~z~College parties are just for losers who don't get let into Maisonette 9.
zh: ~z~大学派对是给进不了9号豪宅的失败者准备的。

english: ~z~It's a good thing you don't want to go out and kill people all the time. There might be some serious consequences to that.
zh: ~z~幸好你没有想着出门杀人，不然后果就很严重了。

english: ~z~It fell through - but, to be honest, cinema is dead. I mean, it's so old fashioned.
zh: ~z~吹了。不过说实话，电影已死。这种载体过时了。

english: ~z~richer and deeper than everyone else's. I mean, they relate to me because I'm better than them.
zh: ~z~都要丰富、深刻。我比他们强，他们才会亲近我。

english: ~z~So, this blog you write. Is that all you want to do?
zh: ~z~那，你在写的这个博客，就是你想做的一切了吗？

english: ~z~Nor did I... that was a joke. I wasn't planning to.
zh: ~z~我也没有...刚才是开玩笑的。我就没打算写书。

english: ~z~I mean, I'll do that myself and I won't rely on men to get me what I need.
zh: ~z~就是说，我自己就会这么做，不会等着男人送上来。

english: ~z~Or a mouth, telling everyone who cares to listen about your life.
zh: ~z~或者说是嘴，可以向所有愿意倾听你的生活的人讲述。

english: ~z~That is so right. People need to hear about me. I really touch people.
zh: ~z~太对了，人们是得了解了解我。我真的很能打动别人。

english: ~z~It's good that you're happy in your home. My home was not so comfortable.
zh: ~z~能在老家幸福生活是件好事。我的老家就没那么舒服了。

english: ~z~You cannot leave your apartment in this city without spending money so I guess you need to work.
zh: ~z~在这里出了家门就不可能不花钱，我想因此才需要工作。

english: ~z~I was trying to figure out why it was that I related to you so easily. That must be it.
zh: ~z~我有想过为什么会这么轻易地就接近你。肯定就是这样。

english: ~z~Some people make it difficult, yes? What do you want me to know about you?
zh: ~z~总有人来找你麻烦，对吧？你想让我了解你的哪些方面？

english: ~z~the situation is weird. This is the twenty-first century. It's so now what we're doing.
zh: ~z~但就是感觉很奇怪。这就是21世纪，这就是我们的现状。

english: ~z~Yes, he's amazing. But don't worry. Not all of the guys I date have to be intellectuals.
zh: ~z~对，他很棒。不过别担心，跟我约会的人也可以不是才子。

english: ~z~I know. But it was also true and that's what this guy told me that I was dating last night.
zh: ~z~我知道，这话没错，昨晚跟我约会的那个男人也是这么说的。

english: ~z~I like variety. Anyway, did I tell you? I'm making a movie.
zh: ~z~各种口味我都会试试。对了，有跟你说过吗？我正在拍电影。

english: ~z~Not like one of those idiot girls - I mean I know them they are all jealous of me because I'm an individual.
zh: ~z~我和那些白痴女不一样，我也知道她们都嫉妒我的特立独行。

english: ~z~Well, that's not the point. I mean, yep, narrative is dead. It's done. It's all about living.
zh: ~z~那不重要。我是说，对，叙事已死，死透了。重要的是生活。

english: ~z~The thing about me is, I'm interesting. People feel like they can talk to me and open up.
zh: ~z~我这人吧，还挺有趣的。跟我聊天的人都会自然地敞开心扉。

english: ~z~Thanks... yep - I'm an intellectual. I mean, I haven't gotten going yet, but I am.
zh: ~z~谢了...对，我是个才女。虽然还不完全是，但也确实是。

english: ~z~I haven't had any trouble. It's not just because I've never had a paying job, because I'm an intellectual.
zh: ~z~我倒没遇上。不只是因为我从未上过班，也是因为我的才华。

english: ~z~I think bits of it, they are so beautiful and sad and... they make me cry.
zh: ~z~我略微想了想，它们太美好、太悲惨了...都让我哭出来了。

english: ~z~But I'm not an airhead. I mean I could be - I'm fun enough - but I'm also really intelligent.
zh: ~z~但我不是傻瓜。我确实能是，因为我够有趣，但我其实很聪明。

english: ~z~Yes - I always knew I'd be a film maker. I have a very strong visual sense.
zh: ~z~确实，我一向认为自己会成为电影人。我的视觉设计能力很强。

english: ~z~Not really what I meant. So, you got a fancy college degree that gets you noticed?
zh: ~z~跟我说的不太一样。对了，你是不是有个引人瞩目的大学学位？

english: ~z~He told me what was so amazing about my writing was that it was funny and tender and heartbreakingly original,
zh: ~z~他告诉我我的文章妙就妙在趣味、柔情与令人心碎的真实经历，

english: ~z~I went to college, I was going to be a psych. major but I found it too easy.
zh: ~z~我是上过大学，本来主修心理学的，不过我觉得这个太简单了。

english: ~z~People really relate to me. They can take a bit of my life and see it as their own.
zh: ~z~人们真的很亲近我。他们可以品味我的人生，当成自己的一部分。

english: ~z~It's going to be amazing. It's going to be the great American novel, only a movie.
zh: ~z~拍出来一定很棒。这将是一部伟大的美国小说，只是以电影呈现。

english: ~z~you ain't the boss of me and he says if he was he'd sack me and then I start crying.
zh: ~z~你又不是我老板。他说要是他是我老板，就炒了我，然后我就哭了。

english: ~z~That don't matter. A pretty girl like me should be famous. And rich. Like in the magazines.
zh: ~z~那都不重要。我这样的漂亮女孩就该出名，就该富贵。像杂志里写的那样。

english: ~z~I was partying the other night in Bungalow 9 and I had my nails done, and I went shopping with the girls.
zh: ~z~我在9号平房的派对玩了一夜，然后去做了指甲，还和闺蜜一起去逛了街。

english: ~z~Yes. Jill van Crastenburg was just in before me. Oh, and Tony McTony.
zh: ~z~没错，吉尔･万･克拉斯顿堡当时就在我面前。哦，还有托尼･麦克托尼。

english: ~z~I had them done. By my girl, Lucille, she does lots of celebrities, you know?
zh: ~z~我专门去做的。找我女友露西尔做的，她给很多名人做过指甲，你知道吗？

english: ~z~I know. I hate them. Listen do you think my teeth need straightening? Or whitening?
zh: ~z~我懂。我讨厌他们。听着，你说我要去做牙齿矫正吗？或者做个牙齿美白？

english: ~z~Not bored. Just unfulfilled. I mean, it's great helping people, but you don't get thanked.
zh: ~z~不是腻了，只是没什么成就感。我是说，帮助别人是好，但你得不到感谢。

english: ~z~Yes. He says you only want one thing and I say I don't care, I like having fun,
zh: ~z~真的。他说你想要的东西只有一个，然后我就说我不在乎，我喜欢享受乐趣。

english: ~z~Ouch.
~z~Great!
~z~No problem.
~z~I guess so.
~z~Carmen was saying something,
~z~We're having fun.
~z~Issues? Fuck you.
~z~Screw you, asshole.
~z~Don't do that again.
~z~Screw you, Niko.
~z~Watch it, Carmen.
~z~Okay, thanks for the vote of confidence.
~z~Man I am drunk as shit.
~z~Sure, I am. I really appreciate that.
~z~This is good. I'm enjoying myself.
~z~I don't need to deal with you here as well.
~z~I don't know, maybe you've got issues.
~z~Guess where Carmen going to hit you fucking next?
zh: ~z~你猜接下来卡门要怎么打爆你？

english: ~z~If you cared you would have picked up on it,
zh: ~z~你要是关心我，早就注意到了。

english: ~z~And I'm drunk! What is wrong with me?
zh: ~z~结果我醉了！我哪根筋搭错了？

english: ~z~Shit, Carmen. I'm not the one they're fucking paying.
zh: ~z~操，卡门，医院他妈又没给我发钱。

english: ~z~Shit, your life sounds real tough, Carmen.
zh: ~z~我靠，你的生活听上去很难啊，卡门。

english: ~z~Fucking whiney sick bitches. I hate all the patients.
zh: ~z~操他妈的牢骚贱人。我讨厌所有病人。

english: ~z~but you too up your own fucking ass to give a shit about the Carmen.
zh: ~z~但你丫只关心自己，根本不在乎卡门。

english: ~z~Carmen don't know how she cope neither, baby.
zh: ~z~卡门也不知道她是怎么过来的，宝贝。

english: ~z~I got to deal with stupid fucking sick children all day long.
zh: ~z~我整天都得跟傻逼一样的小病号打交道。

english: ~z~You have it hard. I don't know how you cope.
zh: ~z~日子这么难过，都不知道你是怎么过来的。

english: ~z~Every time Carmen agrees to go out with you, you getting real lucky.
zh: ~z~每次卡门同意跟你出来，都是你莫大的福气。

english: ~z~I thought you liked the drinks I was buying you. Why didn't you say anything at the time?
zh: ~z~我还以为你很喜欢我买的酒。你怎么不早说？

english: ~z~You like a child, Niko. You simple like a fucking child. Shit.
zh: ~z~你就像个孩子，尼克。单纯得像个小屁孩。靠。

english: ~z~Shit, can't someone else look after them? You fucking do it.
zh: ~z~妈的，就不能换个人照顾他们吗？你丫去照顾。

english: ~z~You only buy her the happy hour drinks not them high price ones.
zh: ~z~你给她买的酒都是便宜的促销酒，不买贵的那些。

english: ~z~she was saying something with her eyes and with her hips and with her whole body language.
zh: ~z~她用眼睛、屁股和全身上下的肢体语言跟你说了。

english: ~z~No problem? I gotta be at work soon. I gotta save lives, man.
zh: ~z~没关系？我待会儿要上班的，还要去救人性命的，老兄。

english: ~z~You a cheapskate or something, Niko? You don't want to spend no money on Carmen?
zh: ~z~你是铁公鸡还是什么，尼克？你不想在卡门身上花钱吗？

english: ~z~I'll give you fucking issues, I'll put you in the fucking hospital myself.
zh: ~z~我会让你丫有问题的，我会亲自把你丫送进那个破医院的。

english: ~z~You lucky Carmen's hanging out with you, baby. She's so out your league.
zh: ~z~卡门肯跟你出来是你的福气，宝贝。她的阶层比你高了不少。

english: ~z~She should be going out with rap stars and football players, not hoods like you.
zh: ~z~她应该和嘻哈明星、橄榄球运动员出门，而不是你这样的小混混。

english: ~z~Fuck you, Niko. You think you better than Carmen? You ain't. You ain't fucking shit.
zh: ~z~操你妈的，尼克。你以为你比卡门强吗？才怪呢，你丫屁都不是。

english: ~z~Thank you.
~z~So.
~z~Ha ha.
~z~Me too.
~z~Probably.
~z~Don't mention it.
~z~Another what?
~z~Maybe.
~z~What's nice?
~z~Not really.
~z~I like that.
~z~No comment.
~z~So, you.
~z~I'm so sorry.
~z~So what?
~z~Were they close?
~z~Maybe you're right.
~z~So me what?
~z~You're still stupid!
~z~Thank you. How are you?
~z~How is your Mother?
~z~Why don't you want to live?
~z~So, are you another one?
~z~Ha ha - I know all about that.
~z~This is nice, isn't it?
~z~You seem well, Niko.
~z~Do you think that that is where he is?
~z~I am what I am, for better or worse.
~z~My aunt, Roman's mother,
~z~Yes. Our fathers were brothers.
~z~What did your brothers think?
~z~I guess it's nice be honest for a change.
~z~The world is hard. What are you going to do?
~z~You know what my family is like.
~z~Thanks, Niko. I needed this.
~z~Sounds like you still are.
zh: ~z~听起来你现在还没摆脱战争。

english: ~z~Try to keep those two sides of my life separate.
zh: ~z~想给我生活的两面划清界线。

english: ~z~It can't be easier, than having a job I mean?
zh: ~z~这总不会比找份工作还难吧？

english: ~z~What was different about you and him?
zh: ~z~那你和他的关系又有什么不同？

english: ~z~I think we all need new beginnings.
zh: ~z~我想我们都需要一个全新的开始。

english: ~z~What's wrong with me? Quite a lot, I'm sure.
zh: ~z~我有什么毛病？一大把吧，肯定有。

english: ~z~You don't have to thank me, Kate. Needed what?
zh: ~z~你没必要谢我，凯特。你需要什么？

english: ~z~My mother - my mother is one of life's victims.
zh: ~z~我的母亲－我母亲她是生活的受害者。

english: ~z~she was... she was... she was raped and murdered.
~z~I know - look at the company I keep.
zh: ~z~我知道，也不看看和我一起的人是谁。

english: ~z~I do not need some quack trying to get inside my head.
zh: ~z~我可不需要什么想诊断我的脑子的庸医。

english: ~z~Everyone needs a way to cope with his or her pain.
zh: ~z~每个人都需要一个克服自己痛苦的方法。

english: ~z~Same as always - trying to deal with the reality of my awful family.
zh: ~z~一如既往，试图应付我糟糕家庭的现实。

english: ~z~You don't normally take the guys you date back to meet the family?
zh: ~z~平常你不会把约会对象带回家见家人吗？

english: ~z~They were wife beating alcoholics, who, luckily, were both what they deserved to be.
zh: ~z~他俩都是打老婆的酒鬼，完全一个德性。

english: ~z~Actually, I wish to forget some of the things that happened to me here, in Liberty City as well.
zh: ~z~其实，我也想忘记一些在自由城的遭遇。

english: ~z~That's it. But it's nice. I'm enjoying myself.
zh: ~z~就是这样。不过这样也挺好，我挺开心的。

english: ~z~Can you do me a favor, and stop preaching? I'm fine.
zh: ~z~能不能麻烦你不要在这儿传教了？我很好。

english: ~z~Not at all, friend. Families are strange things.
zh: ~z~完全没有，朋友。家庭确实是奇怪的东西。

english: ~z~It's nice to have a friend who understands the madness that I've lived through.
zh: ~z~有一个对我疯狂的生活知根知底的朋友真好。

english: ~z~My whole life has been learning to cope. I sort of can,
zh: ~z~我这辈子都在学习如何应付它。我是能应付，

english: ~z~I was in therapy for a long time, Niko. It helped me a lot.
zh: ~z~我接受过很久的治疗，尼克。它帮了我很多。

english: ~z~I'm sure you do, Niko. Maybe it's something other than forgetting that you need though.
zh: ~z~你肯定想的，尼克。或许你需要的不是忘记。

english: ~z~Lord above - you don't even enjoy it? Then why do it?
zh: ~z~上帝啊，你自己都不高兴？那还做这种事干嘛？

english: ~z~How annoying. What is wrong with you people? You men.
zh: ~z~真奇怪，你们这些人都有什么毛病？这些男人。

english: ~z~Tell me about your family. Roman - he's your cousin...
zh: ~z~跟我说说你的家庭吧。罗曼－他是你堂兄...

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. Talk about armchair psychology. I'm boring you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，尼克。净是些空谈心理学。无聊到你了。

english: ~z~Alright then, this isn't a date. We're just two people, hanging out.
zh: ~z~那好吧，这不是在约会。我们就是两个人出来玩。

english: ~z~but it's those moments when you can just forget that I value most.
zh: ~z~但我最珍视的还是可以直接忘却这种家庭的时光。

english: ~z~You have had opportunities that most of the world could not imagine.
zh: ~z~你已经拥有世界上很多地方连想都不敢想的机会了。

english: ~z~I don't know. I have lived a complicated life. I was in a war.
zh: ~z~我不知道，我的人生经历有点复杂。我参加过战争。

english: ~z~The war taught me a lot of bad things, but it also taught me to enjoy life.
zh: ~z~战争教了我很多坏东西，但也教会了我要享受生活。

english: ~z~It's nice to have a friend, Niko. I feel like you are someone I can speak to.
zh: ~z~有个朋友真好，尼克。感觉我可以跟你聊很多东西。

english: ~z~Maybe it's a break from it all... a new beginning.
zh: ~z~比如说远离种种琐事的休息...一个全新的开始。

english: ~z~With a family like yours, I would have thought you would have learnt to cope by now.
zh: ~z~你有这样一个家族在，我还以为你早就学会应付它了。

english: ~z~I just hope that the way you choose to deal with yours is productive, not destructive.
zh: ~z~我只是希望你的处理方式是建设性的，而不是毁灭性的。

english: ~z~An Irish family manages to make it the eighteenth century when or wherever they are.
zh: ~z~我有一个随时随地都想重现18世纪辉煌的爱尔兰家族。

english: ~z~Fair enough. A life time of trying to sort my brothers out has left me a little sanctimonious.
zh: ~z~有道理。一直规劝我那些哥哥都弄得我有点道貌岸然了。

english: ~z~No. It was seeing your home destroyed, seeing members of your family die.
zh: ~z~不，那种经历是看着自己的家被毁，看着你的家人死亡。

english: ~z~The men in my family are just highwaymen and moralists, usually both in equal measure.
zh: ~z~家里男人不是拦路强盗就是道德卫士，通常还是一半一半。

english: ~z~Well, is a good thing that we are just friends. If this was a date, I'd be scared.
zh: ~z~幸好我俩只是普通朋友。如果这是在约会，我就要害怕了。

english: ~z~Some downtime. A moment away from the craziness of it all - my family, life in general.
zh: ~z~放松的时间。能够远离我疯狂的家庭、普通地生活的时光。

english: ~z~It was great - you got to see people turn into animals and your close friends die.
zh: ~z~战争很棒。你可以看见人类变成禽兽，看见你的挚友死亡。

english: ~z~She wanted to send me too, but I wanted to fight. I was stupid.
zh: ~z~本来她想把我也送来，不过当时我想参战。我真是太蠢了。

english: ~z~To live a normal life, I mean - get married, have kids, not steal, rob, kill.
zh: ~z~我是说过正常的生活。结婚生子，不是偷盗、抢劫、杀人。

english: ~z~I do, but I don't think that any life is not mad. You were here in America.
zh: ~z~是知道，不过我觉得所有人的生活都很疯狂。你可是在美国。

english: ~z~I too have things I wish to forget. The things that happened to me back home, the war...
zh: ~z~我也有想要忘却的事情。那些在我故乡发生的事情，战争...

english: ~z~I was mostly raised by Roman's mother. She was great. An amazing person.
zh: ~z~我基本上是罗曼的母亲养大的。她很伟大。是个令人惊奇的人。

english: ~z~I hope so, I don't want to believe that every man in my family was as bad as my brothers.
zh: ~z~但愿吧，我不想相信我家里的所有男人都和我的哥哥们一样坏。

english: ~z~I found her. Roman does not know - he thought she died in a house fire.
zh: ~z~我找到了她。罗曼还不知道，他以为她是因为家中失火丧命的。

english: ~z~When the war came, she saved up all her money and sent Roman here.
zh: ~z~战争来临的时候，她把她的钱都省了下来，把罗曼送到了这儿。

english: ~z~My dad was a drinker and he sure had a temper, but I believe in my heart of hearts that he was a good man.
zh: ~z~我父亲是个酒鬼，脾气也不好，但我发自真心地相信他是个好人。

english: ~z~Well, for a murdering, thieving idiot who can't talk about things, you're kind of nice.
zh: ~z~算了，比起那种偷窃杀人还不会讲话的白痴，你已经算是好的了。

english: ~z~Dad drove my brothers mad. I sometimes think that the reason they act the way they do is rebelling against him.
zh: ~z~我爸让哥哥们很不爽。有时候我都觉得他们的现状是对爸爸的叛逆。

english: ~z~I was his princess, I was the little girl. And I didn't give him a reason to discipline me.
zh: ~z~我是他的掌上明珠，我是最小的女儿。而且我也没给他理由体罚我。

english: ~z~Is nice to get to know you too, seems like I've gotten pretty close to everyone else in your family.
zh: ~z~我也很高兴能逐渐了解你，~n~我似乎和你家的所有人都很熟了。

english: ~z~Sorry. I knew it was a dumb question. It's just, I hoped it wasn't so awful for you.
zh: ~z~抱歉，我不该问这么蠢的问题。我只是希望那次战争对你不算太糟。

english: ~z~Another one like my brothers. A tough guy with a death wish. A man eager to get into Hell as soon as possible.
zh: ~z~和我哥哥一样的那种。怀着死亡觉悟的硬汉。时刻准备下地狱的人。

english: ~z~I guess I played up to it even more because my relationship with him was something I had that the boys didn't.
zh: ~z~我想我这么做更多是为了迎合他，因为我和他的关系是哥哥们没有的。

english: ~z~Forgive me... I'm sorry if this is a weird question - what was the war like?
zh: ~z~请见谅...如果这个问题太怪的话我就先道歉了。战争是怎么样的？

english: ~z~Rather than me keeping secrets about my family from you, you're probably keeping secrets about my family from me?
zh: ~z~这次倒未必是我对我家的事保密了，我看是你在对我保密我家的事吧？

english: ~z~You poor bastard, you have. I don't normally socialize with people that know my family.
zh: ~z~你这可怜的混蛋，是很熟了。~n~平常我不跟熟悉我家族的人来往的。

english: ~z~We grew up the next house to each other. So physically yes. And temperamentally, yes.
zh: ~z~小时候我们两家只有一墙之隔。所以距离上是近的。两个人性格也很接近。

english: ~z~I don't know... getting out, doing stuff, not working or fighting with my family. Getting to know you.
zh: ~z~不知道...出门玩，做各种事，不为我的家人工作或者干架。逐渐了解你。

english: ~z~What have you been up to? Actually, I don't think I want to know. I'm sure it made you feel big and strong.
zh: ~z~你最近在干嘛？不过我也不太想知道。肯定是能让你觉得自己高大威猛的事情。

english: ~z~I don't know if I'd agree that Packie was a moralist. He seems like a highwayman through and through.
zh: ~z~要是派奇也算道德卫士的话我就不敢苟同了。他似乎是个彻头彻尾的拦路强盗。

english: ~z~You know, just waiting around and wasting time until she can join my father in the eternal splendor of Heaven.
zh: ~z~你也知道，只是在等待大限、浪费时间，等着到天堂的永恒光辉中去找我父亲。

english: ~z~None of the boys liked my dad, and he didn't appear to like them much either. He believed in discipline, you know?
zh: ~z~他们没一个喜欢我爸的，而我爸似乎也不太喜欢他们。他相信体罚，你知道吗？

english: ~z~They hated him, they'd fight with him and scream at him and run away for days at a time before he'd drag them home.
zh: ~z~他们都恨他，他们会和他打架，对他大喊大叫，离家出走几天直到被他拖回来。

english: ~z~I couldn't date you... someone like my brothers. I couldn't do that to myself.
zh: ~z~我不可能跟你约会的...约你这种和我哥哥们一样的人。我不会对自己做那种事的。

english: ~z~I wasn't suggesting that, Niko. I was just saying that therapy is one of the reasons I'm still here today.
zh: ~z~我不是那个意思，尼克。我只是想说，~n~那个治疗是我能坚持到现在的原因之一。

english: ~z~Date? This isn't a date, Niko. We're just getting to know each other. We might be friends and that's all.
zh: ~z~约会？才不是约会，尼克。我们只是在互相了解对方。我们可能会做朋友，就是这样了。

english: ~z~They were identical. But did they get along? No. they hated each other. They were both assholes, you see.
zh: ~z~他俩一模一样。至于他们处得好吗？不好，他们互相看不顺眼。他俩都是混蛋，就这样。

english: ~z~You should see him around me, if a man even looks in my direction, he threatens to rip his heart out.
zh: ~z~那你应该看看他在我身边的表现。要是有男人往我的方向看，他就会上去威胁要掏了那个男人的心脏。

english: ~z~It taught me how to get by, how to detach myself from people who upset me. Therapy works... it sort of works.
zh: ~z~它教会了我怎么挺下去，怎么让自己摆脱那些令我伤心的人。~n~治疗还算有效...至少能算有效吧。

zh: ~z~因为我们都有那种狗屁遭遇。

~z~Alright, why do we both understand that?
zh: ~z~好吧，那为什么我们都会明白？

english: ~z~You mean, we're both emotionally scarred?
zh: ~z~你是说，我们俩都有精神创伤？

english: ~z~God, sometimes do you think - what is the point?
~z~I think if two people like one another...
~z~There can be no one thing that gives us purpose.
zh: ~z~可能没有一样东西能给我们目标。

english: ~z~Good. You're a freak. That's why I like you.
zh: ~z~好。你是个怪人。所以我才喜欢你。

english: ~z~How's my favorite sociopath today?
zh: ~z~我最喜欢的反社会者今天怎么样啊？

english: ~z~Do you think this is strange - you and me being friends?
zh: ~z~你觉得这奇怪吗——你和我做朋友？

english: ~z~Doesn't really matter, you'll probably die tomorrow.
zh: ~z~不过也没必要，说不定明天你就死了。

english: ~z~For a long time there was only one thing in my life that I cared about.
zh: ~z~很久以来，我在生活中都只关心一件事。

english: ~z~We don't have to be friends anymore, if it upsets you.
zh: ~z~要是你伤心的话，我们不做朋友也可以。

english: ~z~Yes, good... no... no. I'm terrible.
~z~He's my brother, but he's an idiot. You're not.
zh: ~z~他是我的哥哥，但他是个白痴。你不是。

english: ~z~There is a void in us that cannot be filled.
zh: ~z~但我们心中都有一个无法被填满的虚空。

english: ~z~Okay, you want an answer? What sort of man do I want to be?
zh: ~z~好，你想要答复是吧？我想成为怎样的人？

english: ~z~but if I was, I'd want to be with you.
zh: ~z~但要是我准备好了，我会想和你在一起的。

english: ~z~Tired of everything. Tired of myself. Tired of you.
zh: ~z~对什么都厌倦了。厌倦我自己，厌倦了你。

english: ~z~The very idea I think about having a family given my genes is shameful.
zh: ~z~之前我想过的组建家庭传递血脉太可耻了。

english: ~z~We have survived. That's what life is about - survival.
zh: ~z~我们活下来了。这就是生活的本质——生存。

english: ~z~So you care what your "friend" wants to do with his life?
zh: ~z~那你很关心你的「朋友」这辈子想做什么喽？

english: ~z~I want to be a whole one. I do not want to be owned by anyone.
zh: ~z~我想做一个完整的人。我不想做谁的所有物。

english: ~z~I like you. I like what you are, and that's a good thing.
zh: ~z~我喜欢你，就喜欢你现在这样，这样挺好的。

english: ~z~You know what, when I'm with you, I can be myself.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，和你在一起的时候，我可以做自己。

english: ~z~Here you are, coming with the big questions straight out of the gate. Give me a break.
zh: ~z~又来了，一上来就问了个大问题。你饶了我吧。

english: ~z~I'm tired of this life - tired of this city.
zh: ~z~我对这种生活已经厌倦了，对这座城市厌倦了。

english: ~z~I want to be able to make the right decision and it be my own decision to make.
zh: ~z~我想成为能够做出正确决定、为自己做决定的人。

english: ~z~It isn't a difficult question if you don't care about the answer. What kind of a man do I want to be?
zh: ~z~如果你不在乎答案的话是不难。我想做怎样的人？

english: ~z~I don't know about you, but I have my fair share of physical scars.
zh: ~z~我不清楚你的情况，但我的身体创伤已经够多了。

english: ~z~Give it up. Move away. Grow up. Get out... you could be happy.
zh: ~z~放弃现状，搬走，成长，离开...你可以幸福的。

english: ~z~Whether this will satisfy you though... that is another matter.
zh: ~z~至于这么做能不能满足你...那就是另一回事了。

english: ~z~We want things because we think they will make us whole.
zh: ~z~我们想要某些东西，是因为我们觉得它能满足我们。

english: ~z~This one thing, it drove me, it gave me motivation in everything I did.
zh: ~z~这一件事，给了我动力，我做任何事都是由它驱使的。

english: ~z~This is a good thing to do, you will help people. You should go back to school and become a teacher.
zh: ~z~这是好事，你会帮到别人的。你是该回到学校当老师。

english: ~z~I don't want to get into that. But you know what I mean. What is the purpose of existence?
zh: ~z~我不想讲那个，但你知道我的意思。存在的目的是什么？

english: ~z~I should be forcibly sterilized... imagine a little baby Packie...
zh: ~z~我就应该被强制绝育的...想象一下一个小派奇...

english: ~z~Because I want to be happy - because I want to move away, have a family myself,
zh: ~z~因为我想开心点，因为我想搬出去，自己组建一个家庭，

english: ~z~My pleasure. You know what, Niko, I really... I really...
zh: ~z~没关系。你猜怎么着，尼克，我真的...我真的...

english: ~z~No. Not really. I was trying to be more optimistic. My shrink tells me I need to be more optimistic
zh: ~z~不，不算太好。只是想更乐观点，医生让我想得开一点，

english: ~z~Now, after everything I have been through, I am not sure that life is so simple.
zh: ~z~现在，经历了那么多后，我就不太确定人生有那么简单了。

english: ~z~I don't know, maybe the fact that we both understand that the world is a fucked up place.
zh: ~z~我不知道，也许是因为我们都明白这个世界是个狗屁地方。

english: ~z~It's the period between trips to the laundromat or calls from my mother or dates with you.
zh: ~z~就是去洗衣店的途中，或者我妈打来的电话，或者和你约会。

english: ~z~It's over. This life of yours. You can change. At least think about it.
zh: ~z~就这样了，你的这种生活。你可以改变的，至少考虑一下吧。

english: ~z~He's a psychotic cocaine addict, sure, but he's actually quite sentimental and longs for normality.
zh: ~z~他的确是个精神病瘾君子，但他也多愁善感，渴望变得正常。

english: ~z~Okay, we're both survivors then. Maybe that's why we like each other.
zh: ~z~好吧，那我们就都是幸存者了。也许就是因此才会喜欢对方。

english: ~z~But you're not ready either. You're a lunatic. I don't know if you can change...
zh: ~z~可是你也没准备好。你是个疯子，我不知道你能不能改变...

english: ~z~The point of life. I just get the feeling sometimes that life is waiting between points.
zh: ~z~生活的目的。我有一种感觉，有时候生活处在两个目的地之间。

english: ~z~I care about the lives of people I care about... my family, my friends... yes!
zh: ~z~我关心我关心的人的生活...我的家人，我的朋友...对！

english: ~z~We have scars that come from these horrible situations and we can live to tell the tale.
zh: ~z~我们都有在极恶环境下留下的创伤，而且都能活着讲述那些故事。

english: ~z~Good. Because I don't want to think about it. I hang out with you to forget about that life.
zh: ~z~好。因为我也不想想这个。我和你出来就是为了忘记那种生活的。

english: ~z~If you liked me, you'd give this up. Give up this life, for me, I mean.
zh: ~z~要是你喜欢我，你就该放弃现状了，放弃这种生活，为了我放弃。

english: ~z~I really like you. I mean, not like that. I'm not into that. Not with you.
zh: ~z~我真的喜欢你。我是说，也不是那个。我没那个意思。不会跟你那个。

english: ~z~It's important to me. I've been thinking about you a lot and knowing your aspirations is important.
zh: ~z~对我来说很重要。我最近一直在想你，~n~很有必要知道你的志向。

english: ~z~I can tell you stupid things, because I know you're as mad as me. I like being your friend.
zh: ~z~可以跟你讲各种蠢事，因为我知道你和我一样疯。我喜欢做你的朋友。

english: ~z~He just thinks that he'll find it by doing 5 hits of X a day, and smoking crack at weekends after a spot of bank robbing.
zh: ~z~只是他觉得一天嗑五次摇头丸、周末抢完银行吸可卡因就能变得正常。

english: ~z~Genuinely awful, but at least you're not a fucking hypocrite. That can't be said of many people.
zh: ~z~真诚得不行，但你至少不是个狗屁伪君子。能被这样评价的人也不多。

english: ~z~You're like me - a whack job who should have been locked up years ago. You're a deranged psycho.
zh: ~z~你很像我，一个几年前就该被关起来的疯子。你就是个精神错乱的疯子。

english: ~z~You're scarcely a good judge. No, I'm not ready for a relationship... but...
zh: ~z~你这人当不了好法官。不，我还没准备好开始一段关系...但是...

english: ~z~No you don't. You don't like anything. You tolerate me, like you tolerate life.
zh: ~z~不，你不喜欢。你什么都不喜欢。你在忍受我，就像忍受你的生活一样。

english: ~z~Maybe that is why we get on. We're friends. I like you Kate. I really do.
zh: ~z~可能正是如此我们才处得来。我们是朋友。我喜欢你，凯特，真的喜欢你。

english: ~z~I don't know. I think life can be simple if you let it be. I think that life can have meaning.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我觉得只要你想，生活就可以很简单。我觉得生活可以有意义。

english: ~z~I want to be productive, I want to help people, I think that if I went back to school and became a teacher...
zh: ~z~我想做个有益的人，我想帮助别人，我在想要是我回到学校成了老师...

english: ~z~I'm not ready - I'm scared of all of that - you care about people, they die. I'm pretty messed up.
zh: ~z~我还没准备好。我很害怕那个，你关心谁，谁就死了。我真的是一团乱麻。

english: ~z~Oh, shut up, I don't mean that. I like you. I really like you. You know I do.
zh: ~z~噢，闭嘴，我不是那个意思。我喜欢你，真的很喜欢你。你知道我喜欢的。

english: ~z~Our mutual interest in wine, conversation, art house movies and long walks on the beach...
zh: ~z~我们兴趣相似，无论是在酒上、话题上、小众电影上，还是在沙滩上漫步...

english: ~z~So you could do this until you've killed everyone? Or until you die? Your life must be hell.
zh: ~z~所以你要等到杀光所有人才肯收手是吧？还是要等到你死了？你的生活肯定是地狱。

english: ~z~Sometimes I do not call my life survival, it is somewhere below that, but yeah. I take your point.
zh: ~z~有时候我不管我的生活叫生存，应该连生存都谈不上。~n~不过确实，我同意你的观点。

english: ~z~Bad stuff has happened to people around us, to people we care about, to us even, but we have pulled through.
zh: ~z~坏事都在我们身边的人身上发生过，在我们关心的人身上，甚至在我们自己身上，但我们都挺过来了。

english: ~z~Calm down.
~z~Maybe.
~z~Don't worry.
~z~Fuck you.
~z~Shhh, calm down.
~z~Yeah, sure.
~z~Don't worry about it.
~z~Shit. I'm drunk.
~z~That's better.
~z~That was fun.
~z~I'm drunk...
~z~I don't know about that.
~z~Shut up, please.
~z~Isn't that fun?

~z~Fuck, what is wrong with me?
~z~Please, leave me alone.
~z~That was fun...
~z~My mother! She's great.
~z~I'm sorry... I'm so sorry.
~z~I'm trying... maybe I better shut up.
~z~What are you going to do now? Shoot me?
~z~Probably, you psycho. You're crazy.
zh: ~z~也许吧，你个神经病。这个疯子。

english: ~z~Fuck... I'm just a neurotic, aren't I?
~z~Great... that's a sensation worth paying for...
~z~I'm half crazy, out drinking with a killer,
zh: ~z~我差不多疯了，和一个杀手出来喝酒。

english: ~z~Look at them... I can't take it any more...
~z~and with this family so fucked up I don't even want to talk about it.
zh: ~z~还有一个乱七八糟到我都不想提的家庭。

english: ~z~I fucking knew, and my brothers - look at them.
zh: ~z~我他妈知道。而我的哥哥们，看看他们。

english: ~z~Really self indulgent, really idiotic, pathetic.
zh: ~z~真的太放纵自己了，太蠢了，太可悲了。

english: ~z~I'm sorry... I'm so sorry... I'm so sorry.
zh: ~z~对不起...很对不起...真的对不起。

english: ~z~No, why would I worry? Why would I fucking worry?
zh: ~z~不，我为什么要担心？老娘为什么要担心？

english: ~z~Yes - great fun. Reminds me of being at a funeral...
zh: ~z~对，真开心。让我想起了参加葬礼的时候...

english: ~z~Calms you down... shows you that you really do hate yourself.
zh: ~z~能让你镇定...让你知道你真的很讨厌自己。

english: ~z~Yeah great. Just great. I love drinking - gives you clarity.
zh: ~z~对，很好，真的很好。我爱喝酒，能让你清醒。

english: ~z~You already knew that, maybe... I hate myself and I want to die!
zh: ~z~你已经知道了，大概...我讨厌我自己，我想死！

english: ~z~Why would I worry? What in God's name have I got to worry about?
zh: ~z~我为什么要担心？看在上帝份上我有什么要担心的？

english: ~z~I don't know - because my whole family does, and they're such a bunch of winners!
zh: ~z~我不知道。因为我全家都喝，他们还都是一群人生赢家！

english: ~z~Yes, fuck you, you creep. You fucking lunatic creep. Fuck you.
zh: ~z~对，操你妈，你这变态。你这狗屁疯子死变态。操你妈。

english: ~z~Do us a favor? Try not to freak out like you seem to when you get drunk.
zh: ~z~替我考虑下吧？喝醉以后能不能别和之前一样发酒疯了。

english: ~z~My dad - he did awful things to my brothers, I loved him, but I knew.
zh: ~z~我爸，他对我的哥哥做了很多糟糕的事情。我爱他，但我知道。

english: ~z~They haven't invented a tranquilizer strong enough, but if she combines them with whiskey, she can get to sleep.
zh: ~z~现在的镇静剂药效都不够强，但只要混上一点威士忌，她就能睡着了。

english: ~z~You're a loser. You're a fucking loser. Fuck you. What is wrong with you, you cold hearted creep?
zh: ~z~你就是个失败者。你丫就是个失败者。操你妈。你什么毛病，你这冷血变态？

~z~No can do, Kiki. Maybe another time.
~z~Have you got time to take a girl out?
~z~I'd really like you to take me out.
zh: ~z~我真的很想让你带我出去玩。

english: ~z~Kiki, I'm being harassed by some cops.
~z~Why don't you show me a good time?
zh: ~z~要么你带我出去快活快活吧？

english: ~z~Niko, you never want to see me. Fuck.
~z~Sorry, Kiki. Another time.
~z~Okay, Kiki. I'll come get you in the next hour.
~z~Fine, fine. Go to her instead.
~z~Sure, Kiki. I'll call you later.
~z~Okay, Niko... I'll be thinking about you.
~z~I love you. I need you. I want to feel you.
~z~Okay, Kiki. I'll talk to you soon.
~z~I've got some free time so you could take me out.
zh: ~z~我有空啦，你可以约我出来了。

english: ~z~I wish I could, Kiki, but I'm real busy.
zh: ~z~我也想啊，琪琪，但我真的很忙。

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. Thanks for calling at least.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。至少你先通知我了。

english: ~z~You're a total sweetheart, Niko. See you soon.
zh: ~z~真是我的好宝贝，尼克。待会儿见。

english: ~z~Go to her, Niko. Go to your fucking whore.
zh: ~z~去找她啊，尼克。找那贱女人去啊。

english: ~z~Hey, Kiki. Something's happened. I can't pick you up.
zh: ~z~嘿，琪琪。我有点事儿，接不了你。

english: ~z~You just love punishing me, you take pleasure in this.
zh: ~z~你就是喜欢惩罚我，你还乐在其中。

english: ~z~You just love punishing me, you take pleasure in this.
zh: ~z~你就是喜欢惩罚我，你还乐在其中。

english: ~z~Niko, I'm being discharged from the hospital. Can you pick me up?
zh: ~z~尼克，我马上出院了。能来接我下吗？

english: ~z~I better not find out you're seeing another woman.
zh: ~z~最好别被我发现你在跟别的女人约会。

english: ~z~Ummm. We'll talk later. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~嗯...等下再说吧，我等下打给你。

english: ~z~Oh Niko, it's so good to talk to you.
zh: ~z~啊，尼克，能和你说话真是太开心了。

english: ~z~Oh Niko, it's you. Just let me get a bit more sleep then we'll speak.
zh: ~z~噢尼克，是你啊。让我先睡会儿再说吧。

english: ~z~I'm sorry for waking you, Kiki. Later on.
zh: ~z~对不起吵醒你了，琪琪。那我等会再打。

english: ~z~You're not cheating on me are you, Niko? You better not be.
zh: ~z~你该不会在搞外遇吧，尼克？最好不是。

english: ~z~Anything you want Kiki. I should be able to get there in the next hour.
zh: ~z~悉听尊便，琪琪。一小时内我应该能到。

english: ~z~Hey Kiki. I think it would be best for us not to see each other again.
zh: ~z~嘿，琪琪，我想我们最好不要再见面了。

english: ~z~Maybe call after 6. I'll be dreaming about you...
zh: ~z~6点以后再找我吧。我会梦到你的...

english: ~z~You're missing out, Niko. I'll have to have fun by myself.
zh: ~z~那可真遗憾，尼克。我只能自己享乐了。

english: ~z~Leave a message for Kiki Jenkins after the tone. Kiss, kiss.
zh: ~z~请在提示音后给琪琪･詹金斯留言。亲亲。

english: ~z~Seeing you would make my week. Pick me up in the next hour.
zh: ~z~见到你我能高兴一周。一小时内来接我吧。

english: ~z~Sorry, Kiki. I can't right now. I hope you get home safe.
zh: ~z~抱歉，琪琪，我现在很忙。祝你平安到家。

english: ~z~Why do I like you so much, can someone explain that to me?
zh: ~z~我怎么会这么喜欢你呢？谁可以解释一下吗？

english: ~z~I'm not the sort of girl who can be used and thrown away, Niko.
zh: ~z~我不是你想约就约、想扔就扔的女孩，尼克。

english: ~z~Niko, I'm trying to get some sleep. Call me back after 6 okay.
zh: ~z~尼克，我还要睡觉呢，麻烦6点之后再找我。

english: ~z~You're so beautiful, Niko. Both inside and out. You're amazing.
zh: ~z~你真的好帅，尼克，从里到外都是，你好棒。

english: ~z~Hey Kiki, I'm sorry about this but I have to cancel our date.
zh: ~z~嘿，琪琪，抱歉我不得不取消我们的约会了。

english: ~z~Why do I like you so much, can someone explain that to me?
zh: ~z~我怎么会这么喜欢你呢？谁可以解释一下吗？

english: ~z~I've got a court date coming up. I can't see you. Maybe later.
zh: ~z~我马上就要出庭了。不能见你了。过几天吧。

english: ~z~I'd really like to go on a date with you. Pick me up in the next hour.
zh: ~z~我很乐意跟你出来约会，一小时内来接我吧。

english: ~z~I'm onto you, Niko. I'm onto you. You're hurting me so bad.
zh: ~z~我全知道，尼克。我全知道。你太让我失望了。

english: ~z~Sorry, I'm working a really important case at the moment. Another time?
zh: ~z~抱歉，我手头有个很重要的案子。忙完再约吧？

english: ~z~Kiki, I hate to call you but I've got some cops giving me trouble.
zh: ~z~琪琪，我也不想打扰你，但有条子在找我麻烦。

english: ~z~I wanted to give myself to you, Niko. I wanted you to have me.
zh: ~z~亏我还想为你献身，尼克，亏我想让你拥有我。

english: ~z~Baby, I don't know what you're talking about. I'll call you later, Kiki.
zh: ~z~宝贝，我听不懂你在说什么。待会儿聊，琪琪。

english: ~z~That is exactly what I'd like to do. I'll come by your place in the next hour.

zh: ~z~这地方很赞，在吃上面花太多钱是没有意义的。

english: ~z~Your eyes are beautiful. I'm so pleased you're not wearing those glasses.
zh: ~z~你的眼睛很好看，幸好你没有戴着那副烂眼镜。

zh: ~z~这地方不错，但能和你一起的地方就是好地方。

english: ~z~Please tell me you didn't waste your hard earned money on a new top on my account.
zh: ~z~希望你不是为了我才会花血汗钱买这件新上衣的。

zh: ~z~这副眼镜显得你靠不住，尼克。你没瞒我什么吧？

zh: ~z~特雷梅因以前常带我来这样的地方，又快又方便。

zh: ~z~我很乐意体验你们那边的文化，尼克，我们走吧。

zh: ~z~你能拿掉那顶帽子我真的高兴，你知道我不喜欢它。

english: ~z~If you want new shoes, Niko. I can buy them. Don't spend your own money.
zh: ~z~如果你想换新鞋，尼克，我帮你买，别花你自己的钱。

zh: ~z~我也不能老是和你玩飞镖吧，带我去其他地方不行吗？

zh: ~z~你不穿昂贵的衣服也可以很帅，我喜欢这一点，尼克。

zh: ~z~我们不用刻意去打扮也可以相处得很舒服，真是太好啦。

zh: ~z~和你在一起的时候，我的注意力都不在吃的上面，尼克。

zh: ~z~这车散发着性感的气息，尼克。也许是因为这是你的车。

zh: ~z~我挺喜欢老的那顶帽子的，尼克。能让我想起我们共度的欢乐时光。

zh: ~z~我不太确定。我没有那么多的休息时间，只要能出来转转我就很开心了。

zh: ~z~Katt Williams说得挺好的。很高兴你能带我来这儿，尼克。

zh: ~z~决定权在你，尼克。只要你喜欢我就高兴了。对我来说，出去走走就很快乐。

zh: ~z~尼克，我感觉我们的相遇是命中注定。

zh: ~z~天，我天。我就不该喝最后三杯酒的。

zh: ~z~赢了你真是不好意思，尼克。爱莫能助。

zh: ~z~我将永远记住这一刻，如此特别的一刻。

zh: ~z~我有点怀疑了，尼克。怎么还没到地方啊？

zh: ~z~哇啊。我还以为你会让我少喝两杯呢，尼克。

zh: ~z~我知道你整晚都在想着你的那些贱婊，尼克。

zh: ~z~大家都是成年人，琪琪。要么让我进去坐坐吧？

zh: ~z~别把我一人抛在这冷风中，琪琪。邀我上去吧。

zh: ~z~带我去其他地方怎么样？如果你还不烦我的话。

zh: ~z~唔，尼克，送我回家用的时间好像有点长了吧？

english: ~z~Your language is so beautiful, Niko. It's such a shame you've got to speak English the whole time.
zh: ~z~你的语言真美，尼克。可惜在这儿你只能说英语。

zh: ~z~你真的不用花那钱，尼克。我不喜欢花钱买虚荣。

zh: ~z~你人还挺不错的，尼克。我觉得我有点了解你了。

zh: ~z~我感觉你磨磨蹭蹭的，尼克。为什么这么久才到？

zh: ~z~与男人竞争也是我工作的一部分，赢了你不奇怪。

zh: ~z~拒绝你真的很难。我不用再拒绝你真是太开心了。

zh: ~z~我也想在精神和肉体两方面跟你亲近，但不是今晚。

zh: ~z~我的时间非常宝贵，尼克。我们能快点做些什么吗？

zh: ~z~也许我会再邀你出来，给我你的号码吧。那再见啦。

zh: ~z~感觉我们这次真的亲近了不少，但约会总是要结束的。

english: Hey Mr. Celebinator, we're big fans of your site at the club, so it's kind of confusing when we read this spiteful shit. I'm sure you don't wanna offend us, so give us a call and we'll try to work it out.
zh: 嘿，名人终结者先生，我们来自您博客中提到的夜店，同时也是您网站的忠实粉丝。您博客上这些充斥着恶意中伤的文字实在是让我们有点困惑。您肯定也不想冒犯我们，给我们打个电话，我们一起想办法解决吧。

english: (note: I would never compromise this blog's credibility by accepting bribes. Tony, Luis and me really did vibe, and the clubs are f-ing fabulous. You'd be a doofus to think otherwise! Would people please stop bitching about my Silver Schafter as well! All kinds of public figures get free shit!
zh: (注：我绝不会干接受贿赂这种败坏博客信誉的事。托尼、路易斯和我真的关系很好，他们的夜店太TM棒了。你要是不这么想就太蠢了！大家能不能别再挖苦我的那辆银色莎夫特了！公众人物免费拿点东西很正常的！

english: Tony Queen and his rent boy princess, Luis Lopez, are at it again. Apart from being the least convincing non-couple since two men spit-roasted an albino cheetah in Las Venturas, Queeny and Queenier insist on telling half the few desperate shlobs who bother to try to go to the now irrelevant Maisonette to take a hike. Get over yourselves! Hello sweeties, no one is interested in coming in there to watch you lap dance each other anyway.
zh: 托尼 Queen和他的男妓路易斯･洛佩兹再次登场。尽管他俩在拉斯文加斯共烤一只白化的猎豹的事实已经有力地证明了他们之间的暧昧关系，但他们仍坚持将少数要死要活的蠢货拒之门外，无意让他们进入现已无关紧要的9号豪宅。差不多得了！亲爱的，真没人想进去看你们两个跳脱衣舞的。

english: Whoop! Whoop! After a brief closure by the city on health and safety grounds - boring people - Tony Queen's two nightclubs have reopened. Yay! EVERYONE is going to be at the opening gala including moi! It's going to be proper fabulous! I'd write about it for you, but I'll probably be too gone on Bleutr'd too type, and too surrounded by fabulous people to be able to single one out. Jealous much??? Welcome back, Tony. Kiss kiss. I love you!
zh: 喔！喔！出于健康和安全考虑，托尼 Queen的两家夜店曾被无趣的当局短暂关闭，现在两家店都重新开张了。耶！所有人都会去开业庆典，包括我！一定会非常棒的！我很想为你们记录一篇博客，但我可能会被香槟灌到神志不清，被很赞的人们团团包围，难以抉择与谁作伴。羡不羡慕？？？欢迎回来，托尼。亲亲。我爱你！

english: Some paparazzi got a nasty surprise outside Maisonette 9 the other night as a rogue fire truck accidentally sprayed them with their hose. I know some people who'd kill to have a fireman turn his hose on them, but these paps aren't so happy. Several of them are getting together to launch a class action suit against the LCFD. Keeping the paps' cameras working is a hell of a lot more important that the firemen's pension plans so I say go for it. Who ever saw an old fireman anyway?
zh: 一天晚上，一些狗仔队在9号豪宅外得到了一份惊喜，他们被失控的消防车意外地喷了一身水。我知道有人很愿意被消防员的水枪射到浑身湿透，但这些狗仔队可没那么乐意。他们中的一些人计划对自由城消防局提起集体诉讼。让狗仔队的摄像机正常工作可比消防员的养老金重要多了，所以我是支持诉讼的。话又说回来了，谁又见到过上年纪的消防员呢？

english: In other Maisonette 9 news, Poppy Mitchell was thought to be engaged in group sex in the VIP room! Poppy Mitchell! And we thought she was a nice girl? We wish we'd been there to see it / film it / join in / all of the above. Sadly we weren't and the paps were too soggy to get some good photo journalism for us. :( Anyway, we love your newest RomCom Poppy, we don't care if you're a cum guzzling slut queen.) xxx
zh: 还有一则来自9号豪宅的新闻。波比･米切尔似乎参与了VIP包厢里的群交！波比･米切尔！我们之前还认为她是个好姑娘？我们真希望能够亲身 观看/拍摄/加入/以上全部 这场淫趴。可惜的是我们不能，而狗仔队当时都湿透了，没法拍到好的新闻照片。:( 不管怎样，我们喜欢你新拍的浪漫喜剧，波比，即便你是吞精的荡妇我们也不在乎。么么哒

english: Clay 'The Pain Giver' Jackson was spotted out with a mystery blond last night. No, not Poppy Mitchell or Cloe Parker. Contrary to what Mr. Jackson would have us believe in his raps, this date was less ho and more homo. His new album of ballads LOVE ISN'T A CRIME comes out soon. Being gay isn't a crime either, Clay, so get on out of that closet, amigo! And stop going to Hercules! Closet case or not, that place SUCK, SUCK, SUCKS!
zh: 「痛苦给予者」科雷 杰克逊昨晚被拍到和一个神秘的金发人物约会。不，不是波比･米切尔，也不是克洛伊･帕克。与杰克逊先生在说唱中给我们留下的印象截然相反，这次约会更像是同性恋而不是异性恋。他的新专辑《爱不是罪》即将发行。同性恋也不是罪，科雷，所以别遮遮掩掩了，老兄！也别去大力神了！不管你有没有出柜，那个地方都烂透了！烂烂烂烂烂！

english: Rumor has it a member of the British Royal family has been taking time out from spending taxpayer money in the UK to come spend their money over here. After a few too many at a Middle Park East drinks party he over-shared with one of our secret informants - "I've had all the 18 to 25 year olds in London so I'm going to come over here until a new crop matures. Being next in line to the throne might allow you to quash tabloid kiss and tell stories, but not so much with the statutory rape allegations." Awww. It's a hard life, isn't it, petal?
zh: 有传言称，一名英国皇室成员百忙之中来到了自由城，换了个地方浪费纳税人的钱。他在中央公园东的一场酒会上喝大了，给我们的秘密线人爆了个猛料：「伦敦18岁到25岁的我都搞过了，所以我要到这里来，直到新的『幼苗』长成。作为王位继承人，你或许可以平息小报上的各种绯闻，但对法律上的强奸指控就没那么好办了。」噢。生活很艰难，不是吗，亲爱的？

english: The other day I had the unfortunate experience of getting up-close and personal with the statue of Happiness. It's horrible! I could swear that disgusting strained smile on her face reminds me of someone, too. That's the face of a woman who needs some work done, or some action, or both! I mean, she is seriously living a lie, that one, and for what? She just stands there and does nothing! Reminds me of my mother. If I was married to that cold slab of stone I'd be off with any fat bird who'd take me. It's amazing that angry black heart of hers still beats in her chest.
zh: 前几天，我很倒霉地与幸福女神像来了次亲密接触。太可怕了！我敢发誓，她脸上紧绷着的恶心笑容让我想起了某人。这张脸的主人不是欠收拾就是欠操，也可能既欠收拾又欠操！我是说，她活得很虚伪，有必要吗？她只是站在那里，什么都不做！这让我想起了我的母亲。如果我娶了那种冰冷的石头，我会和任何愿意嫁给我的胖女人一起离开。她那颗愤怒的黑心还在胸中跳动，真是令人惊奇。

english: Once legendary night club Mr. Big, Gay Tony is losing his touch. Rumors persist he's too wrapped up in his rent boy, Luis Lopez, to worry about running a decent club any more. Tony, who was a big star before the internet but has seen his popularity begin to wane, really should try relaxing his notoriously strict door policy and letting people in. Now it seems Tony and Luis are too busy staring into each other's eyes to worry about the fact their drinks are overpriced, their music is lame and even worse, the cool people simply don't go to their shitty clubs anymore. Bye bye!
zh: 曾经的传奇夜店大亨，基佬托尼，正在淡出人们的视野。有传言称他把精力都放在他的男妓路易斯･洛佩兹上，已经无暇经营一家像样的夜店了。托尼是互联网时代之前的大明星，但他的知名度正在逐渐下滑。早该放宽他那出了名严格的准入政策了，多放点人进去吧。估计现在托尼正忙着和路易斯深情对视，根本没空关心店里饮料价格虚高、音乐太差劲之类的问题。更糟糕的是，潮人根本就不去他们的垃圾夜店了。拜拜！

english: Tiny tweeny pop sensations the the Brothers Blue set mouths wagging after a fan accused them of date rape. No one has been able to get the truth since their meany publicist told them to keep schtum. Well, one of our spies managed to corner Bill and Bobby at a party and we've got the low down! You heard it here first, the kind souls only gave her a sedative to calm her down. "She was freaking out having a panic attack so we slipped her one to chill her out. We thought she might die." Good thing you had those roofies on you boys, you can sedate us whenever you like!
zh: 一位粉丝指控Blue兄弟约会强奸，令这一年轻的流行组合立刻成为了八卦中心。在他们刻薄的公关人员要求他们保持沉默后，没有人能够知道真相。但我们的一位线人在派对上堵到了比利和博比，让我们掌握了内幕消息！全网首发，善良的他们只是给了她镇定剂让她平静下来。「她吓坏了，一下子惊恐发作，所以我们给了她一支镇定剂让她放松下来。我们觉得当时要出人命了。」还好你们身上带了迷奸药，想蒙倒我们了就拿出来用吧！

english: Al Di Napoli - star of stage, screen, and drugs interventions around the country - has raised fresh doubts about his ability to perform on the Boulevard stage every night. We're not talking about the garbled lines or the stink of booze that goes all the way back to row F at the AmDram Theatre. No, police are wanting to question him after a Celebinator-reading cop recognised him as one of the suspects in a drugs bust. Big Al claims that he was in his hotel room all night and has several hookers to back up this story, but is still considered a suspect. Whoever's insuring Al's production of Legless better watch out. It's only a matter of time...
zh: 阿尔･迪纳波利——全国舞台、银幕和戒毒记录上的大明星——最近有人对他如何做到每晚都在林荫大道舞台上表演起了怀疑。我们不是在说他在阿姆德拉姆剧院演出时混乱的台词和一直飘到F排的酒臭味。不，而是警队中有一名「名人终结者」的读者认出了他，怀疑他涉嫌参与一起毒品交易想要对其进行问询。阿尔哥则称他整晚都在酒店房间，并且有几名妓女作证，但他仍被认为是嫌疑人。阿尔的作品《寸步难行》的保险公司可要悠着点了，出事只是时间问题...

english: FYI - I'm not writing this as the Celebinator, but a mere human being. Ive got all this power and it should be wielded with responsibility. With that in mind, Gay Tony Prince is the first / only guy we're apologizing to. We got to know him and his charming partner, Luis Lopez, when we shared a bottle of vintage Bleutr'd on a helicopter tour of the city. We talked about summer parties in the Carraways and winters in Vice - we clicked. That stuff we said before was stupid. Maisonette and Hercules are still the two hottest clubs in the town, and the guys who run it are awesome!
zh: 前言：本文是以一名普通人的角度所写，并非是作为「名人终结者」。我有这么大的影响力，理应为自己的言行负责。考虑到这一点，基佬托尼･普林斯是第一位，也是唯一一位我们要对其道歉的人。搭乘直升机游览城市时，我们认识了他和他迷人的伙伴路易斯･洛佩兹，并且有幸与他们共饮了一瓶Bleutr'd陈年香槟。我们谈到了在卡拉韦斯的夏日派对和在罪城的冬日派对——我们很合得来。之前我们在博客里说的话很蠢。9号豪宅和大力神仍然是城里最火的两家夜店，两家店的经营者都很棒！

english: Yummy but ohh so skinny Brit, Charlotte Crown is fighting back against people who say she is anorexic. We saw her out last night and she said "I just love food. I am obsessed by food. Seriously. When I get older and have kids, I'm definitely going to write a cook book. All my favorite recipes. I love eating. I ate 3 shepherd's pies today and lots of crisps and fish and chips and all these scrummy English things, because I'm really proud of being English, even though I have to live in Los Santos now. I'm definitely not anorexic. It's ridiculous. I'm just really lucky." You go girl! And don't forget to start shaving soon. Ciao!
zh: 夏洛特･克朗，一位令人垂涎欲滴却又骨瘦如柴的英国人，正在对那些说她患有厌食症的人进行反击。昨晚我们在路上与她偶遇，她说：「我热爱美食，钟情于美食。真的。等我过几年有了孩子，我一定会写一本烹饪书，记录我最爱的那些食谱。我爱吃。我今天吃了3个牧羊人派，还吃了很多薯片和炸鱼薯条，以及各种美味的英国食物。尽管我现在不得不住在洛圣都，但我依然为自己是一名英国人而骄傲。我绝对没有厌食症。绝无可能。可能是天生体质比较好吧。」继续编吧姑娘！别把脱毛减重这条给忘了。拜拜！

english: Want to know the real reason Vinewood leading man Bruce Spade fired his agent? He couldn't book him a gig at the Civilisation Committee. A source close to El Spado says "Bruce has been reading a lot of pamphlets on international relations recently. He's got some really interesting theories he wants to share with luminaries from around the world and thought addressing the Citadel was the perfect way to do it." When his agent couldn't secure the appointment (normally reserved for world leaders) he threw a hissy fit and tore up their contract. Hopefully his next agent will be able to help him get that Peace Prize he's been eying for the awards cabinet.
zh: 想知道好麦坞男一号布鲁斯･斯佩德解雇经纪人的真正原因吗？那位经纪人没能给他在全球文明委员会预约一场演讲。一名与这位斯佩德佬关系密切的消息人士说：「布鲁斯最近读了很多关于国际关系的刊物。从中他得出了一些非常有趣的理论，想与世界各地的杰出人士分享。而他认为在自由城的市政厅演讲就很合适。」但他的经纪人无法保证能够预约这场演讲(通常是留给世界领导人的)时，这令他大发雷霆，直接撕毁了与经纪人的合同。希望他的下一任经纪人能够帮助他获得他期待已久的诺贝尔和平奖，好摆在奖牌陈列柜里。

english: Tourists in Star Junction got a surprise earlier when they looked up to see aging action star Chris Hunt's flaccid member flashing across the Weazel News Mega-Screen. Our sources hear that an explicit video featuring him and British debutante Daisy Cash-Cooze was broadcast to passers-by before being leaked on the internet. It was like briefly time travelling back to the nineties when people actually went to see Chris Hunt movies. They're about as old as the dinosaurs, people. That oh so familiar sense of disappointment came back too, when we realised that the only thing you get to see is a hand job! Boo! I watch hand shandies every morning in my shower! Come on Chris, you're going to have to do better than that if you expect any of us to believe that you stand to attention for anyone other than your little Filipino house boy! P-lease!
zh: 早些时候，路过星汇广场的游客一抬头就会大吃一惊，年迈的动作明星克里斯･亨特那疲软的老二正在Weazel新闻的大屏幕上播放。据我们的线人所言，当时播放的是他和英国富家女黛西 卡什-库兹的露骨视频，而这则视频甚至还没有在网络上流出。这就像短暂地回到了90年代，那时人们还会去看克里斯･亨特的电影。那些人现在已经像恐龙一样古老了。当我们发现银幕上唯一的内容是撸管时，那种熟悉的失望感也回来了！切！我每天早上洗澡的时候就能看手冲啊！别这样嘛，克里斯。如果你想让我们相信，能让你保持「坚挺」的不止是你的菲律宾男佣，那就拿点更劲爆的东西出来嘛！求求你了！

zh: ~z~我们杀入交易现场，然后拿走钱和货。

zh: ~z~抢劫才是真正有生命危险的啊，兄弟。

english: ~z~What we always doing, taking scores, we getting paid.
zh: ~z~和平常一样啊。辛苦干活，然后赚钱。

english: ~z~Thought maybe we could rip them off, take the money and the product.
zh: ~z~我觉得可以干翻他们，拿上货款和毒品。

english: ~z~I don't know what you talking about, man. I ain't got a boyfriend.
zh: ~z~我不懂你在说啥，哥们。我可没有男友。

english: ~z~Their motherfucking stash, bro. We taking that shit out.
zh: ~z~当然是他们的货，兄弟。我们统统抢走。

english: ~z~Yeah, bro. We hitting these motherfuckers where it hurts.
zh: ~z~好啊，兄弟。他们哪里痛，咱就打哪里。

english: ~z~Good thing your boyfriend got you that helicopter license, bro.
zh: ~z~还好你男友让你考了直升机驾照，兄弟。

english: ~z~Rique, bro, you got any idea what the purpose of this outing is?
zh: ~z~恩里克，兄弟，你能说说今天出来干嘛吗？

english: ~z~That's a shame, bro. I could do with a pleasure cruise.
zh: ~z~那可惜了，兄弟。我还挺想乘邮轮度假的。

english: ~z~Yo, L. These guys got a boat all packed with product and it's ready to go.
zh: ~z~哟，L。这帮人把东西都装上船准备走了。

english: ~z~We moving on a stash, bro. Should collect some nice product.
zh: ~z~我们要去偷货，兄弟。估计这次是批好货。

english: ~z~Hey, L, this shit gonna be fun. We ripping off a convoy.
zh: ~z~嘿，L，这回很好玩，咱要去劫一个车队。

english: ~z~Stupid motherfuckers should keep their route more secret next time.
zh: ~z~这帮蠢逼下次应该对自己的路线好好保密。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna let you kill my vibe man with your cynicism. I'm looking forward to this.
zh: ~z~别拿你的悲观主义坏我心情。我很期待的。

english: ~z~Things go to plan, there won't be no next time for these gentlemen.
zh: ~z~计划顺利的话，这帮人没有下一次机会了。

english: ~z~They got a car all packed up and ready to go. All we got to do is take it.
zh: ~z~有一辆装好毒品的货车，咱们只需要抢走它。

english: ~z~Thought maybe we could get into the mix of that shit and walk with the merchandise and the cash.
zh: ~z~我们可以进去搞波事，然后带上货和钱走人。

zh: ~z~你恐吓未成年小女孩最熟练了，你个可怜虫。

english: ~z~I just happy he lavish them lessons on you, 'cause we all benefit.
zh: ~z~我只是高兴他给你报了驾校，帮了我们大忙。

english: ~z~That's the real work, the stickup's easy. Vinewood shit.
zh: ~z~那可是技术活，抢劫才简单。好麦坞骗人的。

english: ~z~Sugar daddy then. I don't care what you call him, L.
zh: ~z~那就叫干爹吧。我不在乎你怎么称呼他，L。

english: ~z~What you mean, man? It actually called, like, the Armando Moron Cruise Liner?
zh: ~z~啥意思，哥们？是不是叫，阿曼多傻逼邮轮？

english: ~z~These guys got a chopper all loaded with product for us to commandeer.
zh: ~z~这帮人有架装满货的直升机，等着咱们去抢。

english: ~z~You mainly just grind away so your ass can break even. What specifically are we doing?
zh: ~z~一般都是辛苦半天勉强回本。我们到底要干嘛？

english: ~z~Hey, I don't need no kicks. I deal with that shit from the driver's seat.
zh: ~z~嘿，我不需要热身。我在驾驶室就能解决他们。

english: ~z~Damn right. I'm gonna get two sets of fries. That's how rich I'm gonna be.
zh: ~z~太对了。薯条我也要点双份。就是这么有钱任性。

english: ~z~You such a sad cynic, bro. Don't you ever get tired of that shit?
zh: ~z~你怎么这么悲观啊，兄弟。天天发愁还没发腻吗？

english: ~z~It's real easy for you, ain't it L? You just show up and come along on the job.
zh: ~z~你倒是容易，L。你只要集合，和咱们一起干活。

english: ~z~Figures, bro. You probably can't run on them massive jamon legs anyway.
zh: ~z~行吧，兄弟。我看你那双肥肉火腿确实没法跑步。

english: ~z~Don't get your hands too dirty, L. How 'bout you start off simple and drive?
zh: ~z~别把自己惹得一身骚，L。先从简单的开车开始吧？

english: ~z~Fuck you, bro. I got the down low on a stash and this is how you treat me?
zh: ~z~操你妈，兄弟。我给你货物的情报，你就这样对我？

english: ~z~Let me take a guess. You bribed a junkie and he gave up the stash right away.
zh: ~z~让我猜猜。找个瘾君子塞点钱，他就全都供出来了。

english: ~z~You lucky I got my ear to the streets, homie. Otherwise you wouldn't be making no money.
zh: ~z~幸好我在街上有眼线，哥们儿。不然你都没法赚钱。

english: ~z~I'm afraid we getting wet, bro. Putas decided to move this shipment by boat.
zh: ~z~恐怕咱们要湿身了，兄弟。这帮臭逼打算用船运货。

english: ~z~No, actually I don't. Not when it improves my chances of surviving a dope run with you.
zh: ~z~不，确实没腻。何况跟你们一起拉货想不发愁都难。

english: ~z~We going out to get ahold of this car. It meant to be loaded up with some real pure product.
zh: ~z~咱们出去把这车子拿下。车上应该装了批高纯度的货。

english: ~z~You know how much work it's taken to get the info to set this shit up?
zh: ~z~知道我要花多少工夫，才能得到最关键的货物情报吗？

english: ~z~Good work, bro. Good work. Just don't get your grubby ear anywhere near me.
zh: ~z~干得好，兄弟。干得好。那你别拿脏兮兮的眼睛看我。

english: ~z~Cops don't take kindly to that shit. And it ain't a fun bid when you get caught.
zh: ~z~条子可不会对这种事客气，被抓了也不会有啥好下场。

english: ~z~So we making two sets of enemies? Sounds like the rest of my life!
zh: ~z~那我们要跟两批人对着干？我下半辈子也就这样了吧！

english: ~z~We gonna highjack them on the road. Take what we need and get on with our lives.
zh: ~z~我们半路把他抢了。拿走需要的货物，然后直接跑路。

english: ~z~So we just walk in there and alleviate them of it? Why do I think that shit is easier to say than do?
zh: ~z~所以只要进去抢走他们的东西？说起来容易做起来难啊。

english: ~z~Oh, so you mean like, enough to go for the double Bleeder burger, and not just the single?
zh: ~z~哦，也就是说，够点双份的吸血鬼堡了，不是只够一份？

english: ~z~I ain't the one with the swimming problem, A. If I were you, I'd be worried.
zh: ~z~我又不是不会水的那个，A。我是你的话，就已经慌了。

english: ~z~I don't know, but word is they got a car full of product and it all sounds pretty tempting.
zh: ~z~不清楚。我听说，有一辆车装满了货，听起来很诱人啊。

english: ~z~Same old, L. We ripping people off. Hoping to walk away from this one with something some cat's got for sale,
zh: ~z~老样子，L。咱们大开杀戒，带上他们要卖的货物跑路，

english: ~z~How long you been in this game, A? What you mean "there's no way it can fuck up"?
zh: ~z~你干这行多久了，A？你说「这波不可能搞砸」是啥意思？

english: ~z~This exciting, homie. We gonna get to ride in a helicopter. We gonna get paid and it gonna be fun.
zh: ~z~这波很爽，哥们儿。咱们要开直升机，又能捞钱又有乐子。

english: ~z~Maybe, but we probably gonna have to fight a load of blood hungry freaks before we get to the chopper.
zh: ~z~也许吧，但上直升机前可能还得和一帮嗜血的怪物打一架。

english: ~z~They is two parties meeting right now. We can go in there when the cash and the shit is on the table.
zh: ~z~现在有两拨人在。等他们交钱交货，我们就把东西都抢过来。

english: ~z~I ain't got no problem no more, L. I spent most last summer at the public pool.
zh: ~z~我早就会水了，L。去年夏天我几乎都泡在了公共泳池里了。

english: ~z~One day I will and I'll have saved some of this cash for her. Anyway, these cats is holding.
zh: ~z~总有一天会的，我也在为了那个她存钱了。总之，这些先放放。

english: ~z~Guys have a car all packed up with shit and it ain't even on the move yet. We just picking up a stationary vehicle.
zh: ~z~那帮人把货装上车了，开都没开走。我们把停着的车偷走就行。

english: ~z~Yo A, you should watch out, man. There's all kind of germs on the street. You don't wanna catch no rat flu.
zh: ~z~哟，A，你小心点，伙计。街上到处是细菌，你不想得流感吧。

english: ~z~We ain't doing it for the romantical aspect, bro. They moving shit by boat, and that's how it's gotta be took.
zh: ~z~又不是来拍泰坦尼克，兄弟。他们拿船运货，我们才要开船去抢。

english: ~z~You funny, you real funny. I mean we taking that shit. Some fools packed it with product.
zh: ~z~你个逗逼，你真的逗。我是说偷过来以后。有傻逼在船上装了货。

english: ~z~Sure bro, no doubt. I can handle that shit, or at least, I'm dumb enough to try.
zh: ~z~确实，兄弟，没毛病。我能应付得了。再不济，我也愿意试一试。

english: ~z~You want me to give you a beat? I thought you quit rapping, bro, after everyone laughed at you.
zh: ~z~要我来点节拍吗？我以为大家都笑话你之后，你就不敢说唱了，兄弟。

english: ~z~Let's just hope they pussies too, man. That way you get your third P and we walk out of there not dead.
zh: ~z~希望他们的战力也是屁吧，哥们。这样凑齐三P，我们才能活着出去。

english: ~z~Ain't you a specifical little bitch? Okay, we busting open a convoy and taking their shit.
zh: ~z~你这逼崽子咋这么多问题？好吧，我们要截住一个车队，抢走他们的货。

english: ~z~Sounds like a plan, man. Here's hoping it'll all work out that simple. With you involved, how can we go wrong?
zh: ~z~听上去还不错，哥们。希望执行起来也那么容易。有你在，怎么会失手？

english: ~z~Hope you got your kicks on, L. We chasing a moving target. Guys are taking a shipment across town.
zh: ~z~希望你热好身了，L。这次是个移动中的目标。他们想拉着货穿过城市。

english: ~z~How's it feel to slum it, bro? You driving around two low rate pushers, not some Vinewood slut.
zh: ~z~过苦日子的感觉如何，兄弟？带着两个小马仔出门，而不是好麦坞的臭婆娘。

english: ~z~It would be if we was all rich like you, Downtown, but some of us are in this to put food in our babies' mouths.
zh: ~z~如果咱们像你一样有钱，那肯定的，城里人。但咱们干这些是为了养家糊口啊。

english: ~z~Nice of you to join us, bro. We could do with a driver. Imagine we a pair of fags from a boy band.
zh: ~z~你跟我们一起干真好，兄弟。有个司机真好。当我们是男孩乐队里的一对基佬吧。

zh: ~z~我想找个好老婆，再养几个孩子。

zh: ~z~哥们，希望今天这活没那么难办。

english: ~z~Let's wait until we in the clear before we think about partying.
zh: ~z~尘埃落定了再考虑嗨不嗨的事吧。

zh: ~z~哥们，有了钱我又可以尽情嗨了。

zh: ~z~你的头脑可真灵光啊。悲观你妈呢。

zh: ~z~我一直很喜欢埃内斯托。他很正直。

english: ~z~No, because you want to be something you ain't.
zh: ~z~不，因为你想成为不适合你的角色。

english: ~z~This has got to be more fun than hanging out with that fag Tony?
zh: ~z~这比跟托尼那基佬出去玩开心多了吧？

english: ~z~You still got something. You still a fucking psycho.
zh: ~z~你还是有两把刷子的。你还是那么疯。

english: ~z~Coño mano, we don't seem to get past this crazy shit, do we?
zh: ~z~他妈的，这一票咱们好像有点危险啊？

english: ~z~We'll do this again soon, bro. Later
zh: ~z~之后咱们再一起劫货吧，兄弟。回见。

english: ~z~Luis bro, you always pull us through this shit.
zh: ~z~路易斯兄弟，你总能帮我们化险为夷。

english: ~z~You the best, L. That's why we need you.
zh: ~z~你是最棒的，L。所以我们才需要你。

english: ~z~And you're like a cliché from a bad hood flick, you fool.
zh: ~z~你也就是个烂片台词的复读机，傻逼。

english: ~z~Surprise, surprise, the guy from Downtown ain't completely worthless.
zh: ~z~又惊又喜，城里来的家伙还不算太菜。

english: ~z~Maybe, bro, but can we focus on business right now?
zh: ~z~也许吧，兄弟。但现在能不能先忙生意？

english: ~z~We was risking detention. That shit was just as bad.
zh: ~z~万一被老师抓住了呢。这不是一样糟糕。

english: ~z~Oh okay, bro. Why don't we stop off and buy you a TV on the way?
zh: ~z~那好吧，兄弟。要么我顺路给你买台电视？

english: ~z~Why? 'Cause you worried about how many people you gonna kill, Loco?
zh: ~z~为啥？你在担心自己要杀多少人吗，疯子？

english: ~z~I can't really see myself working in a Burger Shot. I'd rather die.
zh: ~z~我不觉得自己能在汉堡店打工，宁可去死。

english: ~z~See if we don't get tracked down and shot up in the process.
zh: ~z~看看我们有没有被跟踪，会不会挨枪子儿。

english: ~z~Why? Because then you'll kill everyone again like a psycho?
zh: ~z~为啥？因为你又会像疯子一样杀光所有人？

english: ~z~Sure man, we rolling on shit. Why wouldn't I be cool?
zh: ~z~当然了，哥们，我们一起干活。有啥不好的？

english: ~z~Yeah, next thing you know, we get caught and I end up in jail, again.
zh: ~z~是啊，没过多久，双双落网，我又要坐牢了。

english: ~z~We wouldn't be getting paid like this you weren't here, bro.
zh: ~z~没有你在，咱们不可能赚这么大一笔，兄弟。

english: ~z~Apart from every hood in this city, and the police, I guess you right.
zh: ~z~除了这城市里的疯子和条子，我猜你是对的。

english: ~z~Maybe we should concentrate on not getting caught and speak about him another time?
zh: ~z~要么我们先想想怎么跑路，他的事以后再说？

english: ~z~No one special, H. You know me. Quantity, not quality.
zh: ~z~没有特别好的，H。你懂我的。重量不重质。

english: ~z~You know, I love Armando, but that freak sure gets on my fucking nerves.
zh: ~z~知道吗，我爱阿曼多，但那疯子真的让我很烦。

english: ~z~Don't waste all that money, guys. Please. Call you soon.
zh: ~z~别把钱都浪费了，伙计们，拜托了。有空联系。

english: ~z~She's okay. I think. She got the benefit of not having people trying to kill her. Why do you ask?
zh: ~z~她应该还好吧。至少没有人想杀她。你问这干啥？

english: ~z~I mean, I'm a moron and you a crazy psycho, so what hope is there for us?
zh: ~z~我是说，我是白痴，你是疯子，这还能指望啥呢？

english: ~z~And you always go crazy and kill anyone who fucks with us, anyhow.
zh: ~z~而且有人和我们对着干，你就会发狂把他们干掉。

english: ~z~Well, I guess I foolishly thought it was preferable to killing fools with you.
zh: ~z~好吧，可能是我犯了傻，觉得那样比跟你们杀人好。

english: ~z~I'm sorry. Maybe I'll wear a dress next time. Make you feel at home.
zh: ~z~我很抱歉。下次我穿条裙子来吧，给你回家的温暖。

english: ~z~Man - we're rolling now. A and L - just like things ought to be.
zh: ~z~哥们，咱们又一起干活啦。A和L，就该是这样子。

english: ~z~Yo, I hear you man, but right now, let's just focus on the matter at hand.
zh: ~z~哟，我懂了，哥们。但现在，先管好手头的事情吧。

english: ~z~She's okay. I think she prefers you and A to me, though. I ain't been a good son.
zh: ~z~她还好。就是她好像更喜欢你和A。我不是个好儿子。

english: ~z~Not quite, bro. It may have seemed to last forever, but not quite.
zh: ~z~不至于，兄弟。虽然留堂的时候度日如年，但不至于。

english: ~z~You know, for a fool with a gay boss, you can handle yourself, L.
zh: ~z~知道吗，虽然你在给基佬打工，但你表现还不错，L。

english: ~z~Thanks, H. Sure, I got a temper, but I don't see life that way.
zh: ~z~谢了，H。确实，我有脾气，但我觉得人生没有注定。

english: ~z~Why? 'Cause we could both end up dead or in jail in the next few minutes?
zh: ~z~咋了？过几分钟咱就要交代在这儿，还是要进局子了？

english: ~z~Not exactly, bro. We weren't risking a violent and painful death back in elementary school.
zh: ~z~不太一样，兄弟。小学那会儿可没有当场暴毙的可能。

english: ~z~Don't be so sure, man. This ain't over until we get the shit to a safe location.
zh: ~z~话别说太死，哥们。把货送到安全的地方之前都不算成。

english: ~z~Yes we was - but we were born gangsters. Only you wanted to become a big shot.
zh: ~z~是这样。但我们生来就是混道上的，只有你想当大明星。

english: ~z~He was always an uptight jackass, bro. Now concentrate, before we make a mistake.
zh: ~z~他一直都是那副正经模样，兄弟。打起精神来，别聊出事了。

english: ~z~Yeah - doing dope deals until you get shot or sent down is like paradise.
zh: ~z~是啊，做毒品生意就像在天堂一样，之后不是挨枪就是坐牢。

english: Things are real complicated right now. Look after yourself. Luis
zh: 我现在因为一堆麻烦事忙得不可开交。多保重吧。 路易斯

english: What's up? or as you might say 'Yo, wassup!?' Still haven't heard much from you. I left a couple of messages. Maybe you didn't get them.
zh: 你好吗？或者按你说的「哟，咋的了！？」你还是没怎么联系我吧。我给你留了几条留言，好像你没收到。

english: I haven't heard from you. did you lose my number? Maybe my phone was unplugged or something. It's been being weird. Listen. Give me a call sometime. Would be great to hang out again.
zh: 你都不联系我，是忘了我的号码吗？也许是你打过来的时候我的手机没电了吧。这样感觉很怪。听好，时不时给我打个电话吧。很希望能和你一起出去玩。

english: Do you want to die alone, Luis, because I think you will. Seriously. You can't treat people like this. I mean who do you think you are? You an asshole and you're not that well endowed. I faked it. Why are you doing this to me? Seriously. Why?
zh: 难道你想孤独终老吗，路易斯？我觉得你会孤独终老的。老实说，你可不能这样对待他人。你以为自己是谁啊？你就是个混蛋，你的屌也没那么雄壮。被你干到高潮都是我装的。你为什么要这么对我？真的，为什么？

english: Well, I'm sorry. I guess you never got the present I sent, because if you did and you haven't thanked me, that's just rude. I mean, seriously. Listen, I don't know what is wrong with you or whatever but come on. I mean, listen, I'm not a stalker or anything but I thought we kind of had a connection and in this crazy city, that means something.
zh: 好吧，我很遗憾。我猜你从没收到过我寄的礼物，要是你收到过却从未对我道谢，只能说你很没教养。坦白说，我不知道你哪根筋搭错了。听着，我不是想骚扰你的变态，但我觉得我俩真的有缘，而缘分在这座疯狂的城市里是很有价值的。

english: Anyway, me and some friends are meeting up later at the club. Maybe see you there? Be good to hang out. This guy is there who wants to date me and stuff but he's kind of annoying. Not like you. Apart from when you don't call back. Which is a bit rude. Seriously. I'm busy too. I've got a life. a good one. I'm hot. Anyway, see you later, maybe.
zh: 总之，我和一些朋友准备在夜店碰面。待会儿约吗？一起出去玩也挺好的。最近有个人想和我约会，但他有点烦人，不像你。不过在待人无礼这一点上，你不给我打电话也没好到哪去。讲道理，我也挺忙的，我有自己的生活，不错的生活。总之，下次见啦，希望能见到你。

zh: 新闻上那件疯狂的事跟你有关吗？你多保重啊，听到没。

english: Please don't lecture me. I've seen Mom go through enough to not put someone through that. L
zh: 我不需要你指导。我已经见够了老妈的苦日子了，不会去祸害别的女人的。L

english: I ain't the one you need to talk to, it's momma! I help her all I can, and she still gets on me. Love to the kids. Luis.
zh: 你跟我说没用啊，跟咱妈说去！我已经尽力帮她了，但她还是那么对我。替我向孩子们问好，路易斯。

english: Hey sis, I figured it would happen some day. Man can't control himself. Send me some pictures of your kids and I'll take down the ones of Dad. Much Love, Luis.
zh: 嗨，妹妹，我早就知道会有这么一天的。他这个人控制不住自己。给我发几张你家孩子的照片吧，我拿来换掉老爸的。爱你，路易斯。

english: it's me, how you doing? I miss you! Listen, I know things been kind of hard and I know I've been absent and hard on you, and I know Ernesto can be a prick (is always a prick!) but can you try and keep an eye on Momma.
zh: 是我啊，过得如何？我可想你了！听着，我知道最近日子不好过，也知道我不在的时候对你有些苛刻，还知道埃内斯托可以多混账(他一直都很混账！)，但你能尽量照顾着点妈妈吗？

english: Hey sis, good to hear from you! I try with momma! She just don't like me so much. All she does is give me a hard time, so it gets kind of hard. Anyway, hope you and the kids and the white bread man are doing well. Love Luis.
zh: 嗨，妹妹。收到你的邮件我很高兴！我有在照顾妈妈！只是她不太喜欢我。她做的每件事都让我很难受，我觉得和她相处有点难。总之，希望你和孩子们，还有那位都市白人过得不错。爱你的路易斯。

english: I know she can be tough, but she needs you. We all away and not doing so much for her and you all she got. I know she gives you a hard time, but she only wants the best for you. I hope you doing well and not breaking too many hearts. PS Don't ever get a job in human resources. People treat you like you need to wipe their asses.
zh: 我知道她很严厉，但她需要你啊。我们都离她很远，没法为她做太多事，你是她的一切啊。我知道她让你很难受，但她也是想为你好。我希望你好好的，别太沾花惹草。PS：不要去人力资源部工作，别人会认为你给他们擦屁股是理所当然的。

english: Heard some news from the midwest. Apparently Dad ran out on his new family too. First it was the army, then us, and now his new set of kids. He's living with a waitress or something. He's a fucking asshole, L. I can't believe you still keep those photos of him up. Anyway, thought you'd want to know. Don't turn out like that, okay? I know you're better than that. Just saying...
zh: 我听到了来自中西部的消息，老爸从他的新家庭逃跑了。先是逃离军队，再是逃离我们，现在又逃离了新的家庭。他貌似跟一个女服务员还是什么的好上了。他真是个混蛋啊，L。你居然还会留着他的照片。这事我就跟你说一声。你可别变成他那样啊，好吗？我知道你是比他好的。只是说说...

english: The only award Roman will win is fantasist of the year. I hope you are well. Look after yourself. Love, Niko.
zh: 罗曼能拿到的唯一一个奖就是年度空想家。希望你没事。请照顾好自己。爱你的，尼克。

english: thank you for your mail. I am glad you well. Look after Roman. I am excite to hear maybe wedding bells are in air soon? What about you, my son? I will write again, soon.
zh: 谢谢你的邮件。你过得好就好。照顾好罗曼。很高兴他即将迎来婚礼的钟声。那你呢，我的儿子？我会再写信给你的。

english: He is still the same - a little fat boy who makes things up and whom everybody loves. it has been interesting in this country. Like home, only with food and more anxiety. Your loving son.
zh: 他还是老样子，还是那个爱编故事却又讨人喜欢的小胖子。这个国家的生活挺有意思，跟老家差不多，只是不愁吃喝，而且烦恼更多。你亲爱的儿子。

english: In America I imagine the people must be bitter. The world used to love the, now they are despised. This President Lawton seems like a foolish man. Have you met him? Roman said that you and him were up for a prestigious award and you had some powerful friends.
zh: 我想美国人一定更加痛苦吧。世界曾经爱着美国，但现在只剩下轻蔑了。劳顿总统看着就是个蠢蛋。你见过他吗？罗曼说你跟总统一起去领了个重量级奖项，还说你有很厉害的朋友。

english: Life here is the same as it always was. People argue, the farms suffer, we pay taxes for new parliament buildings and government reports, and live in poverty. For country people, life is the same the world. Please write me.
zh: 这里的生活还是老样子。人们吵来吵去，农场各种状况。我们交税建造新的国会大厦，养着那些公务员，自己的生活倒还是那么贫困。对乡下人来说，在哪过日子都一样。请给我回信。

english: Word in the village is that Roman was killed on wedding day. I know it is true, as I checked on internet. My son, my heart is broken. Please leave evil place. Please go somewhere safe. Please do not caught up in madness. Please do not become statistic.
zh: 村子里说罗曼在婚礼上被杀了。我知道这是真的，我在网上查到了。我的儿子，我的心都碎了。离开这个邪恶的地方吧，找个安全的地方。请不要陷入疯狂，不要让死亡人数再多一个。

english: . He is still the same - a little fat boy who makes things up and whom everybody loves. it has been interesting in this country. Like home, only with food and more anxiety. s ljubavlju, Your loving son.
zh: 他还是老样子，还是那个爱编故事却又讨人喜欢的小胖子。这个国家的生活挺有意思，跟老家差不多，只是不愁吃喝，而且烦恼更多。s ljubavlju (爱你)，你亲爱的儿子。

english: I hear Roman is getting married! I am so excited. I also heard you had a nice girl, and you could not seem to commit to her? I wish I could make it to the wedding. Have a good time, my son. I am so proud of you both. s ljubavlju,
zh: 听说罗曼要结婚啦！我太激动了。听说你也找到了个好姑娘，但你好像不想向她求婚？真希望我能来参加婚礼。祝你生活愉快，我的儿子。我为你们骄傲。s ljubavlju (爱你)，

english: thank you for your e mail. It made me cry. At least you are well and happy. I know you cannot live here and be well. I hope happiness finds you. Look after cousin. He is good boy. I dream of both of you settling down with nice women. It is what his mother would have wanted, as well. I will write soon.
zh: 谢谢你的邮件，读得我两眼泪汪汪，至少你现在很幸福。我知道你回老家住没法过日子。希望你能遇见幸福。照顾好你堂兄，他是个好孩子。希望你们都能找到真爱，安定下来，罗曼的母亲也会这么想的。我会再写信给你的。

english: He is not a professional wrestler, but I get the sense he still likes to wrestle with men as keen amateur. We have met many people, but most of them have little power and are controlled only by money. Life is strange here. One friend of Roman's likes to inject himself with shark testosterone. These are the kind of people we know here.
zh: 他不是职业摔跤手，但我觉得他还是愿意作为业余爱好者跟别人摔跤的。我们是遇到了很多人，但他们大多没什么能力，眼睛里只有钱。这里的生活很奇怪，罗曼的一个朋友还喜欢给自己打牛鲨睾酮。我们认识的就是这几种人。

english: He is not a professional wrestler, but I get the sense he still likes to wrestle with men as keen amateur. We have met many people, but most of them have little power and are controlled only by money. Life is strange here. One friend of Roman's likes to inject himself with shark testosterone. These are the kind of people we know here.
zh: 他不是职业摔跤手，但我觉得他还是愿意作为业余爱好者跟别人摔跤的。我们是遇到了很多人，但他们大多没什么能力，眼睛里只有钱。这里的生活很奇怪，罗曼的一个朋友还喜欢给自己打牛鲨睾酮。我们认识的就是这几种人。

english: Dear mother, thanks for your mail. Life in America is okay, thank you for your concern. I wish Roman would join me from his time spent living in clouds. He makes things up, I don't know why. He has a nice woman in his life, that is true, the rest is lies. Apart from Florian Cravic. We have seen him. He is very different.
zh: 亲爱的妈妈，谢谢你的来信。我在美国的生活还好，多谢你的关心。希望罗曼能离开他的幻想国度，回到现实中来。也不知道为什么，他就喜欢胡扯。他是找到了一个好女人，这句没错，剩下都是编的。我们也见到弗洛里安･克拉维克了，他变化好大。

english: I was thinking about you, and I thought I write. I receive nice e mail from your cousin. He say you had seen Florian Cravic again. Did he become a professional wrestler, as he say? He was always strange boy. Roman also tells me he has woman nice in his life and that maybe there was someone special for you too. Life here is much same - crops grow,
zh: 刚才在想你的事，我就把想法都写下来了。我收到了你堂兄的邮件，他说你已经见到弗洛里安･克拉维克了。他有实现职业摔跤手之梦吗？这孩子一直都有点怪。罗曼跟我说他找到了一个好女人，还说你也已经有了人选。这里的生活变化不大，我们种种庄稼，

english: Dear mother, thank you for your e mail. I am always happy to hear from you. I am sorry I have not been much of a son to you, and that I am not there to take care of you, but you know I cannot come back home. It would bring trouble, and unhappy memories for both of us. Roman is well. He is living the American dream, mostly in his head, like all dreams.
zh: 亲爱的妈妈，谢谢你的来信。我总是期待着你给我写信的。很对不起，儿子没能为你尽孝，也没能在家照顾你。但你也知道，我不能回家。回来的话会有人找我麻烦的，还可能让我们想起那些不快的回忆。罗曼他很好，他正活在想象中的美国梦里，黄粱一梦。

english: the country flounders, British people come to buy holiday homes they never visit, the politicians argue and we all want things will change. I have long memory. Life always confusing uncertain. Only problems change. We have never known freedom, and nor democracy. Sometimes, I think this makes realist life easier for us.
zh: 国家原地踏步，英国人来这里买一辈子都不会住的度假屋，政治家各执己见。我们都希望情况能有所改变。我还记得以前的事，人生就是迷离又充满变数的，只是遇到的问题不同。我们不知道什么自由，也不知道民主。有时我觉得这样反倒让我们生活得更加轻松。

english: breaks heart of mine to think of you never here. I know life has not always easy for you, Niko. I know you had many trouble, and I know you have done many bad thing, but please know that I am mother, your mother, and I do not judge you. I judge the world for making you so, you who has so much to give people, who is man of principle, who always tried to live the correct way.
zh: 但想到你不会再回来，我又会感到失落。我知道你的生活并不顺利，尼克。我知道你有很多麻烦，也知道你做了许多坏事，但我是一位母亲，你的母亲，我不会责备你的。你明明是个乐于奉献的人，是个有原则的人，是个想过正常日子的人。要责备的是这个把人变成鬼的世界。

english: Nadam se da si dobro i da si srecan u Americi. I hope this reaches you and you respond. I miss you. I write in English because now you are like Roman. He tells me he only speaks English now. I know things better for you to be out in world, and away from here, but I miss you. It is mother's duty to miss son. Are you no longer in sea? Have you stopped that world for good, or will you go back? Will you ever come back to me? It gladdens heart of mine to think of you and your cousin together, living a good life in America, and at the same time,
zh: Nadam se da si dobro i da si srecan u Americi (愿你在美国一切顺利)。希望你能收到这封邮件，再给我回个信。我很想你。罗曼告诉我他现在只会英语了，你应该也差不多吧，所以这封信是用英语写的。我知道你离开家乡会过得更好，但我依然想你。思念游子是母亲的责任。你不在船上干了吗？你是想就此留在外面的世界，还是回到故乡？你还会回到我身边吗？一想到你跟你堂兄一起，在美国过着好日子，我就很高兴；

zh: 你最牛逼，多给妈妈寄点钱吧。我很乐意见到你来自由城跟我谈谈。你的弟弟，L。

english: You're pathetic, pal. You make me sick. Your life is a joke. Get real. I am ashamed to call you my brother. Ashamed. I pretend you don't exist. My kids think you're dead. But Ma needs better than what you give her. So that's why I am emailing. So sort yourself out, or you will have me to answer to.
zh: 你太可悲了，朋友。你让我恶心，你的生活就是个笑话。现实点吧！叫你弟弟已经让我很羞耻了。羞耻。我假装你不存在。我的孩子都认为你已经死了。但妈需要的不止是你给的钱。所以我才会我发邮件给你。别这样生活了，否则我要你好看。

english: I hope you are doing better than when we last spoke. Listen, I won't waste time on pleasantries. I am sure your life as a pimp and drug pusher and night club man is great, but you are killing Ma. She is worried sick and quite frankly, I've had about enough. When the kids' break up for school, I've got half a mind to come there and give you a piece of my mind.
zh: 希望你现在的情况比我们上次交流时更好了。听着，我不想浪费时间说客套话。我很确定你当皮条客、毒品贩子、夜店经理的工作是伟大的，但你这样让妈很担心。她最近十分焦虑，坦白说，我受够了。我都想等孩子们放假的时候回来跟你谈谈我的想法了。

english: Ernesto! My dear brother! I hope being an accountant is still as much fun as ever! Man you are so lucky! Looking at columns of numbers all day. I miss you, bro. I really do. But since you left town and don't send Momma no money, I'm about all she got left. Now, I ain't perfect, but at least I actually seen my momma in the last five years. english: Fear Fatigue
Subway Car Stolen
Sitting Duck Quacks
Pirates on the Open Rails
President Sets up Task Force
Citizens Speak Out Against Age of Paranoia
zh: 市民发声反对偏执时代

english: Authorities Await Ransom Demands
zh: 当局正在等待赎金要求

english: While no ransom demands have been delivered yet, the mayor expects this incident to be in line with other recent piracy around the world. Coming in a year in which an oil rig was stolen in the North Sea and an entire skyscraper went missing in Singapore, it is now thought that nowhere is safe from the pirate menace.
zh: 虽然尚未收到赎金要求，但市长预计这次事件将与最近世界各地的其他海盗事件一样。在这一年里，北海的一个石油钻井平台被盗，新加坡的一整栋摩天大楼失踪。现在人们觉得没有任何地方可以免遭海盗毒手。

english: Under intense political pressure, President Lawton made a major promise yesterday to get down to action, with immediate effect. Responding aggressively to recent criticism that he is a show pony who is only concerned with making sure he gets favorable media coverage, Mr. Lawton made an impassioned speech, promising immediate results.
zh: 在巨大的政治压力下，劳顿总统昨日作出了一项重大承诺，要采取成效显著的举措。最近有人批评他是只关心媒体形象的做秀者，对此劳顿做出了有力回应。他进行了一场慷慨激昂的演讲，承诺会有立竿见影的效果。

english: Citizens are growing increasingly tired of being told to be scared shitless. "It really wears on me," 34 year old Broker resident Hamil Hajaj said. "I've had a heart attack and three strokes. I can't take it anymore." In light of the recent attacks, many say they'd rather take their chances than deal with the congestion, inconvenience and loss of liberty that comes with a so-called safer community.
zh: 市民们越来越厌倦被灌输的种种恐慌。34岁的布洛克区居民哈米尔･哈贾吉说：「这真的让我很烦。我犯了一次心脏病，还中风过三次。我再也受不了了。」鉴于最近发生的袭击事件，许多人表示，他们宁愿冒险，也不想再搭理所谓的安全起见，它只会带来拥挤、不便和束缚。

english: From the coast of East Africa to the shores of the Humboldt River, pirates have become the principal menace to twenty first century commuters. In one of the most daring steals of the last few months, a band of pirates have stolen a subway car in Broker. Bystanders report a "dusky" looking man climbing along the roof of the train and unhooking it before it was pulled into the air by a Skylift. Authorities lost track of the car and Skylift as it disappeared behind a building.
zh: 从东非海岸到洪堡河沿岸，海盗已经成为21世纪上班族的主要威胁。日前一伙海盗在布洛克偷了一节地铁车厢，这是过去几个月里最大胆的劫案之一。据目击者称，一名「黑不溜秋」的男子爬上列车车顶，脱开车钩，车厢随后被一架吊挂直升机拉入空中。拉着车厢的直升机在绕到一栋大楼后面后消失，当局因此失去了它的踪迹。

english: He's setting up a task force with a web site and Bleeter page to ensure things happen quickly to get everything back on track in an all out assault on government action. Lawton looked compassionate but strong and promised to continue to improve the country, reduce taxes, punish foreigners and increase government spending in most areas, but sensibly and with one eye on what America is and another on what it could become. He received a standing ovation for the speech. We will stay with this fluff piece our owner made us run.
zh: 他正在筹建一支配有官方网站和Bleeter账号的特别工作组，以确保工作顺利推进，并通过遍地开花的政策让国家的一切重回正轨。劳顿看上去富有同情心，但态度强硬，他承诺将继续改善这个国家，减少税收，惩处外国人，并在大多数领域增加政府支出，但要理智。他一方面着眼于美国的现状，另一方面着眼于它的未来。他的演讲博得全场起立鼓掌。我们将继续关注我们的老板让我们发的这篇通稿。

english: More than half a million dollars taken
Heist Ends in Death Blood Shocker
zh: 抢劫以骇人的血腥惨案收场

english: A raid on Bank of Liberty has ended in tragedy, police are hunting three suspects
zh: 自由城银行的劫案以悲剧告终，警方正在搜捕三名嫌疑人

english: A daring raid on a downtown branch of the Bank of Liberty has left one robber dead along with multiple police and civilian casualties. The suspect has been identified as Michael Keane, a convicted felon from Dukes. Four men wearing suits and balaclavas entered the branch and held the customers hostage while blowing the door to the vault with explosives. In the confusion, brave customer Eugene Reaper attempted to stop the robbery and was murdered in cold blood. Three robbers left the bank on foot and fought their way through police before escaping on the subway. Authorities are questioning all known associates of Mr. Keane in an attempt to discover the identities of his accomplices. The Bank of Liberty estimates that in excess of half a million dollars was stolen.
zh: 自由城银行中心支行遭到大胆袭击，劫匪团伙造成包括警察和平民在内的多名人员伤亡。劫匪中有一人死亡，其姓名为迈克尔･基恩，是一名居住在公爵区的重罪犯。四名身着西装的蒙面男子进入银行，挟持银行客户作为人质，同时炸开了金库大门。在混乱中，勇敢的客户尤金･里珀试图阻止抢劫，结果被残忍地杀害。三名劫匪步行离开银行，一路杀入地铁站，逃离了警方追捕。有关部门正在询问所有与基恩先生往来的人，以查明其他劫匪的身份。据自由城银行估算，此次有超过50万美元被盗。

english: The Rule of the Mob
Staff Writer
Staff Writer
Oh Mamma!
B & T Crowd Get Violent
Mafia Shootout in Algonquin Nightspot
zh: 阿尔冈琴夜店发生帮派火并

english: Subway Shock as Air Guitar Man Mauled
zh: 地铁惨案：空气吉他手惨遭分尸

english: Star's Desperate Scrape for Ratings
zh: 众明星为争抢收视率使尽浑身解数

english: Howitzer to the face

As if Algonquin residents didn't have enough reasons to resent the hordes of outer borough residents who stream into the center of the city every night, they're now putting them at the risk of being shot. Notorious bridge and tunnel mecca, dance club Bahama Mamma's, was recently the site of a violent shootout that left several dead including club owner Vic Manzano.
zh: 远郊的居民每晚都会涌入市中心，令阿尔冈琴的居民叫苦连天。然而现在，前者还给后者带来了被枪击的风险。臭名昭著的城郊野人圣地，巴哈马妈妈舞厅，发生了一起枪击事件，造成包括店主维克･曼萨诺在内的数人死亡。

english: Manzano was being investigated by the FIB for his links with organised crime in Liberty City and Las Venturas. He was also thought to be in a spat with members of the Ancellotti Crime Syndicate. Authorities are investigating these leads as possible motivations for the mass shooting. Meanwhile a group of Algonquin residents is lobbying the Civic Citadel to reclose the bridges to keep the bridge and tunnel menace out.
zh: 此前，曼萨诺因与自由城和拉斯文加斯两地的有组织犯罪存在联系，受到了FIB的调查。他也被认为曾与安切洛蒂犯罪家族的成员发生口角。有关部门已将这些线索作为可能的犯案动机调查。与此同时，一群阿尔冈琴居民正在市政厅前游行，要求重新封锁大桥，以杜绝城郊野人的威胁。

english: Is there any celebrity with a shred of dignity left? Another middle aged has-been has decided to humiliate himself. Jack Howitzer's recently launched reality show is a ratings disaster, which has the writers and producers scrambling for some unplanned drama to unfold. Rumors abound that a reunion of Howitzer and Ho Chi is in the works, in which Howitzer breaks down and cries after apologizing for the sexual advances that broke up the duo. Desperate, but it might just work.
zh: 还有哪一位名人保留着一丝尊严吗？现在，又有一位已至中年的过气名人决定自取其辱了。杰克･豪泽最近推出的真人秀简直是一场收视率灾难，节目中总会出现一些即兴情节，扰乱编剧和制片人的安排。众多小道消息称Howitzer与Ho Chi的复合正在进行中，此前两人因性骚扰关系破裂，Howitzer为此道歉后失声痛哭。为了收视率使出浑身解数，总归会有点作用吧。

english: A man was killed on the subway when an angry mob took exception to his refusal to stop playing air guitar while he listened to his mp3 player. After repeated requests to stop annoying everybody, the man was turned on by a mob and ripped apart. Passersby cheered as both locals and tourists ripped the man into shreds and scattered bloody remains all over the carriage. Witnesses spoke of a happy, festive atmosphere amongst the mob which is thought to have included three nuns, two teachers and a mother of six. Such was the state of the victim that police where unable to identify him and are asking for help.
zh: 一男子在地铁车厢内边听MP3边弹空气吉他，引起其他乘客不满，并因拒绝停止其扰民行为被杀。多次请求该男子停止扰民无果后，该男子被暴民群起而攻，随后分尸。当地居民与外来旅客都参与了分尸，车厢内血肉横飞，其他乘客则拍手称快。谈及此事时，目击者们都以欢快愉悦的口吻陈述，作案者包括三名修女、两名教师以及一位六个孩子的母亲。鉴于被害者已血肉模糊，警方无法确认他的身份，正在向社会大众寻求帮助。
