zh: 暴怒队老板在办公楼遇害

english: Police Seek Extreme Sports Enthusiast
zh: 警方寻找极限运动爱好者

english: Ashvilli's Private Army Wiped Out
zh: 阿什维利的私人军队全军覆没

english: He wanted the Rampage, and in the end he got it. Carnage today after a bloody shoot out at the offices of highly controversial liberty City Rampage owner Marki Ashvilli. Mr. Ashvilli, who had long denied links to organized crime was left dead along with and several of his employees after a violent clash. The assailant appears to have escaped by means of a daring base jump into the street, but exact details are slow to emerge.
zh: 他渴望「暴怒」，最后也确实得偿所愿。今日，备受争议的自由城暴怒队老板马尔基･阿什维利的办公室内爆发流血冲突，造成一起屠杀惨案。阿什维利一直否认自己与有组织犯罪存在联系，本次暴力冲突中的死者包括他本人和若干雇员。大胆的凶手似乎通过跳伞降落到了街上逃跑，但案件的具体情况仍有待调查。

english: Despite the President's speech last week that the recession is over, speak to anyone on the street and they will tell you times are tough. Bagels now cost a fortune. Gas is through the roof. And daytime TV is terrible. The conservative president may be trying to save face. But we don't believe it, especially since our newsroom has been cut by 75%. Seriously. I'm the janitor but they make me write the stories.
zh: 上周总统说经济衰退结束了，别信他的。去街上随便找个人问问，哪一个不是说日子难过。现在百吉饼贵到离谱，油价笔直向上，白天的电视节目更是一团糟。这位保守派的总统先生还想留点面子，但我们才不买他的账，我们编辑部的人已经被开掉四分之三了。真的。其实我是他们这儿扫地的，硬被拉过来写稿子了。

english: What is clear is that this is a serious blow for the hockey team, who lost their controversial owner, and are plagued with rival claims over ownership of the franchise as well as documented hostile takeover attempts. The Rampage are now likely to be the subject of a series of court cases as Mr. Ashvilli's complex business affairs are untangled by the state. Hockey fans just wished they had got to watch the shoot out as it sounded a lot more interesting than the sport.
zh: 此次事件对这支球队显然是一次沉痛的打击，他们失去了备受争议的老板，面前的对手则主张拥有球队的经营权，球队同时还受到过几次记录在案的恶意收购。阿希维利先生相关的商业纠纷现已移交州政府处理，之后暴怒队将成为一系列庭审案件的主角。冰球爱好者则为没能看到那场枪战感到遗憾，因为它听上去比比赛有趣多了。

english: The 80s are back in liberty City. Not content with bad haircuts, old music and terrible economic crashes, now the city is witnessing a terrible rise in drug related violence. Recent weeks have seen several incidents, raging from stoned people fighting while standing in line for munchies to major shoot outs between gangs during drug deals. City officials denied clams they were useless free loaders and promised that things would change. With the city now solely focused on house prices and coffee shops, a reversion to a high crime rate would be bad for everybody, and maybe force some of us to move back to the suburbs.
zh: 自由城似乎重返八十年代了。不是说那些糟糕的发型、老掉牙的音乐，也不是说令人发指的经济危机，而是指本市日益增长的涉毒暴力事件。最近几周发生了数起事件，小到小吃摊队伍中的吸毒者互殴，大到毒品交易时帮派之间的枪林弹雨。而市政官员则坚决否认自己是没用的饭桶，并保证情况会有所改观。毕竟，本市现在的所有注意力都集中在房价和咖啡店上了，犯罪率重回高峰对大家影响都不好，还可能迫使部分居民搬回郊区。

english: Staff Writer
NO RAMPAGE!
Blasts Rock City
Dirty Dentist Busted
City Pulls Bad Tooth
Is Nothing Safe?
Ashvilli Denies Sale Speculation
zh: 阿什维利否认卖队传言

english: Three Explosions Shake Illusion of Security
zh: 三起爆炸打破安全的假象

english: What have a plane, a train, and a crane got in common? They rhyme and they could all kill your children. Unrelated accidents in three corners of Liberty City have shown how close we come to death when we leave our apartments everyday.
zh: 飞机、车皮、起重机，三者有何共同点？它们押韵，也都可以害死你的孩子。近期在自由城的不同地点发生的三起无关事故已经告诉我们，走出家门后，死神离我们究竟有多近。

english: Controversial Rampage owner, Marki Ashvilli has forcefully denied allegations he is about to sell the team, and says he is looking forward to the new season. Mr. Ashvilli, who has faced down a string of accusations, including claims he is not the legal owner of the team along with on going investigations into his links to organized crime, released a statement through a spokesman.
zh: 备受争议的暴怒队老板马尔基･阿什维利坚决地驳回了他将出售球队的指控，并表达了他对新赛季的期待。阿什维利先生此前遭受了一系列指控，例如涉嫌参与有组织犯罪、否认他是球队的合法所有人等。现在他通过一名发言人发表了以下陈述：

english: While the chronology of these events is still being debated, authorities have used social network updates on the popular bleeter.biz website in order to put them in an approximate order. It is believed that the first blast caused a crane to go down at the Libel site on Columbus Avenue. The second made an out of commission subway train derail on the Algonquin-Bohan line. And a third blast caused a private jet belonging to the LTA to combust at Francis International. Cleanup crews are hard at work on the sites while authorities debate on how to better safeguard against a repeat of these tragedies.
zh: 虽然三起事件的先后顺序仍有争议，但有关部门参考热门社交网站bleeter.biz上的相关动态发布时间，大致确认了事件发生顺序。在哥伦布大道的LibEl工地发生的第一起爆炸造成一台塔吊倒塌。第二起爆炸致使阿尔冈琴-波汉地铁线路上的一列非运营空车脱轨。而第三起在弗朗西斯国际机场发生的爆炸则烧毁了一架属于交管局的私人飞机。善后人员正在爆炸现场进行后续处理，有关部门则在商讨如何避免这种悲剧再次发生。

english: Mr. Ashvilli is committed to the Rampage. He's a life long hockey fan and he has settled happily in Liberty City. He believes that the constant rumors about his finances, his immigration status, his wife, his experiences back in Russia and every other aspect of his life have been spread by people wanting to take over his business interests in both Russia and the US and in particular take control of the rampage. Mr. Ashvilli is 100% focused on the season ahead. League officials are still trying to discover is Mr. Ashvilli passes their test of being a person fit for owning a franchise, while formal investigations into Mr. Ashvilli's finances are on going.
zh: 「阿什维利先生致力于建设暴怒队。他是冰球运动的忠实粉丝，迁居自由城后的生活也幸福美满。他认为，长期流传的关于其经济状况、移民状态、家庭、在俄罗斯时的经历等生活状态的谣言，都是由美俄两国觊觎其商业利益的小人散布的，尤其是那些觊觎暴怒队的家伙。阿什维利先生正全心全意地关注着即将到来的新赛季。」冰球联盟仍在尝试调查阿什维利能否通过球队经营者的资质审查。同时，此前关于阿什维利经济状况的调查也还在进行当中。

english: Simon Epstein loves his job. So much that he gets high on his own supply. The Liberty City Dentist was arrested recently for selling nitrous oxide tanks to local partiers. But some of his dental hygienists are coming forward and saying he liked to suck on the gas while at work, and would often fondle them while doing teeth cleaning. Hygienist Sarah Levin said "He was doing a root canal, and that sucky thing is pulling spit out of the patients mouth, and there's blood and spit everywhere, and the dentist started to caress my thigh. It was very erotic, and I was in to it then. But now I just want money."
zh: 西蒙･爱泼斯坦十分热爱自己的工作，已经热爱到吸自己的货吸嗨了。近日，自由城的这位牙医因向当地的派对参与者出售笑气被捕。然而其诊所的几名洗牙师则称，这位牙医喜欢在工作时吸入笑气，还会在洗牙时占洗牙师便宜。洗牙师萨拉･莱文说：「当时他在给病人做根管治疗，一根管子正在吸出病人的口水，然后血液混杂着口水搞得到处都是，然后医生就开始摸我的大腿了。被摸的感觉真的好色，我也非常享受这个过程。但现在我想要的只有钱。」

Flowerman tops the charts
What happened at the top of Rotterdam?
zh: 鹿特丹塔上发生了什么？

english: NOOSE Shady on Incident Details
Unwashed Hipster Bathed in Blood
zh: 肮脏不堪的嬉皮士浴血而死

zh: 入侵领地导致阶级矛盾尖锐化

english: Debate Rages - Has Vinewood Lost its Balls?
zh: 争论激烈——好麦坞没种了吗？

english: Another murder. Another reason to buy a gun. It only takes one middle-class white boy to be killed by a working-class immigrant to know that it is time to panic, stay inside and trust nobody.
zh: 又一起谋杀。又多了一个买枪的理由。一名中产阶级的白人男孩被工人阶级的移民杀害，是时候恐慌了。待在家里，不要相信任何人。

english: While early reports suggested that this might have been a sting gone wrong, NOOSE spokespeople are sticking to their guns, claiming that they were filming a public relations video. Mr. Saaed's death is being investigated.
zh: 尽管先前的报告猜测这是一场失败的引蛇出洞行动，但国安办发言人仍未改口，坚称这是在拍摄宣传片素材。萨阿德先生的死亡尚在调查中。

english: Mysterious explosions at the top of Rotterdam Tower earlier have been explained as a public relations exercise by the National Office of Security Enforcement. Witnesses report that the observation desk was cleared of tourists by NOOSE agents claiming that it was needed for "official businesses." Several hours later Tahir Saaed, a Dubai resident working for a property developer in Liberty City, fell to his death from the top of the tower. Moments later the explosions started.
zh: 早前在鹿特丹塔顶层发生的神秘爆炸被解释为一场国安办公关演习。目击者称，国安办探员以「公务用途」为由，事先征用了大楼观景台，并疏散了游客。数小时后，塔希尔 萨阿德(迪拜公民，曾为自由城的一家房地产开发商工作)从塔顶坠亡，随后发生爆炸事件。

english: Romantic comedies are all the rage at the box office these days as Vinewood changes course from the macho to the metrosexual. It's been a long time coming. Elisabeth Lanclett, a spokesperson for Liberty City Cinemas said business is booming. "We love the trend of romantic comedies. Men won't bring women to a war or robot movie, but women will drag their men to a romantic comedy. And the men will shove his face full of expensive food from the snack stand just to make it through the film." Experts say it's a phenomenon they don't yet have a theory but isn't it worthy of a major government study as it seems really important?
zh: 随着好麦坞由主打铁血硬汉转向都市美男，最近浪漫喜剧的票房一时疯涨。美男子终于熬成爷了。自由城影协的发言人伊丽莎白･兰开特表示，如今影院生意正旺。「我们很高兴看到浪漫喜剧的增长态势。男性观众不会带女性观众去看战争片和机战片，但女性观众却会拖着伴侣来看浪漫喜剧。被拖来的男观众还会购买影院内的高价食物，撑过整部影片。」专家称目前还没有理论可以解释这种现象，但这个课题似乎很有价值，值得政府设立专项资金进行研究。

english: A fight outside a bar in Broker's East Hook neighborhood ended in death and carnage last night. The One-Eyed Sailor, a neighborhood dive bar for over 50 years, has been overrun with hipsters in recent months following a blog post that described it as, "undiscovered, counter-cultural and uber-raw." Jude Corbin, age 32, had been running up a tab on his parents' credit card with six or seven other identically-dressed, bearded 20-somethings since the early afternoon. The group spent a few hours loudly debating the type of bagel that best defines their identity, while slouching outside every five minutes to nonchalantly smoke clove cigarettes. As they became increasingly drunk, however, tensions with the regular customers began to build. When they started playing 80s music on the juke box and ironically body-popping, their patronizing fauxhemian antics proved too much for one local man, who dragged Corbin outside by his asymmetrical bangs and proceeded to beat him on the sidewalk, shouting, "Go back home you ridiculous hipster scum,". Corbin's friends ran off immediately, leaving the 90-pound, wannabe Beat Poet at the mercy of his 250-pound assailant. Witnesses say that he curled up into a ball, crying like a baby, and died a few seconds later when his skintight corduroys cut off the blood flow to the brain.
zh: 昨晚，布洛克区的东胡克街区发生斗殴，随后演变为一场屠杀。「独眼水手」是该街区的一家平民酒吧，有着超过50年的营业史。此前一篇博客文章将其描述为「未被发现的、非主流的、极其原生态的酒吧」，导致近几个月酒吧里满是「时髦人士」。刚过中午，32岁的裘德･科宾就带着六七位着装统一、满脸胡须的二十出头的年轻人进店，刷着父母的信用卡花天酒地。这群人大声争吵了几个小时，讨论哪种百吉饼最能代表他们的身份，隔五分钟还到酒吧门外抽上一支香烟。然而，科宾一行人的酒劲上来了，酒吧熟客的脾气也上来了。他们用点唱机放起80年代的歌，滑稽地模仿着机械舞的动作。一位老顾客实在难以接受这种傲慢而又充满恶意的嘲弄，扯着科宾不对称的刘海走出酒吧，在人行道上暴揍了他一顿，大声吼道：「给老子滚，回家找你妈去吧，傻逼嬉皮士！」科宾的朋友被吓得落荒而逃，留下这位80斤的节奏诗人任由230斤的袭击者摆布。目击者称科宾缩成一团、痛哭流涕，然后被自己的紧身裤勒到大脑供血不足，当场去世了。

FISH FOOD!
Controversial Businessman Killed

zh: 第一篇署名稿件，求轻喷

zh: 博比 Blue发布黄色动态

zh: 萧条、衰退以及瑞士经济峰会

english: Bobby Blue accidently sends graphic Bleet update to 500,000 fans
zh: 博比 Blue手滑向50万粉丝发送照片动态

english: A controversial South African business man was killed in a violent incident in the harbor yesterday. Fricke Van Hardenburg, who had only recently been granted a visa to enter the country was relaxing with pals on a motor yacht, when an assailant attacked and killed him and his friends.
zh: 昨日，颇具争议的南非商人弗里基･范･哈登堡在港口的一起暴力事件中遇害。被害者最近刚取得我国的入境签证，案发当日其正在游艇上与朋友们休闲放松，随后他们被杀手袭击，无人生还。

english: Mr. Van Hardenburg was loved by some and hated by many who accused him of being involved in all manner of nefarious activities. Having been accused at various points of arms dealing, drug trafficking, slave trading, incest, and supporting repressive regimes, some will not mourn his passing, but many in government enjoyed vacations at his ranch and hunting endangered species on his farm.
zh: 范･哈登堡先生受到部分人推崇，但也被部分人仇视，指控他犯下了种种罪行。由于涉嫌参与军火交易、毒品贩运、奴隶贸易、强奸乱伦以及支持专制政权，有些人不会对他的离世表示哀悼，但许多政府官员曾在他的大牧场享受假期，还在他的农场狩猎过濒危动物。

english: Pressing the wrong button on his phone may cost him millions of dollars as fans react to the scandalous shots of boy band superstar Bobby Blue in women's lingerie posing and mugging in the mirror. Mr. Blue initially claimed it was a digitally altered photo that had been sent out by a rival boy band. Now he's confessed all and says he dressed up for a funny shoot for their next video. However, industry insiders say they haven't had a plan for a video shoot in months.
zh: 玩手机时一个手滑可能带来上百万元的损失。现在，人气男团成员博比 Blue穿着女性内衣，对着镜子凹造型摆鬼脸的照片让粉丝炸开了锅。Blue先生最初称这是对家伪造并发布的照片。但现在他和盘托出，表示他是为了拍摄下一部MV中的搞笑镜头才会穿成这样。然而，据业内人士透露，该团体在之后数月都没有拍摄MV的计划。

english: You may have heard the nonsense coming out of Switzerland this week - no, not their claims that pocket knives and watches are a really important contribution to global culture - but the economists' summit that declared the recession is in fact just a myth. Millions of Americans disagree - in fact one in 7 does so because they're unemployed. Economists are idiots who sit around drawing graphs and getting aroused at comparing GDP numbers from year to year. They were dorks at school who still cannot get laid. We say - Babylon is burning, and nobody cares except a few of us journalists left since all the papers have gone down the shitter. I was an intern last week and now I'm Sr. Economics editor. Journalism is screwed. Big shout outs to my boys Javier and Jason. You know how we do it in Bohan, son! Peace!
zh: 你或许听说了本周来自瑞士的无稽之谈。不，不是「瑞士军刀和手表对全球文化有巨大贡献」，而是经济峰会上的所谓「经济衰退纯属捏造」。广大美国人民都不同意——事实上每七人中就有一名失业者。经济学家不过是一群成天坐着画图表、对着历年GDP数据比来比去就能高潮的白痴罢了。他们就是一群没破处的书呆子。要我们说，巴比伦正在倾倒，但除了我们几个记者以外没有人在乎，因为各个报社都要倒闭了。上周我还是实习生，现在已经是经济新闻部的高级编辑了。新闻业玩完了。特别感谢我的好兄弟哈维尔和杰森。你知道我们在波汉是怎么干的，伙计们！再见！

Finds diamonds sleeping rough
Bum Hits The Jackpot
Mob Boss Dies Before Trial
zh: 黑帮老大于庭审前死亡

english: Russian Gangsters in Shootouts
zh: 俄国黑帮陷入激烈枪战

english: The Beginning or End of Mafiya Menace?
zh: 黑帮威胁，是开始还是终结？

english: What will this mean for organized crime in LC?
zh: 这对自由城的犯罪集团意味着什么？

english: Jon Gravelli cheated justice for the final time, passing away peacefully in his hospital bed
zh: 最后一次欺瞒司法，乔恩･格拉韦利在医院病床上安然离世

english: Attempting to read the tea leaves, as it were, authorities are asking whether this spells a resurgence in violent organised crime in the city, or perhaps its death knell. Are the numbers of these Russian criminals sustainable or will this infighting mean that they eventually become extinct? We shall see, but we certainly like the metaphor. Makes us look Darwinian.
zh: 有关部门正试图「见始知终」，思考此次事件是在暗示自由城有组织暴力犯罪的死灰复燃，还是为其敲响了丧钟。俄国黑帮的种群数量会长期维持吗？还是说这次内讧意味着他们将走向灭绝？虽然这么说很社达，但我们真的很喜欢这个形容，让我们拭目以待。

english: Authorities and pundits are looking for the meanings behind two gangland shootouts that broke out in the city. Several Russian gangsters thought to be involved in a major heroin deal were killed in Hove Beach. Shortly afterwards, a shootout broke out at Francis International Terminal, culminating in the crashing of a private jet belonging to controversial Russian business man Ray Bulgarin.
zh: 有关部门和专家正在研究本市发生的两起黑社会枪战带来的影响。数名涉嫌参与一起海洛因交易案件的俄国黑帮分子在霍夫海滩被杀害。随后不久，弗朗西斯国际机场又发生了激烈枪战，最终导致一架私人飞机坠毁，这架飞机属于备受争议的俄国商人雷･布尔加林。

english: A homeless Vietnam veteran, Jerry Kapowitz, has stumbled upon a haul of diamonds valued at over $2 million. They were in a small pouch amongst the trash in Meadows Park. Mr. Kapowitz had been living near the dump and surviving off of things he salvaged from there. "Before this, the best thing I'd found was a TV and that didn't even work," he told reporters. Mr. Kapowitz plans to take his newfound wealth down to Vice City where he will start a gun shop and liquor store, "They're real men down there and they need real guns and liquor in one convenient location." Mr. Kapowitz's ownership of the diamonds was immediately contested by over 100 people. Mayor Ochoa decided that it would be impossible to verify the claims so allowed Mr. Kapowitz to keep all of the proceeds from the diamonds' sale.
zh: 一名流浪的越战老兵，杰里･卡波维茨，捡到了一批价值超过两百万美元的钻石。钻石被装在一个小袋子里，混在草地公园的垃圾堆中。卡波维茨先生一直住在垃圾场附近，靠捡垃圾生存。「此前，我捡到过的最好的东西是一台电视，而且还是坏的，」他告诉记者。卡波维茨先生计划带着自己刚获得的财富去罪城，然后开一家枪店兼酒馆，「那边的人都是真汉子，他们需要一家同时具备真枪和好酒的店。」已有上百人对卡波维茨先生的钻石拥有权提出了异议，称自己是失主。奥乔亚市长则以无法证实失主为由，允许卡波维茨先生保留出售钻石所获得的收入。

english: Mob Boss, Jon Gravelli, alleged head of the Gambetti crime family, died peacefully in his sleep last night. Mr. Gravelli, 85, had been residing at the Schottler Medical Center for the last 3 years. Although some in the DA's office argued that this was a ruse to avoid a court case, Mr. Gravelli never left hospital after being admitted. Mr. Gravelli has been head of the Gambetti crime syndicate since 1978 and under his stewardship, the family had become the most powerful of Liberty City's crime families, rivaling the Pavano family. Although he had been indicted several times, Mr. Gravelli was never convicted of a serious crime. Some believed he had contacts within the government who protected him, and for whom he would get criminal associates to perform hits and other crimes, but these allegations were never substantiated. What happens now to the delicate balance of power amongst criminal gangs within Liberty City is unknown. It is unlikely to be pretty.
zh: 被认为是甘贝蒂犯罪家族头目的黑帮老大，乔恩･格拉韦利，昨晚在睡梦中安然离世。85岁的格拉韦利先生过去三年一直住在舒特勒医疗中心。尽管地检署中有人认为住院是其回避庭审的诡计，但格拉韦利先生在住院后的确从未离开医院。格拉韦利先生自1978年起担任甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，在其管理下，该家族成为了自由城最强大的犯罪家族，与帕瓦诺家族分庭抗礼。尽管其已被指控多次，但格拉韦利先生从未被判任何重罪。有人认为政府内存在他的保护伞，为其实施谋杀等各类犯罪提供便利，但这些说法并未得到证实。自由城各大犯罪势力间的脆弱平衡或将发生变化，但很难向好发展。

english: Mary Jane made me fat!
zh: 医用大麻让我胖得像头肥猪！

english: Evan Moss, 24, was found murdered in Broker. When, at the age of sixteen, he won the Teen Iron Weightlifting Competition in Arizona, no one could have predicted this violent end. Tragically, his life took a turn for the worse. After positive drug tests, the loss of his weight supplement sponsorship deal, and alleged involvement in a male escort business he hit rock bottom.
zh: 24岁的埃文･莫斯死于一场在布洛克发生的谋杀。他曾在16岁时赢得了亚利桑那州青少年举重比赛的冠军，在那个时候，没有人能预料到他会有这样的结局。可悲的是，他的生活每况愈下。药检阳性、增重药不再找他代言、被怀疑涉嫌男妓生意，最终他陷入了人生低谷。

english: A Los Santos man, who was prescribed medical marijuana for his glaucoma, has filed a lawsuit against his doctor and Cluckin Bell after ballooning from 180 to 350 pounds in less than six months. Phil Rosenburg, who can now back-roll a perfect blunt with just one hand, claims that he was not adequately informed of the side effects of his new medication.
zh: 洛圣都一男子在服用了医生为治疗他的青光眼所开的医用大麻后，在不到六个月时间内体重从160斤激增到了320斤。在经历了这一切后，他对他的医生和铛铛钟正式提起诉讼。这位名叫菲尔･罗森堡的男子现在只用一只手就可以轻松地卷好完美的大麻烟。他声称医生在开药时并未向其阐明新药方的副作用。

english: Moss had recently gained public attention as a star of the Liberty City nightclub scene. He was often sited with minor celebrities too drunk to know better at Algonquin hotspot Masionette 9. It was even rumored that Moss had hooked the biggest whale in the Liberty City Scene - nightclub baron Tony Prince. Mr. Prince would not comment on his friend's untimely death. The LCPD are looking for a group of men wearing tight black leather in connection to the slaying.
zh: 作为自由城的夜店明星，莫斯最近备受关注。据说他经常在阿尔冈琴最著名的9号豪宅中与一群烂醉如泥的十八线明星谈人生聊理想。甚至有传言声称莫斯钓到了自由城最大的鱼——夜店大亨托尼･普林斯。普林斯先生对他朋友的早逝不予置评。LCPD正在寻找一群穿紧身皮衣的人，他们与这起谋杀有密切关系。

english: Rosenburg's attorney told Weazel News that his client now regularly devours a stuffed Pollo Toto Frito, a jar of mayonnaise, three pizzas and a plate of chocolate brownies covered in ranch sauce. He's lost his wallet seventeen times in the last month, developed an obsession with iconic bands of the 1970s and has started expressing increasingly left-wing political views. This is a landmark case and, if Rosenburg is awarded damages, predatory law firms are gearing up to get a class action suit against God, who created weed in the first place.
zh: 罗森堡的律师跟Weazel新闻透露说，他的这位患者现在经常狼吞虎咽地吃掉填酱的意式烤面包卷、一整罐蛋黄酱、三个披萨还有一碟子淋满了田园沙拉酱的巧克力布朗尼。仅仅是在过去的1个月里，这位患者就丢了17次钱包，在迷上了上世纪70年代的偶像乐队的同时，他的政治立场也越发左倾。这一诉讼在法律史上具有里程碑的意义。若是罗森堡起诉成功得到损失费，虎视眈眈的众多律师事务所会向上帝提起集体诉讼，因为大麻是由上帝创造出来的。

english: These are just some of the words that our editors thought would lead you into reading this story. But they are also words that could be used to describe how local recently graduated workers feel about Liberty City companies who are taking advantage of them. Sandra McColland has filed a lawsuit that sets a new standard for workers. After collapsing on the job in what she describes as a work/life balance, McColland is fighting for all Liberty City businesses to allow 2 months paid vacation a year, flexible hours, yoga a flotation/isolation chamber spa on site. Local businesses complain about a generation that wasn't required to work in high school, received an allowance, had college and a condo paid for, and then expect the same from the workforce.
zh: 小编承认自己标题党了，但这也确实是应届求职者对利用他们的自由城企业的感受。桑德拉･麦科兰就势提起诉讼，试图为工人争取更人性化的行业新规。此前她在工作时昏倒，因为那份工作让她无法平衡工作时间和私人时间。在此之后，她便一直致力于为自由城所有企业的员工争取每年2个月的带薪休假、弹性的工作时间、瑜伽活动室、SPA中心等福利。而当地企业则抱怨这一代人高中不需要勤工俭学，拿着助学津贴，大学学费和公寓租金都有补贴，就业后居然还想要这样的待遇。

MyRoom is full of predators

The site, at www.myRoomOnline.net, is a favorite teen hangout. These predators have been highlighted on TV shows that entrap men who want to have sex with hot teen girls, which is essentially every man in America.
zh: MyRoom网在青少年群体中十分热门。这些「食肉动物」已经在狩猎好色之徒的电视节目上得到了关注，然而几乎所有美国男人都是好色之徒。

english: You drive your child to school and teach them that minorities are all ok (but just can't afford your neighborhood because of conservative racism) and that they should treat everyone with kindness. But what about adults who prey on our children? In a recent report, there are over 8 million registered sex offenders with MyRoom accounts.
zh: 你开车送孩子上学，告诉他们少数族裔也是好人(只是因为保守的种族主义，他们住不起你的小区)，他们应该善待每一个人。但是那些「掠食」我们孩子的成年人呢？最近的一份报告指出，有超过800万的性犯罪者注册了MyRoom账户。

english: Reign of the Flower People
The male ego heads to the bottom of the ratings.
zh: 男性向节目收视率惨淡。

english: The 80s were the decade for men. Explosions, international drug running, open shirts that exposed chest hair, freedom to smoke during business meetings. The 2000's are the age of women. It's all waxing, complaining, and gossip. It's little wonder that Jack Howitzers abominable reality show is in the toilet. Our nation is no longer entertained by machismo garbage. Network executives say women are in charge of the remote control, and that they are forcing their men to watch home renovation shows and fashion makeover programs starring catty feminine men and no-nonsense women. We believe this trend will continue, while men focus on day spas and practicing yoga in a 150 degree room.
zh: 80年代是属于男性的十年：爆炸，跨国贩毒，胸毛外露的开胸衬衫，商务场合随意吸烟。而新世纪的头十年则是女性的时代了，街头巷尾充斥着脱毛、抱怨和八卦新闻。正因如此，杰克･豪泽的垃圾真人秀会烂在下水道里也不奇怪了。我国国民已不再中意这些大男子主义的糟粕。许多电视台的高管表示，现在女人把持着遥控器，强迫大老爷们观看由娘娘腔和干练女性主演的家装节目和时装节目。鉴于现代男性会把大量精力放在日间水疗和高温瑜伽上，我们相信这一趋势还会持续下去。

english: Dentists need more regulation

How did we get here? The family dentist has become a creep. A drug dealer. A lecher. And despite most of us having dental insurance, each visit costs us a fortune. It came to a head recently with Simon Epstein, the so called Dirty Dentist, a sad case which sheds a light on a profession that needs to be regulated. Our children go to these creeps. Who knows what these guys are doing to my teen daughter while I'm in the waiting room thumbing through some idiotic right wing magazine? Epstein, it has been claimed, also used to masturbate his patients to relax them during root canals. It's sick, and the conservatives have deregulated our country to such an extent that this kind of thing goes on, unimpeded by the state.
zh: 为什么会变成这样呢？家庭牙医现在成了变态、毒贩、淫魔的代名词。尽管大多数人都有牙科保险，但每次看牙医还是要花上一大笔钱。近日，「龌龊牙医」西蒙･爱泼斯坦的事件引起轩然大波，致使要求监管牙医行业的呼声日益高涨。我们的孩子要去找这些变态看牙，而我只能在候诊室里翻阅右翼的傻逼杂志，鬼知道这些变态在对我的小公主做什么啊？据说为了让病人放松下来，爱泼斯坦会在根管治疗时给病人撸上一管。太恶心了。这种龌龊牙医能在国内畅行无阻，是保守派的松懈管制让国家成了这个样子。

english: Artist Killed
No irony found in hipster's death

A 32-year-old budding artist was viciously beaten to death last night outside a bar in East Hook. Fueled by the pressures of the economic downturn, this is the latest in a spate of revenge attacks by long-standing Broker residents, who believe that their neighborhoods have been ruined by an influx of bearded, over-privileged rich kids in fedoras. While we of course sympathize wholeheartedly and hyperbolically with the plight of poor, ethnic communities, whose futures have been gambled away by President Lawton on war games and big business subsidies, we can and will never condone hate. Hipsterphobia is prejudice like any other and they must be defended, especially as they make up the lion's share of our reader base.
zh: 昨晚，一名32岁的艺术新星在东胡克的一家酒吧外遭人殴打致死。受经济下行压力影响，布洛克区的常住居民已实施了数起这类报复性袭击——他们认为这些留络腮胡戴软呢帽的外地人上人毁了自己的家园。而常住居民的未来也已被劳顿总统在发动战争和补贴大型企业时挥霍殆尽，对于这些东欧可怜人所处的窘境，本报由衷地、发自肺腑地感到同情。但是，我们永远不会、也不可能容忍仇恨。嬉皮恐惧症与其他偏见并无二致，自然也有其存在的意义，更何况这类人还是本报的主要读者群体。

english: So they believe that they are unique and countercultural by dressing in exactly the same clothes? So they ride fixed-gear bicycles and live off their parents' money? So they seek to escape their privileged upbringings and middle-class guilt by expropriating the cultures and fashions of the working class and turning them into kitsch for their own amusement? So they are pitiful, insecure, pretentious, snarky, narcissistic, pasty-faced pseudo-slackers whom the world would be better off without? Are these reasons to hate them? Er, maybe. I don't know any more. I'm incapable of stating an opinion for fear that I might offend somebody. But, if I learned one thing from my Liberal Arts degree, it is this: stereotypes are bad. Never put a label on anything unless it contains animal fats.
zh: 所以这些「嬉皮」真以为穿上一模一样的制服，自己就是特立独行的非主流了是吧？所以他们就骑着死飞啃着老了是吧？所以他们霸占了工人阶层的文化和时尚，使其成为自己的庸俗娱乐，以为这样就能躲开享受中产阶层社会资源的愧怍了是吧？这些人卑微可怜、惴惴不安、尖酸刻薄、自命不凡、自我陶醉、面色苍白、道貌岸然、偎慵堕懒，所以没了他们世界会更好吧？难道这就是可以仇视他们的理由？呃，或许吧。现在我也说不准了。我不会因为害怕冒犯别人就隐藏自己的观点。不过，要说我从人文本科里学到了什么的话，那就是「拒绝刻板印象」了。永远不要给任何东西贴标签，除非它含有动物脂肪。

english: DEATH OF AN ARMS SALESMAN
Justice Done as Mega Yacht Sinks

The military industrial complex claims another victim. Notorious agent of death, Frickie van Hardenburg was killed yesterday, seemingly in the middle of an arms deal. Having only just been allowed a visa to enter the country, the slave trader and arms dealer that human rights groups have been trying to put on trial was himself the victim of horrific violence, after a bloody attack by an unknown assailant on his boat, seemingly killing all on board. This is the kind of violence we expect when the government cares more about weapons than health care. Mr. van Hardenburg who saw himself as a legitimate businessman, but who had links to countless repressive regimes in Africa and the Middle East, and who has been implicated in slave trading in Asia, along with diamond dealing and above all weapons smuggling into conflicts across the globe, was a popular guest of several Senators, who will no doubt mourn his passing and the healthy campaign donations he made.
zh: 军工复合体再次带来死亡。臭名昭著的死亡使者弗里基･范･哈登堡于昨日遇害，遇害时他似乎在进行军火交易。不久前这个军火商兼奴隶贩子才获批签证，引起国内人权组织声讨。如今他也成了骇人暴力的受害者，在自己的船上遭到神秘杀手袭击，船上乘客似乎无一幸免。在政府更加关心军火、忽视医保的当下，这种暴力很难不让人拍手称快。范･哈登堡先生自视为遵纪守法的商人，却与非洲和中东地区的专制政权眉来眼去，与亚洲的奴隶贩子暗通款曲，他还涉足血钻走私和全球冲突地区的军火偷运。不仅如此，他还是我国好几位参议员的座上宾朋，想必这几位参议员一定会为他的死亡与先前提供的政治献金感到无比的悲痛。

english: A code of sexism?
Hate Campaign Against Female Eunux User
zh: 针对女性Eunux用户的仇恨运动

english: The worst part is that these young misogynists will soon be running the high-tech companies that continue to pay women 95% less than their male counterparts. The disgusting treatment of this poor girl at the hands of a group of pimple-faced teenagers who will never get laid is a microcosm of the phallocentric society in which American women are condemned to live. It is high time that Eunux woke up to the fact that a woman's interest in technology runs further than finding a cell phone that matches her shoes. You go girl. Fuck the patriarchy.
zh: 最糟的是，这些年轻的仇女癌迟早会管理起高科技公司，接着给女性雇员开比同岗位的男性雇员低95%的工资。这群注定打一辈子光棍的满脸粉刺的年轻人对这个可怜女孩的恶俗对待，正是美国妇女们被迫接受的父权社会的一个缩影。Eunux也该醒醒了，正视女性对科技的兴趣远不止找一款搭鞋子的手机的事实。前进吧，女孩们。去你大爷的父权社会。

english: A young woman in Alderney City, who installed the Eunux open-source operating system on her home computer, has become the victim of an evil hate campaign. The Eunux community has taken the girl's attempts to infiltrate their little white boys' club as a personal attack on their inadequate masculinity and has thrown all their joint efforts into publicly bashing her on blogs and newsgroups. What gives a bunch of losers who spend their Saturday nights recompiling a kernel, fantasizing about sleeping with their mother and shuddering if a female brushes past them on the subway the right to take out their fear of women and lack of social skills on a 13-year-old girl? Are they afraid that she will disturb their circle jerk session? Since when was a penis a prerequisite for computer programming?
zh: 一位奥尔德尼市的年轻女性，因为在自己的电脑上安装了开源操作系统Eunux，就成了恶毒的反对运动的受害人。Eunux社区将她试图融入白人年轻男性社群的行为认定为对他们缺乏阳刚之气的人身攻击，并且不遗余力地在博客和新闻讨论组上抹黑她。是谁给了他们权利，让这些周六晚上写内核、每天意淫睡他妈、地铁上被女的碰到都发抖的失败者，可以将他们对女性的恐惧和匮乏的社交能力发泄在一个13岁的小女孩身上？他们是怕她搞乱他们的弱鸡循环会话控制吗？从什么时候开始写代码还一定要有屌了？

english: Exploitation that needs to be explained
Who will stand up for the privileged?

Sweatshops. That's what the ragged, broken American college student finds when they hit the workforce. Fresh out of college, a place of learning, they want time to balance life by taking long hikes, getting colon cleansing, writing in a journal! How do we expect people to be part of a democracy when they are bogged down by oppressive work 8-9 hours a day? We feel sad for Sandra McColland, she's standing up for herself and fighting corporate America. Good for you. You go girl. These conservatives will take every ounce of your being. Sue them till they get a clue that work is about more than working.
zh: 广大落魄的美国大学生加入劳动大军时所遇到的是血汗工厂。刚从大学这片知识天地毕业的他们，需要时间远足、洗肠、写日记，借此平来衡生活！如果人们被每天八九个小时的强制劳动绑架，他们还怎么参与到民主社会当中？桑德拉･麦科兰为自己发声，并与美国企业界进行抗争，我们为她的遭遇感到难过。你真行，加油姑娘。这些保守派会榨干你的每分每毫。起诉他们，让他们认清劳动不仅仅是干活。

english: Staff Writer
Grassroots Democracy
Civil liberties are useless if you're dead.
Movement to Reclose Bridges Before it's too Late

Close the bridges. Now. Despite the pleas of many citizens and this newspaper, the police bowed to liberals and reopened the bridges. And look what we've got. english: In consideration of my failing attempts to locate my client's relatives I humbly seek your help very urgently with much courtesy and hope to present you as the Next of Kin of the aforementioned deceased as you both bear the same name.
zh: 考虑到我未能找到我委托人的亲属，我不得不诚恳地紧急寻求您的帮助，并希望让您作为上述死者的近亲出现，因为您与死者同名。

english: Two months ago my client and his entire family was killed in a motor accident on a road of Ouagadougou, which claimed all their lifes, sparing none of the ocupants of the aforementioned vehicle, not one, not even the bouncing headed dog who lived on the dashboard.
zh: 两个月前，我的当事人和他全家在瓦加杜古的一场惨烈车祸中不幸丧生，这场车祸夺去了他们的生命，车上无人生还，就连仪表盘上的狗公仔也死于非命。

english: How do I find you today? Please fogive me if I am instruding your privacy. I am Barrister Saidou Bakayoko, personal attorney to the late Mr. Laurence Brand, who until his tragic death was a building contractor with the government of Burkina Faso.

english: I know that a solitication of this gravitude may cause you apprehension but I assure you wholeheadedly of the good faith in which it is solicited. My sincere apoligies for emptying myself into you unsolicitedly and I trust this letter reaches you in fine health. Please contact me at your earliest comfort. You will be rich.
zh: 我知道这样重大的请求可能会让您不安，但我向您保证，这是一个诚恳的要求。我为我唐突地向您说了这么多深表歉意，我相信您能完好无损地收到这封信。请尽快与我联系。您就要发财了。

english: After the recent murderous incident at Alderney State Correctional Facility, a security review is being called for. Sally Butters of Moms for a Police State says she's "sick and tired of criminals stealing from us. We want to put them to work in order to make the US economy the powerhouse it once was. The private medical sector has worked so well for this country, why can't we privatize everything?"
zh: 发生杀人案件以后，奥尔德尼州立监狱遭到安全检查。「警察国家之母」的成员萨莉･巴特斯表示：「犯罪者一直在窃取我们的劳动果实，我已经受够了。我们想让他们参与劳动，好让美国的经济再次强大。私营医疗机构在国内很成功，我们直接把一切都私有化不就好了？」

english: Certain liberal groups have blamed the incident on strict prison rules. They call for regular meditation sessions and Reiki training for all guards. Earth-Song Bowden, a campaigner for prisoner rights, says "most violent tendencies can be traced to a misalignment of Chakras. We need to treat the cause of the problem. Not the symptom." Whatever the reason for what happened, something has to change at Alderney State. Parents have enough to worry about with terrorists on the loose and our economy failing, our prisons must remain secure.
zh: 某些自由主义团体将这一案件的发生归咎于严格的狱规，他们呼吁所有狱警定期进行冥想和灵气训练。 狱囚人权活动家厄斯桑･鲍登说：「大多数人的暴力倾向是脉轮失调导致的。我们要对症下药，不能治标不治本。」无论导致这一案件的原因如何，奥尔德尼州立监狱必须作出改变。光是逍遥法外的恐怖分子和我国乏力的经济已经够让父母们操心了，我们的监狱必须严抓安全，别给他们再添烦恼。

english: Ever since the flamboyant interior designer, Dalton Randolph, hit the public eye as star of the home makeover show Posh Touch For Poor Schmucks, online message boards have buzzed with claims that he is as gay as a picnic basket and his marriage is a sham. Now, finally, Dalton and his wife Betania have decided to speak out against the constant barrage of accusations. In an exclusive interview, Betania told the Liberty Tree, "He hasn't decorated my interior since the wedding night, I'll admit, but I know what my husband is and isn't. I'd never dream of going shopping for clothes without him. Nobody understands layering like Dalton. Can't a man wear fuchsia and depilate these days without being called gay?" Randolph, who says that he is waging a one-man war against terracotta, is best-known for jumping up and down and clapping while squealing, "What is this hot mess?" when he walks into somebody's house for the first time. The jury might still be out on this one.
zh: 自从表现抢眼的室内设计师道尔顿･伦道夫在家装节目《雅气拂白丁》中走红后，网络社区中到处是他是个骗婚基佬的传言。现在，道尔顿和他的妻子贝塔尼娅终于对这些传言进行了公开反驳。在专访中，贝塔尼娅告诉Liberty Tree：「我承认，在新婚当夜以后他就没替我装修过了，但我知道我的丈夫是什么人。我都不敢想没有他陪我，我还怎么逛街买衣服。没有人比道尔顿更懂层次感。紫红色的衣服和脱毛就非得跟基佬扯上关系吗？」这位设计师正在单枪匹马对抗土红色，他最有名的一点就是在初次进入某人的家时手舞足蹈上蹿下跳，大声尖叫「这是什么玩意？」目前我们暂时无法确定他是否是一名同性恋。

english: After several incidents of wrongful shooting by the Liberty City Police Departments this year, it seems that the shoe is finally on the other foot. The bodies of several police offices were found in Acter Industrial Park earlier. Amongst them, Detectives Jimmy Matthews and Ed McCornish.
zh: 在今年的多起LCPD警员不正当开枪事件后，情况发生了反转。这一次，警员成为了受害者，他们的尸体在阿克特工业园被发现。警探吉米 马修斯和埃德･麦科尼什也在受害者之列。

english: It's time to wake up and smell the lukewarm, germ-infested airplane coffee. This recession is barely out of the starting block. Buy gold, stay at home and pray that your pension and healthcare policy are worth more than the paper they're written on by the time you reach retirement. The time to panic has arrived.
zh: 是时候清醒过来了，闻闻这杯温热的、充满细菌的机上咖啡吧。经济萧条尚处于相当早期的阶段。购买黄金，待在家里，祈祷退休时你的养老金和医保没有贬值到不如打印纸值钱。现在该开始恐慌了。

english: Every human needs water to survive and must expel that water - both of which have airline execs seeing green. The announcement that beleaguered airline, Air Sol, has started charging passengers to use the restrooms on all domestic and international flights could have passengers hiding their daily dump in the front seat pocket.
zh: 人类生存离不开水，也离不开排水，而这两者都被航司高管视为商机。饱受批评的Air Sol航空公司发布公告，宣布将在该公司的所有国际国内航班中推行收费厕所，这一举措或将导致某些乘客在前排座椅背后的口袋中解决三急。

english: Sources within the District Attorney's Office have revealed that there were multiple Internal Affairs investigations against these officers who were suspected of involvement in several corruption scandals. At the time of their death, the two were thought to be investigating the Angels of Death Motorcycle Club. An AODMC spokesman denied any club involvement in illegal activities. "This is typical of the LCPD, a bent cop gets what's coming to him and they blame it on decent hardworking American bikers."
zh: 据地检署内部人士透露，此前这两名警察因涉嫌腐败遭到内务部调查。遇害时他们似乎正在调查死亡天使机车俱乐部。死亡天使的发言人否认了指控，拒绝认同俱乐部涉嫌非法行为：「这就是LCPD的典型做派，明明是罪有应得的腐败警察，到头来却怪罪到正派勤劳的美国骑手身上。」

english: While thousands of security guards were busy giving cavity searches to old ladies they did not like the look of, carnage erupted in immigration, and for once it was not because a Mexican was trying to sneak in.
zh: 成千上万的安保人员正忙于为相貌讨厌的老太太做毒品检查，此时却有一场屠杀在移民中爆发，而这场屠杀并不是墨西哥人想要偷渡入境所致。

english: Security officials were unavailable for comment, but did ask for more funding, especially desiring a better gym, and more breaks, blaming work stress on the recent problems at the Airport. One airport security guard told us "It is tiring annoying people all day long, and sometimes we have to work for an hour straight. No wonder all these drugs get through and people keep getting shot."
zh: 安保部门对此事不予置评，但他们要求获得更多资金、拥有更好的健身房和更多假期，并将机场近期出现的事件归咎于工作压力。一名机场安保人员告诉本报：「整天找别人麻烦真的很累人，有时我们甚至要连续工作一个小时。也难怪毒品走私频频得手，枪击惨案多次发生了。」

english: Remember the good old days of air travel? Getting served endless miniature bottles of cheap vodka by statuesque blondes in low-cut tops and short skirts? Flying used to be considered the height of luxury. Now you have to print off your own ticket, check in your own bags and submit yourself to humiliating security checks before being herded like cattle onto a filthy plane to sit for 2 hours on the runway because an undertrained stoner in air traffic control hit ESC by mistake.
zh: 还记得航空旅行的辉煌曾经吗？低胸短裙的金发美女不断为你续上廉价伏特加？坐飞机曾被认为是一种奢侈的体验。现在你得自己打印机票，自己托运行李，还被迫接受耻辱的安检，然后才能像牲口一样被赶上肮脏的飞机，再在机舱里坐上两个小时等待起飞，仅仅因为一个训练不足的瘾君子在空管室手滑按下了ESC键。

english: A routine arrest for drugs trafficking on the flight into Francis International from Bogota ended in chaos and carnage. A suspected drug smuggler was freed by an accomplice amid a hail of bullets in scenes not seen at the airport since the last major security breach. The smuggler was freed and rescued by an accomplice as a bloody fire storm ensued, and security and innocent by standers were killed. The suspect is described as being "probably foreign" with "a foreign, creepy vibe, like a rapist." Or "one of those white guys who becomes a terrorist."
zh: 一班飞机由波哥大入境弗朗西斯国际机场，对它进行的例行缉毒最终在混乱的屠杀中结束。一名疑似毒品走私者在枪林弹雨中被同伙救走，这是机场自上次重大安全漏洞以来首次出现的场景。走私者逃出生天，枪林弹雨后只剩下无辜民众和安保人员的尸体。对嫌疑人的描述有「凶神恶煞的外国人，像是强奸犯」和「白人恐怖分子」两种。

english: Now they're charging for everything. Tiny, germ-infested pillow? $10. Glass of warm water? $5. In-flight magazine full of old toenails and dried vomit? $4. Stale bag of party mix? $6. The final insult is the $3 to take a dump in a restroom the size of a coffin Air Sol began charging. A new range of adult protective underwear called Flypers has been selling out in airports across the country. We used to have the most envied airline industry in the world. Now we sit in our filth for five hours. Like foreigners.
zh: 现在航班上的一切都要收费。细菌遍布的枕头？十块。一杯热水？五块。满是脚趾甲和干呕吐物的舱内杂志？四块。快过期的小零食？六块。最令人气愤的是，得花三块才能到棺材大小的卫生间里上一次厕所。一种名为「飞人」的成人纸尿裤正在全国各大机场热销。我们曾经有过世界上最成功的航空业。现在却只能在脏兮兮的机舱里熬过5小时，就像外国人一样。

english: It appears that it takes more than a boatload of booze and a smorgasbord of tiny reproductive organs to have a hit series these days. It was billed as: 'One island full of genetic disasters' but CNT's primetime show, Hermaphrodite Island, has been cancelled after just one season following disastrous viewing figures. The producers tried everything from Bikini Tuesdays to Absinthe Thursdays to Jockstrap Fridays but, apart from a confusing fumble between Dave and Ken in the mud pit, passion failed to ignite between the contestants and angry reality TV fans began switching off in their droves. Phoebe, the star of the show, says her calendar will be out in time for Christmas and will excite both men and women.
zh: 现在看来，爆款节目需要的不仅是一船酒水和一大票生殖器。以「充斥着灾难般基因的岛屿」为宣传标语的CNT电视台的黄金时段节目《双性岛》仅仅拍摄了一季，就因惨不忍睹的收视率被迫腰斩。制片人拿出了百般花样：比基尼周二，苦艾酒周四，三角裤周五。但除了戴夫和肯在泥坑中的混乱争球之外，参赛者之间没能擦出任何激情火花，愤怒的真人秀粉丝也纷纷换台。该节目的红人菲比表示，她的写真日历会在圣诞节推出，男人和女人都能从中找到亮点。

english: In an ironic twist of fate, this patriot's children were also killed by rogue acts of terrorism. The family is now headed by Congressman Thomas Stubbs, Arthur Stubb's nephew. Mr Stubbs told reporters at a conference he hastily convened "This is a tragedy. My family has given so much to this country and to freedom. Arthur Stubbs was a great. Great man. I will carry on his work fighting justice and honor wherever I find it. His death had made me a very rich man and I will use that money for good, and for insuring my re-election."
zh: 或许这是命运开的一个玩笑，这名爱国者的子女先前同样是因恐怖主义暴行遇害。现在率领家族的重任降临到了阿瑟･斯塔布斯的侄子，众议院议员托马斯 斯塔布斯身上。他在一场匆匆召开的发布会上告诉记者：「这是一场悲剧。我的家族为自由和这个国家贡献了太多。阿瑟･斯塔布斯是一位伟人，十分伟大的伟人。我会继承他的遗志，为正义和荣耀而战。他的死使我现在非常富有，我会将这笔钱用于正途，还会用于资助我的连任竞选。」

english: Arthur Stubbs, elder statesman of the legendary Stubbs political clan was gunned down by terrorists yesterday shortly after arriving at Francis International Airport. Mr. Stubbs, 83, was arriving in the city for a family meeting and to help to discuss bailing out a lot of rich people upset by the recent problems on the exchange. A passionate democrat when it suited him and also an elitist who hated poor people, Mr. Stubbs embodied an America that has mercifully disappeared. He was brutally killed standing up for freedom by a splinter cell now on the loose in Liberty City. Police are searching for the terror cell and advise people to be very afraid and report any activity by brown people.
zh: 阿瑟･斯塔布斯是传奇的斯塔布斯政治家族中的老政治家，他于昨天到达弗朗西斯国际机场的不久后惨遭恐怖分子杀害。83岁的斯塔布斯先生本要到自由城参加家族会议，并会协助商讨如何帮助近期因证券交易所爆出内幕交易而大失所望的富人。他是一个热诚的民主党人(当民主党符合他的需求时)，也是一个讨厌贫民的精英主义者，斯塔布斯先生身上颇有美国曾经的糟粕之风。他因弘扬自由被一名「独狼特工」残忍杀害，目前凶手仍然在逃。警方正在搜寻恐怖分子的窝点，并建议民众保持恐惧，及时汇报棕种人的一切活动。

english: Michael Graves's campaign is fighting allegations that his campaign manager bore him a love child after discussions over strategy became a little too intimate. Three years ago, Mona Arthurs, 40, gave birth to a child she claimed was fathered by her openly gay husband, Jay. However, as baby Mike grew and developed, observant friends noticed a problem - Jay Arthurs is black. Baby Mikey is apparently, not. Ms. Arthurs and Mikey, who live in Los Santos, have gone into hiding while politicans try to score points off each other over the story. Mr. Graves released the following statement "I did not sleep with Ms Arthurs, nor with any woman, at any time, under any circumstances. My political opponents are ruining this poor woman's reputation, which is odd, given that the wives are notorious sluts."
zh: 迈克尔 格雷夫斯被控在讨论完竞选策略后与其竞选经理过度亲密，致其竞选经理怀孕生子。三年前，40岁的莫娜･阿瑟斯产下一子，她称这个孩子是她已公开出柜的男同丈夫杰的。但是，随着小迈克逐渐长大，细心的朋友就发现了问题：杰 阿瑟斯是黑人，而小迈基显然不是。住在洛圣都的阿瑟斯太太和迈基躲了起来，而政客们正在借助这一故事互相博取民众好感。格雷夫斯先生发表了声明：「我没有睡过阿瑟斯太太，也没用睡过任何女人，任何时候、任何情况下都没有。我的政敌正在摧毁这位可怜女士的名誉，这很奇怪，要知道所有的妇人都是臭名昭著的荡妇。」

english: Brokerage firms were rocked yesterday by the news that some of the people who work there are not corrupt, greedy rule breakers. After a wide spread investigation into insider trading and corporate greed, the FIB only arrested 20 brokers at three brokerage firms in northern Alderney yesterday, which represented only 35 per cent of the work force. Human resource professionals at all the firms were humiliated to discover they had employed as up to 65 per cent of their work force people who are not morally destitute and greedy as can be. One CEO commented to us "How are we supposed to make our growth targets and raise our share price if we are not taking undue risks with other people's money, driven on by the desperate greed of our brokers? I'm appalled at what is happening in this town." Federal investigators promised to search out more corruption on the exchange and make sure those found guilty are properly punished with book deals and talk show appearances.
zh: 各大证券公司被昨天的一则消息震惊，因为公司内竟然有不腐败、不贪婪、遵守规矩的经理人。在一场针对内幕交易和企业贪婪的大规模调查后，FIB仅逮捕了3家北奥尔德尼券商的20名经理人，只占该行业从业者的35%。各大券商的人力资源部门纷纷以此为耻，因为他们雇佣的人中竟有65%的人拥有道德，不够贪婪。一名CEO告诉本报：「如果不拿别人的钱冒险，不雇贪婪至极的经理人，我们怎么实现营业额增长目标，怎么抬高公司股价？这里发生的事情令我震惊。」联邦探员保证会在证券交易所中查出更多腐败，并会让违法者得到应有的惩罚，让他们出书或是亮相脱口秀。

english: The transport bus was taking him to Alderney State Correctional Facility along with several men recently convicted of insider trading. The police advise you to look after your families and share portfolios until they are able to track down this bus full of miscreants.
zh: 囚车本应将他与数名近期因内幕交易定罪的犯人一起移送奥尔德尼州立监狱。在这帮恶棍的行踪明确之前，警方建议民众看好自己的家人和股票投资。

english: The Dine and Dash killer, Curtis Stocker, could be back to his old cannibalistic tricks after his prison bus was hijacked from Leftwood Police Station. If you're not interested in having your internal organs feasted upon, we recommend you stay at home this evening. That said, Double D has a history of breaking into people's houses, so you may not be safe there either.
zh: 一辆囚车在左伍德警察局遭到劫持，食人杀手柯蒂斯･斯托克可能重拾他的食人大餐。如果你不希望自己的器官成为他的美食，我们建议你今晚不要出门。不过，也有记录表明这位食人魔曾经破门而入，所以待在家里也未必安全。

english: It's part of every adult magazine: a several page spread with two nasty hot twins going at it with a guy who we'll call The Luckiest Man in the World. But is he really so lucky? Why is sex with twins ok, but inter-family sex considered foul and taboo? Reports are now coming in that sex with twins isn't all that great. One area man who declined to be named said, "It was a dream, right up until the point where two family members started 69ing. I'm sorry, I'm as red blooded as any man but that's difficult to deal with. I mean, why do you even need me? Why not call your dad over and bang him?" The twins' father refused to comment, only stating that they have a very close family.
zh: 这是每个成人杂志的一部分：几页纸上印着一对身材火辣的双胞胎，在「世上最幸运的男人」身上进进出出。但他真的这么幸运吗？为什么和双胞胎发生性关系没有问题，而家族内的性关系却是恶劣的禁忌？现在有消息称双胞胎之间发生关系并没有那么好。一位不愿意透露姓名的当地男士称：「确实一度如梦似幻，但当两名家庭成员开始做69式时就梦想破碎了。抱歉，我确实是一个血气方刚的男人，但这样真的很难处理。我是说，这还需要我干什么？直接叫你爸过来上他不就好了？」这对双胞胎的父亲拒绝评论，只是说他们的家庭关系非常紧密。

english: Despite allegations of involvement in drug dealing, the cagey Uptown Riders motorcycle gang is launching a clothing line. Known for their turbo-tuned sports bikes, blaring rap music, and reckless stunt riding; the group hopes their street wear will be a hit with suburban white kids looking to impress their friends. "We going for the urban scene, but most the shit that gets bought in North Holland and Bohan ain't exactly street legal. We looking to sell to the white boys whose mommas are gonna pay for the genuine article." When not beating up anyone who thinks they look 'kind of gay' and blowing their own faces off with over cooked batches of meth, the Angels of Death Motorcycle Club spend their time monopolizing the biker merchandise market. Their website sells everything from branded meth pipes to baby diapers. We'll see if the Uptown Riders can carve out a niche of their own.
zh: 尽管被控涉嫌贩毒，但神秘的「上城骑士」飞车党推出了品牌服装。他们以自改涡轮的运动摩托、喧闹的说唱音乐和鲁莽的摩托特技闻名。这一组织希望他们的街头服饰能够在郊区的白人孩子中掀起潮流，让飞车党制服成为给朋友留下印象的不二之选。「我们想表现城市风格，但在北荷兰和波汉流通的大多数商品都是违法的。我们的目标人群是家长愿意为正品买单的白人男孩。」在殴打把他们当基佬的人、用烧焦的冰毒炸烂自己的脸的闲暇之余，死亡天使机车俱乐部付出时间垄断了骑手周边的市场。从品牌冰毒吸管到婴儿尿布，他们的官网什么都卖。上城骑士能否开辟出属于自己的市场，让我们拭目以待。

english: Evan Moss, 24, was found murdered in Broker. When, at the age of sixteen, he won the Teen Iron Weightlifting Competition in Arizona, no one could have predicted this violent end. Tragically, his life took a turn for the worse. After positive drug tests, the loss of his weight supplement sponsorship deal, and alleged involvement in a male escort business he hit rock bottom.
zh: 24岁的埃文･莫斯死于一场在布洛克发生的谋杀。他曾在16岁时赢得了亚利桑那州青少年举重比赛的冠军，在那个时候，没有人能预料到他会有这样的结局。可悲的是，他的生活每况愈下。药检阳性、增重药不再找他代言、被怀疑涉嫌男妓生意，最终他陷入了人生低谷。

english: Moss had recently gained public attention as a star of the Liberty City nightclub scene. He was often sited with minor celebrities too drunk to know better at Algonquin hotspot Masionette 9. It was even rumored that Moss had hooked the biggest whale in the Liberty City Scene - nightclub baron Tony Prince. Mr. Prince would not comment on his friend's untimely death. The LCPD are looking for a group of men wearing tight black leather in connection to the slaying.
zh: 作为自由城的夜店明星，莫斯最近备受关注。据说他经常在阿尔冈琴最著名的9号豪宅中与一群烂醉如泥的十八线明星谈人生聊理想。甚至有传言声称莫斯钓到了自由城最大的鱼——夜店大亨托尼･普林斯。普林斯先生对他朋友的早逝不予置评。LCPD正在寻找一群穿紧身皮衣的人，他们与这起谋杀有密切关系。

english: These are just some of the words that our editors thought would lead you into reading this story. But they are also words that could be used to describe how local recently graduated workers feel about Liberty City companies who are taking advantage of them. Sandra McColland has filed a lawsuit that sets a new standard for workers. After collapsing on the job in what she describes as a work/life balance, McColland is fighting for all Liberty City businesses to allow 2 months paid vacation a year, flexible hours, yoga a flotation/isolation chamber spa on site. Local businesses complain about a generation that wasn't required to work in high school, received an allowance, had college and a condo paid for, and then expect the same from the workforce.
zh: 小编承认自己标题党了，但这也确实是应届求职者对利用他们的自由城企业的感受。桑德拉･麦科兰就势提起诉讼，试图为工人争取更人性化的行业新规。此前她在工作时昏倒，因为那份工作让她无法平衡工作时间和私人时间。在此之后，她便一直致力于为自由城所有企业的员工争取每年2个月的带薪休假、弹性的工作时间、瑜伽活动室、SPA中心等福利。而当地企业则抱怨这一代人高中不需要勤工俭学，拿着助学津贴，大学学费和公寓租金都有补贴，就业后居然还想要这样的待遇。

english: A Los Santos man, who was prescribed medical marijuana for his glaucoma, has filed a lawsuit against his doctor and Cluckin Bell after ballooning from 180 to 350 pounds in less than six months. Phil Rosenburg, who can now back-roll a perfect blunt with just one hand, claims that he was not adequately informed of the side effects of his new medication. Rosenburg's attorney told Weazel News that his client now regularly devours a stuffed Pollo Toto Frito, a jar of mayonnaise, three pizzas and a plate of chocolate brownies covered in ranch sauce. He's lost his wallet seventeen times in the last month, developed an obsession with iconic bands of the 1970s and has started expressing increasingly left-wing political views. This is a landmark case and, if Rosenburg is awarded damages, predatory law firms are gearing up to get a class action suit against God, who created weed in the first place.
zh: 洛圣都一男子在服用了医生为治疗他的青光眼所开的医用大麻后，在不到六个月时间内体重从160斤激增到了320斤。在经历了这一切后，他对他的医生和铛铛钟正式提起诉讼。这位名叫菲尔･罗森堡的男子现在只用一只手就可以轻松地卷好完美的大麻烟。他声称医生在开药时并未向其阐明新药方的副作用。罗森堡的律师跟Weazel新闻透露说，他的这位患者现在经常狼吞虎咽地吃掉填酱的意式烤面包卷、一整罐蛋黄酱、三个披萨还有一碟子淋满了田园沙拉酱的巧克力布朗尼。仅仅是在过去的1个月里，这位患者就丢了17次钱包，在迷上了上世纪70年代的偶像乐队的同时，他的政治立场也越发左倾。这一诉讼在法律史上具有里程碑的意义。若是罗森堡起诉成功得到损失费，虎视眈眈的众多律师事务所会向上帝提起集体诉讼，因为大麻是由上帝创造出来的。

Corporations crushing the soul of workers
Air travelers need to be more flush than ever.

Just as workers were getting their work-life balance back, corporations are crushing resistance, forcing employees to stay at their constraining cubicles, not surf the internet for seventy five percent of the day, and show up on time. Another casualty this week as Sandra McColland collapsed while at work. Many therapists and holistic specialists believe an open attendance policy, lack of management hierarchy, and daily breaks to catch up on literature about celebrities creates a happy and fruitful workplace.
zh: 一如工人们想夺回他们工作与生活的平衡，企业也在进行反抗。他们逼迫职工呆在工位上，让他们一天有75%的时间不能网上冲浪，还要求他们每天准时出勤。本周还有一个噩耗，桑德拉･麦科兰在工作时昏倒。许多治疗师和调养专家认为，快乐而又高效的工作环境需要满足以下条件：包容的出勤考核，缺失的管理体系，用于阅读名人八卦的每日休息时间。

english: The greed and corruption of war-mongering politicians has left our economy in tatters. Air Sol squandered half a billion dollars last year on executive bonuses. People that run companies shouldn't get rich. We at PLO are all in favor of raising taxes. But when Big Business thinks it can start taxing our bodily functions, it's time to make a stand. Boycott the airlines. Take the bus. March on the White House. Wear sloganned t-shirts. Eat more sprouts. Your consumer choices CAN make a difference. The people still have the power. Honestly.
zh: 好战政客们的贪婪和腐败已让我们的经济千疮百孔。Air Sol公司去年在高管奖金上浪费了五亿美元，经营企业的人就不该这么有钱，本报职员都赞成加税。但当大企业连我们的身体机能都不肯放过时，我们就该表明立场了。联合抵制航空公司，改坐公共汽车，白宫门口游行，衣服印上口号，多吃豆芽菜。你的消费选择至关重要。权力依然在人民手中，真的。

english: Are you incontinent, diabetic or menstruating? Make sure you arrive at the airport with a big bag of quarters for your next flight (although be aware that you'll probably exceed your weight allowance). In a last-ditch attempt to sustain their record levels of profit, Air Sol has announced that pay toilets have been installed on all its aircraft. Passengers will now be charged $2 for a number one and $3 for a number two. Where will this lunacy end? $20 for a life jacket? And, yes, before all the CEOs start whining from the top of their ivory towers, we know what's at the root of all this nickel-and-diming: Oil.

english: Exploitation that needs to be explained
Who will stand up for the privileged?

Sweatshops. That's what the ragged, broken American college student finds when they hit the workforce. Fresh out of college, a place of learning, they want time to balance life by taking long hikes, getting colon cleansing, writing in a journal! How do we expect people to be part of a democracy when they are bogged down by oppressive work 8-9 hours a day? We feel sad for Sandra McColland, she's standing up for herself and fighting corporate America. Good for you. You go girl. These conservatives will take every ounce of your being. Sue them till they get a clue that work is about more than working.

zh: ~z~计划如此。能否成功有待实践。

zh: ~z~怎么看都不是一次成功的行动。

zh: ~z~接到指示之前，谁也别想过去。

english: ~z~It's the one the Russians is expecting to come pick up the C.
zh: ~z~给俄国人装货的卡车就是这辆。

zh: ~z~尼克，看来还是得用老办法了。

zh: ~z~而组织里的人也不是团结一心的。

zh: ~z~事干了不少，结果钻石都没拿到。

english: ~z~Shit Niko, what we meant to do with a boat on dry land?
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克，船着陆了还怎么开？

english: ~z~For the record, I did everything I was meant to do.
zh: ~z~本人声明，我分内的事我都做到了。

english: ~z~Well a lot of people want to get hold of this merchandise as well.
zh: ~z~其实也有很多人想弄到这次这批货。

english: ~z~We're taking this C to the docks in North Holland. Come on.
zh: ~z~把这批货送到北荷兰的码头。快点。

english: ~z~No, but we can be pretty sure it's clean. Chill out.
zh: ~z~没，但这车肯定没装东西。放松点。

english: ~z~And we make some money in the process by selling the stuff. Easy.
zh: ~z~我们还能顺便把货卖了赚钱。简单。

english: ~z~It's gonna take more than wanting it real bad. It's gonna take a clear head.
zh: ~z~光是想要还不够，还需要清醒的头脑。

english: ~z~We should be able to turn up and have 'em load it up for us.
zh: ~z~我们应该能直接进去等他们过来装货。

english: ~z~You ain't gonna be happy about everything you get told to do, are ya?
zh: ~z~别人吩咐你做的事哪有能让你满意的。

english: ~z~There's something wrong about you. Get out of the truck real slow.
zh: ~z~你们不太对劲。慢慢从车上下——来。

english: ~z~And that means that certain people is gonna assume we'll rat.
zh: ~z~而且还会有人怀疑我们泄密换取减刑。

english: ~z~Whacking someone who catches some heavy time is just an insurance policy.
zh: ~z~暗杀被判重刑的人只是一道保险措施。

english: ~z~I'm a grown man walking around like a chump.
zh: ~z~我这么大人了，还跟白痴一样到处跑。

english: ~z~He talks a lot of shit, but he's a good earner, capiche?
zh: ~z~他是很会扯，但确实特能赚钱，懂吗？

english: ~z~The problem was Ray's planning and the amount of people involved.
zh: ~z~问题出在雷的计划和牵涉到的人数上。

english: ~z~Tommy, gimme a call if my big buddy calls.
zh: ~z~汤米，要是老大找我，给我打个电话。

english: ~z~This is it, keep a cool head and everything should be fine.
zh: ~z~就这里，头脑不要发热，应该就没问题。

english: ~z~Whether you're putting yourself in harm's way because that's the way the Skipper wants it done,
zh: ~z~老大叫你当敢死队送死，你也只能照办。

english: ~z~Man, they ain't giving up easy. We got more of them!
zh: ~z~天哪，他们还是不肯放弃。追兵过来了！

english: ~z~Too many people wanted that ice, no one was ever going to end up with it.
zh: ~z~太多人盯着钻石了，没人能拿着它善终。

english: ~z~By your logic that means it's going to end up dissolving into the Humboldt River.
zh: ~z~照你说的，这批货全得溶解在洪堡河里。

english: ~z~I ain't part of no family. I'm an independent contractor.
zh: ~z~才不是什么家族成员。我就一民间杀手。

english: ~z~but there's other times where you got to look at something and make a decision for yourself.
zh: ~z~但也有需要你仔细审视自己决定的时候。

english: ~z~Maybe he's getting somewhere. He definitely knows a lot of people.
zh: ~z~也许他能攀上高枝，毕竟他认识的人多。

english: ~z~That coke's lost. It's lost to us, man. Later.
zh: ~z~可卡因没了，被我们弄没了，兄弟。回见。

english: ~z~You're gonna learn that there ain't much in this life that you got control of.
zh: ~z~你会明白生活中很少有你能掌控的事情的。

english: ~z~They're gonna let us take the coke with this truck then, are they?
zh: ~z~他们会让我们开着卡车就把可卡因带走吗？

english: ~z~Sure, sure, I get that. Whatever makes it all make sense in your head.
zh: ~z~好，好，我明白了。只要你觉得舒服就行。

english: ~z~Because these is the orders and we gotta follow them. That's the way things work.
zh: ~z~因为这是必须服从的命令。规矩就是如此。

english: ~z~Shit, you seen any choppers? Any birds been in the sky?
zh: ~z~妈的，有见着直升机吗？天上有在飞的吗？

english: ~z~Then, they ship you off to Ohio and get you selling microwaves.
zh: ~z~然后就送你到俄亥俄州，让你去卖微波炉。

english: ~z~I'm paranoid because we especially don't wanna get caught on this one.
zh: ~z~我是有点多疑，因为这次我们绝对不能被抓。

english: ~z~We just got the heads up that a shipment has arrived in Liberty City by boat.
zh: ~z~我们刚收到消息，有批货用船运进了自由城。

english: ~z~Err, Niko. The stuff's still on those boats. We best get 'em outta here.
zh: ~z~呃，尼克。货还在船上，最好直接把船开走。

english: ~z~Some of my boys stole it from the Ancelottis this morning.
zh: ~z~今早我手下的人从安切洛蒂家族那儿偷的车。

english: ~z~Damn, looks like these guys really want to hold onto the coke!
zh: ~z~我靠，看来他们真的不肯对这些可卡因放手！

english: ~z~Keep your head, things ain't even started yet. What're we doing?
zh: ~z~保持冷静，都没开始办正事呢。待会儿怎么做？

english: ~z~Ah shit, it's three days early, Madonna mia, what am I gonna do?
zh: ~z~啊，干！提前了三天，我的天哪，这我怎么办？

english: ~z~I'll get the jobs done if the money is there, and I ain't gonna turn state's.
zh: ~z~只要钱到位，我就能完成工作，我也不会背叛。

english: ~z~I been around long enough to know that there is some things that we don't have a choice about,
zh: ~z~来这儿这么久，我也知道有些事大家都没得选，

english: ~z~You handled yourself real good back there. Kept your head. That's a valuable trait.
zh: ~z~你刚才的表现很好，头脑冷静。很可贵的品质。

english: ~z~Looks like we're gonna have to do this the old fashioned way. Get these commies, Niko.
zh: ~z~看起来我们只好走老路了。干掉这群共党，尼克。

english: ~z~It should be a lot of sugar, but that ain't the only reason why we're taking this truck.
zh: ~z~拉的应该是糖，不过开这辆车也不止这一个原因。

english: ~z~Why we need this truck? It must be a shit load of coke we're taking?
zh: ~z~要这辆卡车干嘛？我们肯定要拉一大堆可卡因吧？

english: ~z~Shit, you sound like you're saying all this just so it's clear on the wire tap.
zh: ~z~我靠，你这种说话方式像是特意说给窃听器听的。

english: ~z~All I care about is that you're loyal enough to get the jobs done and not turn state's.
zh: ~z~我只关心你能否忠诚地完成工作，并且不会背叛。

english: ~z~Yeah, sure, this is just plan A. It's the one Jimmy P worked out.
zh: ~z~对，确实，这只是A计划。是吉米 P想出来的。

english: ~z~The Feds monitoring my every move. I flip out whenever I'm even outside.
zh: ~z~FIB监控我的一举一动。每次出门我都很紧张。

english: ~z~You mean that someone in the family would see someone else going inside as an opportunity to get ahead?
zh: ~z~就是说有些家族成员会把别人被抓视为上升机会？

english: ~z~I don't know if anyone would give away a load of coke without asking any questions.
zh: ~z~我是不觉得会有人不加怀疑就交出一大堆可卡因。

english: ~z~That truck was part of the plan. You start cutting corners and you get sloppy. See you round.
zh: ~z~那辆卡车是计划的一部分。欲速则不达啊。回头见。

english: ~z~Shit, if anyone does start listening to Ray's shit then I could be in some trouble.
zh: ~z~妈的，要是真有人信雷说的那套，我就会有麻烦了。

english: ~z~Taking a shipment of coke from some Russians before they can sell it to the Ancelottis.
zh: ~z~在俄国人把可卡因卖给安切洛蒂家族前抢走这批货。

english: ~z~Since that little love affair ended, they been getting this Russian guy to supply them with C.
zh: ~z~那段感情结束后，他们就找这些俄国人进可卡因了。

english: ~z~I'll take the one on the right, you get the one on the left. C'mon, move it, Niko!
zh: ~z~我开右边那艘，你开左边那艘。赶紧，走吧，尼克！

english: ~z~It's all internet porn and dreamin about home, that ain't no life.
zh: ~z~只能看看黄色网站，奢望能够回家，那才不是生活。

english: ~z~Alright, alright. It's just that if we get caught on this one, you and me is going down for a long time.
zh: ~z~好吧，好吧。万一这回被抓，我们就得牢底坐穿了。

english: ~z~His moves might be easy for you to see, but maybe they're working.
zh: ~z~他的举动可能是很容易被你看穿，但说不定确实管用。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, maybe you're right. Maybe you ain't. I dunno.
zh: ~z~行，好吧，你说的可能有理，也可能不对。我不知道。

english: ~z~So, why don't we use a more subtle approach, not just drive right into the middle of them?
zh: ~z~那我们干嘛不换种更稳妥的方案？非得直接开进去吗？

english: ~z~There ain't no action and the only cannolis you're gonna see are the ones on TV.
zh: ~z~那里什么都不会发生，只能在电视上见到意大利卷饼。

english: ~z~You're working with the wrong people if you expect 'em to whack you if you go inside.
zh: ~z~你要是觉得进去了会有人暗杀你，那说明你入错伙了。

english: ~z~And that the only way we're gonna be able to leave that place with the sugar is if all the Russians in there are dead.
zh: ~z~唯一能拉着糖出来的情况，就是在场的俄国人都死了。

english: ~z~Family's a way of saying we ain't gonna fuck each other... at least that's what it's meant to mean.
zh: ~z~家族只是说我们不会内斗而已...至少说起来是这样。

english: ~z~If someone who knew what I knew got flipped then the whole organization would go down.
zh: ~z~要是知道的跟我一样多的人反水了，整个组织都会倒掉。

english: ~z~Me neither. Maybe if we want it more than anyone else, we'll be able to hang onto it.
zh: ~z~我也不想。或许只要我们比谁都想得到它，就能弄到手。

english: ~z~Enough governments have let me down in the past. I don't know why I'd trust this one.
zh: ~z~过去让我失望的政府已经够多了，怎么会相信这里这个。

english: ~z~No, you ain't. I ain't either. That's why we gotta at least try what we're told to do.
zh: ~z~对，不白干，我也一样。所以怎么说都得照命令来一次。

english: ~z~I don't think I'd trust him to send me on another job after the shit he had me doing.
zh: ~z~就凭他让我做的那些事，我都不敢让他再给我一份活干。

english: ~z~Hell, our own family might come after us for fear we'll turn state's.
zh: ~z~妈的，就连我们的家族都可能派人灭我们的口，以防背叛。

english: ~z~Fuck you, I ain't. I just keep thinking these choppers is following me, that's all.
zh: ~z~去你妈的，不是。只是我经常觉得有直升机跟着，就这样。

english: ~z~These guys promise you a new life if you screw every person who ever did a kind thing for you.
zh: ~z~这些人说是只要出卖所有帮过你的人，就会给你新的生活。

english: ~z~We're taking a load of product off of some Russians the Ancelottis have been dealing with.
zh: ~z~我们要从最近跟安切洛蒂家族做生意的俄国人那里偷一批货。

english: ~z~-seven horse, seven race, Joe Shmoe.~n~-Hey Phil.
~z~Hey, amigo, let's make this easy. I just wanna give the stuff to my boss and go home.
zh: ~z~嘿，大兄弟，咱们省点事吧。我只想把货交给老大，然后回家。

english: ~z~Every move he makes is so obvious, it's disgusting to see him trying to sleaze his way up the ladder.
zh: ~z~他那些举动的意图太明显了，谋求高位的样子实在是让人想吐。

english: ~z~The Feds'll throw away the key, the Russians and the Ancelottis'll know we was fucking them over.
zh: ~z~政府会判我们无期，俄国人和安切洛蒂家族会知道是我们捣的鬼。

english: ~z~Ray's a greedy rat. He wants this stuff more than anyone else, but that don't mean he's gonna get it.
zh: ~z~雷是个贪婪的小人。他比谁都想得到这批货，但他未必就能得到。

english: ~z~or you're staying away from your kids because of a stupid court order and a malicious bitch of an ex-wife;
zh: ~z~被恶毒的前妻告上法庭，也只能服从白痴判决就此告别亲生子女。

english: ~z~He's got his eyes on my position, the skipper's too, I'm sure. Wanting it and getting are two different things though.
zh: ~z~他觊觎我的位置，还觊觎老大的位置，真的。想要跟得到是两码事。

english: ~z~You know something? I woulda liked Ray to be on this job instead of me. But there's some things that he ain't trusted with.
zh: ~z~你知道吗？这次的活我更想让雷替我。不过他有他不被信任的原因。

english: ~z~For the record I don't know what this man is talking about. We're rehearsing a scene for an acting class.
zh: ~z~本人声明，我不知道这个人在说什么。我们是在排练表演课的片段。

english: ~z~It's the boss... said you gotta head down the docks... emergency... said you'd understand.
zh: ~z~是老大...他要你立刻去码头...情况紧急...说你听得懂。

english: ~z~Sounds straightforward. We take the coke so that the Russians and the Ancelottis have a falling out.
zh: ~z~听起来很简单。我们偷走可卡因，俄国人和安切洛蒂家族间就破裂了。

english: ~z~Ok listen. There's a truck waiting for us. It's under the overpass off Catskill Avenue, drive us there.
zh: ~z~听着。我们要去开一辆卡车，车在卡茨基尔大道的高架下面，带我过去。

english: ~z~We lost some of that sugar, it ain't no good taking it from the Russians if we can't sell it ourselves. Ciao.
zh: ~z~我们损失了一些糖。要是卖不出去，不就白从俄国人那儿抢了吗。再见。

english: ~z~Shit man, I'm just the hired help. I'm the fucking immigrant maid cleaning up your guys' shit.
zh: ~z~我靠，老兄，我就是个拿钱办事的，就一给你们收拾烂摊子的移民女仆。

english: ~z~You was helping those Irish idiots cause some beef between the Ancellotis and their Albanian muscle a while back.
zh: ~z~之前你帮那些爱尔兰白痴破坏了安切洛蒂家族和阿尔巴尼亚打手间的关系。

english: ~z~Exactly. We're taking the C off the Russians so they can't deliver it to the Ancelottis.
zh: ~z~正是。我们从俄国人那儿抢走可卡因，他们就没法给安切洛蒂家族送货了。

english: ~z~I work in waste management. Everything we're saying is fiction, it has no bearing in the real world. Watch it Niko.
zh: ~z~我在垃圾处理厂工作。我们说的一切纯属虚构，与真实世界无关。注意点，尼克。

english: ~z~Hey man, this familiarity is getting to me. I'm a 'friend' of Ray's. I'm part of the 'family'.
zh: ~z~嘿，兄弟，这亲戚攀的就有点过分了啊。~n~说我是雷的「朋友」，说我是「家族」的一份子。

zh: ~z~我的委托人之一遇上了麻烦。

english: ~z~You'll get your normal rate to assist them with it.
zh: ~z~用你之前的效率帮他们解决。

zh: ~z~可不能像上次那样放着不管。

zh: ~z~我得把活外包给清洁人员做。

zh: ~z~我会通知委托人你成功了的。

zh: ~z~你要找的目标在布斯隧道上方。

english: ~z~There's nothing on my desk, my brother.
zh: ~z~桌上没有任何案子，我的兄弟。

english: ~z~The kids are in bed and the dishes are done.
zh: ~z~孩子都上床了，盘子也洗好了。

zh: ~z~找点别的事做吧，别光顾着杀人。

zh: ~z~我想接份活，我的朋友。你这儿有吗？

zh: ~z~手边是有几个案子，但必须确保结案。

english: ~z~People come to me when they need something handled.
zh: ~z~需要解决事务的时候，别人就来找我。

english: ~z~Get me on the hard line if you still think this is your game.
zh: ~z~如果你还想参赛，用固定电话联络我。

english: ~z~If you want more files, you can reach me on the outside line.
zh: ~z~还想接案子的话，就用公共电话找我。

english: ~z~I've got work for you, but it needs to be done.
zh: ~z~我这儿有活给你，但务必要确保成功。

english: ~z~A quick, smooth job like the last one is what we need.
zh: ~z~这次的差事也要像上次那样迅捷稳健。

english: ~z~The target is in a car, they're moving around Alderney.
zh: ~z~目标在车里，他们在奥尔德尼一带移动。

english: ~z~The target is in Alderney City. You're being relied on to eliminate it.
zh: ~z~目标在奥尔德尼市。灭他的口就靠你了。

english: ~z~Not many in this game cross that line. So long.
zh: ~z~至今为止，这行很少有人能越过那条线。

english: ~z~This is a down period, man. I haven't got anything for you.
zh: ~z~现在形势不好啊，伙计。我这儿没活给你。

english: ~z~Get me on the outside line if you are still interested in working for me.
zh: ~z~如果你还想为我工作的话，请给我打外线。

english: ~z~If you want more work, contact me on the hard line.
zh: ~z~要是你需要更多差事，用公共电话联系我。

english: ~z~Phil's good at that. I only talk business on a hard line.
zh: ~z~菲尔很会用手机。我只在固定电话上谈正事。

english: ~z~The target's on a boat trip in the canal between Tudor and Acter.
zh: ~z~目标在都铎和阿克特之间的运河上乘船旅行。

english: ~z~A red sock got in with the white wash. You're going to look like a dick.
zh: ~z~纯色袜子被洗成条纹的了。你的形象要毁了。

english: ~z~When you've taken care of something for me, call me on my cellular, but no specifics.
zh: ~z~替我把事办成后，打给我的手机，但别提细节。

english: ~z~Be cool, brother. Keep your senses alert and you might make retirement.
zh: ~z~保重，兄弟。保持警惕，说不定还能安稳退休。

english: ~z~I only get you the prices I do because I am known for reliability.
zh: ~z~能拿到高额的报酬，都是因为客户对我的信任。

english: ~z~You need to eliminate three targets at the refinery in the Acter Industrial Park.
zh: ~z~你需要消灭在阿克特工业园炼油厂的三个目标。

english: ~z~Handle this like you did the last one and we'll collect our money without problems.
zh: ~z~像上次一样把事办成，我们的报酬就没有问题。

english: ~z~Sorry, brother. The milk went sour. You're going to have to drink your coffee black.
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟。牛奶变质了。你只能喝黑咖啡了。

english: ~z~A man loses taste for this kind of work after a time. I can't run that risk with a partner.
zh: ~z~这种活做太久就没意思了。我不能拿合伙人冒险。

english: ~z~I'll give you the job. You need to be confident that it'll go smooth this time though.
zh: ~z~我会给你活的。不过你务必要保证这次能顺利完成。

english: ~z~Reach me on the hard line if you want another pass at a job, brother.
zh: ~z~你要是想再有一次机会，就用公共电话找我，兄弟。

english: ~z~You've done good, brother. Cleared a lot of files from my desk.
zh: ~z~你做得很好，兄弟。从我的办公桌上清掉了很多案子。

english: ~z~Niko Bellic, I know who you are, brother. You're after some money.
zh: ~z~尼克･贝利克，我知道你是谁，兄弟。你是冲着钱来的。

english: ~z~It's three men, they've been lured to an old building in Alderney City.
zh: ~z~他们有三个人，已经被引到奥尔德尼市的一座老建筑里了。

english: ~z~I come to people like you when I need someone handled. Do you get me, brother?
zh: ~z~我需要解决某人的时候，就找你这样的人。能听明白吗，兄弟？

english: ~z~The turkey flew the nest before we could have our thanksgiving dinner, brother. I hate to disappoint.
zh: ~z~感恩节晚餐都没吃，火鸡就飞回家了，兄弟。我也不想让人失望。

zh: ~z~这破直升机最好别掉下来。操。

~z~This ain't good. I gotta tell Jimmy P.
zh: ~z~这可不好。我得告诉吉米 P。

english: ~z~Can't be a close friend, know what I mean.
zh: ~z~别做亲密的朋友，想想我说的话。

english: ~z~Chubby Charlie's gonna live to eat another canolli.
zh: ~z~肥佬查理想活着去再吃些卡诺里。

english: ~z~I'm outta here. Next stop the fucking Commission.
zh: ~z~拜拜啦您。下一站，狗屁委员会。

english: ~z~The fucking Russians have got to Charlie Matteo.
zh: ~z~俄国混蛋跟查理･马泰奥联系上了。

english: ~z~Chubby Charlie Matteo ain't someone you wanna piss off.
zh: ~z~肥佬查理･马泰奥不是你该惹的人。

english: ~z~You burst in the front and hit them in the face with everything you got.
zh: ~z~正面突击，火力全开，面对面交火。

english: ~z~Every time. I don't want that. I got kids.
zh: ~z~每次都是。我不想这样。我有孩子。

english: ~z~Jimmy P's taken it too far this time. He's over.
zh: ~z~吉米 P实在是太过分了。他死定了。

english: ~z~I'm coming back to clip you, asshole. Don't worry about that.
zh: ~z~我会回来干掉你的，混蛋。不必担心。

english: ~z~With all respect, that's not my business. I'm the hired help
zh: ~z~恕我直言，与我无关。我只是临时工。

english: ~z~You want me to take this fat man out before that happens?
zh: ~z~你想让我在这个胖子上报前把他干掉？

english: ~z~We shoulda whacked all them low rate Alderney hoods a long time ago.
zh: ~z~我们早应该狠揍那群低能的奥尔德尼佬。

english: ~z~Alright, now the way I sees it there's two ways it can go down.
zh: ~z~好了，据我观察，现在有两种行动方案。

english: ~z~Great, I gotta go get noticed so I ain't a suspect.
zh: ~z~好，我去别的地方露露脸，省得被人怀疑。

english: ~z~Blow up the fucking bridge... make it look real ugly.
zh: ~z~炸烂这破桥...给他们看看真正的邪恶。

english: ~z~I mean, I ain't raising them, and I ain't seeing them,
zh: ~z~我说，我可不会养着他们，更不会去看他们，

english: ~z~my chopper pilot's gonna take the message straight to the Commission.
zh: ~z~我的直升机驾驶员也会把消息送去委员会的。

english: ~z~No, paranoia is when you worry about things unnecessarily...
zh: ~z~不，偏执狂不是你现在必须担心的事情...

english: ~z~You don't need to worry about the fat man singing. He's lost his voice.
zh: ~z~你不用担心那个胖子去告密了，他说不了话了。

english: ~z~So, I go into this factory and I ice this Fat Charlie?
zh: ~z~所以我先进这家工厂，再把这个胖查理给干掉？

english: ~z~That's right, I'm gonna go make a lot of noise so no one thinks I had anything to do with it.
zh: ~z~没错，我就去别处搞点动静，制造不在场证据。

english: ~z~What has to happen is that you gotta take out Chubby Charlie before he choppers it into Algonquin
zh: ~z~当务之急是在肥佬查理飞到阿尔冈琴前把他做掉。

english: ~z~to tell the Commission that we're knocking off the Ancelottis' action.
zh: ~z~别让委员会知道我们在搅合安切洛蒂家族的生意。

english: ~z~Okay, let's go, c'mon, quick. We gotta head towards Port Tudor.
zh: ~z~那好，出发，行动，快。我们现在就要去都铎港。

english: ~z~Everyone on the Commission is gonna want Jimmy P clipped after this.
zh: ~z~从今往后，所有委员会成员都会想做掉吉米 P的。

english: ~z~Cause I been hearing things, things I don't like...
zh: ~z~因为我听到了一些事情，一些我不喜欢的事情...

english: ~z~I may be getting whacked, but at least I don't employ no low rate hoods like you.
zh: ~z~我也许会受到打击，但至少我不会雇佣你这种败类。

english: ~z~How about them swingers, eh? Great work man, great work.
zh: ~z~浪人队的比赛怎么样了？干得好啊，兄弟，干得好。

english: ~z~You immigrant scumbag. In my prime I coulda turned you inside out.
zh: ~z~你是个卑鄙的偷渡客。我要是还年轻非把你干掉不可。

english: ~z~One lesson I've learnt, Niko. Assume everyone knows everything.
zh: ~z~我得到了一个教训，尼克。若要人不知，除非己莫为。

english: ~z~You're finished. All the Pegorinos is dog food.
zh: ~z~你的工作完成了。所有佩戈里诺家族都已经做成狗粮了。

english: ~z~He is about to take a chopper into Algonquin to share that knowledge with the Commission.
zh: ~z~马上他就要乘直升机去阿尔冈琴，把这事上报委员会了。

english: ~z~Not only is we gonna be looking over our shoulders every two seconds but we ain't gonna be able to earn.
zh: ~z~时刻担心自己人头落地也就算了，我们连钱都没得赚了。

english: ~z~Great, Jimmy P sent one of his low rate goons to try and clip me. Good luck, asshole!
zh: ~z~好啊，吉米 P派了个三流打手来杀我。祝你好运，混蛋！

english: ~z~Jimmy wants you to hit the meeting while he and I are publicly at dinner.
zh: ~z~吉米希望你去破坏这场会面，他和我会在公开场合吃晚餐。

english: ~z~Otherwise you slip around the back, go in through the basement and fuck them up their asses.
zh: ~z~要不然，绕到他们后面，走地下室进去，爆了他们的菊花。

english: ~z~It's no big deal... has Ray been talking shit? About me?
zh: ~z~那不是大问题...雷还说了什么浑话？有没有关于我的？

english: ~z~I thought Phil Bell had Jimmy P under control. They've gone over the edge.
zh: ~z~我想菲尔･贝尔已经被吉米 P控制住了。他们已经越界了。

english: ~z~A capo named Benny is going to be meeting with the Russians. They're gonna convince him to go to war.
zh: ~z~一个叫本尼的小头目将会与俄国佬见面。他们会劝说他参战。

english: ~z~Somehow, Chubby Charlie Matteo has found out it was us who ripped off the Russian coke.
zh: ~z~肥佬查理･马泰奥居然知道了是我们劫走了俄国人的可卡因。

english: ~z~Did you see a blue van parked nearby as you drove here? Back on Lyndon Avenue?
zh: ~z~你开车来的时候看到一辆蓝色厢型车停在附近？回林登大道？

english: ~z~They told this top Ancelotti Capo that it was us that took the sugar.
zh: ~z~他们告诉了这个安切洛蒂家族最大的组长，是我们抢走了货。

english: ~z~Of course but they don't know that and we don't want them convincing the Ancelottis either.
zh: ~z~他们当然不知道，我们也不想他们说服那些安切洛蒂家的佬。

english: ~z~Understood... I'm a little on edge here. We got a real problem. Jimmy wants you to handle this.
zh: ~z~懂吗...我没有地位。我们有一个难题。吉米希望你去处理。

english: ~z~What's the world coming to if low rate hoods like you is being used for muscle?
zh: ~z~如果让像你这样的贱货拥有权力，那这世界会变成什么鬼样子？

english: ~z~Shit, Phil. The fat man is on his way to Algonquin. I couldn't get him.
zh: ~z~妈的，菲尔。胖子已经在去阿尔冈琴的路上了，我无能为力了。

english: ~z~So, if you see Ray, if you speak to him, remind him, someone's gonna get hurt.
zh: ~z~所以，如果你认识雷，如果你责备他、提醒他，有的人将会受伤。

english: ~z~trust me, I been in this game long enough to know there's two kind of wise guys...
zh: ~z~相信我，我在这场游戏中参与了很久，我知道有两种聪明人...

english: ~z~If you don't then it'll be the Pegorinos going to the mattresses with every one of the Liberty City families.
zh: ~z~如果干不掉他，就等于佩戈里诺家族和所有自由城的家族开战了。

english: ~z~but I'd like to think that when my ex-wife stops wanting to have me killed herself, maybe I'll be part of their lives.
zh: ~z~但我想，如果我前妻不再想要我自杀了，可能我会成为他们生活的一部分。

english: ~z~Cause I been hearing things, things I don't like, things will get someone hurt.
zh: ~z~因为我听到了一些事情，一些我不喜欢的事情，一些会给我们带来伤害的事情。

english: ~z~Maybe the ones who don't worry, act all crazy, maybe they get to the top for a bit, frighten a few people.
zh: ~z~可能那些人并不担心，行动却是很疯狂，也许他们达到了顶峰，吓到了一些人。

english: ~z~You remember that sugar we borrowed... well the Russians ain't too pleased. They're convinced it was down to Jimmy.
zh: ~z~你还记得我们借来的毒品吗...俄国佬可不是很乐意。他们确信是吉米搞的鬼。

zh: ~z~现在该去转移我侄子把守的白粉了。
