zh: ~z~这些屌毛条子就不能消停一会儿吗。

english: ~z~Sorry, Phil, but we lost Frankie.
zh: ~z~抱歉，菲尔，但我们失去弗兰基了。

english: ~z~If you wanna get rid of the chopper there's some fire power in the back.
zh: ~z~你要是想除掉直升机，后面有些装备。

english: ~z~Ray runs his mouth so much that no one pays much attention to what comes out of it.
zh: ~z~雷满嘴跑火车，没人在意他说什么的。

english: ~z~The Feds don't fuck with the boss and get away with it. Get close to them.
zh: ~z~条子给我老板添乱还想跑？快追上去。

english: ~z~Crap, we're losing him. We're screwed.
zh: ~z~糟了，我们要跟丢他了。我们要完了。

english: ~z~You know, since you don't look like you're full of crap,
zh: ~z~你知道吗，你也不像是满嘴假话的人，

english: ~z~I ain't seen a soul, boss. It's a ghost house.
zh: ~z~人影都没见着一个，老板。就一鬼屋。

english: ~z~Okay, I had word from Frankie, my nephew.
zh: ~z~好了，我收到我侄子弗兰基的消息了。

english: ~z~Sure, Frankie. My lips are sealed.
zh: ~z~当然了，弗兰基。我能管好我这嘴的。

english: ~z~Gimme a break, man. I got a lot on my mind, you know?
zh: ~z~饶了我吧，伙计。我顾不过来，懂吗？

english: ~z~There's no way out of this. Give up your bags and weapons.
zh: ~z~你们无路可逃。交出你们的包和武器。

english: ~z~This ain't over until we got the H in a safe place.
zh: ~z~没把白粉送到安全的地方就还没结束。

english: ~z~If only the Feds knew how full of shit most wiseguys were.
zh: ~z~要是FIB知道多数黑手党有多会扯淡，

english: ~z~I need to find something out about someone. Maybe you can help.
zh: ~z~我需要调查某人的情报。也许你能帮忙。

english: ~z~Don't I know it, Phil. I shoulda seen 'em.
zh: ~z~确实如此，菲尔。我应该要发现他们的。

english: ~z~Drop your guns and your bags, now. Let us take you into custody.
zh: ~z~放下你们的枪和包。老老实实接受逮捕。

english: ~z~No one's been paying undue attention to the H we took off the Triads.
zh: ~z~没人盯着我们从三合会那儿弄来的白粉。

english: ~z~I don't want to see a fucking picture. I'm trying to get us out of this situation.
zh: ~z~我他妈的不看。老子忙着摆脱条子追捕。

english: ~z~Niko, that's the van. We gotta get to a safe house.
zh: ~z~尼克，就是那辆货车。我们得去安全屋。

english: ~z~Why do you think I put my neck on the line for you?
zh: ~z~你以为我为什么肯为你把头别在裤腰带上？

english: ~z~If you're getting smart about seeing Angie at my place then you can button it.
zh: ~z~你要是想暗示在我的地方见到安吉就闭嘴。

english: ~z~There's been some fucked up shit going on but you been keeping cool.
zh: ~z~尽管中途出了些岔子，但你还是十分冷静。

english: ~z~Don't think about it. He fucked up today and he paid the price.
zh: ~z~别再想了。这次他搞砸了，就付出了代价。

english: ~z~We can't let those Feds run the boss off the road, get them.
zh: ~z~不能让那些条子把老板的车掀翻，干掉他们。

english: ~z~That's what keeps me alive and outta the pen. We'll see when we get there.
zh: ~z~所以我还能活在监狱外面。到那里就知道了。

english: ~z~Shit, I ain't made for this sort of stress. Can we lose the heat already?
zh: ~z~妈的，我要顶不住了。能不能快点甩掉条子？

english: ~z~Don't lose the boss, man. I got no idea where we're headin'.
zh: ~z~别跟丢老板，伙计。我不知道目的地是哪儿。

english: ~z~We both gotta take a lot of shit from Jimmy and it helps to speak about it.
zh: ~z~我们都被吉米弄得很憋屈，互相聊聊挺好的。

english: ~z~He fucked up. Us unloading the H was his call.
zh: ~z~他搞砸了。叫我们来转移白粉也是他的决定。

english: ~z~We will fire if you fail to surrender what you are carrying.
zh: ~z~再不交出身上的东西就范，我们就要开枪了。

english: ~z~I don't want to take a bullet or a stint in the pen for anyone else's fuck up.
zh: ~z~我不想为别人的失误去蹲监狱或者挨枪子儿。

english: ~z~Next time, mind on the job. This ain't a fucking joke.
zh: ~z~下一次，多顾着点工作。别拿这事儿当儿戏。

english: ~z~Maybe then you can spend time with your wife instead of some jailhouse bitch.
zh: ~z~否则你就到监狱里找婊子吧，有老婆也没用。

english: ~z~I'm sorry man. It's just... I only got married the other day.
zh: ~z~很抱歉，伙计。只是...前几天我刚结的婚。

english: ~z~Damn, this is a wild ride. I didn't think I was gonna come outta that one.
zh: ~z~妈的，这次太惊险了。我还以为自己要没命了。

english: ~z~Shit, we can't stash the stuff with the cops on our backs, lose 'em.
zh: ~z~妈的，我们不能背着警察把东西藏起来，扔了。

english: ~z~The Feds know that wiseguys run their mouths, they love it.
zh: ~z~FIB知道黑手党满嘴跑火车，他们就喜欢这个。

english: ~z~Nice driving, Niko. We're gonna be able to shift this H for a lot of money.
zh: ~z~好车技，尼克。我们可以用这些白粉换来很多钱。

english: ~z~A Fed don't care if he's taking someone down on a legitimate beef or if it's total bullshit.
zh: ~z~FIB不在乎抓人靠的是证据确凿还是一堆屁话。

english: ~z~This thing of ours is built upon trust for everyone else in the family.
zh: ~z~我们这件事是建立在对家里其他人的信任之上的。

english: ~z~Hey, let's see if we get back before you start talking like this, shall we?
zh: ~z~喂，这些有的没的等我们平安抵达了再说，好吗？

english: ~z~These cops ain't flipping me if I'm caught. And they better not flip you either.
zh: ~z~我被抓了绝不会向他们告发。你最好也不会告发。

english: ~z~You got a wife, you got a ma, don't play around with your life.
zh: ~z~你娶了媳妇，上又有老母，别拿自己的命开玩笑。

english: ~z~I didn't have much time to scope this out. My ma's kinda sick. I been looking after her.
zh: ~z~我没空盯着这边。我妈身体不好，一直是我照顾。

english: ~z~We're heading back up to that old house off Beaverhead Avenue in Westdyke.
zh: ~z~我们要回到韦斯代克区比弗黑德大道的老房子那边。

english: ~z~Might just keep the Pegorino family's head above water. See you around.
zh: ~z~也许能给佩戈里诺家族的财政续上一会儿。回头见。

english: ~z~Niko, that's the van. We gotta get back to the pizza place in Westdyke.
zh: ~z~尼克，就是那辆货车。我们得回韦斯代克的披萨店。

english: ~z~As long as he can get his face in the newspaper and a blowjob from his wife, he's happy.
zh: ~z~只要能在报纸上露脸，老婆肯口一次，他就高兴了。

english: ~z~Look, I don't ever assume something's gonna go down easy, without any trouble.
zh: ~z~听着，我从不认为有什么事能顺顺利利、不受妨碍。

english: ~z~Ray's gonna be pleased about this. He's been trying to bang Frankie's wife ever since they got married.
zh: ~z~雷会很高兴的。自从弗兰基结婚，雷就想睡他老婆。

english: ~z~This is one more reason for my ex-wife to hate my guts. He was her nephew, man.
zh: ~z~我前妻又多了个恨我的理由。这是她侄子啊，兄弟。

english: ~z~Shit Frankie, you dumb fuck. The Feds have been watching us all along.
zh: ~z~妈的，弗兰基，你个傻逼。FIB一直在盯着我们。

english: ~z~You can if you do everything yourself. If you don't rely on anybody else.
zh: ~z~如果你自己做每件事你就能做到。如果你不依赖别人。

english: ~z~I believe it. I'd be dead already if Jimmy P listened to anything he'd said about me.
zh: ~z~是这样。要是吉米 P信了他说的我的事，我早死了。

english: ~z~he can ask the bitch to take it out of the divorce settlement. Fucking cunt.
zh: ~z~不想要就让那个贱人从离婚协议里去掉啊。混蛋婊子。

english: ~z~Dammit, Niko. We can't do this with just two of us. I'm calling it off. Ciao.
zh: ~z~该死，尼克。光我们两个人不行，只能先取消了。再见。

english: ~z~Well, you can't count on nothing going right. That's the lesson I've learnt today.
zh: ~z~好吧，你不能指望事事顺利。这就是我今天学到的教训。

english: ~z~You and me are only here today because we didn't make the fuckup that Frankie did.
zh: ~z~你我现在还活着，是因为我们没像弗兰基那样把事搞砸。

english: ~z~Frankie's one guy, he can disappear real easy if the Feds show. Plus, he's a smart kid.
zh: ~z~弗兰基是平民，就算FIB出现也能脱身。而且，他聪明得很。

english: ~z~Shit, you might be right there but that's only an attitude that'd work for a lone gun like you.
zh: ~z~妈的，你可能是对的，但这种态度只适合你这种孤军奋战的人。

english: ~z~Yeah, call it a cooling off period. We took it, but we don't know who was watching it beforehand.
zh: ~z~是啊，算是种冷静期吧。货到手了，但不知道有没有被人盯上。

english: ~z~Fuck. He was a good kid, but he screwed up today and now he paid for it.
zh: ~z~操。他是个好孩子，但他今天搞砸了，现在他为此付出了代价。

english: ~z~Shit. Uncle Phil's gone forever. Don't tell the other guys you saw me crying, okay?
zh: ~z~妈的。菲尔叔叔永远走了。别告诉其他人你看到我哭了，好吗？

english: ~z~So, it's been long enough. You think we're gonna be okay to pick it up? No trouble?
zh: ~z~已经放了很久了，现在就能不受妨碍顺利转移了？你这么想的？

english: ~z~Frankie, Niko, grab the stuff from the trunk and follow me. I got a van we can use.
zh: ~z~弗兰基，尼克，拿上后备箱的货跟我走。我有辆小货车可以用。

english: ~z~Yeah, we put it in an isolated place, hopefully any attention it was getting would be noticed.
zh: ~z~对，我们故意找了个偏僻的地方，很容易知道货有没有被人盯上。

english: ~z~He's related to my ex-wife and she was smart enough to ruin my life with one law suit.
zh: ~z~他是我前妻的亲戚。我前妻则聪明到仅靠一纸诉讼就毁了我的人生。

english: ~z~Niko, they're all over us. We're ditching the cars and going on foot. Park up behind me when I stop.
zh: ~z~尼克，他们到处都是。我们要弃车步行了。待会儿我停哪儿你停哪儿。

english: ~z~As long as we don't see any helicopters, vans, suspicious gardeners talking into earpieces.
zh: ~z~只要我们没见着什么直升机啊、厢型车啊、可疑的园丁对着耳机讲电话啊，

english: ~z~He's my nephew through my ex-wife, I might give him work sometimes but I ain't gonna give him this load of horse.
zh: ~z~他是我前妻那边的侄子，我偶尔会找他干活，但绝不可能把这批海马送他。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. My half ain't in too good shape neither but I don't wanna tell the skip we lost it all. Ciao.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克。我这份看起来也不太好，但我不想告诉老大我们全弄丢了。再见。

zh: ~z~抱歉了，亲爱的，你生不逢时啊。

zh: ~z~尼克，咱希望你跟在咱屁股后面。

english: ~z~It was hardly the most progressive place. How does my hair look?
zh: ~z~这算哪门子的开明社会啊。咱的头发怎么样？

english: ~z~It's my hiney that I'm worried about honey, get be-hiney me.
zh: ~z~咱担心的是咱的后庭，亲爱的，到我后头去。

english: ~z~I keep thinking I'm being followed, and I don't know why.
zh: ~z~咱一直都觉得有人跟踪我，也不知道为什么。

english: ~z~Dancing in Hercules with my shirt off - every eye in the room was on me.
zh: ~z~在大力神里裸衣热舞——咱就是全场的焦点。

english: ~z~Watch your skinny frappes, Bernie's coming through.
zh: ~z~注意你们的刨冰饮料什么的，伯尼要过来了。

english: ~z~No siree, you think I look like this when I get up in the morning?
zh: ~z~不，先生，你以为咱早上起来就现在这样吗？

english: ~z~~c~Speak English.~s~ And I told you, it's Bernie.
~z~How can you say that? I thought you were different!
zh: ~z~你怎么能这么说？咱还以为你跟那些俗人不同！

english: ~z~It's cardio time, Niko. Remember to keep some distance though.
zh: ~z~现在是健身时间，尼克。记得和我保持点距离。

english: ~z~Bernie, what's the deal? Are you asleep or something? Wake up.
zh: ~z~伯尼，什么情况？你睡着了还是咋了？快醒醒。

english: ~z~Whatever you say, buddy. Unfortunately, for hitting my friend,
zh: ~z~你爱咋说咋说，小子。只可惜，你打的是我朋友。

english: ~z~Catch him Niko. This man has haunted my dreams for weeks.
zh: ~z~追上他，尼克。这人害咱连做了好几个星期恶梦。

english: ~z~Niko, he got me. Where were you? I thought you were watching me?
zh: ~z~尼克，他打到我了。你在哪？你没有替我盯着吗？

english: ~z~I won't stand it... it's not fair. I'm just being me!
zh: ~z~咱也忍不了...太不公平了。咱只是做咱自己！

english: ~z~Bryce only likes carpet burns he's given me. Not these things.
zh: ~z~布莱斯喜欢拿他的络腮胡扎我，可不是这些东西。

english: ~z~There are so many young, fit men out there. He could have anyone.
zh: ~z~外面年轻健美的男人有的是，他变心了都说不准。

english: ~z~Every time I go out jogging, and doing aerobics or playing ultimate disc,
zh: ~z~每次咱去跑步，做有氧运动或者玩极限飞盘的时候，

english: ~z~I'll tell you, I don't look fabulous when I'm waking up with cold sweats at all hours of the night.
zh: ~z~咱跟你说，咱在晚上冒着冷汗惊醒的样子可不好看。

english: ~z~Flor... Bernie. Don't go jogging for a while. He's still out there.
zh: ~z~弗洛尔...伯尼。暂时先别去跑步了，他还在外面。

english: ~z~Get him, Niko. I want him to suffer for every gray hair and worry line.
zh: ~z~追上他，尼克，咱要让他为每根白发和皱纹付出代价。

english: ~z~Let's get our heart rates up, Niko. Remember to hang back, I need to charm him out.
zh: ~z~先热身暖暖身子，尼克。记得离远点，咱得把他引出来。

english: ~z~Niko, this isn't working sweetie. Either the hater has seen us and he'll stay away.
zh: ~z~尼克，这样不管用啊，甜心。要么他发现咱俩然后走掉。

english: ~z~I wish people would just accept me for who I am, you know, the good and the bad?
zh: ~z~咱只希望别人能接受咱的为人，你懂吗？优点和缺点都是。

english: ~z~It takes hours of plucking and buffing before I can even bear to look at myself.
zh: ~z~咱得花好几小时化妆、抛光，不然咱自己都不敢看咱的脸。

english: ~z~I'm going to rot in my apartment. The mummy of Middle Park West they'll call me.
zh: ~z~咱要烂在自己的家里了。他们会管我叫西中央公园木乃伊的。

english: ~z~That was Florian... urgh. Bernie was beautiful when he arrived on the scene.
zh: ~z~那个是弗洛里安...呃。伯尼刚来那会儿真是英俊潇洒啊。

english: ~z~I've gotten fat and ugly, Niko. You should have seen me when I first got here.
zh: ~z~咱现在是又胖又丑，尼克。你应该看看咱刚来这里时有多好看。

english: ~z~There's no way the hater's going to think I'm alone with you clamped to my buns like that.
zh: ~z~仇同者看你贴咱屁股这么近，不可能会觉得咱是一个人跑步的。

english: ~z~Sometimes I think it's a godsend that Bryce has to go back to his wife for the night instead of sleeping with me.
zh: ~z~有时咱都觉得布莱斯晚上回去不跟咱睡跟老婆睡已经是万幸了。

english: ~z~Or someone's going to tell Bryce I'm with you and he'll think I'm cheating.
zh: ~z~要么会有人告诉布莱斯咱跟你在一起，然后他会觉得咱出了轨。

english: ~z~Niko Bellic that is the sweetest thing you have ever said to me. I think I'm going to cry.
zh: ~z~尼克･贝利克，这是你对咱说过的最甜的话了。咱都要感动哭了。

english: ~z~It's the TV man. They just rub it in your face all day long. All those... men.
zh: ~z~是电视里的人，他们老是对着你的脸戳你的痛处。全部的...人。

english: ~z~No he ain't. You're an absolute sweetie Niko Bellic. I never would have thought it.
zh: ~z~是不会了。你对咱真是太好了，尼克･贝利克。没想到你人这么好。

english: ~z~Is there a name for that fitness plan? I'd take a class if I could be guaranteed buns like yours.
zh: ~z~你的健身计划有名字吗？要是能有你这么结实的屁股，咱也想学一学。

english: ~z~I have to jog. How am I going to keep fit? One ounce of cellulite and Bryce will leave me.
zh: ~z~咱必须跑步，不然怎么保持身材？多一块赘肉布莱斯都会立马甩掉咱的。

english: ~z~We're going for a jog, Niko. Try to keep up. And stay back too, we don't want to be rumbled.
zh: ~z~咱们要准备跑步了，尼克。尽量跟上，但别跟太近，咱可不想被看出来。

english: ~z~Sit tight, Bernie. Let me finish this.
~z~Your choice is your choice, man.
zh: ~z~人要为自己的选择负责，兄弟。

zh: ~z~破坏咱俩费尽心血建立的一切。

zh: ~z~现在不是开玩笑的时候，伙计！

zh: ~z~我靠，警察也不好当啊，不是吗？

english: ~z~Come on, Bryce... come on.
~z~Am I right? We're going to show them.
zh: ~z~咱没说错吧？咱们证明给他们看。

english: ~z~Bernie, please. Can you be quiet until this is over.
zh: ~z~伯尼，行行好。完事前先闭上嘴。

english: ~z~Enjoying your new life in the land of opportunity, then?
zh: ~z~机遇之地的新生活挺舒服的是吧？

english: ~z~That's it is it? My life is over.
zh: ~z~就这样了是吗？咱的人生结束了。

english: ~z~Jesus H, Niko. Bryce is going to be devastated.
zh: ~z~咱的天哪，尼克。布莱斯会崩溃的。

english: ~z~The information he has on Bryce is too valuable.
zh: ~z~他手上关于布莱斯的情报太宝贵了。

english: ~z~A man I met when I first arrived in Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我刚到自由城的时候认识的一个人。

english: ~z~Not that there's anything wrong with dating you...
zh: ~z~也不是说跟你约会有什么不妥...

english: ~z~I saw his face through the bubbles and I knew.
zh: ~z~从泡泡中看见他的脸时咱就明白了。

english: ~z~Then it happened, out of nowhere I was struck.
zh: ~z~然后这事就发生了，咱突然就爱了。

english: ~z~Stay here, Bernie. I'm going to handle this.
zh: ~z~待在原地，伯尼。剩下的就交给我。

english: ~z~Bernie, I can't concentrate with you talking.
zh: ~z~伯尼，你一直说话会干扰我开车的。

english: ~z~It was good knowing you, sweetie. I'm going home.
zh: ~z~能认识你真好，甜心。咱要回家了。

english: ~z~Here we are. Should I speak to them or do you want to?
zh: ~z~我们到了。是我去跟他们说还是你来？

english: ~z~What about the life Bryce built with his wife?
zh: ~z~那布莱斯和他老婆一起建立的生活呢？

english: ~z~Something strong... oh man, I am cooked.
~z~They'll ruin Bryce if they escape, Niko.
zh: ~z~他们跑掉的话布莱斯就完蛋了，尼克。

english: ~z~Dimitri Rascalov only asks once.
zh: ~z~迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫只给一次机会。

english: ~z~Alright. The guys are dead. I'll take you back to your place.
zh: ~z~行了。那些人都死了。我送你回家吧。

english: ~z~Did he find out any information about Darko Brevic yet?
zh: ~z~那他找到达尔科･布雷维奇的情报没有？

english: ~z~That's what people are trying to take away. That's love.
zh: ~z~那就是别人想从咱身边夺走的，那就是爱。

english: ~z~This is a disaster. I have to go home. My life is over.
zh: ~z~这是末日啊。咱要回家了，咱的人生完了。

english: ~z~Thank you so much, Niko. I'll speak to you soon.
zh: ~z~太谢谢你了，尼克。之后咱再给你打电话。

english: ~z~Maybe he should have thought about that when he started dating you.
zh: ~z~这种事在他开始跟你约会的时候就该想到了。

english: ~z~You think? It would kill Bryce if he didn't have his career.
zh: ~z~你这么想吗？丢掉饭碗的话布莱斯就凉透了。

english: ~z~He preaches homosexuality is evil. It's insanity!
zh: ~z~他还到处宣扬同性恋是一种罪恶。真是疯了！

english: ~z~Yuk, I can't even imagine where that is, I hope you know.
zh: ~z~讨厌，咱都不知道那地方在哪。希望你知道。

english: ~z~Listen, you're going to speak to your boss and tell him to back off.
zh: ~z~听清楚了，你回去告诉你老板，叫他滚远点。

english: ~z~Dimitri is too much of a rat to go to the media himself.
zh: ~z~迪米特里这人狡猾得很，不会亲自去找媒体的。

english: ~z~Screw your wife, honey... this is for real!
zh: ~z~叫你老婆去死吧，亲爱的...这句是真心的！

english: ~z~That bitch wife of his will probably sell her story too.
zh: ~z~那个婊子老婆可能还会跟媒体出售她的独家新闻。

english: ~z~Shit, I'll shut up now. You don't need me telling you about your life.
zh: ~z~靠，我这就闭嘴。也用不着我来教你日子怎么过。

zh: ~z~准备好没，亲爱的？会面在北伍德的核桃路进行。

english: ~z~What right do they have to jeopardize Bryce's career, our relationship,
zh: ~z~他们有什么权利破坏布莱斯的事业和咱俩的关系，

english: ~z~I thought the police might do our job for us for a second. No such luck.
zh: ~z~我还以为警察能替我们把事情办了。没那运气啊。

english: ~z~Go get us a car, sweetie. I want something big and awful and intimidating.
zh: ~z~去弄辆车，甜心。最好是那种又大又猛又吓人的车。

english: ~z~Bryce'll be all over Weazel News tomorrow morning.
zh: ~z~明早的Weazel新闻上就是布莱斯的整版报道。

english: ~z~My life is over, Niko. This is terrible. What am I going to do?
zh: ~z~咱的人生结束了，尼克。真是太糟了，咱要怎么办啊？

english: ~z~Love is strong enough to rip down mountains and throw trucks and all that stuff.
zh: ~z~只要有爱的话，叫咱移山填海，追星摘月都不在话下。

english: ~z~At least they can't tell Dimitri about the meeting or go to the papers.
zh: ~z~至少他们不能回去跟迪米特里汇报或者找记者爆料了。

english: ~z~I don't normally talk this much. I'm your friend, and I will try to help.
zh: ~z~平常我没这么多话。我是你的朋友，我会尽力帮你的。

english: ~z~So, we were just meant to scare them? Well, that didn't work out so good, did it?
zh: ~z~原来好像只想吓吓他们吧？不过那样也不管用，对吧？

english: ~z~Sweetie, this is a list I would never want to be on. Again, I mean.
zh: ~z~亲爱的，咱可一点都不想上那个名单啊。不想再上一次。

english: ~z~All she sees in Bryce is mink coats and dinner party invitations.
zh: ~z~布莱斯在她眼中只是无数件皮草大衣还有晚餐请柬罢了。

english: ~z~If all the police in the city weren't on the take, I might feel sorry for that guy.
zh: ~z~要是这里的警察都是两袖清风的话，我就会替他惋惜了。

english: ~z~But he should have thought about who he really was before getting elected on a family values ticket.
zh: ~z~但是他在靠家庭观念当选之前就该想清楚自己是什么人。

english: ~z~Where's Bryce? We wanted to speak to him, not his rent boys.
zh: ~z~布莱斯在哪儿？我们想跟他本人谈，可没让他派鸭过来。

english: ~z~We have to tell them to tell the boss we won't be pushed around, no way.
zh: ~z~得让他们转达给幕后黑手：咱们不是好欺负的，想都别想。

english: ~z~We don't know. They won't even meet us themselves. This is just some flunky they're sending.
zh: ~z~不知道。他们都不肯亲自跟咱会面，只是派了些马仔过来。

english: ~z~After Darko Brevic, Dimitri is at the top of my list.
zh: ~z~除开达尔科･布雷维奇，迪米特里就是我的黑名单头号了。

english: ~z~You know, I don't think I've ever been north of Middle Park. This is exciting.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，咱从没去过中央公园以北的地方。想想都兴奋。

english: ~z~No, he came after Roman. Destroyed the home and business he had worked hard to make.
zh: ~z~不，他找上了罗曼。把他辛辛苦苦建立的事业和家都毁了。

english: ~z~He betrayed his best friend and used me to do it. Then he stabbed me in the back.
zh: ~z~他利用我背刺了他最好的朋友，然后又从背后捅了我一刀。

english: ~z~That bitch. She's just in it for the status. She doesn't love Bryce like I do.
zh: ~z~那个贱女人。她只是空有虚名的妻子。她还没咱爱布莱斯。

english: ~z~Every beautiful boy in Algonquin was there that night but he was the only one for me.
zh: ~z~当时阿尔冈琴的所有美男都在，但能夺走咱芳心的只有他一个。

english: ~z~They don't even know what they're in for. No way. Nothing stands in the way of love.
zh: ~z~他们还不知道自己惹上了什么。门都没有，爱情是无可阻挡的。

english: ~z~He's a hypocrite and it was only a matter of time before someone like Dimitri tried to capitalize.
zh: ~z~他这种伪君子，被迪米特里之类的人发掘利用也只是时间问题。

english: ~z~Have I told you about the first time I met Bryce? It was a foam party at Hercules.
zh: ~z~咱有跟你讲过咱与布莱斯的邂逅吗？是在大力神的一场泡泡派对上。

english: ~z~Here we are. Look after yourself, yeah? I hope Dimitri and his people back off now.
zh: ~z~我们到了。照顾好你自己，好吗？希望迪米特里和他的人能收手了。

english: ~z~I was high on X and youth and beauty and I was dancing like I've never danced before.
zh: ~z~咱那会儿摇头丸嗑多了很嗨，还年轻貌美，跳舞的状态那叫一个好啊。

english: ~z~You know what? Maybe the best way to get the message to your boss is for me to send him your heart.
zh: ~z~这样吧，我看最能让你老板明白的方法，就是把你的心挖出来送给他。

english: ~z~You know. You can feel it deep down inside. He may be a nasty hypocrite, but he's mine.
zh: ~z~知道吗，是发自内心的真爱。就算他是个糟糕的伪君子，他也还是咱的爱。

~z~Niko, my life is in turmoil.
~z~The police and a government agency are both on my case.
zh: ~z~警察和政府探员都盯上了我。

english: ~z~You cut it fine, don't you Niko?
~z~Actually, maybe it does all makes sense.
~z~They're taking to the high ground, sweetie.
~z~The bitch ain't gonna be happy.
zh: ~z~那个婊子脸色可不会好看的。

english: ~z~We've scared them off the water, Niko.
~z~Bryce's boat is as well, practically.
zh: ~z~布莱斯的船几乎没什么大碍。

english: ~z~Look! More people want me dead than alive.
~z~I'm so glad you've come back into my life,
zh: ~z~咱很高兴你能重返咱的生活。

english: ~z~Look how long it took me to find you.
zh: ~z~看看我用了多长时间才找到你。

english: ~z~Be the water, Niko. Be the waves. Catch them.
~z~Come on, Niko. Put this thing into overdrive.
~z~Go toward the headland, that's where the best rays are going to be.
zh: ~z~去海角那边，那里的阳光最好。

english: ~z~Perfect, sweetie. Let's stop.
~z~I need you to come on this boat trip with me.
zh: ~z~咱需要你跟咱一起乘船出去玩。

english: ~z~I need to talk to someone who truly knows me.
zh: ~z~咱得找个真正了解咱的人聊聊。

english: ~z~You could slice cheese on those puppies.
zh: ~z~你这颧骨可以迷死不少小伙子啊。

english: ~z~Didn't see that one coming, did ya?
zh: ~z~你们没料想到会这样吧，不是吗？

english: ~z~You don't go because Bryce is here.
zh: ~z~你不会去的，布莱斯还在这儿呢。

english: ~z~Snap to it, sailor. You're losing them.
zh: ~z~加快速度，水手。你快被甩掉了。

english: ~z~I'm definitely not saying I took this now.
zh: ~z~我绝对不会说是我把船开出去的。

english: ~z~Bryce is pulling his hair out over this blackmail thing.
zh: ~z~布莱斯被勒索这事搞的焦头烂额。

english: ~z~Channel your anger, Niko. Catch up to them.
zh: ~z~先别生气，尼克。先把他们干掉。

english: ~z~Stop immediately or we will use lethal force.
zh: ~z~立即停船，否则将使用致命武器。

english: ~z~Ruler of the high seas, Niko Bellic.
zh: ~z~水上霸主就是你，尼克･贝利克。

english: ~z~Hey Bernie, are we cool to stop around here?
zh: ~z~嘿，伯尼，船停在这你没意见吧？

english: ~z~How many knots are you doing, Niko?
zh: ~z~你的船都开到什么速度了，尼克？

english: ~z~Oh, sometimes, I can't bear to be alone.
zh: ~z~噢，偶尔是这样，咱耐不住寂寞。

english: ~z~They're making a run for it, the land lubbers.
zh: ~z~他们要弃船逃跑了，一群旱鸭子。

english: ~z~I like them tight but not that tight.
zh: ~z~咱是喜欢紧点的，但不是那种紧。

english: ~z~I wanted to get a tan, not a burn.
zh: ~z~我只是想晒个日光浴，而不是晒伤。

english: ~z~Do not be fucking with Dimitri Rascalov.
zh: ~z~不要跟迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫作对。

english: ~z~Dimitri Rascalov sends his regards.
zh: ~z~迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫向你们问好。

english: ~z~Get me to the coast. I'm done with this.
zh: ~z~带咱去海岸，我已经受够这种事了。

english: ~z~I think she suspects. It's a nightmare.
zh: ~z~咱觉得她开始怀疑了。简直是噩梦。

english: ~z~I've still got my sea legs, I'll wait here.
zh: ~z~咱不会晕船的，放心。咱在这等着。

english: ~z~This is the LCPD Harbor Unit, stop your engines.
~z~Let me see. They don't look like they're on a pleasure cruise.
zh: ~z~我看看。他们看着不像是乘船来玩的。

english: ~z~His wife is getting on his back about yours truly -
zh: ~z~他老婆一直在问他「你的密友」是谁，

english: ~z~Shit, Bernie, you're in trouble. I'll be there.
zh: ~z~该死，伯尼。你有麻烦了。我马上过来。

english: ~z~I've got to get the bitch her dingy. Good luck.
zh: ~z~那个婊子肯定又会发飙的。祝我好运吧。

english: ~z~Why does everything that's meant to be fun have to be so miserable?
zh: ~z~为什么本该快乐的时间都会变成这样呢？

english: ~z~They're leagues ahead, sweetie. What are you doing?
zh: ~z~他们越来越远了，甜心。你到底在干嘛？

english: ~z~I must be the only Slav without cheekbones.
zh: ~z~咱肯定是唯一一个没有颧骨的斯拉夫人。

english: ~z~I'm sorry our fun day wasn't so very much fun. See you soon.
zh: ~z~很遗憾今天的欢乐日没那么有趣。之后见。

english: ~z~Does this look like the type of place we could hang out, Bernie?
zh: ~z~你觉得这里是个值得逗留的地方吗，伯尼？

english: ~z~Hey Bernie, I'm going to stop here. That cool with you?
zh: ~z~嘿，伯尼，我要把船停在这，你没意见吧？

english: ~z~Musicals aren't really my thing, Bernie. You should go with Bryce.
zh: ~z~音乐不太适合我，伯尼。你应该跟布莱斯去。

english: ~z~Scratch that, not so cute.~c~ Ugly Russians.
zh: ~z~当我没说，才不是帅哥。~c~丑逼俄国佬。

english: ~z~You, Bernie, are in this too. You have to keep your eyes open.
zh: ~z~你，伯尼，也身陷其中。睁大眼睛保持警惕。

english: ~z~No! No! No! No! No you don't, Niko. I need you.
zh: ~z~不不不不不不不！你别走，尼克。咱需要你。

english: ~z~Stop your engines immediately. This is the Harbor Unit of the Liberty City Police Department.
zh: ~z~请立即停船。我们是LCPD下属港口支队。

english: ~z~Ahoy, sailor. Cute guys off the starport brow!
zh: ~z~你们好啊，水手们。都是些表情严肃的帅哥。

english: ~z~so that my cousin can fritter it away online and pay off debts...
zh: ~z~然后我堂兄就能在网上挥霍、拿钱还债...

english: ~z~When I knew you you were training to be a shepherd.
zh: ~z~我刚认识你时，你还在接受成为牧羊人的训练。

english: ~z~So long, sailor. Bernie has a lot of explaining to do.
zh: ~z~再见了，水手。伯尼回去会有很多事要解释呢。

english: ~z~I'm at the Pier in Fishmarket South. I need you... now.
zh: ~z~我在鱼市南端的码头。咱需要你...就现在。

english: ~z~You've got more important things to do than backstroke.
zh: ~z~比起在这仰泳你还有其他更有意义的事情要干。

english: ~z~Stop your engines at once or you will be considered a security threat and eliminated.
zh: ~z~现在立刻停船，否则你们将被视作威胁而击毙。

english: ~z~~c~This is a message from Dimitri Rascalov.
zh: ~z~~c~迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫向你们致以问候。

english: ~z~It's a four letter word, I know, but we can still try.
zh: ~z~说起来有点下流，咱知道，不过咱们还是能试试。

english: ~z~Niko, you are my knight in shining armor. Thank you.
zh: ~z~尼克，你就是咱心中穿着闪亮盔甲的骑士，谢谢你。

english: ~z~You can handle this, right? I need to give Bryce his boat.
zh: ~z~你搞得定，对吧？我得把船安然无恙地交给布莱斯。

english: ~z~Why don't I just up and leave for San Fierro. They'd understand me there.
zh: ~z~还不如早点离开去圣辉洛呢。那里的人们会理解咱的。

english: ~z~Bryce could come to San Fierro. He could even be himself there.
zh: ~z~布莱斯也可以去圣辉洛。到那儿他还能做真正的自己。

english: ~z~This is the LCPD Harbor Unit. Stop your engines and prepare to be boarded.
zh: ~z~我们是LCPD港口支队。立即停船，准备接受检查。

english: ~z~This is your final warning. Stop your engines or force will be employed.
zh: ~z~这是最后一次警告。立即停船，否则我们将使用武力。

english: ~z~You drive, I'll work on my tan. My midriff is really pale.
zh: ~z~你来开船，咱先晒个日光浴。咱的肚子实在是太白了。

english: ~z~I know, sweetie, let's forget about him and have some F-U-N!
zh: ~z~咱知道，亲爱的。先别管他了，咱们先找点乐－子－吧！

english: ~z~I've heard of mud packs but that river is practically sewage.
zh: ~z~虽然听说过这河脏，但没想到这河脏的就像污水池一样。

english: ~z~I get all the stress of having a man but none of the perks. That's my tragedy.
zh: ~z~咱空有有男人的压力，没有丝毫有男人的好处。真是悲剧。

english: ~z~I came here because it was meant to be the most progressive city in the world. But it just isn't.
zh: ~z~咱就是听说这里是世上最开明的地方才来的，结果并不是。

english: ~z~They're wide open, sweetie, I'm focused. One hundred percent. Let's get 'em.
zh: ~z~眼睛睁着呢，甜心。咱专注得很，百分百专注。干了他们。

english: ~z~Bryce would never be seen with me at a play. People would ask questions.
zh: ~z~布莱斯从来不和我一起在公共场合露面。会有人问东问西的。

english: ~z~Uhh, my hair will never recover from this. It's a disaster, Niko. Wish me luck.
zh: ~z~啊，咱的头发再也回不去了。真是场灾难，尼克。祝咱好运吧。

english: ~z~The bitch and her brats will never forgive him. Thanks, Niko.
zh: ~z~那个婊子和她的小崽子绝对不会原谅他的。拜你所赐啊，尼克。

english: ~z~I don't know. We just got to get these guys or they'll just come back.
zh: ~z~不知道。我只知道不干掉这些家伙的话，他们还会卷土重来的。

english: ~z~Soldier, you ain't such a sailor. They got away. Now I've got to face the music.
zh: ~z~大兵，看来你不是水手的料。他们跑了。现在咱只能回去等死了。

english: ~z~I told you that there was no time for this. People are after me and I have to stay alert.
zh: ~z~我都跟你说了没时间找乐子。想要我命的大有人在，我得时刻警惕。

english: ~z~Do you want to go to a musical later? There are some great things playing on Burlesque at the moment.
zh: ~z~你等会想去看音乐会吗？这会儿滑稽剧场那边有很多不错的音乐演出。

english: ~z~You've destroyed Bryce's boat and I must have an infection from this water. This was the least fun ever.
zh: ~z~你把布莱斯的船毁了，咱也肯定会被这海水感染得病。实在是太没趣了。

english: ~z~They got away from you, babe. Who knows when they'll come back. I'll never sleep again.
zh: ~z~他们从你这儿跑了，宝贝。谁知道他们几时会回来。这咱晚上还怎么睡。

english: ~z~Come on. Bryce accidentally left the keys on purpose somewhere I could steal them.
zh: ~z~两面都懂！来吧。布莱斯「一不小心」把钥匙放在了咱可以偷到的地方。

english: ~z~Haters, haters, haters. This city is full of haters, Niko. I just don't get it.
zh: ~z~仇同，仇同，还是仇同。这个城市挤满了仇同，尼克。咱实在是想不明白。

english: ~z~I don't know what I'm going to tell Bryce about this. The bitch will really stick the knife in now. Bye, Niko.
zh: ~z~咱不知道该怎么跟布莱斯开口。他家那婊子肯定要提起柴刀了。再见，尼克。

english: ~z~We lost them, Niko. They're probably goin' after Bryce now. They've probably killed my baby.
zh: ~z~咱们跟丢了，尼克。他们可能会去找布莱斯麻烦。咱的宝贝可能已经遇害了。

english: ~z~Bryce's wife is going to freak out about his boat. This was meant to be our fun day, Niko.
zh: ~z~布莱斯的老婆知道船被开出来糟蹋会发狂的。本该是梦一般快乐的一天，尼克。

english: ~z~Yeah, got a bit hairy out there. Good thing you have your sea legs.
zh: ~z~确实，出了点小意外。还好你不会晕船。

english: ~z~I'm gonna go drown my sorrows. I'll speak to you soon.
zh: ~z~我只能回去借毒消愁了。之后再打给你。

english: ~z~And Frankie's the biggest damn rat I know.
zh: ~z~而弗兰基是我知道的最可能泄密的家伙。

english: ~z~There's only one thing that's gonna make me forget about this fuck up. See ya.
zh: ~z~只有一样东西能让我忘了这次失败。再见。

english: ~z~Me, Bucky and Aiden, we all cared about the same stuff.
zh: ~z~我、巴基还有艾登，我们都有相同的信念。

english: ~z~Get in the boat, me boy. You're the skipper of this little vessel.
zh: ~z~快上船，小伙子。你就是这条小船的船长。

english: ~z~Best way to avoid checks. We'll cover your rear.
zh: ~z~回避检查的最佳路径。我们会保护好你的。

english: ~z~Seems like a good kid, reminds me of you actually.
zh: ~z~看起来是个好孩子，看着他我就想到你了。

english: ~z~Shit. They're on the coastline. Can't even dock here.
zh: ~z~妈的。他们上了海岸线。这里都没法靠岸。

english: ~z~You got better things to be doing than take a swim, Niko.
zh: ~z~比起下水游泳，你还有更好的选择，尼克。

english: ~z~Meet me at the jetty off a Rand Avenue. I need some help with something.
zh: ~z~来兰德大道边的码头找我，我需要你帮忙。

english: ~z~Good thing your aim is steadier than mine. You can drive the boat again now.
zh: ~z~幸好你的准头比我好。你可以回来开船了。

english: ~z~Come on, man. I thought you was taking me back to land?
zh: ~z~拜托，老兄。你这是想把我往陆地上带吗？

english: ~z~Counterfeits. They look so good you wouldn't spot 'em in a month of Sundays.
zh: ~z~就是假钞。成色很好，仔细看都看不出来。

english: ~z~Shit, can't they let us go about our activities in peace.
zh: ~z~妈的，他们就不能让我们安安稳稳做点生意。

english: ~z~You can't leave those notes out there without protection, Niko.
zh: ~z~你不能让那些钞票没人保护晾在那儿，尼克。

english: ~z~Fuck, he's come all this way and it looks like he's gonna end up in the drink.
zh: ~z~妈的，他跑这么远一趟，眼看要落水收场了。

english: ~z~I'd rather swim home tonight than come back tomorrow to dive for those notes.
zh: ~z~我宁可今晚游泳回家，也不要明天再来捞钱。

english: ~z~I don't give a shit if this thing sinks, we got to protect him.
zh: ~z~我他妈才不管这条船的死活，能保住金就行。

english: ~z~Don't put all the pay off up your arm, Derrick.
zh: ~z~别把这些钱全部花在给自己扎针上，德里克。

english: ~z~Fuck, imagine who'd turn up if it was real notes he was bringing into the country.
zh: ~z~操，要是他船上的是真钞，来的人可能更多。

english: ~z~You were meant to use that on choppers. Not the guy we're protecting.
zh: ~z~那玩意是用来打飞机的，不是打保护对象的。

english: ~z~Thank you Mr. McReary. Not such smooth journey.
zh: ~z~谢谢你，麦克雷里先生。路上有点不太顺啊。

english: ~z~What's happening out there? I didn't think you had many friends left.
zh: ~z~出海干什么？我还以为你没剩下几个朋友了。

english: ~z~Fuck, imagine who'd turn up if it was real notes he was bringing into the country.
zh: ~z~操，要是他船上的是真钞，来的人可能更多。

english: ~z~I don't give a shit as long as it keeps me in brown, you know.
zh: ~z~我也不管这么多，能让我打海洛因就行，懂吧。

english: ~z~Yeah. So Aiden got caught with something when he was somewhere he wasn't meant to be.
zh: ~z~对。然后艾登在不该在的地方带着东西被抓了。

english: ~z~Think I gotta clue? Use our boat to shield Kim from these fuckers.
zh: ~z~我咋知道？用我们的船从这些狗逼手里保护金。

english: ~z~When this is done I won't have to leech off my brothers no more.
zh: ~z~这票成了以后，我就不用再啃家里兄弟的钱了。

english: ~z~This is a Korean guy I did business with back in Ireland.
zh: ~z~这次是个以前在爱尔兰跟我做过生意的朝鲜人。

english: ~z~Sort your shit out. Get back in the boat so we can look for Kim.
zh: ~z~你丫适可而止一点。回船上来，我们好跟着金。

english: ~z~He's paying for protection, Niko. Protect him, why don't ya.
zh: ~z~他可是付了保护费的，尼克。你就保护保护他嘛。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. The Korean and his notes need our help.
zh: ~z~妈的，尼克。那个韩国人和他的钞票需要我们救。

english: ~z~Another immigrant, arriving in this city, trying to make something of himself.
zh: ~z~又一个移民来到了这座城市，想让自己有所成就。

english: ~z~Anyway, I figured you'd know a thing or two about smuggling stuff into the country.
zh: ~z~再说，你对怎么把东西偷运入境应该也略知一二。

english: ~z~Him and them notes ain't gonna do shit for us no more. Let's go back to land.
zh: ~z~他和那些钞票对咱们已经没用了。咱们回岸上吧。

english: ~z~Shit, Derrick. You sound almost like a human being. I might just see you there.
zh: ~z~妈的，德里克。你这是活过来了啊。我们码头见吧。

english: ~z~Fuck! You'd think the Coastguard had drowning kids to save.
zh: ~z~妈的！搞得好像海岸警卫队有溺水的孩子要救似的。

english: ~z~Only place for it, me boy. Only place for it. See you soon.
zh: ~z~只会花在那儿，小伙子。只会花在那儿的。之后见。

english: ~z~Is that because he's coming into the country to rob the good people of America of their hard earned money?
zh: ~z~是不是因为他入境也是来掠夺美国好人的血汗钱的？

english: ~z~I haven't felt safe since Aiden O'Malley went inside.
zh: ~z~自从艾登･奥马利进局子以后，我就没觉得安全过。

english: ~z~Shit, there goes pay day. At least he died rich, eh?
zh: ~z~妈的，发薪日泡汤了。好歹他是死在富贵里，对吧？

english: ~z~Escorting a Korean contact of mine into the country with a boat load of fake hundred dollar bills.
zh: ~z~护送我的朝鲜联络人入境，他的船上装满了百元假钞。

english: ~z~Christ, the notes may be fake but these bullets ain't. Get closer to Kim.
zh: ~z~老天，钞票可能是假的，子弹可是真家伙。靠近金一点。

english: ~z~That's all you can hope for in this God forsaken world. See you round, Niko.
zh: ~z~在这个被神抛弃的世界也没别的指望了。回头见，尼克。

english: ~z~Over there, we used to buy 'em off him off of him then exchange 'em for genuine currency.
zh: ~z~在爱尔兰的时候，我们就问他买假钞，然后再洗成真钱。

english: ~z~Doesn't look like the arrival of these notes was such a secret. Can you think of why that is?
zh: ~z~走私钞票的消息好像保密不够到位嘛？你知道咋回事吗？

english: ~z~Maybe a few people at the pub I borrowed money from, as well. You'll say anything for a fix.
zh: ~z~也可能是酒馆里借给我钱的人。为了毒品你什么都会说。

english: ~z~When you put it like that, he reminds me of a McReary. Good luck to him.
zh: ~z~你这么一说，倒让我想起某个姓麦克雷里的了。祝他好运。

english: ~z~Nice scam if you don't hit the same place too often. His boys are pulling the same gig over here.
zh: ~z~不盯着一个地方洗就不会被发现。他的人要在这里来这套。

english: ~z~Here we are. Got him here in one piece. That was the deal. Thanks, Niko.
zh: ~z~我们到了，把他安全护送到这儿了。就这点事，谢了，尼克。

english: ~z~We got to make sure these notes make it, just to piss off Frankie if nothing else.
zh: ~z~我们一定要把这些钞票送到，不为别的，就是要气死弗兰基。

english: ~z~Sure, I been telling a few people about this, but, hell, I smell a rat.
zh: ~z~的确，我有跟别人说过这事。不过，妈的，肯定是有人泄密。

english: ~z~I don't know. I told my dealer I was good for the money I owed him.
zh: ~z~不知道。我跟卖我毒品的人说过我很快就能把欠他的钱还上了。

english: ~z~Get over it, Derrick. He was a smuggler and the cash was fake. I'll see you around.
zh: ~z~让它过去吧，德里克。他是个走私者，钱也是假钞。我们之后见。

english: ~z~A rocket launcher. It's in the back. Get rid of the chopper with it. I'll drive the boat.
zh: ~z~火箭发射器，就在后头。拿它把那架直升机打下来，船我替你开。

english: ~z~Needless to say, he'll be inside for a time. Him and Bucky think I talked.
zh: ~z~想都不用想，他肯定得进去一段时间。他和巴基觉得是我告发的。

english: ~z~I didn't think he even knew I was back. Can't the man just let his brother be?
zh: ~z~我都没想到他居然知道我回来了。这家伙就不能放他兄弟一马吗？

english: ~z~Shit, I hope me dealer will front me another dime bag. I'll call ya, Niko.
zh: ~z~操蛋，希望卖我毒品的人肯让我再赊一包。过会儿再联系，尼克。

english: ~z~Maybe Frankie has been tapping Ma's fucking phone and he called this in to mess with me.
zh: ~z~说不定弗兰基这厮一直在偷听妈的电话，这群人就是他派来搞我的。

english: ~z~Yeah, welcome to America. We're meeting your friends in Bohan. I'll text ya the route you got to take.
zh: ~z~对，欢迎来到美国。我们要去波汉和你的朋友碰头。要走的路线我会发给你。

english: ~z~I owe ya an apology, Niko. I was dosed when you told me you'd killed Bucky and his boys.
zh: ~z~我欠你一句道歉，尼克。你跟我说你杀了巴基和他的手下的时候我刚好药嗑多了。

english: ~z~You're illegal, right? You think us McRearys was legal when we came here?
zh: ~z~你是非法移民，对吧？你以为我们麦克雷里家族刚来这儿的时候就是合法公民吗？

english: ~z~Niko, get rid of dear old Aiden...
~z~Drive the van, Niko. I'll handle the prisoner.
~z~Shit, Niko. They're all over me.
~z~Good, because I couldn't catch the prison van.
zh: ~z~那就好，因为我可赶不上囚车。

english: ~z~Go, Niko, go! Get these fuckers!
~z~Come on, buddy you're going to have to move this thing.
~z~We will not lose a prisoner on my watch.
zh: ~z~在我当值期间，绝不能丢囚犯。

english: ~z~That wasn't about getting out, that was pay back.
zh: ~z~那不只是为了出来，那是报仇。

english: ~z~Derrick McReary? He's my brother.
~z~A damn fucking road block. This is gonna hurt.
zh: ~z~该死的路障。这下要撞得够呛。

english: ~z~People remember you alright. You're at the front of certain people's minds.
zh: ~z~是有人记着你。那人很惦记你的。

english: ~z~The, the same... we're the same...
~z~Hey buddy, we're gonna need you to move this thing.
zh: ~z~嘿，伙计，我们需要你把车挪开。

english: ~z~Well, who is it? Not Julia?
zh: ~z~好吧，是哪位？不会是朱莉娅吧？

english: ~z~You're not free yet, asshole. Get in that car!
zh: ~z~你还没自由呢，混蛋。给我上车！

english: ~z~Derrick? But he ratted me out.
zh: ~z~德里克？不就是他把我卖了的吗？

english: ~z~They're making a play for the prisoner. Defend the stockade.
zh: ~z~他们是冲着犯人来的。保护囚车。

english: ~z~Lose 'em before I lose my fucking mind, okay?
zh: ~z~趁我还没疯之前甩掉他们，好吗？

english: ~z~Derrick? But he ratted me out.
zh: ~z~德里克？不就是他把我卖了的吗？

english: ~z~We're doing this on behalf of an old acquaintance of yours.
zh: ~z~我们是替你的一个故交做这事的。

english: ~z~This is our prisoner, you will not take him.
zh: ~z~这是我们的囚犯，你们别想带走。

english: ~z~Hey Buddy, get this thing outta the road, will you?
zh: ~z~嘿，伙计，麻烦你把车开走，好吗？

english: ~z~It's a surprise. Wait until we get to the cliffs. You'll find out then.
zh: ~z~是个惊喜。等到了悬崖你就知道了。

english: ~z~They ain't gonna break this perp out on our watch.
zh: ~z~有我们在，他们别想救走这个囚犯。

english: ~z~Okay, Derrick. I'll call you again when it's done.
zh: ~z~好的，德里克。办完了我再打给你。

english: ~z~Christ, we can't make him disappear now.
zh: ~z~上帝啊，现在我们没法让他消失了。

english: ~z~Nobody's going to find you where you're going, friend.
zh: ~z~你要去的地方没人能找到你，朋友。

english: ~z~You're going to a faraway place, my friend.
zh: ~z~你要去一个遥远的地方，我的朋友。

english: ~z~You're gonna get there first and block the road with your truck.
zh: ~z~你要抢先到达那里，然后用卡车封路。

english: ~z~Shit, they're sending fucking choppers after us.
zh: ~z~妈的，他们派他妈的直升机追我们了。

english: ~z~I need you to clear the area for us, Niko.
zh: ~z~我需要你替我们杀出一条路来，尼克。

english: ~z~You drive while I watch our cargo, Niko.
zh: ~z~你开车，我去看着我们的货物，尼克。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. Will you handle these boys?
zh: ~z~我操，尼克。你能不能解决这些人啊？

english: ~z~Hey Mitch, can you find out what this guy's up to?
zh: ~z~喂，米奇，你能去看看这人想干嘛吗？

english: ~z~We got to ditch this truck. It don't exactly blend in.
zh: ~z~我们得把囚车处理了。这样太显眼了。

english: ~z~I nearly gave up hoping. I nearly lost faith.
zh: ~z~我差点就不抱希望了。差点失去信念。

english: ~z~But you came. I do have friends. I do.
zh: ~z~可你还是来了。我确实有朋友。确实有。

english: ~z~I went into a situation full of optimism, full of naiveté...
zh: ~z~我曾经就有过盲目乐观的单纯岁月...

english: ~z~I ain't gonna be around much longer at this rate. Fucking help me!
zh: ~z~再这样下去我可撑不住。快他妈支援我。

english: ~z~Look at me... like smack on a fucking spoon.
zh: ~z~看看我...就他妈像勺子上的可卡因。

english: ~z~That's probably what Derrick would have told you to do in his smacked out state.
zh: ~z~也就吸毒吸昏头的德里克会让你这么做。

english: ~z~not that stale shit they pump though the correctional facility air conditioning units.
zh: ~z~而不是监狱空调里吹出来的那股馊味儿。

english: ~z~Fucking Derrick Mc-fucking-Reary.
~z~Who fucking knows? Today is the first day of the rest of my life.
zh: ~z~谁知道呢？今天是我后半辈子的第一天。

english: ~z~Now this is a piece of luck. Things are looking up. Looking up alright.
zh: ~z~这下运气来了。情况在好转。大有好转。

english: ~z~You boys, you boys... who sent you?
zh: ~z~你们几个，你们几个...谁派你们来的？

english: ~z~Lose the cops. I'll try to lose the fucking cops.
zh: ~z~甩掉条子。我会尽力甩掉这帮该死的条子。

english: ~z~I don't think I coulda spent another night in the joint.
zh: ~z~我觉得我可能熬不过牢里的下一个晚上了。

english: ~z~I thank ya, boys. I thank ya with all me heart.
zh: ~z~谢谢你们，小子们。我真心实意地谢谢你们。

english: ~z~Let alone eaten another prison meal or taken another fucking shower.
zh: ~z~更别说再吃一顿牢饭、再洗一次他妈的澡了。

english: ~z~I hope you can deal with Aiden still being out there.
zh: ~z~我希望你们能处理得了艾登还在外面这件事。

english: ~z~Shit, I thought I was out. I thought I was liberated.
zh: ~z~靠，我还以为我出来了。我还以为我自由了。

english: ~z~Alright, alright. I'll try to lose these fucking cops.
zh: ~z~好了，好了，我会尽量甩掉这些傻逼条子的。

english: ~z~Damn right, somewhere the cops'll never find me.
zh: ~z~太他妈对了，去个条子永远找不到我的地方。

english: ~z~A truck with a rocket launcher in it? What am I meant to do with them?
zh: ~z~装着火箭发射器的卡车？我要这些有什么用？

english: ~z~Why? Why? Why, in God's name, why?
zh: ~z~为什么？为什么？为什么，上帝啊，为什么？

english: ~z~Shit. The Aryan Brotherhood are going to be pissed, that's for damn sure. Sprung.
zh: ~z~妈的。雅利安兄弟会肯定要气炸了。越狱了。

english: ~z~Release the handbrake, Packie. We need to get rid of the van as well.
zh: ~z~把手刹松开，派奇。这辆囚车咱们也得处理掉。

english: ~z~He's the reason I ended up in that place to start with, the spineless...
zh: ~z~一开始我会进去就是因为他，这没骨气的...

english: ~z~He's the reason I ended up in that place to start with, the spineless...
zh: ~z~一开始我会进去就是因为他，这没骨气的...

english: ~z~Shit, the cops have got choppers in the sky. That's fucking cheating.
zh: ~z~妈的，条子的直升机都上天了。这他妈是作弊。

english: ~z~Trust the LCP-fucking-D to block the damn road.
zh: ~z~封路这种缺德事，也就 LCPD 干得出来。

english: ~z~It's about bloody time. I been in there doing a stretch I didn't deserve for too long.
zh: ~z~也该到时候了。我在里面蹲了太久本不该蹲的牢。

english: ~z~Okay, it looks like we've lost them. Take us over to the cliffs in Leftwood.
zh: ~z~好了，应该甩掉他们了。带我们去左伍德的悬崖。

zh: 他还是老样子，还是那个爱编故事却又讨人喜欢的小胖子。这个国家的生活挺有意思，跟老家差不多，只是不愁吃喝，而且烦恼更多。你亲爱的儿子。

english: In America I imagine the people must be bitter. The world used to love the, now they are despised. This President Lawton seems like a foolish man. Have you met him? Roman said that you and him were up for a prestigious award and you had some powerful friends.
zh: 我想美国人一定更加痛苦吧。世界曾经爱着美国，但现在只剩下轻蔑了。劳顿总统看着就是个蠢蛋。你见过他吗？罗曼说你跟总统一起去领了个重量级奖项，还说你有很厉害的朋友。

english: Word in the village is that Roman was killed on wedding day. I know it is true, as I checked on internet. My son, my heart is broken. Please leave evil place. Please go somewhere safe. Please do not caught up in madness. Please do not become statistic.
zh: 村子里说罗曼在婚礼上被杀了。我知道这是真的，我在网上查到了。我的儿子，我的心都碎了。离开这个邪恶的地方吧，找个安全的地方。请不要陷入疯狂，不要让死亡人数再多一个。

english: Life here is the same as it always was. People argue, the farms suffer, we pay taxes for new parliament buildings and government reports, and live in poverty. For country people, life is the same the world. Please write me.
zh: 这里的生活还是老样子。人们吵来吵去，农场各种状况。我们交税建造新的国会大厦，养着那些公务员，自己的生活倒还是那么贫困。对乡下人来说，在哪过日子都一样。请给我回信。

zh: ~z~尼克，我们快追上他了。他已经无处可逃了。

zh: ~z~你很幸运我们选择了这样的逃生载具，表兄。

english: ~z~Okay, cousin, okay. I was just saying, be safe is all.
zh: ~z~好吧，堂弟，好吧。我只是想说，安全第一。

zh: ~z~他们已经无处可逃了。全城没人想放过他们。

zh: ~z~尼克，你的战斗就是我的战斗。我们是一家人。

zh: ~z~靠，堂弟，这样真的好吗？真要杀光所有的打手？

english: ~z~They say that the dying animal is the most dangerous in the jungle, cousin.
zh: ~z~他们说濒死的野兽是丛林里最危险的生物，堂弟。

english: ~z~Well, I guess I'll be doing the whole city a favor when I kill Pegorino, then.
zh: ~z~那我杀了佩戈里诺应该是替全城做了件大好事了。

english: ~z~I do not care if I am killed, if I am hurt, as long as he pays for his attack.
zh: ~z~我不在乎我的死活，我的安危，我只要他杀人偿命。

english: ~z~Easy now Niko. Dat shit work in all dem spy torture type show pon TV, seen?
zh: ~z~冷静尼克。这种拷问只在电视上播的谍战片里有用。

english: ~z~This man will lead us there, we'll get him cousin. I assure you.
zh: ~z~这人会带我们过去的，会找到他的，堂弟。我保证。

english: ~z~Then we're going to make that shithead pay for what he did to Kate. Understand?
zh: ~z~然后让那个混蛋为他对凯特做的事付出代价。明白？

english: ~z~I guess Pegorino is not so weak after all, there were many men with him.
zh: ~z~我猜佩戈里诺毕竟没有那么弱，还有很多人追随他。

english: ~z~I am not taking you on some tourist sightseeing tour. We're chasing a scumbag back to his boss.
zh: ~z~我不是带你们来旅游的。现在要跟着他找到他的老板。

english: ~z~I did not start this, I have no choice after Pegorino killed Kate.
zh: ~z~我也不想的。既然佩戈里诺杀了凯特，我也别无他选。

english: ~z~Where'd you get this chopper, anyway? This is a serious piece of equipment.
zh: ~z~你在哪整的这架飞机，不管怎么样。这真是个大家伙。

english: ~z~I want to get this guy.I just don't think we want to take any unnecessary risks while we're doing that.
zh: ~z~我也想找到他。只是我不想让我们陷入没必要的危险。

english: ~z~At least we're seeing some of Alderney. I don't normally come this side of the West River.
zh: ~z~至少我们见识了下奥尔德尼。平常我不会来西河西边的。

zh: ~z~至少，事情解决了。我们能开始赚钱了...自由地赚。

zh: ~z~好吧，我们跟着他找到佩戈里诺，然后再切了丫的手指。

english: ~z~Are you sure that he's going back to Pegorino? He's not going to go on the lamb?
zh: ~z~你确定他会去找佩戈里诺吗？万一是他自己的藏身处呢？

english: ~z~Sure, cousin, sure. Eyes to the front. Mind on the job at hand and all that shit.
zh: ~z~当然了，堂弟，当然。向前看，专注手头的任务之类的。

english: ~z~She... was something worth protecting... by helping me today you are doing something good.
zh: ~z~她...是值得保护的...今天你们帮我是在做好事。

english: ~z~From what you tell me about Jimmy P, he's too desperate to do without this shit.
zh: ~z~从你口中吉米 P的为人来看，采购结束前他不敢跑的。

english: ~z~Yeah, but this guy better not be fucking with us. He better be bringing us to Pegorino.
zh: ~z~嗯，但这人最好别耍咱们。他最好能带我们找到佩戈里诺。

zh: ~z~据说佩戈里诺的势力所剩无几，现在正躲在哪里准备跑路。

zh: ~z~他像无头苍蝇一样在城里乱转，兄弟。到处采购，他怕了。

zh: ~z~我的线人告诉我说，佩戈里诺可能躲在奥尔德尼北部的某处。

zh: ~z~你主动请缨的，罗曼。~n~现在上了车，就别叽叽歪歪了。

zh: ~z~你说你想帮忙，罗曼。你说你和我一样想让佩戈里诺付出代价。

zh: ~z~对，兄弟，能找到他的。那小子不可能在这世上多活一天，懂？

zh: ~z~我们会杀了佩戈里诺的，堂兄。不管这是不是一场胜利，那都是另一回事了。

zh: ~z~那俩白痴以为自己是大佬中的大佬。

english: ~z~There ain't no way those boys gonna be scared of some boys like I and I following their boy, ya know.
zh: ~z~他们也不会怕手下被我们跟踪懂吗。

english: ~z~Instead I did the business deal that lead to Roman getting killed.
zh: ~z~反而去进行了交易，害得罗曼被杀。

english: ~z~Did you get Pegorino back at de place, bredren?
zh: ~z~你有在那里干掉佩戈里诺吗，兄弟？

english: ~z~Nuh, man. I and I do dis for Roman.
zh: ~z~嗯，老兄。我们这么做是为了罗曼。

english: ~z~You were there when Dimitri first wronged me.
zh: ~z~迪米特里第一次背叛我的时候你也在。

english: ~z~I'm going to catch Dimitri and end this for good.
zh: ~z~我要逮住迪米特里，彻底结束这一切。

english: ~z~Dimitri and Pegorino will find this out as well,
zh: ~z~很快迪米特里和佩戈里诺也会明白了。

english: ~z~Roman was a gambler, he would've liked those odds.
zh: ~z~罗曼是个赌徒，他会喜欢那些可能性的。

english: ~z~Me feeling dat, ya know, breda, I and I gwan get him.
zh: ~z~深有同感，懂吧，兄弟，我们要干了他。

english: ~z~Everybody in Liberty City know dat, so dem after de money too.
zh: ~z~自由城人尽皆知，很多人都盯上了这钱。

english: ~z~I thought the money would help Roman and the people I loved.
zh: ~z~我以为那笔钱能帮上罗曼和我所爱的人。

english: ~z~Yes, but the chances of my cousin being dead would be much slimmer.
zh: ~z~确实，但我堂兄死掉的可能性会小很多。

english: ~z~I had to fight through a lot of people to get to Dimitri.
zh: ~z~我必须得杀出一条血路才能靠近迪米特里。

english: ~z~I think he probably did. We'd have to go to Russia to find out though.
zh: ~z~我想也是。不过我们得去俄罗斯才能查证。

english: ~z~Seen, think about how you going to bust these bitches up then.
zh: ~z~懂了，那就想想你要怎么干烂这些贱人吧。

english: ~z~If he did, ya know, say him boss don' have long fe live 'pon this earth.
zh: ~z~要是他懂，就会说他的老板活不了多久了。

english: ~z~I don't tink you have a choice about dat, ya know, Niko. Roman loved you.
zh: ~z~我想这你也没得选，尼克。罗曼一直爱你。

english: ~z~they will find it out when they stare down the barrel of my gun.
zh: ~z~等他们注视着我的枪口的时候就会明白了。

english: ~z~You are right, but we can change what is about to happen.
zh: ~z~你说的对，但我们可以改变将要发生的事。

english: ~z~I will put a bullet in his heart for every life he ruined,
zh: ~z~我会在他胸口开洞，他每毁掉一个人一枪，

english: ~z~Just be calm now, rasta. Just make sure ya don't lose dat blood clot.
zh: ~z~先保持冷静，兄弟。别跟丢那个狗逼就行。

english: ~z~That's just the way Roman was. Don't ever forget him, seen?
zh: ~z~罗曼他就是这样的。永远不要忘记他，好吧？

english: ~z~I did not forget about this, but I let it slide in the interest of business.
zh: ~z~我没有忘，只是出于利益考量没去计较而已。

english: ~z~Roman did not deserve to die. Not on this day, not in that place.
zh: ~z~罗曼不应该死的。不该在此日，不该在彼处。

english: ~z~He has reason to be nervous, the man who will kill his employer is following him.
zh: ~z~他是该慌了，要杀他老板的人现在就跟着他。

english: ~z~Come on Niko man. Get out of here. Let's go. Come on!
zh: ~z~好了，尼克兄弟。离开这儿吧。我们走。走吧！

english: ~z~Tink about how ya gwan mash dem up when time ya find out which part dem a hide.
zh: ~z~想想找到他们的藏身处以后要怎么粉碎他们吧。

english: ~z~True me breda, true. I ain't gwan fe let it go neither.
zh: ~z~确实，兄弟，确实。我也不会就这样放着不管。

english: ~z~I just want to drive this scum off of the road and smash his brain out on the concrete.
zh: ~z~我现在就想撞飞这个人渣，再轧到他脑浆涂地。

english: ~z~I let it eat out everything good in me. It took me over.
zh: ~z~我任由它吞食了身上的一切正念。它占据了我。

english: ~z~Ya mind be clouded and ya don't be able fe tink clearly, ya know. Ya want some weed?
zh: ~z~头脑不清就没法好好思考，懂吧。要来点草吗？

english: ~z~I will not forget him. Nor will I let these men forget him.
zh: ~z~我不会忘记他的。我也不会让这些人忘记他的。

english: ~z~We not angry at him, ya know, Niko. Its di people he's working for, seen?
zh: ~z~别对他发火，尼克。要发也对他的老板发，懂？

english: ~z~I do not need any marijuana, Jacob. I can think clearly enough.
zh: ~z~我不需要大麻，雅各布。我现在就能好好思考。

english: ~z~Come on, why does this take so long? Where are these idiots hiding out?
zh: ~z~真是，怎么要花这么久？那些蠢蛋到底躲在哪儿？

english: ~z~We haffi get to dem, so we follow dis bumba clot, seen?
zh: ~z~我们必须找到他们，所以才跟着这个小杂种，懂？

english: ~z~Roman brought me to this city and I was nothing but a curse to him.
zh: ~z~罗曼让我来到这个城市，而我于他完全就是灾厄。

english: ~z~What's done is done, and dere ain't no way to change what happen earlier.
zh: ~z~木已成舟，没有什么办法能够改变已经发生的事。

english: ~z~for every agreement he went back on, for every friend he betrayed.
zh: ~z~每与人达成一个协议一枪，每背叛一个伙伴一枪。

english: ~z~We can make sure that Roman's life is not the only one that is lost today.
zh: ~z~我们可以做到让罗曼不是唯一一个在今天没命的人。

english: ~z~If you didn't wanna come up here, he was gonna go to Europe and drag you pon a boat.
zh: ~z~就算你不想来这儿，他也会去欧洲拉着你上船过来。

english: ~z~I guess I'll just have to pass the time by thinking about how much I'm going to punish these scum.
zh: ~z~我大概得靠思考如何惩治这些小人消磨这段时间了。

english: ~z~Okay, this is good news. I do not know how much of this driving I can continue to do.
zh: ~z~好的，是个好消息。不知道这种追车我还能忍多久。

english: ~z~I had the opportunity to settle my score with Dimitri the other day but I chose not to take it.
zh: ~z~之前我就有机会和迪米特里把账算清，但我没有行动。

english: ~z~We must find Dimitri and Pegorino and end all this.
zh: ~z~我们必须找到迪米特里和佩戈里诺，给一切画上句号。

english: ~z~Me understand ya know, rasta. It's a good ting dat blood clot don't know you as good as I and I know ya, ya know?
zh: ~z~我明白，兄弟。幸好那个狗逼没我那么了解你，懂吗？

english: ~z~He was kidnapped. I should have known that the lives of those close to me would be destroyed.
zh: ~z~被人绑架。我早该知道亲近我的人的生活都会被破坏。

english: ~z~Seen, we just need fe stay on dis bumba clot and we'll be able to mash dem up real good.
zh: ~z~懂了，我们只要跟住这个杂种，就能把他们彻底粉碎。

english: ~z~Maybe we should go with Dimitri's body. Bury him in his homeland.
zh: ~z~也许我们应该带上迪米特里的尸体过去。把他埋在故乡。

english: ~z~Had I got rid of Dimitri then, the bloodshed would have ended.
zh: ~z~要是我那会儿就杀了迪米特里，这些杀戮就已经结束了。

english: ~z~To get them back for what they have done, I would look for them in every corner of the earth.
zh: ~z~要让他们为自己的行为付出代价，我会寻找到天涯海角。

english: ~z~A man stab you in the back once, him gonna keep stabbing until di job is done, seen?
zh: ~z~背叛过你的人永远都会背叛你，直到双方做个了断，懂？

english: ~z~Are we getting near to them or is this man taking us on a tour around Alderney?
zh: ~z~我们有接近他们吗？还是说这人在带我们参观奥尔德尼？

english: ~z~He had many men there. Both Russians and Pegorino's men.
zh: ~z~他在那儿安排了不少人。俄国人和佩戈里诺的手下都有。

english: ~z~De boy leading us back because him tink him boys going fe tear us to pieces and ting.
zh: ~z~他把我们带过去是因为他觉得他的人足以把我们撕成碎片。

english: ~z~Yo Niko, ya need fe lose some of dis anger, ya know, before ya go after dem boy dere.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，在跟着他们找到人之前你还是先消消气比较好。

english: ~z~Anyting could happen if you kill Dimitri pon dat day.
zh: ~z~就算你当时把迪米特里杀了，也不能保证之后会发生什么。

english: ~z~He was a good man. No matter what happened to him, he would never be angry or upset for more than a minute.
zh: ~z~他是个好人。无论遇到什么，他都不会愤怒或者伤心多久。

english: ~z~If Dimitri and Pegorino are so on top, why would they care about me?
zh: ~z~要是迪米特里和佩戈里诺都有这么大权势了，还担心我干嘛？

english: ~z~Alright, so this guy is taking us to his bosses. We cannot kill him yet then.
zh: ~z~好了，既然这家伙会带我们找到他的老板，暂时就不能杀他。

english: ~z~He was beaten because of me, he was shot, his business and his home were burnt down.
zh: ~z~他因为我的缘故被打，挨了枪子，他的家和事业都成了焦土。

english: ~z~If we had got him then, Roman would still be alive. Things would be good.
zh: ~z~要是我们在那时就杀了他，罗曼现在就还活着，一切都会很好。

english: ~z~How you know he's going back to Pegorino and Dimitri? Why would he lead us back to them?
zh: ~z~你怎么知道他会去找佩戈里诺和迪米特里？他真会把我们引过去？

english: ~z~I can tell him getting nervous, ya know, Niko. He's driving different. We must be getting close.
zh: ~z~我敢肯定他慌了，尼克。他的开车风格变了。我们肯定很接近了。

english: ~z~I do this for my cousin and for his wife. I needed to make Dimitri pay.
zh: ~z~我这么做是为了我的堂兄和他的妻子。我要让迪米特里付出代价。

english: ~z~Cha! A burial be too good for that bumba clot, ya know. He ain't worth putting inna di ground, ya know, star.
zh: ~z~擦！那狗逼根本不配下葬懂吧。他不值得被葬在地下，懂吧老兄。

english: ~z~A snake always be a snake, ya know rasta. Dimitri woulda steal from him own mother fe get ahead, ya know.
zh: ~z~叛徒永远都是叛徒懂吧，兄弟。迪米特里为了目标连他母亲都敢偷。

english: ~z~No, Dimitri killed Pegorino when I arrived. I don't think he likes to share.
zh: ~z~不，我到的时候迪米特里就杀了佩戈里诺。我想他不喜欢和人分享。

english: ~z~I have finally learnt this lesson. It has taken the death of my cousin, but it is something I must accept.
zh: ~z~我终于明白了这个道理。以我堂兄的死为代价，但我也必须得接受。

english: ~z~If there was any way I could change my actions so that he would not die, I would do it.
zh: ~z~要是有什么办法能改变我的选择，保住他的性命，我一定会去做的。

english: ~z~Dat be a whole heap of teeth, ya know, Niko. I don't tink we have enough ammo fe shoot him dat many times, ya know.
zh: ~z~那可得打上不少子弹，尼克。我觉得我们的子弹还不够打那么多次。

english: ~z~We catch him, then we kill him, then we decide what to do with the body. How's that sound, Jacob?
zh: ~z~先逮住他，再杀了他，然后再决定怎么处理尸体。这样如何，雅各布？

english: ~z~No matter what you say about dat murderer, he's consistent. He's consistently fucking anybody him can.
zh: ~z~无论你怎么评价那个杀人犯，他都是一样的。他一直都是能搞谁搞谁。

english: ~z~Also, dey ain't going to know their boy at the wedding didn't do his job properly. They tink ya dead, ya know.
zh: ~z~还有，他们都不知道派去婚礼的杀手没办成事。当你已经死了，懂吗？

english: ~z~Dere ain't no guarantee you gonna make it, bredren. I and I don't know what our actions can do and ting.
zh: ~z~没人能保证你会成功，兄弟。我们也不知道我们的选择会有什么后果。

english: ~z~Who dat inna de helicopter? Did Dimtri and Pegorino both leave when you get inna de ground?
zh: ~z~那架直升机里是谁？你进去的时候迪米特里和佩戈里诺是不是都跑了？

english: ~z~All we can be tinking about is taking dat ras clot down, and stopping him from hurting anyone else. Seen?
zh: ~z~我们现在能考虑的就是干掉那个狗杂种，让他不能再伤害任何人。懂？

english: ~z~Dat was a long time ago, ya know, king. Dere ain't no promise dat life would be any different from now, ya know.
zh: ~z~那是很久以前了，兄弟。而且也没法保证那样就会和现在有什么区别。

english: ~z~Ya man, we getting closer. Me hear from me source dat Pegorino might be inna di north of Alderney.
zh: ~z~喂老兄，我们很近了。我听线人说佩戈里诺可能就在奥尔德尼的北部。

english: ~z~Seen Niko, a whole heap a bodies left inna dat place dere, ya know? Ya a real lion for real, ya know, star?
zh: ~z~懂了，尼克，那里留着一大堆尸体是吧？你真是头雄狮，知道吗，老兄？

english: ~z~Dey say a dying animal is de most dangerous inna de jungle, ya know, cousin. So, ya better be careful.
zh: ~z~他们说濒死的野兽是丛林里最危险的生物懂吧，老弟。所以最好小心点。

english: ~z~Sending an assassin after me and killing Roman on his wedding day, this is something I will not ignore.
zh: ~z~派杀手来杀我，还在罗曼的大喜之日杀了他。这，才是我不能坐视不理的。

english: ~z~He stabbed Pegorino in the back, just like he did to everyone he has worked with while I have known him.
zh: ~z~他背叛了佩戈里诺，就像他对他的所有合伙人做的一样，我已经很清楚了。

english: ~z~I came to this city wanting revenge, I let that desire build up inside of me for many years.
zh: ~z~我怀着复仇的心来到这座城市，我已经任由那种欲望在心中生长很多年了。

english: ~z~I an' I gwan find dem, we going to find dem and take dem out, for real, dat's what we doing for Roman.
zh: ~z~一定能找到他们的，找到以后就是斩草除根了，这就是我们要为罗曼做的。

english: ~z~Ya man ya man. How'de ginnal get away from you anyway, Niko? Me tink ya get dat boy for sure.
zh: ~z~好，兄弟，好，兄弟。那骗子怎么可能躲过你？我觉得你肯定能逮着那崽子。

english: ~z~Don't worry, rasta. I gwan shoot him out de blood clot sky. He ain't going to be able to talk his way outta dis.
zh: ~z~别担心，兄弟。我这就让他在天上血妈爆炸。他没法再用花言巧语骗出生路了。

english: ~z~Yeah, I understand. I get it. I just need those bastards to know and understand what they did to me.
zh: ~z~是，我明白。我懂的。我只是要让那些混蛋明白，知道自己到底对我做了什么。

english: ~z~Easy Niko, just be cool now. Pegorino and Dimitri be splitting up de large amount of money dem get from de business deal.
zh: ~z~放松，尼克，现在先冷静。佩戈里诺和迪米特里正在分配那次交易的巨额钱款。

english: ~z~No matter what he was gonna get close to ya. Because, before you come all him a do is talk about him cousin, Niko.
zh: ~z~不论亲近你会带来什么。因为在你来前，他最常做的事就是谈论他的堂弟尼克。

english: ~z~I can't believe I did that deal with Dimitri. How could I trust him? I'm a fool.
zh: ~z~我都不敢相信我居然会帮迪米特里去交易。我怎么会相信他的？我就是个白痴。

english: ~z~Dimitri and Pegorino, they be pon top after that deal, ya know. They got de coil and de brown, didn't dey?
zh: ~z~迪米特里和佩戈里诺，他俩在那次交易后就上位了。他们既有钱又有货，不是吗？

english: ~z~Roman was a good man, ya know. He had a righteous heart, ya know, star. Jah know him in a better place now.
zh: ~z~罗曼是个好人，懂吧。他的心肠很好，懂吧，老兄。主知道他现在在更好的地方。

english: ~z~Dimitri tinks dat you forget about what happen on the docks ya know, in Broker. Him screw ya over after ya kill Faustin for him.
zh: ~z~迪米特里觉得你把布洛克码头的那件事给忘了。你替他杀了福斯汀，他却出卖了你。

english: ~z~Yo Niko, Dimitri and Pegorino gwan have mad firepower pon di ground, ya know. Dis ain't gwan be easy.
zh: ~z~哟，尼克，迪米特里和佩戈里诺肯定会在周边布置大量的火力懂吧。不会那么容易的。

english: ~z~Jah know not many man could a got through dem boys, ya know, star. Ya a real badman for real, real badman!
zh: ~z~主也知道很少有人能杀出这样的血路懂吧，老兄。你真是个大恶人，真真正正的恶人！

english: ~z~Dem boy dey no right ya know, Come inna church and come kill a man pon him wedding day. Jah know, it ain't right.
zh: ~z~那几个小子不做好事懂吧。冲进教堂，冲进去把婚礼的新郎给杀了。主知道那是不对的。

english: ~z~I cannot allow that to happen again, not to me, not to Mallorie and everyone who loved Roman.
zh: ~z~我不能让那种悲剧重演，在我身上，在玛洛丽身上，在任何爱着罗曼的人身上都不能重演。

zh: ~z~宝贝，我想是时候换辆新车了，就像，十年前一样。

zh: ~z~没事，别担心，尼克。毕竟大家都会在穿搭上出错。

zh: ~z~好吧，在这儿吃吧。这里应该不是那种传送带餐厅吧？

zh: ~z~很高兴你终于把那帽子扔了，你已经把那玩意烧了吧。

english: ~z~Okay, those are some pretty bold choices. Are you hoping to come across as an eccentric or something?
zh: ~z~好吧，这套搭配有点大胆。你是想做个怪人之类的吗？

zh: ~z~这车是假的吧，我还以为只有第三世界才会开这种车。

zh: ~z~好吧，快告诉我我们怎么过去，我连你的车都没看见。

english: ~z~Niko, I've been waiting. No fucking wonder when you haven't brought a car.
zh: ~z~尼克，我等很久了。你丫连车都没开来，难怪这么慢。

zh: ~z~你对这种破烂车的痴迷程度已经用古董风格都解释不了了

english: ~z~Let's go and hit some balls into holes with long sticks. Oh what fun.
zh: ~z~那我们就去用长长的棒子把球打到洞里吧。哦，真有趣。

english: ~z~Well, if that's your only nice outfit you may as well get the most out of it.
zh: ~z~好吧，要是那是你唯一一件的好外套，倒是该物尽其用。

english: ~z~Can you please explain to me what the appeal of really shit cars is? I don't get it.
zh: ~z~麻烦你告诉我这辆破铜烂铁有什么好的？我是真搞不懂。

english: ~z~You want to play darts... again? Well this is really a hobby of yours, isn't it, Niko?
zh: ~z~你又想玩飞镖...？这个是你的个人爱好是吧，尼克？

english: ~z~Thank God you've got rid of that thing you were driving before. I mean anything would be better than that.
zh: ~z~谢天谢地你终于不开那辆垃圾了。开啥都比那辆垃圾好。

english: ~z~It's so good that that hat is gone. It made you look like a thug.
zh: ~z~没戴那顶帽子真是太好了，那顶帽子让你像一个小混混。

english: ~z~I didn't think anything could be worse than the car you used to drive, I was wrong.
zh: ~z~我还以为你上次开的车已经够差了，没想到还有更差的。

english: ~z~If I'd known you weren't bringing a car I would have gotten Daddy to lend us a driver.
zh: ~z~早知道你没把车开过来，我就让爹地给我们派个司机了。

english: ~z~Oh God, I hope none of my friends sees me out with a man dressed like this.
zh: ~z~天哪，希望不会被朋友看见我和穿成这样的男人在一起。

zh: ~z~实在太无聊了，我们不是出来约会的吗？能送我回家吗？

zh: ~z~摩托车能让我想起很多往日时光。好了，我们走吧，尼克。

zh: ~z~我的想法就是，即便我讨厌某些东西，我还是能为它写篇博客。

zh: ~z~尼克，拜托你去弄辆新车。我坐这玩意里被别人看见很没面子的。

english: ~z~Niko, can't you go for a more preppy look? That hat makes you look like a criminal.
zh: ~z~尼克，你就不能打扮的正经点吗？那顶帽子让你看起来像个罪犯。

zh: ~z~好吧，那就再打一次台球吧。我感觉自己像是死了以后又在中西部醒来。

zh: ~z~我是唯一一个可以迟到的人，尼克。你这样搞得我说话都像我母亲了。开车吧。

zh: ~z~天，你也知道，我什么都会试一试。我不就试着在craplist上约了人吗？

zh: ~z~特雷梅因的上诉刚刚被驳回了。

english: ~z~How can I be grateful when I'm in so much pain?
zh: ~z~我这么痛苦，怎么高兴的起来？

english: ~z~Thank you, Niko, I knew you'd understand.
~z~The world is certainly determined to screw itself up.
zh: ~z~这个世界注定是会走向毁灭的。

english: ~z~Don't you sometimes feel really guilty driving a car?
zh: ~z~你开车的时候会不会感到很内疚？

english: ~z~What made you decide to look for love online?
zh: ~z~你为什么会选择在网上寻找爱情？

english: ~z~I defend the people that the rest of the community has forgotten about.
zh: ~z~我会为那些被社会遗忘的人辩护。

english: ~z~I represent the people who can't even help themselves.
zh: ~z~我代表那些甚至都无法自救的人。

english: ~z~It doesn't matter why you do something as long as it's right.
zh: ~z~只要你的行为正确，动机就不重要。

english: ~z~Like I said, this is so unlike me.
zh: ~z~我也说了，这太不像我会做的事了。

english: ~z~I'm starting to understand why you're seeing me, I think.
zh: ~z~我大概有点明白你为什么肯见我了。

english: ~z~It's an absolute farce the miscarriages of justice that he's had to suffer.
zh: ~z~让他承受正义缺失的代价实在荒谬。

english: ~z~I don't know, I just thought I'd try it. What made you?
zh: ~z~我不知道，我只是想试试。那你呢？

english: ~z~It sounds as if you're being as helpful as you can be.
zh: ~z~听起来你好像在尽可能地帮助别人。

english: ~z~He's such a big softie. He's practically Buddhist.
zh: ~z~他心肠很好的，几乎是一个佛教徒。

english: ~z~Unlucky though. Hopefully that won't rub off on me.
zh: ~z~真是倒霉。好在我应该不会被传染。

english: ~z~Triple homicide - well that was what he was accused of.
zh: ~z~谋杀三人——这就是他的被控罪名。

english: ~z~And you've come out okay - you should be grateful.
zh: ~z~但你的命不差啊，你应该高兴才对。

english: ~z~I'm going to warn you Niko, I'm not in the best of moods.
zh: ~z~先跟你说好，尼克，我现在心情很差。

english: ~z~Well, sometimes the cops are bigger crooks than the guys they're arresting.
zh: ~z~嗯，有些警察确实比被捕的犯人还坏。

english: ~z~I cannot take grown men playing dressing up games very seriously.
zh: ~z~我不喜欢看一群成年人在那里过家家。

english: ~z~I'm an idealist, if that's what you mean.
zh: ~z~我想你的意思是我是个理想主义者吧。

english: ~z~You're a noble savage. You should sue the government.
zh: ~z~你是个高尚的莽夫。你应该起诉政府。

english: ~z~Because of the carbon footprint, because of future generations, of course.
zh: ~z~因为产生了碳足迹，还会祸害子孙后代。

english: ~z~I mean, Mitch was no angel. I'm not going to pretend that he was.
zh: ~z~的确，米奇不算是好人，这点我不否认。

english: ~z~The line is so blurry. I'm too close to be able to tell what he is.
zh: ~z~界线太模糊了。当局者迷，我区分不了。

english: ~z~I'm a go getter, Niko. A real Alpha female.
zh: ~z~我是个上进的人，尼克。真正的一流女人。

english: ~z~Yeah, really sweet guys - misunderstood, you know?
zh: ~z~是啊，都是些好人，只是不被理解，懂吧？

english: ~z~Not everyone born in a project sells their ass for crack.
zh: ~z~出生在公屋社区的人未必会为了毒品卖身。

english: ~z~Yes - I knew you'd be nice, from your email.
zh: ~z~没错，我就知道你人很好，看邮件就知道了。

english: ~z~You're seeing a different side of me meeting me this way. It's working out.
zh: ~z~跟我约会能让你见到我的另一面。挺不错的。

english: ~z~All your ex-boyfriends seem to be real pacifists...
zh: ~z~你的前男友好像都是真正的和平主义者...

english: ~z~But he's a survivor. I'm trying to get him to write a book about it.
zh: ~z~但他挺住了。我建议他把自己的经历写成书。

english: ~z~If I got hauled down to City Hall, I'd be grateful for your help.
zh: ~z~如果我被扭送市政厅，我就会感谢你的帮助。

english: ~z~I mean, I was born into privilege. I was given an education.
zh: ~z~我是说，我是富人家的孩子，有机会接受教育。

english: ~z~I was being sarcastic... don't worry about it... who is Dorian?
zh: ~z~我就顺口一说...别在意...多里安是谁？

english: ~z~Because some people are having a miserable time, I guess. I don't know.
zh: ~z~可能是因为还有人在经历不幸吧。我也不知道。

english: ~z~None that are still on the outside. This government really annoys me, Niko.
zh: ~z~他们全都进去了。政府真的很让我恼火，尼克。

english: ~z~This ex of mine, Mitch, I met him when I represented him on this bogus murder charge.
zh: ~z~我前男友，米奇，替他处理谋杀冤案时认识的。

english: ~z~The only guys I meet are the other lawyers - complete creeps - and my defendants.
zh: ~z~能见到的只有我讨厌的其他律师，和我的委托人。

english: ~z~There will always be people who suffer, Kiki. That is the way of the world.
zh: ~z~总会有人遭遇不幸的，琪琪。这个世界就是如此。

english: ~z~It's nearly impossible for a man born into poverty in this country to make it without breaking the law.
zh: ~z~在这个国家，穷人家的孩子不犯法是很难成功的。

english: ~z~He's got such soul. Being unfairly incarcerated would break most men.
zh: ~z~他有高洁的灵魂。大多数人含冤入狱后都会崩溃，

english: ~z~It's just that I'm working these cases the whole time and I can't get out to meet new people.
zh: ~z~只是因为我每天忙着打官司，没空出去交新朋友。

english: ~z~I wanted to help people. That's why I do pro bono work at City Hall.
zh: ~z~我想帮助别人，所以才会去市政厅做无偿法律援助。

english: ~z~I don't pretend that I wouldn't be selling my ass for crack if I was born in project housing though.
zh: ~z~要是我出生在公屋社区，多半也会为了毒品出卖肉体。

english: ~z~Mom and Dad made me promise not to date any more of them so here I am, dating on the internet.
zh: ~z~爸妈让我保证不再跟这些人约会，所以我现在搞网恋。

english: ~z~Yeah, only Tremaine was completely innocent. There's no way he killed those guys.
zh: ~z~是啊，但特雷梅因是完全无辜的。他不可能杀那些人。

english: ~z~this is so unlike me, but I'm giving it a go and it seems to be working out.
zh: ~z~这太不像我会做的事了，但我试了一试，似乎也还不错。

english: ~z~It was a conspiracy. The government doesn't like free thinkers and autodidacts.
zh: ~z~这是个阴谋。政府不喜欢思想自由的人和无师自通的人。

english: ~z~I'm so sorry! Our society let you down! My country failed you!
zh: ~z~真对不起！我们的社会让你失望了！我的国家辜负了你！

english: ~z~So, Niko, are there any skeletons in your closet? Is anyone haunting you?
zh: ~z~那，尼克，你有什么不可告人的秘密吗？有人缠着你吗？

english: ~z~It's not bad luck Niko. It's the system. It's totally fucked. Totally.
zh: ~z~这不是倒霉，尼克，是体制问题。体制烂了，完全烂了。

english: ~z~Client / ex, ex / client, lover, friend, spiritual guru.
zh: ~z~委托人兼前任，前任兼委托人，爱人，朋友，精神导师。

english: ~z~Relationships can't rarely last when they get sent out of state to a Federal Penitentiary though.
zh: ~z~不过等他们被送进联邦监狱以后，这段感情就难以维系了。

english: ~z~Oh... ummm... nothing. Have you got any ex-boyfriends I should worry about?
zh: ~z~噢...呃...没什么。我需要担心你的哪个前男友吗？

english: ~z~It might be because I feel guilty but is that a bad thing? Am I doing it for the wrong reasons?
zh: ~z~可能是出于内疚，但这有关系吗？难道我的动机就错了吗？

english: ~z~I mean, it's just the arresting officer's word against the perps. "We found this gun on him."
zh: ~z~我是说，光靠办案刑警的证词就定罪了。「嫌犯身上有枪。」

english: ~z~As I see it, I have chosen to live life outside the law. Rights mean nothing to me now.
zh: ~z~在我看来，既然选择了当法外之徒，权利就对我毫无意义了。

english: ~z~And now I'm here, trying to make a difference. I'm not naïve... but...
zh: ~z~现在我进城了，想要有所改变。不是我太幼稚...但...

english: ~z~It was stupid. It just goes to show how the system is primed to punish people who already disadvantaged.
zh: ~z~说来可笑，他的经历只会证明，现有体制旨在惩罚弱势群体。

english: ~z~The world has rights, just like criminals and murderers and immigrants and all the other disadvantageous do, too.
zh: ~z~地球也有权利，就像罪犯、杀人犯、移民和各种弱势群体一样。

english: ~z~But the police will arrest any man in the vicinity of a crime in order to clear a file from their desks.
zh: ~z~但那些警察为了尽快结案，只会在案发现场附近随便抓一个人。

english: ~z~"His clothes were covered in the victim's blood." An innocent man with a felony prior doesn't stand a chance.
zh: ~z~「他的衣服沾满了受害者的血。」曾犯重罪的良民是没有机会的。

english: ~z~He's serving life upstate. Can you believe that they revoked his conjugal visit privileges? It's inhuman.
zh: ~z~在北方终身监禁。他的配偶探望权居然还被剥夺了。太没人性了。

english: ~z~Yeah, I guess I do make a difference. I feel like all my life I've been given things by my parents.
zh: ~z~是啊，我大概确实有所改变。感觉我这辈子一直在接受父母的给予。

english: ~z~Cars, clothes, my apartment, my education. I help the people who haven't been given anything.
zh: ~z~车子，衣服，我的公寓，我的教育。现在我帮助那些无法得到给予的人。

english: ~z~I mean, are there any ex-girlfriends who are still hung up on you? What did you think I meant?
zh: ~z~我是说，有没有哪个前女友现在还对你死缠烂打？你以为我是什么意思？

english: ~z~You two have so much in common, I mean more than just me. You're both such peace loving men.
zh: ~z~你们两个有很多共同点，不只是都和我处得好。你们都是爱好和平的人。

english: ~z~Just sometimes I feel like I can't do enough though. I feel like I can't help people as much as I want to be able to.
zh: ~z~不过有时我会觉得自己做得还不够，帮助他人时时常感觉心有余而力不足。

english: ~z~But it was obviously self defense. A mother clearly attacked him, and he shot her, and her kids.
zh: ~z~但明明是正当防卫。那个母亲攻击了他，他掏枪反击，还打中了两个孩子。

english: ~z~Do you not think that it is vain to think you can make a difference? To think it is your concern?
zh: ~z~难道你不觉得，认为自己可以发挥作用，认为这是你的责任，是没有意义的吗？

english: ~z~I'm a girl who wants to make it in the big city. You know, I grew up in the suburbs, bored out of my mind...
zh: ~z~我是个想在大城市有所成就的女孩。你看，我在郊区长大，从小就很无聊...

english: ~z~You can try. Most of the people from my law class just went to big firms on the Exchange to make their millions.
zh: ~z~不试试怎么知道。跟我同专业的同学大多去了证券交易所的大公司，年入百万。

english: ~z~I thought it would be like I imagined. But I'm really lonely. I mean, it's nice to be out with you.
zh: ~z~我以为能过上想象中的生活，但实际上我很孤独。我是说，很高兴能和你出来玩。

english: ~z~But, well... it was nice. It's strange. You always want something to be like it is in the movies, don't you?
zh: ~z~但是，嗯...普通就好。很奇怪，你会不会期待生活偶尔像电影情节一样发展？

english: ~z~Sometimes, when I'm having a fun time - even a fun time with a crazy man like you, I feel so guilty.
zh: ~z~有时候，即便我很开心，我还是会感到内疚，哪怕是跟你这样的好人在一起的时候。

english: ~z~I'm a criminal, and a murderer. I arrived in your country and fell in with a bad crowd. What rights do I have?
zh: ~z~我是一个罪犯，还是杀人犯。我来到你们国家，和不法分子厮混。我能有什么权利？

english: ~z~I could just tell... I mean, not that I read too much into it. This is just a casual date, you know. Casual.
zh: ~z~就是能看出来嘛...也不是说我过度解读了。反正这次就是个普通约会而已。普通约会。

english: ~z~Niko?
~z~What?
~z~Sure.
~z~Yes?
~z~What?
~z~Kiki?
~z~Niko.
~z~Thank you.
~z~So?
~z~Nothing.
~z~What did you say?
~z~Oh Niko.
~z~I don't know.
~z~How?
~z~Okay, ask away.
~z~Uh, nothing.
~z~Is what impossible?
~z~Yes, what is it?
~z~Okay, I'm sorry.
~z~What does that mean?
~z~What are they, then?
~z~I don't see a difference.
~z~I try not to lie to women.
~z~Can I ask you a question?
~z~Are you an honest person?
~z~Ummm, not really.
~z~This. Us. You and me.
~z~Sure, Kiki, sure.
~z~Let me ask you a question, Niko.
~z~Is this another one of your clients?
~z~This ex of mine, he...
~z~Yes, but are you a cheater?
~z~There's always a way to make it work. Always.
~z~Do you think about politics much, Niko?
~z~I think we could have something really special.
~z~Good. I am glad I make you happy.
~z~I hope you work out. I'm pretty heavy.
~z~Sometimes I think you should be committed.
zh: ~z~有时我觉得你应该坚定一些。

english: ~z~I don't know about that... I err...
~z~I'll bear that in mind next time I marry you.
zh: ~z~娶你的时候我会记住这条的。

english: ~z~But you have a value system, don't you?
zh: ~z~但你有自己的价值观，不是吗？

english: ~z~it's just disgusting. Marriage is sacred.
zh: ~z~这种人很恶心。婚姻是神圣的。

english: ~z~But I thought you had a nice time?
zh: ~z~原来你不享受之前那些时光吗？

english: ~z~People get married and it doesn't always work out.
zh: ~z~就算是夫妻，也未必幸福美满。

english: ~z~Things cooled off alright, I sued him for slander.
zh: ~z~关系确实断了，我控告了他诽谤。

english: ~z~For someone to want to know where their boyfriend is.
zh: ~z~我只是想知道男友当时在哪儿而已。

english: ~z~You don't make me happy. You're breaking my heart.
zh: ~z~你没有让我开心。你伤透了我的心。

english: ~z~I love our time together, I really do.
zh: ~z~我很享受我们在一起的时光，真的。

english: ~z~You're not in court now, Kiki. Give me a break.
zh: ~z~现在又不是庭审，琪琪。饶了我吧。

english: ~z~Or if not, at least know where they are all the time?
zh: ~z~就算不能在一起，也要知道他的行踪？

english: ~z~Where's this relationship going? I mean, seriously?
zh: ~z~我们间的关系会怎样？请你认真回答。

english: ~z~Perseverance is the key. The key to everything.
zh: ~z~毅力才是关键，是做任何事情的关键。

english: ~z~If we don't hold onto that, then we won't have anything.
zh: ~z~如果不能坚持这些，我们将一无所有。

english: ~z~So he deserves to suffer. All cheaters do.
zh: ~z~所以说他应受惩罚，所有的骗子都是。

english: ~z~and when times are tough, I carry you on my shoulders.
zh: ~z~每当你不如意时，我都会背上你前行。

english: ~z~No, not really. I just lead an unconventional life.
zh: ~z~不，不是的。只是我的生活没那么古板。

english: ~z~Nothing, Kiki. Nothing. I admire your passion.
zh: ~z~没什么，琪琪。没什么。我欣赏你的激情。

english: ~z~It's like I'm complete. It's like the world makes sense.
zh: ~z~我感觉我变得完整了，与世界融为一体了。

english: ~z~So, I guess things cooled off between you when he made that accusation.
zh: ~z~我想在他控告你之后，你们的关系就断了吧？

english: ~z~I mean I was just checking up on him. That's okay isn't it?
zh: ~z~我是说，我只是在调查他。这没什么关系吧？

english: ~z~I don't know. I mean, it seems a bit soon to be worrying about that.
zh: ~z~不知道。我是说，现在担心这个似乎有些早。

english: ~z~That made him think twice about taking advantage of his students and jumping to ridiculous conclusions.
zh: ~z~好让他不敢轻易占学生便宜，草率闹出笑话。

english: ~z~People who jeopardize family with adultery and internet porn and homosexuality and...
zh: ~z~用通奸、网络色情和同性恋危害家庭的人...

english: ~z~Not really. In my line of work, honesty is not always the best quality.
zh: ~z~不太诚实。干我这行，诚实不算是最重要的品质。

english: ~z~We have a special understanding, haven't we? This is so real.
zh: ~z~我们之间有特别的理解，不是吗？这感觉很真实。

english: ~z~You know, the French have it right. Crimes of passions are not real crimes.
zh: ~z~知道吗，法国人说得对，激情犯罪不是真正的犯罪。

english: ~z~I don't know. We have a nice time, usually. When you're not feeling too guilty.
zh: ~z~我不知道。只要你没感到内疚，一般大家都能高兴。

english: ~z~Yeah, but if you had to choose - liberal or conservative?
zh: ~z~确实，硬要选的话，你会选自由主义还是保守主义？

english: ~z~I mean, I'm not looking for a commitment. But where is it going?
zh: ~z~那个，我也不是想直接订婚，但这段感情到底怎么办？

english: ~z~This nation was built upon a belief in the family unit and the strength of the nuclear family.
zh: ~z~这个国家的基石是对家庭成员的信任和原生家庭的力量。

english: ~z~But it's not perfect, you know. I'm conservative when it comes to family.
zh: ~z~但自由主义也不完美，懂吧。我在家庭观念上比较保守。

english: ~z~Nice? I'm talking about love, about passion, about the important stuff, not nice!
zh: ~z~享受？我在说的是爱情，是激情，是人生大事，严肃点！

english: ~z~No, this was my professor at law school. He had the gall to accuse me of stalking him.
zh: ~z~不，这个是我法学院的教授。他竟厚颜无耻地指控我跟踪他。

english: ~z~I don't know. These days, I think I'm just a whore, running around working for the highest bidder.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我觉得自己最近像个妓女，四处奔波，价高者得。

english: ~z~They're out for themselves, no matter what party they are a member of or what they claim to believe in.
zh: ~z~全都是为了自己。无论他们属于哪个党派，无论他们信仰什么。

english: ~z~I guess I'm a liberal. I mean I believe in the welfare state and the green energy movement.
zh: ~z~我想我是个自由主义者。因为我相信福利国家和绿色能源行动。

english: ~z~Sometimes, late at night, I imagine us as two souls meeting on a beach...
zh: ~z~有时，深夜时分，我会把我们想象成两个在沙滩相遇的灵魂...

english: ~z~Are you the casual encounter kind of guy, is that it? The use them and lose them guy? Fuck 'em and sling them?
zh: ~z~你只是想搞一夜情，对不对？对女人用完就扔？提上裤子不认人？

english: ~z~Don't you find that when you're getting close to someone you just want to be with them the whole time?
zh: ~z~你不觉得当你和某人关系越来越好时，就会想一直和他在一起吗？

english: ~z~When you have seen what I have seen, you realize that most leaders are after the same thing.
zh: ~z~如果你经历过我的遭遇，你就会发现大多数领导者都只有一个动机。

english: ~z~I like saying your name, Niko. You're amazing. This is just so so nice, isn't it?
zh: ~z~我喜欢念你的名字，尼克。你很出众。这样实在是太棒了，不是吗？

english: ~z~There's something special going on here. Can't you feel it? When you're inside me, Niko.
zh: ~z~我的身上有种奇妙的变化，你没感觉到吗？你我结合的时候，尼克，

english: ~z~By not making a proper commitment to me, by not telling me you love me. By not being there for me.
zh: ~z~因为你没有向我好好承诺，没有告诉我你爱我，没有在我身边陪伴我。

english: ~z~Well, you better not cheat, because if a man cheats on a woman, he is cheating on life.
zh: ~z~好吧，你最好不要骗人，因为欺骗女人感情的男人，平时一定在自欺欺人。

english: ~z~They are an essential part of the human psyche. And I say that as a committed liberal.

english: ~z~Shit, I don't wanna spend another minute in this crap-hole, let's get outta here.
zh: ~z~操，我不想在这个粪坑里多待一秒了，我们赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~That might be okay where you're from, Niko. But this is an enlightened society we live in.
zh: ~z~在你老家可能可以，尼克。但我们这儿可是开明社会。

english: ~z~This is not the first time he has assumed that I will be killed by some of his employees.
zh: ~z~这已经不是他第一次以为我能被他的几个手下解决了。

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. The exchange is over on Charge Island at the water treatment plant.
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。人质交易将在查奇岛的污水处理厂进行。

english: ~z~Well, Niko. That was a whole lot of effort for no fucking reward.
zh: ~z~好吧，尼克。又是屁回报都没有，工夫倒是费了不少。

english: ~z~That's a real shame, I can see you fitting right in down in Hove Beach, Niko.
zh: ~z~那还真可惜，依我看你能在霍夫海滩过得很好的，尼克。

english: ~z~-I'm here for you, sweetie.~n~-Hand over the fucking stuff!
zh: ~z~－我是来救你的，宝贝。~n~－快他妈把东西交出来。

english: ~z~Niko Bellic, how is it that whenever something is stolen from me you are not far away?
zh: ~z~尼克･贝利克，怎么每次我东西被偷都能在附近找到你？

english: ~z~Gracie, watch your mouth. Niko is good friend of mine. Don't say that about him.
zh: ~z~格雷西，嘴巴干净点。尼克是我的好朋友。别那么说他。

english: ~z~I don't care what you did to that man, but we ain't leaving here without them diamonds.
zh: ~z~你跟他的纠纷我不感兴趣，但是没拿到钻石我们就不走了。

english: ~z~Bulgarin lost a lot of money that night and he needed someone to blame.
zh: ~z~那天晚上布尔加林损失了一大笔钱，他需要找一个人背锅。

english: ~z~Bulgarin, he the motherfucker who busted up our peaceful hostage exchange?
zh: ~z~布尔加林，就那个破坏了我们和平人质交易的狗逼玩意儿？

english: ~z~We was outnumbered, Niko. I can see how he thought it was covered.
zh: ~z~我们被人数压制了，尼克。我能想到他觉得自己优势很大。

english: ~z~Jesus Christ, why did that moron have to throw the ice away? It was just plain selfish.
zh: ~z~我的天哪，为什么那个蠢货要扔掉钻石？完全就是自私嘛。

english: ~z~Me and some biker had to try to sell them to a diamond dealer and it turns into a blood bath.
zh: ~z~我和一个飞车党想把它卖给一个钻石商，结果又成了一场血战。

english: ~z~He coulda walked away from there. Instead, he's fucked and the diamonds are who knows where.
zh: ~z~大可放他走人。结果呢，他被搞了，也没人能知道钻石的下落。

english: ~z~Packie, this is great. You've finally found a woman who will sit down and listen to your shit.
zh: ~z~派奇，这下可好。你终于找到了一个会坐下来听你逼逼的女人了。

english: ~z~That's the plan. Hopefully someone might bring a big present for us to this shindig as well.
zh: ~z~计划就是这样。很可能还会有人在这场饯行会上送我们一份大礼。

english: ~z~Probably a good thing you got out though. Wouldn't a met me if you'd stayed, would ya?
zh: ~z~不过你出来了也算是件好事。你呆在那儿就遇不到我了，不是吗？

english: ~z~A guy like Gerry can still do stuff in the joint. He organized this kidnapping shit, didn't he?
zh: ~z~格里这样的人就算在牢里也能做事，这次的绑架不就是他策划的吗？

english: ~z~Screw that. I got close to knocking her teeth out. That was about it. We ain't got shit now.
zh: ~z~放屁，我差点没把她的牙给打下来。就是这样，我们现在屁都没了。

english: ~z~I'm screwed either way. If I don't give you the diamonds, you kill me here and you take 'em.
zh: ~z~反正我怎么着都是死。不给你们钻石，你们就会当场杀了我拿走它。

english: ~z~Shit, these diamonds have been trouble since Ray first made me take them out of a trash can for him.
zh: ~z~操，从雷让我把钻石从垃圾堆捞出来的时候开始，它就带来了麻烦。

english: ~z~See, she was just telling me how much she loved me. What do ya think of Niko, Gracie?
zh: ~z~你看看，她又在跟我说她爱我有多深了。你觉得尼克怎么样，格雷西？

english: ~z~There's nothing right about this situation, but that would be an accurate description of what went down.
zh: ~z~对情况的描述没有一个对的，但是对于发生了什么描述的还是很到位。

english: ~z~I worked for him on the Adriatic, he thought I stole from him and he came after me.
zh: ~z~还在亚得里亚海的时候我就替他卖命，他觉得我偷了他东西就来追杀我。

english: ~z~Maybe they belong to this homosexual man, Gracie's friend. I don't know. Maybe to Bulgarin.
zh: ~z~可能属于这个男同性恋，格雷西的朋友。我不清楚。也可能是布尔加林。

english: ~z~I'm screwed either way. If I don't give you the diamonds, you kill me here and you take 'em.
zh: ~z~反正我怎么着都是死。要是不给你们钻石，你们在这儿就会杀了我拿走它。

english: ~z~I know I'm too good for him, but sometimes a guy has got to hang out with lowlifes like Niko here.
zh: ~z~我知道我比尼克强太多了，不过有时候就是得跟他这样的底层人一起出去。

english: ~z~It's gonna be a nice thing to mull over. You know, while he's staring at them metal bars for the next decade or so.
zh: ~z~反倒是很适合拿去苦思冥想。你也知道，在他盯铁窗盯个十年之类的时候。

english: ~z~Some time ago, I worked for Mr. Bulgarin in Europe, smuggling people across the Adriatic.
zh: ~z~之前有段时间，我替布尔加林先生在欧洲干活，通过亚得里亚海贩卖人口。

english: ~z~My cousin and I moved up to Bohan to get away from him and another man called Dimitri Rascalov.
zh: ~z~我的堂兄和我搬到了波汉，好避开他和另一个叫迪米特里･拉斯卡洛夫的人。

english: ~z~Kidnapping the bitch, holding onto her, fighting through them damn Russians... all of that for jack shit.
zh: ~z~绑架那个贱人，牢牢看住她，和这群狗日的俄国佬干架...全他妈成了狗屁。

english: ~z~Fuck, he weren't too chipper the last time I spoke to him and he's gonna be a long way from chipper when I tell him what went down.
zh: ~z~操，上次我跟他交谈的时候他就没什么生气，这次的事讲完他还不得直接断气。

english: ~z~Maybe we was going to have to give up them diamonds to fucking Ray Boccino but we woulda got a payday.
zh: ~z~可能我们是该把钻石都上交给雷･博奇诺那个狗逼，那样我们至少还能拿到点钱。

english: ~z~Then some Russian turns up saying they're his. Then everything goes to shit. That's about right, isn't it?
zh: ~z~然后就有个俄国佬跳出来说钻石是他的。之后情况就完全不对了。是这样子没错吧？
