zh: ~z~帕瓦诺家族在西河这边做一些小贷生意。

english: ~z~Well at least they had the respect to do it at a meet.
zh: ~z~他们在会面的时候来明的也算给面子了。

english: ~z~and run all of Liberty City, the whole country maybe!
zh: ~z~然后接管整个自由城，甚至是整个国家！

english: ~z~Earned a lot of good money for a lot of bad people. And this happens,
zh: ~z~给这帮坏蛋赚了不少钱。结果成这样了，

english: ~z~You ain't the type of guy to follow orders if they weren't in your interest.
zh: ~z~你这种人不会服从不符合你利益的命令。

english: ~z~I'm gonna get that seat because of what I done.
zh: ~z~经营了这么多年，我肯定会有一席之地的。

english: ~z~I mean I'm going to ask you to deal with a problem,
zh: ~z~我的意思是，我要让你帮我解决一个麻烦。

english: ~z~I'd cut his cock off and shove it down his throat.
zh: ~z~我会把他的鸡巴切下来，塞到他的喉咙里！

english: ~z~They didn't even send a fucking Capo.
zh: ~z~他们只派了几个小喽啰，连个组长都不派！

english: ~z~I know it's them. God, give me strength...
zh: ~z~我知道是他们。老天啊，真是受不了...

english: ~z~You gonna get a seat on that commission real soon, ain't ya boss?
zh: ~z~你很快就能位列委员会成员了，对吧老大？

english: ~z~Only, how much can I do with a guy who ain't a full Italian?
zh: ~z~但我能为一个不是纯种的意大利人做多少？

english: ~z~Ain't nobody been given a seat since the Commission got founded.
zh: ~z~委员会成立以后，就再没产生过新的席位。

english: ~z~God give me strength. It's like I'm dealing with children here.
zh: ~z~我真他妈的操了。合着我在这儿带孩子呢。

zh: ~z~或许委员会的其他家族会立刻把席位给我！

english: ~z~Can't wait to see the look on their faces.
zh: ~z~我已经迫不及待地想看他们脸上的表情了。

english: ~z~Ray was helping me out with something, so I helped him with the diamonds.
zh: ~z~雷帮我干了一件事，所以我就帮他弄钻石。

english: ~z~Sometimes I feel like I'm having a heart attack with that girl.
zh: ~z~有时候我都觉得自己会在她面前心脏病发作。

zh: ~z~是他们。他们已经到了。看来雷好像也来了。

english: ~z~No matter how long you're around you ain't gonna speak perfect are you?
zh: ~z~不管人活多少年，都不可能不说错话，对吧？

english: ~z~Keep an eye on things, 'cause they won't be looking out for you.
zh: ~z~仔细盯着情况，他们不会注意到你的存在的。

zh: ~z~我再去街上找些有志向的黑手党给我干活吧。

zh: ~z~哪儿都能见到他，跟踩不死的蟑螂一样，哈？

english: ~z~We got a lot riding on this meet with the Pavanos
zh: ~z~这次我们还要大老远地去跟帕瓦诺家族见面。

zh: ~z~他们最好别给我趾高气昂地跑到西河这边来。

zh: ~z~不，不会有的。他们很高兴能和老大坐一辆车。

english: ~z~Now the thing is, these guys ain't, shall we say...
zh: ~z~但现在的问题是，这些家伙没有...应该说，

zh: ~z~至少没趁你跟你老婆睡觉的时候跑你家来暗杀。

english: ~z~The Pavanos, are they gonna offer you a seat then?
zh: ~z~那些帕瓦诺家族的，他们是要给你一个席位吗？

english: ~z~Ask me why it matters. Women just don't understand this life of ours.
zh: ~z~一直说有必要吗。女人是真不明白我们这种生活。

english: ~z~or you're not going to deal with it, and you're going to be a problem that somebody else has to deal with.
zh: ~z~要是你办不成，你就会成为需要别人解决的麻烦。

english: ~z~Yeah, I'm in a life threatening situation and I'm having a conversation here.
zh: ~z~是啊，我现在性命受到威胁，还在这里跟人聊天。

english: ~z~When I say I wish she'd run off with another guy it's a figure of speech.
zh: ~z~我刚刚说的希望她跟别的男人跑路是夸张的说辞。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna do shit for him no more. I don't like the way he does business.
zh: ~z~我再也不会替他办事了。我不喜欢他的办事风格。

english: ~z~Yeah, even if you can't speak right, at least you can shoot straight.
zh: ~z~是啊，就算你这人不会说话，枪法也还是可以的。

english: ~z~We just hoping they got the manners to smile to our faces before they do it.
zh: ~z~我们指望他们能在下手前对我们先笑一阵子就行。

english: ~z~You see the respect we're getting out on the street. Jesus.
zh: ~z~你也看见外面的人对我们有多「尊重」了。老天。

english: ~z~I don't mind 'em taking a bite, I don't even make 'em give me a taste.
zh: ~z~我不介意他们来插一脚，我都没让他们给我分成。

english: ~z~Niko, this is Pete and Marco. Guys, Niko.
zh: ~z~尼克，这两位是皮特和马可。伙计们，这是尼克。

english: ~z~You giving them a nice little offering though, skip.
zh: ~z~你不是给他们准备了一份挺好的小礼物吗，老大。

english: ~z~Only way you know is by finding their shit all over the place in the morning.
zh: ~z~只有起床后看见满地老鼠屎，才会知道有老鼠在。

english: ~z~It means something in Alderney even if it don't in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~就算在阿尔冈琴不太管用，但在奥尔德尼总有份量。

english: ~z~We gonna get that gift back and make this crew pay for their disrespect. Come on.
zh: ~z~赶紧夺回礼物，让他们为不尊重我付出代价。干他。

english: ~z~Don't tell me what's due to me. I been waiting for this and working hard for this for years.
zh: ~z~不用你告诉我该干什么。为此我辛苦努力了好多年。

english: ~z~Yeah, uh boss, I got you this, because I care.
zh: ~z~好，呃，老大，我给您带来了这个，因为我在乎您。

english: ~z~Exactly... I mean, we can pretty much guarantee you were followed.
zh: ~z~没错...我是说，我可以确认你百分百被跟踪了。

english: ~z~Guy who owned the diamonds, Gay Tony, is in with the Ancelottis.
zh: ~z~钻石的主人，基佬托尼，他站在安切洛蒂家族那边。

english: ~z~Or because they got too much power and they're too smart to get themselves clipped.
zh: ~z~要么因为他大权在握，头脑聪明到没那么容易被杀。

english: ~z~I didn't get where I am by believing what every schmuck told me.
zh: ~z~要是什么人说的话我都信，我就不会有今天的地位。

english: ~z~Anyways, that's why Ray ain't ever gonna make it to the level he wants to reach.
zh: ~z~总之，这就是雷永远都得不到他想要的地位的原因。

english: ~z~I'm surprised you can even speak when your lips are always puckered up, kissing my ass.
zh: ~z~都舔到我屁股上了，你还能说出话来倒让我很惊讶。

english: ~z~No wonder I ain't on the Commission when my muscle is this stupid!
zh: ~z~怪不得委员会不给我席位，谁让我的手下都这么弱智！

english: ~z~What I'm worried about is our involvement with getting back to Gay Tony and his connections...
zh: ~z~我只担心我们做的事被基佬托尼和他的盟友知道...

english: ~z~You're insurance. I'm the captain of this ship because I look at every possibility.
zh: ~z~保险措施而已。我是这艘船的船长，需要考虑所有情况。

english: ~z~Marco and Pete? Oh yeah, those guys didn't make it, did they? Well, too fucking bad.
zh: ~z~马可和皮特？哦对，他俩没活下来是吧？确实太可怜了。

english: ~z~Me and two of my guys gonna meet with a couple of boys from the Pavano family.
zh: ~z~我和两个手下，待会儿要去见帕瓦诺家族的几个小伙子。

english: ~z~Can you do me a favor? Can you just shoot yourself to save me the trouble of doing it?
zh: ~z~你能帮我个忙吗？你他妈给自己来一枪省得我动手好吗？

english: ~z~I think about what's gonna happen if this guy screws me, if this one turns state's, and so on.
zh: ~z~我也考虑过有人反咬我一口，或者突然背叛。都考虑过。

english: ~z~They knew what they was signed on for. Weren't complaining on the way out, were they?
zh: ~z~他们知道当我手下的下场如何。在路上也没有怨言，对吧？

english: ~z~I guess not. Lucky I have people like you to teach me when I'm wrong.
zh: ~z~我觉得不会。幸好有你这样的人能在我犯错的时候提醒我。

english: ~z~Has to be. I only start paying attention to my crew when they start putting me in an awkward position.
zh: ~z~必须这样。只有哪个手下让我处境尴尬了，我才会关注他。

english: ~z~Hopefully they gonna respect that when it comes time to ask them for a favor.
zh: ~z~希望能让他们多尊重我些，要他们帮忙的时候能给点面子。

english: ~z~I got a nice little offering to the Pavanos that's gonna persuade 'em to argue my case.
zh: ~z~我为帕瓦诺家族准备了一份小礼物，应该能说服他们帮我。

english: ~z~Gets us into debt and in some heavy shit with people, but... he's family.
zh: ~z~让我们负债累累，惹上一堆硬骨头，但...他是我的家人。

english: ~z~It ain't like she's my only woman. I got a nice little goomah set up in an apartment in Acter.
zh: ~z~她又不是我唯一的女人。我在阿克特的公寓那边还有个娘们。

english: ~z~That's just if the shit goes down, right boss? The Pavanos wouldn't fuck with you.
zh: ~z~只是防一手意外情况，对吧老大？帕瓦诺家族不会暗算你的。

english: ~z~With guys like you, no wonder this 'organization' is doing so wonderfully.
zh: ~z~有你这样的「得力干将」，难怪这个「组织」运作得这么好。

english: ~z~This is a declaration of war. The Pegorinos and the Pavanos are hitting the mattresses.
zh: ~z~这就是开战宣言！佩戈里诺家族和帕瓦诺家族现在正式开战了！

english: ~z~Well, he's being paid to look out for me so saving you guys' asses would be overtime.
zh: ~z~其实，给他的钱只是负责我安全用的，保护你们的话算是加班。

english: ~z~Alright, let's get these slimeball bastards. People like that give Italians a bad name.
zh: ~z~好了，让我们追上这群混蛋。就是这种人毁了意大利人的名声。

english: ~z~My wife, Angie's, gonna love this. She keeps busting my balls about trying to get on the Commission.
zh: ~z~我夫人安吉肯定很高兴。她一直对我加入委员会的想法冷嘲热讽。

english: ~z~It don't do too well for the reputation of us Pegorinos having St Patrick that high up in our organization.
zh: ~z~组织高位有个绿帽子小精灵对我们佩戈里诺家族的声誉可不太好。

english: ~z~Shit, sometimes I wish she'd just run off with some other guy. Leave me in peace.
zh: ~z~操，有时候我都希望回到家发现她跟别的男人跑了。让我得以安宁。

english: ~z~My old man, God rest his soul, didn't have the balls to bring the family to the level I got it to.
zh: ~z~我老爹，愿他安息，胆子没我大，没能让家族达到现在的实力水平。

english: ~z~You guys all friends now? Nice. You best hope you made a good first impression on Niko, boys.
zh: ~z~你们现在都是朋友了吧？好。最好给尼克留下个好点的印象，小的们。

english: ~z~If the Pavanos is a Liberty City family, what are they doing coming out to Alderney for this meet?
zh: ~z~如果帕瓦诺家族是自由城的家族，他们为什么要来奥尔德尼跟你见面呢？

english: ~z~Ray was nothing to me until he started earning big and sticking his nose in places it didn't belong.
zh: ~z~在雷赚到大钱，把触角伸到不属于我们的地盘之前，他对我什么都不是。

english: ~z~So you here to work for him, shoot him, or arrest him? Or maybe all three?
zh: ~z~所以，你是来给他干活的，来把他做掉的，还是来逮捕他的？或者三种都是？

english: ~z~Yeah, but a wife is a wife. I guess it's like with my cousin. He puts me in so much shit.
zh: ~z~确实，但你老婆就是你老婆。我觉得就像我堂兄一样，他给我带来太多麻烦了。

english: ~z~I can't believe them Pavanos would treat me like this. The Pegorino name should mean something to them.
zh: ~z~帕瓦诺家族的孙子居然敢这样对我！佩戈里诺这个名字对他们应该是有份量的！

english: ~z~Yeah, well best ain't good enough. I did my best. Made a name for the Pegorinos.
zh: ~z~是啊，但光尽力还是不够。我已经为家族呕心沥血了，替佩戈里诺家族打出了名声。

english: ~z~Ah these kids come and go. It ain't worth paying attention to them until they prove they can survive.
zh: ~z~啊，这些小伙子来来走走的。如果他们不能证明自己的生存能力，就不值得我去关注。

zh: ~z~是，在你和他们见面的时候我注意到了。

zh: ~z~警察吧...他们这个点经常开车路过。

zh: ~z~所以，听好了。我们和帕瓦诺家族有点麻烦。

english: ~z~When you marry a dragon, you gotta expect a few knights are gonna turn up to try to slay him.
zh: ~z~你要是嫁给了恶龙，就会担心有勇士出来屠龙。

zh: ~z~他们纯粹当我们家族是臭要饭的！一直都是这样。

zh: ~z~安东尼！你他妈能闭嘴吗？直白点，你能滚了吗？

english: ~z~Tell me this job ain't as crazy as when you and me hit that bank together.
zh: ~z~告诉我，这活不会跟之前我们抢银行那件那么疯狂。

zh: ~z~你说迈克尔死的时候？我当时可没有那么「开心」。

zh: ~z~他们就没把我们当真正的家族，只把我们看作根西的小老弟。

english: ~z~You disrupt it, and I'll let you keep the money, but make sure you hit the Pavanos real hard! Capiche?
zh: ~z~你去干烂他们，钱你可以留着。但得给我重创帕瓦诺家族！懂？

english: ~z~Word is they're at the Diner in Acter. Find 'em, and follow them to the meet.
zh: ~z~他们现在在阿克特的餐厅里。找到他们，尾随他们到碰头地点。

english: ~z~Shit, Packie. I'm kind of busy chasing down some wiseguys for those guido buddies of yours.
zh: ~z~操，派奇。我现在很忙。我在为你老大开车追一些黑手党成员。

zh: ~z~听好了，他们家族的人今天在城里，准备去收奥尔德尼一家赌庄的分成。

zh: ~z~尼克我知道你现在很忙而且不愿意和我出去玩，但我现在真的太他妈无聊了。

zh: ~z~你高兴就好。看上哪个上流人士就杀了吧，他死了家里人多半会很想他的...

zh: ~z~我需要一点和病人独处的时间。

english: ~z~Can I have some time alone with my patient?
zh: ~z~我能和我的病人独处一段时间吗？

english: ~z~It's only hospital staff beyond this point sir.
zh: ~z~先生，这边只允许医院职工进入。

english: ~z~I think maybe I've talked him out of it...
zh: ~z~当时我以为他要被我说服了...

english: ~z~after he's gone state's of course...
~z~Go to sleep, Anthony. You look tired.
zh: ~z~睡吧，安东尼。你看起来有点累了。

english: ~z~then he has a Goddamn heart attack on the phone.
zh: ~z~然后，他就在电话那头心脏病发了。

english: ~z~I'm thinking problem solved - he's dying right in front of my ears.
zh: ~z~我觉得问题解决了，我听着他死的。

english: ~z~I'll go, but I ain't going quietly!
zh: ~z~我会溜走的，但不会偷偷摸摸地走！

english: ~z~Stay away from the burns ward. It's not a pretty sight.
zh: ~z~别进烧伤病房。那里光景可不太好。

english: ~z~Wait, isn't the boss in jail? What're you here for?
zh: ~z~等等，老大在监狱里吧？那你来干嘛？

english: ~z~I don't think you will be seeing Anthony on the witness stand.
zh: ~z~我想你不会在证言台上见到安东尼了。

english: ~z~When my son killed himself, Anthony became my son.
zh: ~z~我儿子自杀后，安东尼就成了我儿子。

english: ~z~He may be a scumbag, but we need him for trial.
zh: ~z~尽管他是人渣，但审判不能没他作证。

english: ~z~Boss... Peg, is that you? I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
zh: ~z~老大...是你吗？对不起，真的对不起

english: ~z~I heard he's wearing a wire, so I freak out...
zh: ~z~听说他带着窃听器的时候，我气炸了...

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. You here to see the boss? He's just this way.
zh: ~z~哦，尼克，你是来找老大的吗？他在这边。

english: ~z~Not you as well. Tell me it ain't you as well, you Slavic fuck!
zh: ~z~你也是吗？该不会你也是吧，斯拉夫傻逼！

english: ~z~he's such a moron, he leaves his cell phone on, so we speak.
zh: ~z~他是真的白痴，手机都不关，我们就聊了聊。

english: ~z~You think that coat's gonna fool me? You ain't a doctor.
zh: ~z~别以为穿个马甲我就不认识你了，你不是医生。

english: ~z~And after that I want you to kill all the other rats I surround myself with...
zh: ~z~再然后，我还要你把我身边的叛徒都给杀了...

english: ~z~He freaks out on the phone, and I put the fear of God in him.
zh: ~z~他在电话那头吓得要死，我就在这头一直威胁他。

english: ~z~Oh shit, I didn't have a choice. They was gonna put me away for some hard time.
zh: ~z~哦天哪，我真的没得选。不然我就要被关进去了。

english: ~z~I better not be seeing you up there neither. Or anybody else I know for that matter.
zh: ~z~也别让我在那儿看见你，或者哪个我认识的熟人。

english: ~z~Hey, watch out for those cops. They're down the hall acting like they own the place.
zh: ~z~嘿，小心点那些条子。他们把走廊那头当自己的地盘。

english: ~z~Hey, I saw you a second ago. If you're a doctor I'm the Pope.
zh: ~z~喂，之前我刚见过你。你要是是医生，那老子就是天皇。

english: ~z~But the asshole lived and now he's in the Leftwood hospital under heavy guard.
zh: ~z~结果这混蛋没死，现在在左伍德的医院里被人严密保护。

english: ~z~Argh... my arm... Peg... Peg...
zh: ~z~啊...我的胳膊...佩戈里诺...佩戈里诺...

english: ~z~Fucking feds. Turning everybody into rats. See ya round, Niko.
zh: ~z~该死的FIB。把所有人都变成了叛徒。一会儿见尼克。

english: ~z~Oh, it looks like I messed something up. Sorry about that, Anthony.
zh: ~z~哦，我好像动了什么不该动的东西。不好意思了，安东尼。

english: ~z~Speak, you Balkan piece of shit - I'm done with you, done with everyone.
zh: ~z~说话啊，你这巴尔干烂人，我跟你结束了，我跟所有人都结束了！

english: ~z~Mr. Pegorino, I don't know what you're talking about. I came as quickly as I could.
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺先生，我不知道你在说什么，我已经尽可能快地赶过来了。

english: ~z~Do I know you? I've seen so many green doctors, patients and cadavers, I don't recognize anyone anymore.
zh: ~z~我认识你吗？我见过了太多一身绿的医生、病人和尸体，现在认不出人了。

english: ~z~Cops act all nice when they get shot but it's Mr. Toughguy now that they're down the hall with a witness.
zh: ~z~挨了枪子儿的条子那叫一个温顺，这会儿跟证人在一起，就成硬汉先生了。

english: ~z~Okay.
~z~Ya know?
~z~I agree.
~z~Finally!
~z~I will.
~z~Excuse me...
~z~Trust me on that.
~z~You better leave.
~z~Phil yesterday.
~z~Sure, boss.
~z~I'll talk to you soon.
~z~but he's a good earner.
~z~I gotta think about it.
~z~It's a fucking hit.
~z~Then there's Ray...
~z~Police are all over us.
~z~I see his car.
~z~Let's earn our fee, boys.
~z~We got real problems.
~z~Maybe he's too straight.
~z~Yeah, yeah. Okay tough guy.
~z~The guy's after Boccino.
~z~Somebody got to my people!
~z~Eh, I need to speak to Niko.
~z~So, what are you going to do about it?
~z~It might create a good opportunity for you.
~z~Gentlemen. What's going on?
~z~Him and Phil hate each other...
~z~Mr. Boccino ain't seeing nobody.
~z~He's at a sit down on Cod Row in East Holland.
~z~Boss - I gotta tell you this... he's not straight.
~z~Relax... I didn't mean nothing by it.
~z~The meeting went to plan, Mr. Pegorino.
zh: ~z~会面成功进行，佩戈里诺先生。

english: ~z~I don't know, I don't trust him...
~z~But uh... think about what I said.
~z~Nothing... discussing pest control.
~z~Somebody's talking - wants us out of the picture...
~z~where your crap ain't gonna do me no favors.
zh: ~z~在那里你那些废话也不会管用了。

english: ~z~Maybe you heard. I got served papers today.
zh: ~z~你可能听说了。我今天收到传票了。

english: ~z~Be careful - I'll see you later. Boss, gentlemen.
zh: ~z~你小心点。待会见，老大，先生们。

english: ~z~Right before he came in here I saw him talking to Angie again.
zh: ~z~进来之前我又看见他在跟安吉说话。

english: ~z~If you know what's good for you, you will get out of here.
zh: ~z~你要是识相的话，就会离开这儿了。

english: ~z~There he is. Welcome to the war council, my boy.
zh: ~z~他来了。欢迎参加战前会议，尼克。

english: ~z~I know he's got his eye on the big prize... but he's no dummy.
zh: ~z~我知道他觊觎权位...但他也不傻。

english: ~z~Ray told us specifically he don't wanna see your ugly mug.
zh: ~z~雷特别叮嘱我们说不想看见你的丑脸。

english: ~z~I don't want to hurt you, so go. Get lost. Okay?
zh: ~z~我不想伤害你，你走吧。走远点，好吗？

english: ~z~Go for a walk. If anyone asks, you didn't see my face.
zh: ~z~散步去吧。有人问起来，你可没见过我。

english: ~z~Then again, I'll get his chump muscle to stop for gas on the way.
zh: ~z~不过，我会让他的白痴保镖中途去加油的。

english: ~z~I mean I don't agree with what he says - I agree that you know best...
zh: ~z~我不是同意他的建议，我同意你自有考量...

english: ~z~The only people gonna get close to Ray today are his missus and his goomah. Stay away.
zh: ~z~今天只有雷的媳妇和娘们能接近他。离开这儿。

english: ~z~I know him and Angie are friends, but that don't worry me too much.
zh: ~z~我知道他和安吉是朋友...但他俩我不担心。

english: ~z~If that's your decision, Mr. Pegorino, it's done.
zh: ~z~既然这是你的决定，佩戈里诺先生，我就照办。

english: ~z~Mr. Pegorino, my meeting with Ray didn't go as planned.
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺先生，我和雷的碰面未能照计划进行。

english: ~z~I've known Phil a long time - he's straight, more or less...
zh: ~z~我认识菲尔也很久了。他很直率，挺直率的...

english: ~z~Look either we make the right call or we all end up in prison anyway,
zh: ~z~要么做出正确的决定，要么大家一起死在监狱里。

english: ~z~maybe Jon Gravelli... or them Ancelottis.
zh: ~z~也许是乔恩･格拉韦利...或者是安切洛蒂家族。

english: ~z~Well, I've given you my advice, Peg, you do what you think is best.
zh: ~z~该说的我都说了，佩戈里诺，余下就是你的考量了。

english: ~z~We got a couple of boys in jail... I think they might squeal!
zh: ~z~我有很多手下被抓进去了...我觉得他们会告密！

english: ~z~Ray got wise to me, Mr. Pegorino. I think I spooked him.
zh: ~z~雷把我甩掉了，佩戈里诺先生。我想我把他吓到了。

english: ~z~He should be heading over to a chop shop in BOABO. Don't get too comfortable with him, Niko.
zh: ~z~他应该是要去博阿博的改车店。不要掉以轻心，尼克。

english: ~z~He bought some protection and he ain't gonna hang around and wait for "you know what" to happen.
zh: ~z~他雇了几个保镖，不会招摇过市等着「你懂的」发生。

english: ~z~I don't know... I gotta shut someone up, and show people I mean business.
zh: ~z~不知道...我要杀鸡儆猴，告诉他们我要动真格了！

english: ~z~Cleaning house is a tough job, Bellic. I don't got much left in mine, it's so clean.
zh: ~z~打扫屋子可不容易啊，贝利克。我家快打扫完了，很干净。

english: ~z~Fuck, do I gotta do everything myself? He's gonna be onto us now. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~操，一定要我事必躬亲吗？他马上就要反水了。之后再联系。

english: ~z~I'll give you a call... whoever I say to go see, go see 'em. And shut 'em up!
zh: ~z~待会儿我给你打电话...我说去找谁就找谁，让他永远闭嘴！

english: ~z~Shit, I told you he had his eyes open. He'll be on the lamb now. Dammit.
zh: ~z~该死，我告诉过你他一直保持警惕着，他马上就要告发我了，操。

english: ~z~I pay you to be a nuclear holocaust, Bellic. Sort your shit out. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~花钱就是让你去核爆他的，贝利克。自己看着办吧。之后再联系你。

english: ~z~Niko, I've been thinking about it and I want you to pay our friend Ray a visit. Give him a message from me.
zh: ~z~尼克，我考虑良久，决定让你去找我们的雷一趟。向他传达我的态度。

english: ~z~Like every rat, he's a survivor, he's got good instincts. He has a bad feeling about you in particular.
zh: ~z~他有叛徒的共性，擅长死里求生，直觉也很好。他对你也有不好的感觉。

english: ~z~Sorry, Mr. Pegorino. He's a cockroach, Ray would survive anything. Even a nuclear holocaust.
zh: ~z~不好意思佩戈里诺先生。雷就是个打不死的小强。估计就算核弹爆炸他也能活下来。

english: ~z~-The problem with this guy is, I can't even think straight, he's always talkin'. ~n~-Slow down Phil you take everything too personal.
zh: ~z~－这人的问题是，别打断我，他一直说个不停。~n~－嘿，你，慢慢讲，菲尔，别老在意别人。

english: Police Lieutenant Chuck Montresse said, "This is what the terrorists want - they want us to be afraid. So, just to be cautious, we're going to be shit-scared, shut down the bridges and show them that freedom will always win."
zh: 查克･蒙特雷斯警长说：「这正是恐怖分子想要的——让我们恐惧。所以，谨慎起见，我们就该被吓出屎来，只能封锁桥梁，让他们知道自由必胜。」

english: Reacting to angry citizens' groups claiming that police brutality is on the rise, Liberty City's Police Commissioner for Public Affairs, Tom Pireni, told reporters, "Our police are here to make you feel safe. Sometimes you are acting in an unsafe manner or not standing in a designated free speech zone, at which point we have to take action quickly and violently."
zh: 许多愤怒的民间组织宣称暴力执法事件持续增多，作为回应，LCPD公共事务处处长汤姆･皮雷尼告诉记者：「我们警察是来给予你们安全感的。不过偶尔各位的行为不太安全，或者超出了给定的言论自由，我们就只能采取迅速暴力的措施。」

english: Citing increased chatter by known terrorists, officials raised the threat level to Magenta 5 and have closed many bridges in the metropolitan area causing havoc for commuters and forcing many to lose their jobs and contemplate selling their bodies to make up for lost income. Officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said that, while they don't speak Arabic, the chit chat they heard was something like "slalom" which rhymes with "dirty bomb."
zh: 鉴于恐怖分子持续传播恐慌，官员将威胁等级提升至紫红色级(5级)，并封锁了大都会地区的大量桥梁。这是通勤族的灾难，不少人已因此丢了工作，只得考虑卖身填补收入缺口。一位不愿透露姓名的政府官员表示，他们从传言中听到的词是「红砖」，跟「脏弹」押韵。

english: However, police brutality and corruption have dogged his time in office. There are also allegations of statistical tampering. Lawyer Tom Goldberg has pointed out that the high conviction rate comes from the clearing of so called "cold cases" after examination with new forensic evidence, "Mayor Ochoa and the Liberty City PD are using statistics to blind the people as to the true nature of life on the streets of this city. It's dangerous - your children are not safe."
zh: 然而，警方暴力执法和腐败问题仍困扰着他。也有人揭发数据造假。律师汤姆･戈德堡指出，高结案率源于通过新的法医证据解决的「陈年旧案」，「奥乔亚市长和自由城警局正在用统计数据蒙蔽人们的双眼，和他们掩盖本市街头治安真实情况的行为如出一辙。这很危险，你们的孩子没有安全可言。」

english: Last year over 10,000 illegal firearms were recovered by the LCPD. There were over 500 gun-related homicides. Is Ochoa's campaign a case of too little, too late? Will his jaunts to sunnier cities save our children from their almost certain fates? The sale or possession of firearms is illegal here, in Liberty City. Does that mean that weapons are only in the hands of people willing to use them for evil? It remains to be seen.
zh: 去年LCPD收回了超过一万支非法枪械。超过500起涉枪谋杀于去年发生。奥乔亚的行动是否会收效甚微，为时过晚？他到阳光更好的城市进行考察，能否让孩子们摆脱几乎注定的命运？在自由城，贩卖或持有枪支弹药是违法的。这是否意味着，武器只会出现在愿意用其作恶的人手中？让我们拭目以待。

english: After a major scuffle at the Broker Bridge earlier, citizens lined up, showing welts, bruises and bullet wounds from what they say is a macho police force gone seriously overboard. Some passersby had other opinions. "You Americans bring this upon yourself," Natalya Shironova told Weazel Radio, "When we fix elections, all dissenters are rounded up and sent to salt mines. It soon stops anyone from complaining."
zh: 在先前布洛克桥发生的大型冲突发生后，市民们一字排开，展露了身上的红肿、淤青以及枪伤。他们称这些伤痕是由一群彪悍的警察部队过度执法所致。一些路人则抱有截然相反的看法，「都是你们美国人自己作孽，」娜塔莉亚･希托诺娃对Weazel电台说，「我们那儿操纵选举的时候会把反对者集中在一起，送去挖盐。一下子就没人抱怨了。」

english: Idealistic Liberty City Mayor, Julio Ochoa, vowed to rid our city's streets of illegal firearms yesterday, "Our gun laws are in place for a reason. It is my duty as Mayor to enforce those laws - whether that means prosecuting the thugs possessing weapons here in Liberty City, or the salespeople providing those weapons out of state." Mayor Ochoa's task force has launched cases against Ammu-Nation stores as far a field as Los Santos and Vice City. The mayor boasts of low crime rates in the city and a high murder conviction rate.
zh: 理想主义的自由城市长，胡里奥･奥乔亚于昨日发誓，要根除本市街头的非法枪支弹药：「我们的控枪法律是有必要存在的。作为市长，我有义务强化这些法律，无论是要起诉本市持有武器的暴徒，还是起诉来自其他州的武器贩子，我都在所不辞。」奥乔亚市长的专门工作组已对远在洛圣都和罪城的武装国度商店提起诉讼。市长以本市的低犯罪率和高谋杀案结案率为荣。

english: City encouraged to panic
Serial Killer On Loose
Surprising new survey results
Liberty City #1 for Pizza, Terrorism
zh: 自由城的披萨和恐袭世界第一

english: Liberty City gets it's first serial killer in years.
zh: 自由城迎来近年首位连环杀人犯。

english: It's a long time since the city has had a proper serial killer and we think this is going to get worse before it gets better. Detective Squad Chief Jon Atkinson said, "I'm going to be getting my name in the papers a lot if this guy turns out to be a serial killer, so I've got to make sure I don't say or do anything stupid. We strongly recommend people don't go out and, if they do, that they stay where there's lots of people and carry a cell phone or a policeman with them at all times. The most important thing, though, is that people don't panic more than is strictly necessary." We will keep you posted.
zh: 本市已经很久没出过像样的连环杀人犯了，而我们认为事态来不及好转就会急剧恶化。专案组指挥乔恩･阿特金森说：「如果这个人真的是连环杀人犯的话，我肯定会在报纸上声名鹊起，所以我的发言和行动都不能有任何闪失。我们强烈建议市民不要外出，非要外出，那也待在人多的地方，而且还要全程携带手机或警察。但最重要的还是，千万不要无缘无故慌张过度。」我们会为您持续报道。

english: The answer is, duct tape, plastic sheeting and raised city taxes. N.O.O.S.E officers give practical advice on racial profiling and identifying the symptoms of chemical and biological weapons; however, there is no surefire way to guarantee that you will be able to survive an offensive. Possible targets include: the Subway System, the Broker Bridge, Rotterdam Tower, Grand Easton Terminal and many others. A recent N.O.O.S.E press statement warns that, "We really can't be sure where an attack might occur. All we can say is that nowhere is safe." The threat level in Liberty City is Indigo 6.
zh: 答案是：强力胶布，塑料薄膜和增收税款。国安办的官员给出了一些建议，包括依据肤色断案和生化武器的特征。然而，他们无法保证你能在遇袭时生还。可能的遇袭目标有：地铁系统，布洛克大桥，鹿特丹塔，大伊斯顿车站等诸多场所。最近的一场国安办新闻声明进行了警告：「我们真的无法确认何处会遭遇袭击，能确定的只有没有绝对安全的地方。」自由城的威胁等级已提升至靛青色级(6级)。

english: It's the reality nobody wants to face up to. It's the stuff of nightmares - police have admitted they are concerned about similarities in a series of murder cases over the past few years, making them think a serial killer may be at work in Liberty City. The killer, who's yet to be given a nickname, seems to have a particular thing against keep-fit enthusiasts as the three victims so far were joggers. Each had been decapitated after running late at night. It seems we are in for a news bonanza as we consider the ramifications of this terrifying case in gruesome detail and try to figure out exactly who will star in the movie. In the meantime, police strongly recommend people pay more taxes and push for a rise in both overtime benefits and basic pay.
zh: 没人愿意接受这种现实。这是真正的噩梦：警方承认，过去几年相似的多起谋杀案令他们怀疑自由城内存在连环杀人犯。我们甚至还不知道怎么称呼这个杀手，但他似乎对健身爱好者情有独钟。三起案件的被害者都是慢跑锻炼者，每个人都在深夜慢跑后被凶手砍头。本报将会为您持续报道这一骇人连环杀人案的可怕细节，并尽力寻找案件舞台上的演员，这简直是新闻界的宝库。同时，警方强烈建议市民多纳税，并呼吁市民为警方争取更高的底薪和加班费。

english: A recent survey of known terrorists has revealed that Liberty City is the most desirable target for an attack. Some cite its visibility in films and TV shows such as the Weazel Network's '72'. Others mention the banks trading on Liberty City's BAWSAQ 100 stock exchange. Others just don't like the Liberty City "attitude". Whatever the reason, Liberty City has never been in more danger of being hit by a terrorist attack than it is today. The National Office of Security Enforcement gives a statistical probability of 90% for an attack being attempted in the next 5 years. What can a resident of Liberty City do to prevent such an attack?
zh: 最近对一些已知恐怖分子的问卷调查表明，自由城是最理想的袭击目标。有的恐怖分子是出于自由城在电影和电视节目中的曝光度考虑，如Weazel电视台的《72小时》。有的则提到了多家交易BAWSAQ 100股票的银行。还有些人单纯不喜欢自由城的「做派」。无论原因如何，自由城已陷入了前所未有的恐袭风险。根据国家安全办公室给出的统计学概率，5年内会发生一次恐怖袭击的可能竟高达九成。为了避免遭受袭击，自由城居民有什么能做的吗？

Hold The Call
Police are baffled

Terror suspected behind explosion at Bohan garage.
zh: 波汉车库爆炸疑为恐怖袭击。

english: Explosion in Bohan Linked to Terror Cell?
zh: 波汉发生爆炸或与恐怖分子有关？

english: Low cost, gadget-filled mobile phones have flooded the market - but are they safe? 10 ways in which they are putting you at risk:
zh: 廉价且功能繁多的手机席卷市场，但它安全吗？手机使你置身危险的10种方式：

english: An explosion has occurred at a garage on Guantanamo and Windmill in South Bohan. Investigators on the scene have found traces of ammonium nitrate and nitromethane as well as the remains of a large truck. These are common ingredients in explosive devices. It doesn't take a genius to connect the dots and blame terrorists here in Liberty City for the horrific destruction wrought at the garage. Luckily, no employees were present at the time of detonation. The garage is located on a busy street where people walk to go to work and do their shopping. We got lucky this time.
zh: 南波汉的一间车库发生爆炸，位于关塔那摩大道风车街路口。调查人员在现场发现了硝酸铵和硝基甲烷的痕迹，以及一辆大卡车的残骸。这都是炸弹中的常见成分。很容易让人联想到自由城内的恐怖分子，车库爆炸也必然是他们的手笔。该车库位于繁忙的街道，是当地居民购物上班的必经之路。好在爆炸时并无任何员工在场，这次我们十分幸运。

english:
1) A study at Vespucci University revealed that lab rats that were strapped to active cell phones for weeks at a time were more likely to die early than rats not strapped to cell phones.

2) Several perverts have been caught on the Liberty City subway system secretly photographing women's private parts with their camera phones.

3) You are 60% more likely to be mugged if a criminal sees you talking on your cell phone.

4) The government can intercept cell phone calls, thus compromising your civil liberties.

5) If you need to make an emergency call in a life threatening situation, a cell phone is 90% more likely to drop its signal than a hard line.
zh:
1) 韦斯普奇大学的一项研究表明，被绑在开机手机上的小白鼠比没绑在手机上的小白鼠寿命更短。

2) 几名变态因在自由城的地铁中用手机偷拍女性私处被捕。

3) 犯罪分子看到你用手机通话时，你被抢劫的可能性会增加60%。

4) 政府可以监听你的电话，从而限制公民自由。

5) 如果你在生命垂危时拨打紧急电话，手机没信号的概率会比固定电话高90%。

english:
6) Talking or "texting" on a cell phone while walking makes you unaware of your surroundings and means that you are more likely to be hit by a car or to fall down an exposed manhole.

7) Criminals can overhear your cell phone conversations. Any personal details can then be used in criminal enterprise or perverted sex games.

8) The majority of cell phones are manufactured by non-US companies. Money spent on them will not further the US economy and may be used to fund terrorist activity abroad.

9) 7/10 illness sufferers in the US own cell phones.

10) Many people store their mobile in their pocket, reducing sperm count and disappointing your eager lover.
zh:
6) 走路时打电话发短信会让你忽略周边情况，你被车撞或掉井里的可能性会大大增加。

7) 罪犯可以偷听你的手机通话，你的个人信息可能被犯罪组织所用或用于性变态游戏。

8) 大多数手机都是外国公司产的，你花在上面的钱不仅对美国经济无益，甚至还会变成打向美国的子弹。

9) 美国的七成病人拥有手机。

10) 很多人把手机放在口袋里，这样会减少精子数量，还会让饥渴的爱人失望。

Violence By The Beach
The Changing Pattern of Crime
They've got the bats, but have they got the balls?
A host of new racial stereotypes ripe for parody
zh: 大量新的种族标签登上舞台

zh: 人生是片海滩，然后你就曝尸枪战

english: Drug-addled Millionaire Heroes Threaten Strike
zh: 吸毒成瘾的「百万英雄」扬言罢工

english: Shooting in East Broker leaves nightclub owner dead
zh: 夜总会老板死于布洛克东部的枪击事件

english: The mostly Russian community of Hove Beach is in shock. Mr. Faustin was a well known local figure, a colorful man who ran one of the best dinner clubs in the area. A lover of life, he leaves a wife and daughter.
zh: 霍夫海滩的俄裔居民集体震惊。福斯汀先生是当地的知名人物，个性鲜明的他经营着当地最好的一家夜总会。他是一个热爱生活的人，就这样被迫抛下一妻一女而去。

english: Once it was the Mafia, the Jewish mob and the fighting Irish. Now it is Albanian, Russian, Jamaican and Korean hoodlums who are as likely to be running rackets and dealing drugs. Crime in Liberty has changed as the population has changed, and the recent bloodbath in a Hove Beach nightclub has shone a light on the murky world of the underworld. The police have few links with these newer communities in our city, and language barriers often make it harder for them to find out what is going on, so crime has run riot in a way not seen since the passing of the RICO act in the 1970s.
zh: 从前是黑手党，犹太黑帮和爱尔兰斗士。现在是来自阿尔巴尼亚、俄罗斯、牙买加和朝鲜的各国暴徒，他们几乎都在敲诈勒索、贩卖毒品。随着人口的变化，自由城的犯罪行为也发生了变化，最近在霍夫海滩夜总会的大屠杀照亮了黑社会的现状。警方在本市的这些新帮派中几乎没有线人，而语言障碍也让警方更难了解情况。因此犯罪行为愈演愈烈，达到了上世纪七十年代RICO法案(组织犯罪取缔法)通过以来前所未有的新高度。

english: The Swingers have announced to baseball officials that they will officially strike if the city refuses to come to the bargaining table regarding the building of a new stadium. Designs call for a radical vision of all luxury boxes and no open seats. "Sponsorships and corporate boxes are the most important thing in baseball, and currently we aren't able to serve our real fans. And by real fans I mean the ones who are able to support the team with $50,000 luxury boxes. It makes a player feel good to know that fans are comfortable in air-conditioned luxury boxes, knocking back 12 or 18 beers, shoving nachos in their faces and making passes at each other's wives," said team manager Henry Thornsteen.
zh: 浪人队已向棒球官员宣布，若市政府拒绝就新建体育场进行谈判，他们将正式罢工。球队要求采用全豪华包厢的激进设计，亦即不设露天观众席。球队经理亨利･索恩斯汀说：「赞助商和企业包厢才是棒球运动中最重要的部分，而目前我们无法为真正的球迷服务。这个『真球迷』指的是能花五万美元包下豪华包厢来支持球队的人。球员会为自己的球迷能在豪华空调包厢舒服地看球感到高兴，更别提球迷们还能喝上一打半的啤酒，把玉米片糊到脸上，然后互玩换妻Play了。」

english: The police are demanding greater funds and expect massive public anxiety over the matter. One criminal expert, Jimmy Cast, is less convinced. The well-known expert on organized crime in our city commented, "There will always be gangs of criminals at work, especially when you have a lot of poor immigrants, but the idea that they will ever supersede the Mafia in importance is frankly laughable, as they will never be able to take control of so many government and city departments. Of course, following years of being attacked by law enforcement, the Mafia are in decline, but bear in mind it also serves them to exaggerate the extent of their decline so people leave them alone." Whichever way you look at it, crime in Liberty City remains an international business and something we do best.
zh: 警方要求得到更多经费，并期望公众对犯罪激增的现状感到恐慌。但本市研究有组织犯罪的知名专家吉米･卡斯特并不同意警方的观点。他说：「贫穷移民的存在必然带来犯罪组织，但认为他们会取代黑手党纯属无稽之谈，因为那些贫穷移民根本不可能控制繁多的政府机构和市政部门。的确，黑手党在多年的执法打击下呈现颓势，但夸大他们的颓势只会帮助他们淡出公众视线，让他们得以隐蔽生长。」无论你的观点如何，自由城的犯罪都会保持国际化的现状，也仍是我们这儿的特产。

english: A nightclub owner is dead and the beachside communities of east Broker are in panic after another violent shoot out last night. Patrons at the Russian-themed Perestroika night club and cabaret were horrified when an argument between the owner and a man he appeared to know ended in murder. The owner, Mikhail Faustin, 45, was killed along with several accomplices whose names have not yet been released by police. The assailant escaped. Eye witnesses described a dark-haired European man in his late twenties or early 30s of average height and build, which does not narrow it down that much.
zh: 昨晚布洛克东部又有一起暴力枪战发生，一名夜总会老板死亡，海滨一带的居民陷入恐慌。死者生前经营的Perestroika是一家俄罗斯风格的夜总会，其与熟人发生的争执最终成为了一起杀人案，令当时在场的顾客受到惊吓。死者是45岁的米哈伊尔･福斯汀，与他一起遇害的还有他的数名保镖，但警方尚未公开其他死者的姓名。凶手仍然在逃。据目击者描述，凶手是一名深色头发的欧洲人，年龄大约在30岁左右，不胖不瘦，不高不矮。然而这份证词很难缩小嫌疑人范围。

english: Biker Gang Chaos
Motor-cycle of violence continues
The Lost cause more problems
zh: 失落摩托帮引起更多问题

english: There's a war going on right here on our doorsteps. Everyone thinks that members of motorcycle gangs are friendly bearded rebels who want to take you for a ride. But there's more to that beard than meets the eye.
zh: 战争就在我们的家门口。摩托帮并不是友善的叛逆大胡子，也未必会骑车带你兜风。大胡子底下可没表面上那么简单。

english: Was Judge Barry Griffin's sentence too lenient for this hardened drug trafficker? If anyone deserved to be put into a maximum security correctional facility, it was Billy Grey. His sentencing to a country club rehabilitation center is an insult to all of us on the side of law and order.
zh: 巴里･格里芬法官对这个贩毒惯犯的判决是否过轻？比利･格雷这种人就该关进最高安保级别的监狱。判他去乡下戒毒所完全是对我们这些遵纪守法好公民的侮辱。

english: Recently, Billy Grey, leader of the Alderney chapter of The Lost biker gang, was released from a rehabilitation center. Members of the community were shocked that Mr. Grey got off with such a light sentence after his crimes and that he is now back on the street. During his period inside, biker crime in Liberty City had dwindled to almost nothing. However, in recent days, new skirmishes have broken out making police think that old scores are being settled. Reports have come in of shootouts and bike chases through the metropolitan area. The bodies of several suspected members of both The Lost and their arch rivals the Angels of Death have been recovered.
zh: 近日，失落摩托帮奥尔德尼分会的首领比利･格雷从戒毒所被释放。格雷先生案底累累，竟然只是被判强制戒毒，现已重获自由，当地居民对此十分震惊。在其服刑期间，自由城的飞车党犯罪基本销声匿迹。不过，最近又有几场小规模冲突爆发，警方认为这是在清算旧账。大都会地区已接到多起枪战和机车追逐的报告。同时还发现了多具尸体，疑为失落帮及其敌对帮派死亡天使的成员。

english: Nameless Killer Strikes Again
General Public having opinions again
zh: 普罗大众再次提出意见

english: Will nothing stop what's-his-face?
zh: 无面杀手莫非无人可挡？

english: LC's new serial killer has left a new victim
zh: 自由城的新杀人魔犯下新罪

english: Mayor Under Pressure To Reopen Bridges
zh: 市长面临恢复桥梁通行的压力

english: The Broker Bridge, the Algonquin Bridge, the East Borough Bridge, the Northwood Heights Bridge, the Hickey Bridge and the Booth Tunnel have remained closed since the threat of Terrorism escalated over the summer. Thousands of Liberty City residents are failing to reach work each day and having to resort to public transport. Experts estimate that this is costing Liberty City business millions of dollars a day. Surely it is time for Mayor Julio Ochoa to reopen these bridges?
zh: 自今年夏天的恐怖主义威胁升级以来，布洛克大桥、阿尔冈琴大桥、东区大桥、北伍德高地大桥、希基大桥以及布斯隧道一直处于关闭状态。成千上万的自由城居民无法准时上班，被迫搭乘公共交通。据专家估算，这种情况每天将给自由城的企业造成上百万损失。胡里奥･奥乔亚市长也差不多该开放这些大桥了吧？

english: Police admitted they were baffled by their failure in this regard and put it down to a change in demographics since 1977. One cop, who refused to be named, blamed "a culture of equality; the fact is, non whites are just not funny. In the old days, we'd make racist jokes and have a great time; now people get all excited about racial equality, and the result - anarchy on our streets." Whatever the cause, the failure to give this serial killer a nickname is likely to damage future movie rights and book deals. Detective Jon Atkinson asked that we mention him in this story, so we just have.
zh: 警方承认他们被取名难住了，并将其归咎于1977年以来的人口结构变化。一位不愿透露姓名的警官表示：「都怪追求平等的文化。实际上，现在的非白人实在是无趣。想当年，我们可以讲种族主义的笑话，大家都很开心；现在，种族平权令人振奋，结果就是现在城里的无政府状态。」不论原因如何，没能给这一连环杀手起名很有可能对未来的电影改编和图书市场造成巨大负面影响。乔恩･阿特金森警探要求我们在本报道中提到他一次，现在就提到了。

english: The serial killer our unimaginative police force and media cannot name has struck again. This time, a jogger in Alderney got the chop as a headless body was found in some bushes by the river. The body had been badly mutilated and taken advantage of, and police have still not identified the victim. Local residents are starting to panic. One local heavy-set woman, Siobhan Phillips, told us, "They say keeping fit is good for you; well, it wasn't good for this man - he went running and had his head chopped off by a maniac." Of greater concern for many is the failure by our police force to name the killer. Surely a man who chops off heads for fun could inspire a funny nickname or moniker of some sort?
zh: 我们缺乏想象力的警察和媒体还没替他想好外号，这个连环杀手就再次犯案了。这次的死者是一位住在奥尔德尼的慢跑者，警方在河边的灌木丛中发现了他的无头尸体。尸体受到了严重摧残，还曾遭到性侵，目前警方仍未确认死者身份。当地居民开始恐慌。当地一位魁梧的女士西沃恩･菲利普斯告诉我们：「都说健身有好处，结果你看看他，出门跑个步，头就被一个疯子砍了，哪有什么好处。」不过大多数人更加担忧的是，警方至今未能给这个杀手命名。对于一个以砍头为乐的人，怎么说都不至于想不到一个像样点的绰号或者代号给他吧？

Finally It's A City Again
9 out of 10 people still have no idea what the hell that means
zh: 九成民众并不知道这有什么影响

english: BAWSAQ 100 Closes Up 12 Points
Mayor Ochoa has opened city bridges that were closed in anti-terror precautions.
zh: 奥乔亚市长解封出于反恐目的封锁的大桥。

english: In what will have a massive affect on the American economy, the BAWSAQ closed up 12 points. Traders were seen furiously running around the floor of the stock exchange writing things on small bits of paper and yelling at each other. Numbers and letters scrolled by really fast on the walls and people looked excited then upset then really happy.
zh: 能对美国经济产生巨大影响的BAWSAQ指数收盘上涨12点。交易员在证券交易所的地板上狂奔，在小纸条上奋笔疾书，在场内高声呼喊。墙上的数字和字母飞速滚动，人们的情绪如过山车一般大起大落。

english: Financial news channels spent the rest of the evening speculating on what this means, which is a good thing, as most of America has no fucking clue what any of this boring horseshit is. All we know is our pensions are probably screwed while some shitdick is riding to his 10-million-dollar house upstate in an Italian sports car.
zh: 收市后，各个财经新闻台都在分析此次上涨的含义，这是好的，因为绝大多数美国人都不知道股市这个傻逼玩意是怎么回事。我们只知道我们的养老金可能要没，同时却还有混蛋开着意大利跑车奔向自己的千万郊区豪宅。

english: Liberty City Mayor, Julio Ochoa, has caved to pressure and reopened the bridges separating Algonquin from the eastern boroughs. In a cautious move, the Hickey Bridge and Booth Tunnel have remained closed because N.O.O.S.E officials are convinced of specific but unnamed threats to the West River crossings. Some city officials have countered that not even a terrorist would want to live in Alderney.
zh: 自由城市长胡里奥･奥乔亚终于向压力屈服，解封了连接阿尔冈琴和东部地区的桥梁。出于谨慎考虑，希基大桥和布斯隧道仍将关闭，N.O.O.S.E官员相信西河一带存在某些无名隐患。有市政府官员反驳称，就连恐怖分子都不愿意住在奥尔德尼。

english: Others have been more forthright. The Police Commissioner warned that, "This man is a repeat offender and must be stopped. Hate crimes have no place in our city, unlike financial fraud, insider trading, counterfeit goods, or political corruption." Suddenly, a walk in Middle Park doesn't sound like a good idea.
zh: 其他人则更为直率。警察局长警告说：「这个人是惯犯，必须制止。与金融欺诈、内幕交易、假冒伪劣和政治腐败不同，我市对于仇恨犯罪绝不容忍。」突然间，去中央公园散步就成了馊主意。

english: A group of young men are turning the streets of Liberty City into death traps. They meet in super-charged killing machines in order to race at insane speeds through city streets. In the world of illegal street racing, all that matters is the size of your stick, the smell of your leather, the garishness of your paintjob, and the sheen on your rims.
zh: 一群年轻人正在将自由城的街道变为死亡陷阱。他们驾驶着性能强劲的杀戮机器碰头，然后就在自由城的大街小巷一路狂飙。在非法街头赛车的世界里，最重要的是你的车贴大不大，皮革的味道好不好，你的涂装有多花哨，你的轮圈有多闪亮。

english: As if Middle Park was not dangerous enough, a suspected gay basher is on the loose. Several gay men have been attacked over the past weeks. Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins believes that this spree of beatings is down to a lack of family values. "Homosexuality should not be flaunted around parks where impressionable young children or I might see."
zh: 似乎还有人嫌中央公园不够危险，一名男同猎人仍然逍遥法外。过去几周已有数名同性恋男子遭到袭击。副市长布莱斯･道金斯认为这种过分的殴打系家庭观念缺失所致。他说：「同性恋不应该在在公园里招摇，小孩子看了很容易学坏的，而且还有可能被我看见。」

english: Tempers flared on Capitol Hill as Congress put aside health care and war legislation to discuss what is on everyone's mind - cocks. Specifically, man cock and another man with a dog collar. At times the debate centered on hot lesbian action, but conservatives defeated riders and focused on man-on-man debate. Politicians went at it fiercely into the night, tired and sore from hours of passionate exchanges. Legislation on same-sex marriage is expected soon.
zh: 国会山的气氛摩擦升温，但国会并不是在讨论暂时搁置的医保制度和战争法案，而在讨论所有人的关注的议题——屌。具体来说，是男人和另一个戴项圈的男人。辩论的焦点有时是性感的女同行为，但保守派会把话题引回来，回归关于男男的辩论。政客们激烈地争论到深夜，经过数小时的激烈交锋，他们疲惫不堪，浑身酸痛。同性婚姻的相关法律有望于近期颁布。

english: Staff Writer
Hell For Leather
Where there's smoke, there's crime
Arson Spate In Broker
Yet more arson attacks have taken place on buildings in Broker
More biker gang violence on the streets of LC
zh: 自由城摩托帮暴力增加

english: Following the massive rise in shootings recently in eastern Broker, police warned of a new danger lurking for residents - arson. Two buildings including a taxi garage were recently gutted by fire. Although two men were seen starting the fire with Molotov cocktails, no arrests have been made. We will stay with this story if we can find something interesting to say. In the meantime, be very suspicious of anyone buying vodka, matches and a gas soaked rag, but try not to panic. Local police were appealing for calm and also lots of snitches and widespread anxiety.
zh: 此前枪击事件在布洛克东部大量增加，现在当地警方指出了新的潜在威胁——纵火。包括一家出租车行在内的两处建筑遭到纵火破坏。尽管有人目睹两名男子投掷土制燃烧弹纵火，警方仍未逮捕任何嫌疑人。如果关于此案有新的发现，我们将进行后续报道。现在，请各位警惕任何购买伏特加、火柴和泡油布条的人，但也不要过度紧张。当地警方呼吁民众保持冷静，希望民众积极检举，时刻保持警惕。

english: A gas, leather, and crystal meth-fueled war is raging on the streets of Liberty City. It isn't nations fighting but rival motorcycle gangs battling for control of the streets. Men have died in this war, like The Lost biker Jason Michaels who was killed in Broker recently. How long is it going to be before innocent civilians are killed as well? Mainly thanks to the Angels of Death and their public relations efforts, biker gangs have taken on a much more friendly image in recent years. They appear in family-friendly movies and are romanticized in video games and TV shows. They are thought to stand for a noble rebellion against the norms of society. Be warned, this image is just a smokescreen used to cover up their real criminal agenda - sleeping with your wife and selling meth to your kids.
zh: 一场由汽油、皮革和冰毒驱动的战争正在自由城的街道上演。这不是国与国的争斗，而是敌对摩托帮间的地盘争夺。这场战争已经出现了死者，比如失落帮的杰森･迈克尔斯就于近日在布洛克遇害。再过多久才会出现无辜平民遇害呢？多亏了死亡天使的公关工作，近年来民众对摩托帮的印象十分良好。他们在合家欢电影里出镜，在电视上和游戏里美化自己，将自己塑造成反抗社会陈规的高尚叛逆者。当心点，这幅表象只是伪装犯罪企图的烟雾弹，他们的真正目的是：睡了你的老婆，毒害你的孩子。

english: Dog Meat Has His Day in Court
Making a meal of justice?
Feared criminal does a deal to turn in mob bosses
zh: 畏惧的罪犯供出黑帮老大

english: Tony Prince Asks For Night-Time Leniency
zh: 托尼･普林斯要求放开夜生活

english: Club owner bemoans loss of LC Nightlife
zh: 夜店老板哀叹自由城没有夜生活

english: Menotti is just one of a number of mobsters who have recently turned on their fellow criminals in exchange for lenient sentencing. While some applaud the efforts of the FIB, others think that the convictions are futile. Ex-Secretary of Security Enforcement, Bobby Jefferson, had this to say, "There's always going to be organized crime. The mob in Liberty City is being weakened, but it's just opening up room for new gangsters coming to town. The Alderney-based mobsters are trying to take control of Liberty City rackets and gangsters are coming in from Eastern Europe. These guys are even worse than the likes of Vito Dog Meat. There's a lot of money in Liberty City and officials willing to be bought off, so there'll always be crooks here trying to take advantage of the situation. It's unfortunately the dark side of human nature."
zh: 最近有许多罪犯供出同伙换取减刑，梅诺蒂只是其中一个。有人认同FIB的贡献，但也有人认为这些定罪是无用功。前国安办主任博比･杰斐逊认为：「有组织犯罪无法根绝。自由城的罪犯的确遭受打击，但这只会为外来犯罪团伙提供空间。奥尔德尼系犯罪团伙试图掌控自由城黑社会，而东欧黑帮也开始猖獗起来。他们比维托･狗肉更加糟糕。自由城充满财富，官员也乐意受贿，所以总会有坏蛋想从中牟利的。很可惜，这就是人性之恶。」

english: Vito "Dog Meat" Menotti stood in front of a judge at the Civic Citadel today in order to give evidence against his fellow mobsters. Menotti, having admitted to a series of murders here in Liberty City in the early 90s, has accepted a plea deal from the DA. This will allow him to gain a new identity in the witness relocation program in some horrible town in a desert state, providing his testimony leads to the conviction of his criminal cohorts. Mr. Menotti, a long-time senior-ranking member of Pavano crime family, gained his moniker from his ownership of a dog food processing plant. Menotti now admits that this gruesome plant was a good means of laundering money and disposing of the unfortunate victims of his mob hits.
zh: 今天，维托 "狗肉" 梅诺蒂站在市政厅的法官面前，供述了其同伙的罪行。梅诺蒂承认了90年代初在自由城发生的一系列谋杀案，并接受了地方检察官的认罪协议。协议以其供述其犯罪同伙的罪行为条件，为其提供新的身份，并会将其安置到某沙漠州的偏僻城镇接受证人保护计划。梅诺蒂是帕瓦诺犯罪家族的资深成员，其绰号「狗肉(狗肉)」源于其拥有的一家狗粮加工厂。梅诺蒂承认，这个可怕的工厂既用于洗钱，又用于处理家族暗杀目标的尸体。

english: Staff Writer
Death At The Diner
Shipment intercepted at docks
Clone Med Erection Shocker
Yet another brutal murder in Hove Beach
zh: 霍夫海滩的又一起残忍谋杀

english: More immigrant crime sweeps through community with latest murder
zh: 这起谋杀只是移民犯罪的冰山一角

english: There was another brutal murder in Hove Beach today. This time, however, police do not believe it is related to the ever-tightening hold of the Russian mafia on the area. The victim, a Mr. Tom Rivas, had told the owner of the 69th Street Diner that he was on a "hot date." He was then seen in a romantic context with an older, "foreign-looking" man. Moments later, he was dead. Mr. Rivas was unemployed but is reported to have had a number of older boyfriends who supported him. Police are currently pursuing all leads in the hope that one will lead them to the killer.
zh: 今天在霍夫海滩又发生了一起残忍的谋杀。然而，警方认为这起谋杀与在当地势力渐增的俄罗斯黑帮无关。受害者是汤姆･里瓦斯先生，遇害前他告诉69街餐馆的老板，自己是来「激情约会」的。有人目击受害者与一位年迈的、「长得像外国人」的男子卿卿我我。片刻之后，他死了。里瓦斯当时没有工作，但有消息称其有许多年长的男友作为经济来源。警方目前正在追查所有线索，希望能找到凶手。

english: Another shipment of cloned medication was intercepted at the docks today. The haul included counterfeit drugs used to treat depression and erectile dysfunction. A spokesman for Betta Pharmaceuticals, producer of the erectile dysfunction treatment drug, Mollis, has warned of the harmful effects of cloned medication. "Not only do these actions undermine the economy, but they can be very dangerous. We spend years putting our drugs through clinical trials and giving lab monkeys exploding erections. These guys brew something up in their basement and illegally ship it into the marketplace." Last year, a man in Las Venturas took some cloned Mollis and accidentally killed his wife when the toxic brew caused him to experience 18 days of priapism.
zh: 今日，码头又截获了一批仿制药，包括治疗抑郁症和勃起功能障碍的药物。生产治疗勃起功能障碍药物Mollis的贝塔制药的一位发言人对仿制药物的有害影响作出预警：「走私仿制药不仅破坏经济，还非常危险。我们花了数年时间才让我们的药通过临床试验，让实验室里的猴子雄风大振。这些人就在地下室酿了些东西，然后非法流入市场。」去年，拉斯文加斯一男子服用仿制的Mollis，这一毒药让他持续勃起18天，害死了其妻子。

Worse Things Happening at Sea
New security measures are ushered in
Liberty City Cab Prices Sky Rocket
