zh: ~z~你跟得太近了，伙计。被他看见了。

english: ~z~Rojo, rojo. Hit the brakes, man.
~z~I mean, you taught them these moves, right?
zh: ~z~我是说，他们的动作是你教的，对吧？

english: ~z~Yeah, right here. Wait... where are you going?
~z~-about cleaning up the streets of Bohan.~n~-Yeah!
~z~How come whenever I say something that really sings.
zh: ~z~怎么每次说出至理名言的时候都这样。

english: ~z~Of course he's seen us now. Shit, man.
zh: ~z~现在他能不发现我们吗。操蛋，伙计。

english: ~z~Look, I got money. I got... I got money.
~z~I'm paying you to follow him so do it, man.
zh: ~z~我花钱让你跟踪他，你就照做，伙计。

english: ~z~who beat up all those thugs in Broker?
zh: ~z~他单枪匹马干翻了布洛克的那些暴徒。

english: ~z~This boy's got personal space issues, man. Stay back.
zh: ~z~他也需要有私人空间，伙计。退后点。

english: ~z~Man, I thought you was serious about cleaning up these streets, man.
zh: ~z~伙计，我还以为你是真的想清理街道。

english: ~z~So, Niko, this is Manny - we grew up together.
zh: ~z~那，尼克，他是曼尼。我们一起长大的。

english: ~z~Thank you very much, that'll be all for today, thanks a lot.
zh: ~z~非常感谢你们，今天就到这儿了，多谢。

english: ~z~An entrepreneur who's gonna clean this shit up. Money and respect.
zh: ~z~会把这里收拾干净的企业家。名利双收。

english: ~z~No, no, not at all. It's a very manly kind of dancing.
zh: ~z~不，不，完全不像。这种舞姿很男人的。

english: ~z~Okay, well just keep looking at me, but stand over there, okay?
zh: ~z~好，你往我这儿看，人往那边站，好吧？

english: ~z~I thought you had passion in your veins, man.
zh: ~z~我以为你的血管里流动着满满激情，伙计。

english: ~z~More senseless death and the police aren't even here yet.
zh: ~z~又是无谓的死亡，而警察都还没到达现场。

english: ~z~I think that's as much of a decision of Mallorie's as it is Roman's.
zh: ~z~我想玛洛丽的选择也很重要，和罗曼一样。

english: ~z~Here Manny Escuela is rapping with a street accomplice
zh: ~z~现在曼尼･埃斯库埃拉正在和一名街友讨论

english: ~z~You're following him man, not ass raping him. Get back.
zh: ~z~你是要跟踪他，伙计，不是雷普他。回来。

english: ~z~Yeah? Great! Listen, Mallorie, would you, uh,
zh: ~z~是吗？好啊！听着，玛洛丽，麻烦你，呃，

english: ~z~Yeah, well, you know, we gotta clean up some eggs, brother.
zh: ~z~对，你也知道，我们得收拾些风雨，兄弟。

english: ~z~Hey, yeah, yeah, yeah. Whassup, man? Streets, man.
zh: ~z~嘿，耶，耶，耶。咋样伙计？街道，伙计。

english: ~z~He's not around because I'd break his camera if he shoved it in my face again.
zh: ~z~因为只要他敢拍我，我就会把他的相机砸烂。

english: ~z~Ok everyone, that'll be all for today, that was great.
zh: ~z~好了各位，今天就到这儿了，你们表现很棒。

english: ~z~That's us, man, only at a street level.
zh: ~z~那就是我们，伙计，不过我们是街道层面的。

english: ~z~-trying to reform their neighbourhood.~n~-Wait!
zh: ~z~－试图以此改革他们的街区。~n~－别啊！

english: ~z~I don't know why the people out there want to hurt people man?
zh: ~z~我不知道为什么这些人会想伤害别人，伙计。

english: ~z~This boy think he can come up in our shit. Drop him.
zh: ~z~这个小子认为他能挺住我们的活力。放倒他。

english: ~z~Apparently the mob teaches people to stay two car lengths behind a target.
zh: ~z~黑帮都会和要跟踪的目标保持两辆车的距离。

english: ~z~-These criminals are...~n~-Wait, wait, wait a second.
~z~-Can you tape us...?~n~-Just don't even...
~z~Shit, you look obvious being that close without a car, man.
zh: ~z~干，没车还跟那么紧，看上去很明显的，伙计。

english: ~z~Alright, okay, well listen, look... here's what were gonna do...
zh: ~z~那好，这样，你听着...我们要这么做...

english: ~z~Want to hurt these streets, man. They live and breathe.
zh: ~z~会想伤害这些街道，伙计。街道是有血有肉的。

english: ~z~Looks like he about to stop yo. You best pull up behind him, man.
zh: ~z~看来他要停车了。你最好在他后面停下，伙计。

english: ~z~We gotta get some of these dealers off the streets, man, you know?
zh: ~z~我们得把街上的一些毒贩赶跑，伙计，知道吗？

english: ~z~This is my boyfriend's cousin, the guy I was telling you about, Niko.
zh: ~z~他是我男朋友的堂弟，之前跟你说的那个尼克。

english: ~z~There he be. We gots to follow him to them other leeches, man.
zh: ~z~他走了。我们要跟着他找到其他寄生虫，伙计。

english: ~z~Man, it's almost like you want this scum on the streets.
zh: ~z~伙计，你是存心想让这些人渣在街上害人是吧。

english: ~z~I don't think we sent an invitation to this punk. Eject him from the party.
zh: ~z~我不认为我们给这傻逼发了邀请。把他赶出去。

english: ~z~-Okay, go.~n~-Yeah, beautiful, beautiful, alright.
~z~I guess the streets is going to have to stay dirty for a little longer. See you, Manny.
zh: ~z~我想街道只能再脏上一段时间了。之后见，曼尼。

english: ~z~This film is my gospel, man. The gospel of the streets.
zh: ~z~这部影片就是我的福音书，伙计。街道的福音书。

english: ~z~You think these streets is safe enough? See for yourself - get out.
zh: ~z~你觉得街道现在够安全吗？自己去看看吧，慢走。

english: ~z~Yo, chill on the shooting, man. We trying to keep this shit on the down low.
zh: ~z~嘿，先别想着开枪，伙计。现在我们得低调一点。

english: ~z~Shit, man. You don't need to fire that thing until we find the rest of those suckers, man.
zh: ~z~我靠伙计。我们找到其他毒贩之前你没必要开枪。

english: ~z~-okay, but we want to see you, too.~n~-Just film it, man.
zh: ~z~－好，但也得拍到你。~n~－直接拍吧，伙计。

english: ~z~You know, when I really start talking the truth, how come Jay's not around man?
zh: ~z~每次我触及真理的时候，怎么杰就是不在呢，伙计？

english: ~z~That's right, follow me, but be prepared. Street life ain't pretty.
zh: ~z~没错，跟我来，做好心理准备，街头生活可不漂亮。

english: ~z~"Help" has only one name on the streets of South Bohan - Manny Escuela.
zh: ~z~南波汉的「救星」只有他一个－曼尼･埃斯库埃拉。

english: ~z~For a guy who just lost his home and his business and who now has a price on his head?
zh: ~z~考虑到他刚没了自己的家和事业，还被人重金悬赏，

english: ~z~Shit, man. I thought you were the streets man. We need to tail him.
zh: ~z~干，伙计。我还以为你是街道同僚。我们得跟着他。

english: ~z~Only someone who has been to prison gets that close to a man. Hold off, man!
zh: ~z~只有坐过牢的人才会离男人那么近。拉开点，伙计！

english: ~z~Hey did it look good? Huh? Was it a good mixture of that sadness and resolve?
zh: ~z~嘿，效果还好吗？哈？是不是融悲伤与决心为一体？

english: ~z~He going to propose, right? He's going to make an honest woman of her, right?
zh: ~z~他要求婚，对吧？他会对玛洛丽负起责任的，对吧？

english: ~z~Niko, you made a promise to me, man. Your bond is your word, man.
zh: ~z~尼克，你跟我可说好了，伙计。说话要算数，伙计。

english: ~z~I ain't touched that shit in years. Who you been talking to, man?
zh: ~z~我好多年没碰那玩意了。你把我当什么人啊，伙计？

english: ~z~So you and Mallorie is tight, huh? She and your cousin is together now.
zh: ~z~你和玛洛丽关系很好是吧？现在她跟你堂兄在一起了。

english: ~z~Yeah here, right here, right here, turn around, man, right here.
zh: ~z~对，这边，就这边，就这边，转过来，伙计，就这边。

english: ~z~Shit, we meant to be keeping this shit on the down low. What you doing getting five-oh on our ass?
zh: ~z~我靠，我说了要低调做事。你把条子惹上是几个意思？

english: ~z~You lost him, man. He probably selling drugs to kids right now.
zh: ~z~你跟丢他了，伙计。他现在可能在向孩子们卖毒品了。

english: ~z~A kid dies tonight, man, on your head it be. Get outta here.
zh: ~z~要是今晚有孩子死了，伙计，就全是你的责任。你走吧。

english: ~z~-Turn this way. Yeah. Looking at me.~n~-Five, six, seven and eight.
zh: ~z~－往这儿转。对。朝我看。~n~－五 六 七然后八。

english: ~z~This is the one, man - we're gonna get a really nice shot of them, it's going to be beautiful.
zh: ~z~就是这样，伙计。要把他们一起拍进去，效果会很棒的。

english: ~z~You taking my money, aren't you? Be my voice. I'm gonna go back and get Jay.
zh: ~z~我付你钱了，不是么？替我把话带到。我要回去找杰了。

english: ~z~Hey, the message is what's important, man. It don't matter who gives it.
zh: ~z~嘿，重要的是意思能传达到，伙计。是谁动的手不重要。

english: ~z~It's two car lengths, right? That's how far you stay behind a woman when you're harassing her?
zh: ~z~两辆车的距离，对吧？骚扰女人的时候也是这个距离吧？

english: ~z~-give us a little space please? Thanks.~n~-Alright, alright...
zh: ~z~－给我们腾个位置吧？谢了。~n~－好的，好的...

english: ~z~Man, you hit him. No way we can get the rest of them leeches now!
zh: ~z~伙计，你撞上他了。现在我们不可能找到其他寄生虫了！

english: ~z~Step on it, man. I need you close to this guy, but not too close. You hear me?
zh: ~z~快点，伙计。我需要你跟紧他，但也别跟太紧。懂了吗？

english: ~z~Shit, man. He seen us. He ain't never gonna go to his boys now.
zh: ~z~该死，伙计，他看见我们了。他不可能去找他的同伙了。

english: ~z~That guy gets away there'll be more drugs on the street, killing our kids.
zh: ~z~给那家伙跑了的话街上会有更多毒品的，会害死孩子的。

english: ~z~Shit, how about that for a title? 'Manny's Street Gospel' man.
zh: ~z~我靠，要么就叫这名字吧？《曼尼的街道福音》，伙计。

english: ~z~Ok, yeah, great, so, eh, so you know streets take no prisoners, right?
zh: ~z~好，对，很好。那个，你知道街道对敌人绝不手软，对吧？

english: ~z~The dealer and his drug wagon are up there. Pull up behind and we wait.
zh: ~z~毒贩子和他装毒品的车都在那儿。停到他后面，见机行事。

english: ~z~If you can't clean up the streets, man, then you can walk on them, man. Get out.
zh: ~z~要是你不能收拾干净街道，就去街上走走吧，伙计。滚吧。

english: ~z~Shit, he'd pulled up. It's almost like you don't care about the kids, man.
zh: ~z~我靠，他停车了。你这人真就不在乎孩子们死活吗，伙计。

english: ~z~Philanthropicalism, man, like one of them rich guys who makes computers and cures AIDS and shit.
zh: ~z~心怀大善，伙计。就像那些造电脑啊、治艾滋啊的有钱人。

english: ~z~How we going to clean up these streets if there's cops on us, man? Lose the heat.
zh: ~z~身后有条子跟着我们还怎么整治街道啊，伙计？摆脱通缉。

english: ~z~Best of both worlds, man. I see myself that way, man.
zh: ~z~两个领域都是最好的，伙计。我觉得我就是这种人，伙计。

english: ~z~Yeah, I'm an entrepreneur, man. You got to have some money if people is gonna respect you out there, man.
zh: ~z~对，我是个企业家，伙计。有钱才能让别人尊重你，伙计。

english: ~z~I don't know if he's grown up enough to make a good husband. What's it to you anyway?
zh: ~z~我不知道现在他能否当一个好丈夫。不过跟你有什么关系？

english: ~z~See, it's the streets man, but people gotta understand the struggles...
zh: ~z~看，街道大家庭。伙计，但各位一定要明白背后的付出...

english: ~z~This dealer's going to see us if we rolling with all this heat, man! You gotta shake the cops, man.
zh: ~z~这么招摇的话会被毒贩发现的，伙计！你得甩掉警察，伙计。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, you know, sometimes you gotta break some omelets to make some eggs, you know what I'm saying?
zh: ~z~行，没事，要知道，不经历彩虹怎能见风雨，懂我什么意思吗？

english: ~z~Could you walk out of there just one more time? We need to get the shot just right.
zh: ~z~你能不能再从里面出来一次？我们拍到这个镜头的时机得合适。

english: ~z~You think Jesus started breaking shit up when those disciples followed him around with a bit of parchment?
zh: ~z~你觉得耶稣被一群拿着羊皮纸的信徒追随的时候会开始摔东西吗？

english: ~z~The kids have to look up to me, man. To know that the clean path is the good path. You hear me?
zh: ~z~孩子们以我为榜样，伙计。能学到干净的路才是正道。听见了吗？

english: ~z~ I love that girl, man, I love her, man. Your cousin better not be messing with her head.
zh: ~z~我爱那女孩，伙计，我爱她，伙计。你堂兄最好别搅得她心烦意乱。

english: ~z~Everytime the streets is hurt, I hurt inside, man. You cut me deep, man. Get out of here.
zh: ~z~每次街道受伤，我的心就会更痛，伙计。你深深伤害了我。你走吧。

english: ~z~You know, when I was stalking this girl in Europe, I found that two car lengths was the best distance.
zh: ~z~你知道吗，我在欧洲跟踪姑娘的时候，发现两个车距是最好的距离。

english: ~z~You know, these streets is mine, man! I can feel them flowing through my veins.
zh: ~z~知道吗，这片街区是我的，伙计！我能感觉到它在我的血管中流动。

english: ~z~I'm disappointed in you man. I thought we was on the same page. I thought you cared. Get out.
zh: ~z~我对你很失望，伙计。我以为我们是一路人。还以为你也在乎。滚吧。

english: ~z~Just wait 'til you see your face on the screen, man. Maybe you change your mind then!
zh: ~z~你就等着瞧自己在电视上露脸吧，伙计。说不定到时候你就改主意了！

english: ~z~We're gonna get all these dealers off the streets and we're gonna kick their ass and they're gonna know it was me...
zh: ~z~赶跑街上的所有毒贩，把他们揍出屎来，人们就知道我的功劳了...

english: ~z~Shit, man. Manny's close to everyone who grew up on the streets of South Bohan, man.
zh: ~z~我靠，伙计，曼尼跟所有在南波汉的街道长大的人关系都很好，伙计。

english: ~z~You cut them and they bleed. Man, that was good. I should write that down. You got a pen?
zh: ~z~划上一刀，它也会流血。伙计，这话漂亮，我得先记下来。你有带笔吗？

english: ~z~Last I heard these dealers was up on Grand Boulevard. Let's go take a look, man.
zh: ~z~我最后一次听说这些毒贩是在格兰德大街。~n~我们过去看看，伙计。

english: ~z~It's for the love, man. They know me coz I help people, man. I'm all love for these streets.
zh: ~z~是为了爱，伙计。人认识我是因为我帮了他们，伙计。我对街道心怀大爱。

english: ~z~You ever thought about doing some TV? You might be able to get a series off the back of mine, you know?
zh: ~z~你想过录电视节目吗？~n~等我拍完说不定能给你拍个专题出来，懂吧？

english: ~z~I like your vibe, man. I like it. You're out to make money but you want to make a difference too, man.
zh: ~z~我喜欢你的风格，伙计。我喜欢。赚钱谋生的同时，也想要有所作为，伙计。

english: ~z~-I don't mind doing that again and again until I get it right.~n~-Oh, oh, easy, easy Niko.
zh: ~z~－我不介意在教会你之前多这样来几次。~n~－哦，哦，放松，放松，尼克。

english: ~z~People say to me, "Manny why you do this? Why you want to clean up the streets so bad? What's your passion?"
zh: ~z~人们对我说，「曼尼，为什么这样做？你怎么这么想整治街区？你的动力是什么？」

english: ~z~I thought you was going to clean shit up. For me and these streets. For these people man, my people.
zh: ~z~我以为你会把街道清理干净。为了我和街道，为了这里的人们，伙计，为了我的子民。

english: ~z~-Hey, hey! Please, please, what are you doing? Hey! My...~n~-Hey, hold on a second, man! Wha...
zh: ~z~－喂，喂！拜托，拜托，你要干啥啊？喂！我的...~n~－喂，停一下，伙计！哇...

english: ~z~-The fearsome street warrior stands outside the site of another gangland massacre. Oh...~n~-Yeah... 'sright...
zh: ~z~－罪犯畏惧的街道战士正站在另一起黑社会大屠杀的现场外。哦...卡。~n~－对...是这样...

english: ~z~Huh.
~z~A'ight.
~z~I'm on you.
~z~Over here man.
~z~As long as they pay.
~z~Okay... how many?
~z~Thank you Officer. Thanks.
~z~Alright, I'm just saying.
~z~Keep doing what you're doing.
~z~They're over on Windmill Street right now.
~z~Alright. What did they do?
~z~Yeah, like charity work?
~z~Whatever man, fucking punk...
~z~Look Manny - I gotta go...
~z~But I guess the streets already told you that.
zh: ~z~不过我猜街道已经告诉你了。

english: ~z~We live by these codes. You know what I mean?
zh: ~z~我们按规矩生活。懂我意思吗？

english: ~z~Manny - I got things to do... you, off.
~z~Right over here. Officer please I need you this way. Thank you.
zh: ~z~你站那儿。警官您往这儿站，谢谢。

english: ~z~Well, no. I'm uh, just a tourist.
~z~Manny, I thought you should know that I lost those dealers.
zh: ~z~曼尼，我想你有必要知道我放跑了几个毒贩。

english: ~z~to start working with the gatekeepers of the community to make things better.
zh: ~z~通过与社区的守护者们合作，来让一切更好。

english: ~z~I was one of them cats who invented that shit man, it went commercial.
zh: ~z~那玩意的发明有我一份功劳，结果商业化了。

english: ~z~I'll call you when I got more work. Stay safe. Stay real.
zh: ~z~我这儿有活了再打给你。注意安全，活出真我。

english: ~z~All I can say is I hope you'll continue to make the community a better place.
zh: ~z~我能说的就是，衷心希望你能让这个社区不断变好。

english: ~z~Okay guys, I just want to get one more shot please. This is gonna look great.
zh: ~z~好了各位，再拍一个镜头就可以了。效果会很好的。

english: ~z~I need you to get some bitches taken out, moved on, whatever.
zh: ~z~帮我解决一些贱人，干掉也行，赶走也行，怎样都行。

english: ~z~Niko, you cold, man. You cold and you ain't doing shit right. Come see me.
zh: ~z~尼克，没良心的，伙计。没良心还办不成事。过来找我。

english: ~z~Hey, Officer McReary, this is Niko right here. This is my man Niko.
zh: ~z~嘿，麦克雷里警官，这边这位就是尼克。我的伙计尼克。

english: ~z~Yo man, I was getting my flow on, man, I ain't rapped for years.
zh: ~z~哟，伙计，我刚才在找感觉，伙计，好多年没唱Rap了。

english: ~z~Cause yo, I promised Mr. McReary I was gonna get this place cleaned up and I will.
zh: ~z~因为我答应了麦克雷里先生会把这里收拾干净，说到做到。

english: ~z~Yo, that's what I'm saying man. The streets, we got codes man you know what I'm saying.
zh: ~z~哟，就是这么回事。在街道，我们自有规矩，你们也懂我意思。

english: ~z~A little closer. Thank you so much. Wonderful, wonderful. Beautiful. Now we are gonna be da da da da.

zh: ~z~我已经帮过你一次了，不过会再帮一次。等我的联络吧。

zh: ~z~他没跟我说过。不过我敢肯定，这对你们两个都是好事。

english: ~z~Hey man, did you just call me?
~z~Shit, man. I coulda sworn it was her.
zh: ~z~我靠，老兄。我敢发誓那个是她。

english: ~z~He must have robbed the diamonds off of Isaac.
zh: ~z~他肯定是从艾萨克那里抢来的钻石。

english: ~z~Having man troubles. I helped her out.
zh: ~z~在跟她男人闹矛盾，我帮她解决了。

english: ~z~You all got love for a fool at the top and don't know a fool at the bottom. Out.
zh: ~z~有钱有势被人捧，一无所有没人问。滚。

english: ~z~It wouldn't be nothing, except I know that Ancelotti ain't gonna pay up.
zh: ~z~是没关系，但我知道安切洛蒂不肯出钱。

english: ~z~You got jumped by a white trash biker, Nicky.
zh: ~z~你被那个骑摩托的白垃圾背叛了，尼克。

english: ~z~The diamonds that got robbed off you in the Libertonian.
zh: ~z~在自由城博物馆的时候从你那儿抢来的。

english: ~z~Shit. Come to Drusilla's. And get here sharp.
zh: ~z~妈的。来德鲁西拉's一趟，赶紧过来。

english: ~z~Shit. Come to Drusilla's. And get here sharp.
zh: ~z~妈的。来德鲁西拉's一趟，赶紧过来。

english: ~z~You got jumped by a white trash biker, Nicky.
zh: ~z~你被那个骑摩托的白垃圾背叛了，尼克。

english: ~z~That fucking snake in the grass. When I'm done with that motherfucker...
zh: ~z~这个两面三刀的混蛋。再让我见到他...

english: ~z~So, Nicky, you and the Peg is getting close I see?
zh: ~z~喂，尼克，我看你和佩戈里诺关系挺好嘛？

english: ~z~That fucking snake in the grass. When I'm done with that motherfucker...
zh: ~z~这个两面三刀的混蛋。再让我见到他...

english: ~z~I hear you need work. I wanna throw you a bone, Nicky.
zh: ~z~听说你需要工作。我想给你丢块骨头，尼克。

english: ~z~So, you ain't no item? It ain't like that, is it Niko?
zh: ~z~就是说你俩没好上喽？你俩没好上吧，尼克？

english: ~z~Come over to Drusilla's in Little Italy. We'll have a little sit down.
zh: ~z~来小意大利的德鲁西拉's，一起坐一会儿。

english: ~z~The Irish'll be square with that and you'll be square with me.
zh: ~z~那个爱尔兰人会用人质换它，而你就拿它还我。

english: ~z~I bumped into her, man. I helped her out with a problem she was having.
zh: ~z~偶然碰见了，兄弟。我还帮她解决了一些麻烦。

english: ~z~It's her pal, Gay Tony, that's coughing up with my damn ice.
zh: ~z~出钱的是她朋友，基佬托尼，用老子的钻石顶账。

english: ~z~Yo, I hear you been rolling with Cherise, Niko. You two tight now?
zh: ~z~哟，听说你跟谢丽丝在一起，尼克。你俩好上了？

english: ~z~Sorry, man. She's gone. Maybe things coulda been different in another life.
zh: ~z~抱歉，兄弟。她已经走了。可能下辈子会不一样吧。

english: ~z~If you wanted to pass something up to me... pay me some tribute.
zh: ~z~如果你想孝敬点什么给我...给我上点贡金就行。

english: ~z~Sorry, Ray. I'm freelance. I don't buy into that tribute stuff.
zh: ~z~抱歉，雷。我是自由职业者。贡金之类的我不买账。

english: ~z~Dammit, Nicky. Cut the bullshit. You got 'em? Where are they?
zh: ~z~干他妈的，尼克。别说那个了，到手了吗？在哪儿呢？

english: ~z~I got the money robbed off of me by a biker, remember? The diamonds were sold.
zh: ~z~我的钱被一个飞车党抢走了，记得吗？钻石被卖掉了。

english: ~z~This work has many disadvantages, but, hey, at least it is tax free.
zh: ~z~这个工作是有很多缺点，不过，嘿，至少它不用交税。

english: ~z~Yo, this is Dwayne. I'm out and I ain't letting shit get me down.
zh: ~z~哟，我是德维恩。我现在在外面，不会让别的事妨碍的。

english: ~z~Well, we took it off Tony in the first place, but it shoulda ended there.
zh: ~z~虽然一开始就是从托尼那里偷的，但不该有这么多事的。

english: ~z~Nicky, I got a piece of advice for ya - stay away from Phil. He's causing himself some problems.
zh: ~z~尼基，给你个忠告——离菲尔远点。他在给自己惹麻烦。

english: ~z~Liberty City Dump... I don't know. They got thrown into traffic.
zh: ~z~自由城垃圾场...我不知道。钻石被扔到垃圾车里了。

english: ~z~I don't wanna see you get caught up in it, that's all. Just looking out for ya, pal.
zh: ~z~我只是不想看你卷进去，就这样。照顾你才提醒你，伙计。

english: ~z~Dwayne, she's no good for you. Forget about her. We'll hang out soon. Later on.
zh: ~z~德维恩，她不适合你。忘了她吧。有空一起出去玩。回见。

english: ~z~Nicky, I hear you and the Irish have got your hands on Ancelotti's daughter.
zh: ~z~尼克，我听说你和那个爱尔兰人对安切洛蒂的女儿出手了。

english: ~z~Turns out a serious Russian called Bulgarin claims ownership as well.
zh: ~z~有一个叫布尔加林的麻烦的俄国人也宣称了对它的所有权。

english: ~z~I mean, you got a whole city full a potential lays and he's chasing the skipper's cooze.
zh: ~z~我是说，满城都是随时能上手的姑娘，他偏偏去追头儿的妞。

english: ~z~This is Dwayne, guess not many people got this number cause nobody's calling.
zh: ~z~我是德维恩，我想知道这个号码的人不多，因为没什么人打。

english: ~z~I told you to take our half of the money, and I said let Johnny take the half and you hold onto the other half.
zh: ~z~我让你拿走我们的那一份钱，还说过强尼拿一半你拿另一半。

english: ~z~I told you to take our half of the money, and I said let Johnny take the half and you hold onto the other half.
zh: ~z~我让你拿走我们的那一份钱，还说过强尼拿一半你拿另一半。

english: ~z~Nicky, this is Ray Boccino. The man keeping your Irish friends in liquor.
zh: ~z~尼克，我是雷･博奇诺。就那个让你的爱尔兰朋友有酒喝的人。

english: ~z~Dwayne, it was her. She screwed you over while you were inside. She's dead now.
zh: ~z~德维恩，就是她。你在里面的时候她把你给骗了。她已经死了。

english: ~z~The one you said you killed with Jayvon outside the arcade. You sure that was her?
zh: ~z~之前你说在机厅外面把她和杰丰一起杀了。你确定杀的是她吗？

english: ~z~Because of that I got Phil telling me that the Peg - Jimmy Pegorino - is pissed.
zh: ~z~后果很严重，菲尔告诉我佩戈里诺－吉米･佩戈里诺－很生气。

english: ~z~Because of that I got Phil telling me that the Peg - Jimmy Pegorino - is pissed.
zh: ~z~后果很严重，菲尔告诉我佩戈里诺－吉米･佩戈里诺－很生气。

english: ~z~Nah, man. Don't worry about that. She's not my type. We'll hang out soon.
zh: ~z~没有，兄弟。你放一万个心，她不是我的菜。有空我找你出去玩。

english: ~z~You a good friend, Niko. She ask about me? You think she been thinking about this fool?
zh: ~z~够朋友，尼克。她有问到过我吗？你觉得她还在不在乎我这个傻子？

english: ~z~Yeah? Well, remember who made the introduction. Remember who brought you in, don't you forget about me.
zh: ~z~是吗？记住是谁替你做的介绍。记住是谁引荐的你，你可别忘了我。

english: ~z~Hey, Ray. I got some bad news for you. You weren't the only one who thought they owned those diamonds.
zh: ~z~喂，雷。我有一些坏消息要说。你不是唯一一个觉得钻石是自己的的人。

english: ~z~Dwayne, man. I bumped into your ex. The one that messed you around while you were in the joint.
zh: ~z~德维恩，兄弟。我碰见你前女友了，就是趁你蹲号子的时候背弃你的那个。

english: ~z~This Dwayne. Don't know why I'm doing this. Nobody leaving me messages. You all fake.
zh: ~z~我是德维恩。不知道为什么要这么做。反正没人给我留言。你们这些虚伪的人。

english: ~z~I was in the shower and I heard the phone ringing so I thought you mighta called or something. My bad. Later.
zh: ~z~刚才我洗澡的时候听见手机响了，我就在想可能是你打过来的。我的错。回见。

english: ~z~Niko, man. I was out today and I saw this bitch coming out a nail place. She looked just like my old girl, Cherise.
zh: ~z~尼克，兄弟。今天我出去的时候看见一个从美甲店出来的婊子，长得很像我的老情人谢丽丝。

english: ~z~Hey.
~z~So long.
~z~They fucking better.
~z~I'll pull some strings.
~z~I'll make some calls.
~z~Please hang up and try again.
~z~Be careful what you wish for.
~z~I'll see what I can do...
~z~Niko, it's Gerry.
~z~Gerry, what's this about?
~z~Gerry, how's it going?
~z~I'll do what I can, man.
~z~In here too, for that matter.
~z~How'd the interview go? Is it done?
~z~Come and see me at my ma's house. Use the back entrance.
~z~Don't make me do something I'll regret.
zh: ~z~等我后悔的时候就来不及了。

english: ~z~You're getting too much attention. I can't do nothing.
zh: ~z~你实在是太显眼了，我无能为力。

english: ~z~Frankie boy, it's time for you to get me out of trouble.
zh: ~z~弗兰基仔，你该替我摆平一下了。

english: ~z~Good. Got a little business opportunity I need your help with.
zh: ~z~挺好。有个生意机会需要你帮忙。

english: ~z~You know what, me and Packie get along.
zh: ~z~你猜怎么着，我跟派奇处得很好。

english: ~z~Alright already. You want me to turn water into wine as well?
zh: ~z~好了。你是不是还想我变个魔术？

english: ~z~I guess that's the problem with having gangsters for kids.
zh: ~z~养了几个黑帮儿子，这就是麻烦。

english: ~z~I should meet the other McRearys.
zh: ~z~我就该去找麦克雷里家的其他人了。

english: ~z~Jesus. You're out of control. I'll do my best.
zh: ~z~天哪，你这人已经失控了。我尽力吧。

english: ~z~She didn't need to say goodbye to Derrick with that going on.
zh: ~z~妈不该在那样的情况下跟德里克告别。

english: ~z~This is Francis McReary. Please leave me a message.
zh: ~z~我是弗朗西斯･麦克雷里。请给我留言。

english: ~z~Francis, your fellow police officers are starting to irritate me.
zh: ~z~弗朗西斯，你的警察同僚开始骚扰我了。

english: ~z~But I'll be more of a wreck if any one finds out about this.
zh: ~z~可要是有人发现这事，我会垮得更彻底。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. You're gonna get me arrested. I'll try.
zh: ~z~我靠，尼克。你是想让我坐牢啊。我尽量。

english: ~z~Hey, Francis. I'm feeling the heat. Cool things down.
zh: ~z~嘿，弗朗西斯。有人来抓我了，替我摆平。

english: ~z~We apologize for the inconvenience but this number has been disconnected.
zh: ~z~很抱歉给您带来不便，但此号码已被注销。

english: ~z~Fuck, I shoulda just shot him in the line of duty.
zh: ~z~妈的，当初执行任务时直接毙了他就好了。

english: ~z~Hey Gerry. I heard you'd been locked up, I'm sorry to hear that.
zh: ~z~嘿，格里。听说你进去了啊，真的是很遗憾。

english: ~z~Francis, I got some of your colleagues on me. Get rid of them.
zh: ~z~弗朗西斯，你有几个同事在追我。解决一下。

english: ~z~Niko, a gunfight at my brothers funeral? My poor, poor Ma.
zh: ~z~尼克，在我兄弟的葬礼上枪战？我可怜的妈啊。

english: ~z~I'm not planning on taking him down. He's my damn brother, you idiot.
zh: ~z~我不是要干掉他，那他妈是我弟弟，你个白痴。

english: ~z~Keep your trap shut and I'll try to keep you outta the pen for a bit longer. See ya round.
zh: ~z~管好你的嘴，我尽量让你再多逍遥一阵。回见。

english: ~z~Niko, my boy, this is Packie's brother Gerald McReary.
zh: ~z~尼克，小伙子，我是派奇的哥哥格里･麦克雷里。

english: ~z~Maybe if doing what you do is good, then I wanna be no good instead.
zh: ~z~要是你做的事情是好事，那我还是别做好事了吧。

english: ~z~He said he'd get outta town. I thought that'd be enough for you.
zh: ~z~他说过要离开本城的。我以为那对你就算交代了。

english: ~z~My brothers ain't no good, Niko. Trust me on that.
zh: ~z~我的兄弟都不是什么好人，尼克。这你要相信我。

english: ~z~Just thank the Lord you ran into Packie and not my other brothers.
zh: ~z~感谢上帝你遇到的是派奇，而不是我的其它兄弟。

english: ~z~Hey, I'm playing this game of cops and robbers and it's getting boring. End it.
zh: ~z~嘿，我已经玩腻了警察抓小偷的游戏了。结束它吧。

english: ~z~Maybe at the next McReary family function. Whatever that might be.
zh: ~z~也许下次麦克雷里家的聚会上吧。管它是什么聚会。

english: ~z~They're gonna need some looking after. Especially young Patrick and Katie, my sis.
zh: ~z~他们需要有人照应。尤其是小帕特里克和我妹妹凯特。

english: ~z~Hey, I don't like the sound of sirens. Tell your cop friends to stay away from me.
zh: ~z~嘿，我不喜欢警笛的声音。告诉你的条子朋友别来烦我。

english: ~z~Packie McReary, Francis McReary. It's all starting to make sense.
zh: ~z~派奇･麦克雷里，弗朗西斯･麦克雷里。这就说得通了。

english: ~z~Shit, something came up. I didn't make it. Maybe they'll schedule another one.
zh: ~z~操，突然有点事。我没去成。他们可能会另外安排一次。

english: ~z~Yo, Frankie. The smell of bacon is starting to get on my nerves. Get these cops off my back.
zh: ~z~哟，弗兰基。条子的味道搞得我很不爽。让他们别来追我。

english: ~z~What, are you mental? You shouldn't even be calling me when you're this hot. I don't know you.
zh: ~z~什么，你疯了吗？这么严重了还给我打电话？我不认识你。

english: ~z~Niko, Gerald McReary here. Calling from the Alderney State Correctional Facility.
zh: ~z~尼克，我是格里･麦克雷里。从奥尔德尼州立监狱打过来的。

english: ~z~We gotta discuss something. I've put you on the visitors list here. Come down...
zh: ~z~我们得商讨些事情。我把你写到探监名单上了。来一趟...

english: ~z~This is Gerald. Don't leave me a message 'cause I ain't gonna listen to it and I sure as shit ain't gonna return your call. Fuck off.
zh: ~z~我是格里。别给我留言，我听不了，而且也回复不了。滚蛋。

english: ~z~And the problem with having a dirty cop for a kid is that he'll kill his own brother if he gets in his way.
zh: ~z~养个黑警儿子的问题就在于，谁挡他的道，他连亲兄弟都杀。

english: ~z~If that asshole ever comes back from Ireland, I can't be held responsible for what I'd do.
zh: ~z~要是那个混蛋从爱尔兰回来了，我可不能对我会做出的事负责。

english: ~z~Niko, what's this I hear about you running with Patrick McReary now these days?
zh: ~z~尼克，最近我怎么听说你和帕特里克･麦克雷里跑一块儿去了？

english: ~z~Sorry, you've gone past my jurisdiction. Don't mention my name if you get caught.
zh: ~z~抱歉，你的事已经不是我能摆平的了。就算被捕也别提我的名字。

english: ~z~Easy there, Niko. You think this has been easy for me? I ain't sleeping nights. I'm a wreck.
zh: ~z~别激动，尼克。你以为我轻松吗？我夜夜睡不着。整个人都垮了。

english: ~z~You're a fucking Weazel, Niko. I trusted your word and you screwed me. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~你他妈就是个卑鄙小人，尼克。我信了你的话，你却坑了我。再见。

english: ~z~I want you to look after 'em is all. Keep an eye on 'em. Make sure no harm comes to them. It's a fucked up world out there.
zh: ~z~我只是想让你照应他们。盯紧点。别让他们出事。外面这世界烂透了。

english: ~z~He's got work and he's a good guy. You're not planning on taking him down, are you? Lay off him for me.
zh: ~z~他那儿有活干，他也是个好人，你该不会是想把他给干掉吧？你就别管他了。

english: ~z~Actually, I ain't heard nothing. I've seen him walking down Vauxite Street in the middle of the day.
zh: ~z~其实我什么都没听说。我光天化日亲眼看见他走在 Vauxite 街上。

english: ~z~Packie's just a hood but Gerald is into some serious shit. And Derrick. He's the worst.
zh: ~z~派奇只是个小苍蝇，不过格里就涉及到大案子了。至于德里克，他是最坏的。

english: ~z~Great. Look, Niko. I've always been responsible for my family. Now, one of my brothers is dead and I'm on the inside.
zh: ~z~好极了。听着，尼克。我一直撑着这个家。现在一个兄弟死了，我自己还在坐牢。

english: ~z~I knew Irish families were big but I didn't expect to run into brothers in a place the size of Liberty City.
zh: ~z~我知道爱尔兰家族很大，不过我倒没想到会在自由城这么大的地方遇见一对兄弟。

english: ~z~I just heard that Clarence Jones - that no good, kid killing, drug dealer I paid you to whack - is still alive.
zh: ~z~我刚听说克拉伦斯･琼斯——那个我出钱让你做掉的、杀孩子的烂人毒贩——还活着。

english: ~z~We're lucky to have you in the family.
~z~That's something you're going to have to accept.
~z~Who are you calling, Vlad?
~z~Hey, sorry things didn't work out, goodbye.
~z~Hey, let's keep this a business relationship.
zh: ~z~嘿，咱们还是保持雇佣关系吧。

english: ~z~Vlad? Name doesn't ring any bells. I'm sorry.
~z~You been a useful set of hands. Look after yourself.
zh: ~z~你一直都是个好帮手。照顾好自己。

english: ~z~I'd prefer to be a paid employee than a relative.
zh: ~z~我宁可做拿钱的雇员，也不做亲戚。

english: ~z~Ha, sure, Niko. I'm giving you a gift.
zh: ~z~哈，当然，尼克。我这是送你礼物。

english: ~z~I'm my own man and I follow my own instincts.
zh: ~z~我是独立的人，只跟着自己的直觉走。

english: ~z~Alright Mr. Pegorino, I'll see you there.
zh: ~z~好的，佩戈里诺先生，我会来找你的。

english: ~z~I never made any promises to you, Mr. Pegorino.
zh: ~z~我从没向你许诺过什么，佩戈里诺先生。

english: ~z~You're a snake. You've turned around and bit the hand that fed you.
zh: ~z~你就是条毒蛇。转过头去咬喂养你的手。

english: ~z~Yokel, fatty Roman's cousin, it's Vlad.
zh: ~z~乡巴佬，肥仔罗曼的堂弟，我是弗拉德。

english: ~z~I guess I will. The horse is gone and I can't get Phil on the phone.
zh: ~z~我想会的。货没了，菲尔的电话也打不通。

english: ~z~Who knows what's happened to him. Think of all the money you coulda made.
zh: ~z~谁知道他出什么事了。想想你本来能挣的钱。

english: ~z~This is a gift, Jimmy, or a way for you to keep your eye on me?
zh: ~z~这是礼物，吉米，还是你盯梢我的一种方式？

english: ~z~Salve. This is Jimmy Pegorino's phone. Leave a message.
zh: ~z~你好，这是吉米･佩戈里诺的电话。请留言。

english: ~z~I hope your partnership is a fruitful one. Good luck and goodbye.
zh: ~z~希望你们的合作能有好结果。祝你好运，再见。

english: ~z~Forget about it. I'm gonna hold onto it for a while. Least I could do. Ciao.
zh: ~z~别提了。这钱我先留一阵。算我一点心意。再见。

english: ~z~Niko, what's up, listen. This family's falling a-fucking part.
zh: ~z~尼克，怎么样，听着。这个家正在他妈的四分五裂。

english: ~z~A nice apartment in Alderney City, on Mahesh Avenue. Real classy.
zh: ~z~奥尔德尼市马赫什大道上的一套好公寓。相当气派。

english: ~z~Dimitri and I had unfinished business so I went ahead and finished it.
zh: ~z~迪米特里和我有笔没完的账，所以我去把它了结了。

english: ~z~We're back on top, Niko. The Pegorinos is still somebody.
zh: ~z~我们重振雄风了，尼克。佩戈里诺家族还是有地位的。

english: ~z~Niko, the shit has gone down. I need to see you. Come to the club in Tudor.
zh: ~z~尼克，情况不太妙，我需要见你。到都铎的俱乐部来。

english: ~z~Ahh, the dumb yokel, I meant to call this girl I'm seeing.
zh: ~z~啊，土包子，我本来是想打给我正交往的那个姑娘的。

english: ~z~And that means we're looking after your cousin too. That guy likes to gamble, don't he?
zh: ~z~那就意味着我们也照应着你表哥。那家伙好赌，不是吗？

english: ~z~Now, I'm out. I don't want to get involved in this shit no more. Good luck to you.
zh: ~z~现在，我退出。我不想再掺和这摊子烂事了。祝你好运。

english: ~z~You smug fucking bastard, after all I done for you, you play me like this.
zh: ~z~你个自鸣得意的混蛋，我为你做了那么多，你却这样耍我。

english: ~z~Phil's bringing me my taste of the cash and Dimitri's still got hold of the horse. This is perfect.
zh: ~z~菲尔会把分成给我，迪米特里手上的海马也还在。太完美了。

english: ~z~What'd'ya mean, Niko? We're family. We've welcomed you into the fold.
zh: ~z~你什么意思，尼克？我们是一家人。我们已经把你当自家人了。

english: ~z~Hello, this is Vladimir's answer phone message. Be leaving a recording for me after the buzz has been playing.
zh: ~z~你好，这里是弗拉基米尔的留言信箱。请在蜂鸣声后向我留言。

english: ~z~Money's not what motivates everyone, Mr. Pegorino. I had more important things to think about.
zh: ~z~钱不是驱动每个人的东西，佩戈里诺先生。我有更重要的事要想。

english: ~z~You don't need to do that for my cousin, Mr. Pegorino. I can handle all his debt. I'll cover it.
zh: ~z~不用为我表哥这么做，佩戈里诺先生。他的债我来担。我全包了。

english: ~z~You better start remembering important people you dumb peasant. Your cousin owes me a lot of money.
zh: ~z~你最好记住那些大人物，蠢蛋土包子。你堂兄可欠了我一大笔钱。

english: ~z~Too bad, man. It was clean, wasn't it? Well, maybe you should stay home. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~太糟了，老弟。车本来是干净的吧？大概你还是该待在家里。再见。

english: ~z~I'm not in the family, I'm your employee, Mr. Pegorino. You seem to get this stuff confused.
zh: ~z~我不是家里人，我是你的雇员，佩戈里诺先生。你好像老把这搞混。

english: ~z~She won't be impressed with the way you look, so clean car is good thing. Later on.
zh: ~z~她不会对你的长相留下好印象的，所以一辆干净的车也还不错。回见。

english: ~z~Niko, It's Jimmy. You're doing real well, kid. You're becoming part of the family.
zh: ~z~尼克，是我，吉米。你干得很出色，小子。你正在成为家里的一分子。

english: ~z~Who'd a thought an immigrant from the wrong side of the Adriatic would be the most reliable soldier we got?
zh: ~z~谁能想到，一个从亚得里亚海穷那边来的移民，竟是我们最靠得住的兵？

english: ~z~Don't get cute, kid. It don't suit you. You're staying in Alderney now, just like me and Phil.
zh: ~z~别耍小聪明，小子。不适合你。你现在就待在奥尔德尼，跟我和菲尔一样。

english: ~z~I bought some of his debt for him. Now he don't have to worry about no loansharks coming after him, just me.
zh: ~z~我替他买下了一些债。现在他不用担心放高利贷的追他，只要担心我就行。

english: ~z~How hard would it have been to suck up your pride to do one deal? Now, I got nothing left to lose.
zh: ~z~放下身段做一票生意能有多难？现在，我什么都不剩，也没什么可输的了。

english: ~z~If you don't want to make things real difficult for him you're going to come to Comrades Bar on Mohawk. I have a work for you.
zh: ~z~你要是不想让他难做，就到莫霍克的Comrades酒吧来。我有活给你。

english: ~z~I had that deal set up. I needed this, it was my only way back in and you fucked me.
zh: ~z~那笔交易是我安排好的。我需要这个，那是我翻身的唯一机会，你却坑了我。

english: ~z~Hey baby, how about I take your beautiful ass out tonight? Maybe we can take one of your fat boyfriend's cabs...
zh: ~z~嘿宝贝，今晚我带你这美人儿出去玩怎么样？也许咱们能开你那胖男友的出租车...

english: ~z~Hey, yokel. What the fuck? That car you got to me, it looked like shit. I got a hot date tonight.
zh: ~z~喂，乡巴佬。你搞毛？你给我弄来的车，烂得跟坨屎一样。今晚我还有个火热的约会呢。

english: ~z~For a peasant you did okay. Car looks good. Girl I'm taking out tonight is going to be impressed.
zh: ~z~作为一个乡巴佬你的表现还不错。车子看上去很好。今晚我带出去的姑娘会有个好印象的。

zh: ~z~今天我很高兴。很期待下次再见到你。

english: ~z~Maybe there is more to this place, I'm not sure yet.
zh: ~z~可能还有别的原因，我自己也不太确定。

zh: ~z~没有，估计我这辈子就和工作一起过了。

zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么不早点来赴约？有什么事吗？

zh: ~z~对了，那边上面有个保龄球馆。去那儿吧。

english: ~z~I'd like to know about you though. See the places you hang out.
zh: ~z~我倒是挺想了解你的。想看看你常去的地方。

english: ~z~What have you been doing? Nothing illegal, I hope.
zh: ~z~你刚才干啥去了？希望没做什么违法的事情。

english: ~z~Here we are, this will be fun. Let's play a few frames.
zh: ~z~我们到了，这个很有趣的。我们去打几球吧。

english: ~z~I work with Mallorie. What do you do, exactly?
zh: ~z~我和玛洛丽一起工作的。你到底是做什么的？

english: ~z~All your stuff is new. Some even still have tags on.
zh: ~z~房间里的东西都是新的，有的连标签都没摘。

english: ~z~A lot of people feel that way. It's hard to keep what you do from taking over your life.
zh: ~z~很多人都这样。很难让工作不占据你的生活。

english: ~z~There's nothing else about Liberty City then, just Roman?
zh: ~z~没别的跟自由城有关的理由了吗？只是罗曼？

english: ~z~I like to keep active I guess. Sports, working out, things like that.
zh: ~z~我大概比较好动。运动啊，锻炼啊，诸如此类。

english: ~z~I'm sorry about that, Michelle. I get carried away sometimes.
zh: ~z~很对不起，米歇尔。有时候我会有点情绪失控。

english: ~z~We don't know each other very well, Michelle. I'll talk to you soon.
zh: ~z~我们还不是很熟，米歇尔。下次我会告诉你的。

english: ~z~I'm sorry about the car, Michelle. I can get you a new one.
zh: ~z~车子的事我很抱歉，米歇尔。我会赔你辆新车的。

english: ~z~I'm not a local in Liberty City. I came here from somewhere...
zh: ~z~我也不是自由城本地人。我从其他地方来的...

english: ~z~Sorry I had to run out on our date, Michelle. Something important came up.
zh: ~z~约会中途就走我很抱歉，米歇尔。突然有点急事。

english: ~z~You're good, Niko. That was fun. Will you take me back home now?
zh: ~z~打得真好，尼克。我玩得很开心。你能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Oh, the Midwest. You probably know more people here than me.
zh: ~z~呃，中西部来的。说不定在这你比我认识的人还多。

english: ~z~There's a bowling alley over on the boardwalk. Why don't we play a few frames?
zh: ~z~那边的木板道上有家保龄球馆。要不我们去打几球？

english: ~z~Good game, Niko. We had fun. Will you take me home now?
zh: ~z~打得不错，尼克。挺开心的。你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~I thought you were doing me a favor by going out with me. You're the local.
zh: ~z~我还以为你陪我出来是在迁就我，毕竟你是本地人。

english: ~z~I feel like I should have been more organized. Had a better plan for our date.
zh: ~z~我还是觉得该好好策划一下。给约会弄个更好的计划。

english: ~z~I think you do. There must be something that made you leave your home and come here.
zh: ~z~你应该知道吧。总不会无缘无故就离开老家来这里吧。

english: ~z~So, you don't know many people here in Liberty City. No boyfriends or husbands or anything?
zh: ~z~那，你在自由城认识的人不多喽？没有男友老公啥的？

english: ~z~Roman? He's made some mistakes, got involved with people he shouldn't have but
zh: ~z~罗曼？他确实犯了些错误，认识了一些不该认识的人，但

english: ~z~You already know Roman. I don't hang out with anybody else really.
zh: ~z~罗曼你已经认识了。剩下就没别的人和我一起出去过了。

english: ~z~The carnival's closed, Niko. I think some big developers have bought it or something.
zh: ~z~嘉年华关门了，尼克。我觉得应该是被大开发商买走了。

english: ~z~I can look after myself Michelle, don't worry about me. Sorry again.
zh: ~z~我可以照顾好自己米歇尔，不用这么操心我。很对不起。

english: ~z~You know, the carnival isn't open this time of year. I don't know if it would pass safety regulations anyway.
zh: ~z~嘉年华每年这会儿都不开门。不知道能不能通过安全审查。

english: ~z~I'm working the whole time. Sometimes I think all I am is my job.
zh: ~z~我一直在工作。有时候我都觉得没了工作我就什么都不是了。

english: ~z~I was really looking forward to that, Niko. I'm sorry if it wasn't your thing. Goodbye.
zh: ~z~我本来还很期待的，尼克。如果不是你的事，我很抱歉。再见。

english: ~z~Roman's bullshit stories maybe. I just felt like I needed a new start.
zh: ~z~那大概就是罗曼的狗屁故事了。我只是觉得自己需要一个新起点。

english: ~z~I just want to get to know you, Niko. See the places you hang out. The people you associate with.
zh: ~z~我只想好好了解下你，尼克。看看你常去的地方，见见你的熟人。

zh: ~z~你是不是要去偷车？你是不是和霍夫海滩的犯罪团伙有关系，尼克？

english: ~z~Thanks for taking me out. I haven't been on a date for a while. I'm kind of lonely here.
zh: ~z~谢谢你带我出来玩。我已经很久没有约会了。我在这儿还有点寂寞。

english: ~z~Really? Does Roman get himself into a lot of trouble? Is he involved in criminal stuff?
zh: ~z~真的？罗曼是不是经常惹上一堆麻烦？他有没有和什么犯罪勾当扯上关系？

english: ~z~Niko, the carnival isn't open. I think they're going to turn it into a big Las Venturas style theme park.
zh: ~z~尼克，嘉年华没有开门。我觉得这里会被改造成拉斯文加斯风格的主题公园。

english: ~z~Shame we couldn't finish that game, Niko. It was fun playing though. Can you take me back now?
zh: ~z~没能打完真是遗憾，尼克。不过我还是玩得挺高兴的。你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~I didn't realize you were so violent, Niko. Have you got caught up with the Hove Beach criminals?
zh: ~z~真没想到你是个这么暴力的人，尼克。你是不是和霍夫海滩的犯罪团伙有关系？

english: ~z~I thought you'd be better at that, Niko. We had fun, didn't we? Will you take me back home now?
zh: ~z~我还以为你不止那么点水平呢，尼克。玩得挺开心不是吗？你现在能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Is that a fact? You haven't gotten involved in anything dubious here in Liberty City, have you? You'd tell me if you had, wouldn't you?
zh: ~z~是这样吗？你该不会是跟一些可疑的事情扯上关系了吧？就算扯上了，你也会告诉我吧？

zh: ~z~有个傲慢的美国人想在我们的地盘上卖货。

english: ~z~You pick them up, you show them what happens in America.
zh: ~z~你去接他们，让他们见识见识美国的规矩。

english: ~z~I thought accountants were too boring to steal, I was wrong.
zh: ~z~我原以为会计师太无聊不值得偷，我错了。

english: ~z~~r~Scabs ~s~are continuing to work despite the strike.
zh: ~z~~r~工贼~s~们不顾罢工还在继续干活。

english: ~z~Come get the ~b~heads ~s~and drop them in river, okay?
zh: ~z~来把~b~脑袋~s~拿走扔进河里，好吗？

english: ~z~The first person to bring me ~b~one ~s~will be rewarded.
zh: ~z~第一个给我带来~b~一辆~s~的人有奖。

english: ~z~Destroy ~r~it all ~s~before they can.
zh: ~z~在他们动手之前把~r~一切~s~都摧毁。

english: ~z~If you see any of their ~r~vans ~s~operating, destroy them.
zh: ~z~看到他们的~r~货车~s~在跑，就摧毁。

english: ~z~So nice to know that this country is just as corrupt as homeland.
zh: ~z~知道这个国家和祖国一样腐败，真让人欣慰。

english: ~z~Bring them some ~b~crystal ~s~to keep them quiet.
zh: ~z~给他们带点~b~冰毒~s~，让他们闭嘴。

english: ~z~Get rid of the ~r~gang ~s~for their treatment of him.
zh: ~z~他们那样对他，把~r~帮派~s~解决掉。

english: ~z~I have told the business owners in this area that they should not work.
zh: ~z~我已经告诉这一带的店主们，他们不该营业。

english: ~z~Make an example of ~r~them ~s~to ensure discipline in the union.
zh: ~z~拿~r~他们~s~开刀示众，以正工会纪律。

english: ~z~The ~b~Police Commissioner ~s~is not behaving in way we need him to.
zh: ~z~~b~警察局长~s~的做派不合我们的心意。

english: ~z~This is our opportunity to punish him for getting caught. Kill ~r~him.
zh: ~z~这是我们惩罚他栽了跟头的机会。杀了~r~他。

english: ~z~I cannot get the bloodstains off the upholstery of these ~b~cars.
zh: ~z~这些~b~车~座椅套上的血迹我怎么都弄不掉。

english: ~z~The LCPD are launching simultaneous raids on our operations.
zh: ~z~LCPD 正在同时对我们的生意发起突击搜查。

english: ~z~Maybe if you destroy his ~r~car, ~s~he will see sense.
zh: ~z~说不定你毁了他的~r~车，~s~他就能想通了。

english: ~z~Damn family, eh? Bring ~b~vans ~s~to him.
zh: ~z~唉，该死的一家人。把~b~货车~s~给他送去。

english: ~z~If ~b~they ~s~go blind from sex disease, you will pay.
zh: ~z~如果~b~他们~s~因为性病瞎了眼，你要负责。

english: ~z~Pick ~b~him ~s~up and bring him to me so he can be given discipline.
zh: ~z~把~b~他~s~接来带到我面前，好好管教管教。

english: ~z~I'm not going to use ~b~them ~s~but you are more than welcome.
zh: ~z~我不打算用~b~它们~s~，不过欢迎你随便用。

english: ~z~Round up the ~b~men ~s~so I can show him our strength.
zh: ~z~把~b~人手~s~召集起来，让他见识我们的实力。

english: ~z~Only, we can't leave the heads on because we don't want them identified.
zh: ~z~只是，脑袋不能留在身上，我们不想让他们被认出来。

english: ~z~Russians, we know how to keep mouths shut. Americans just yabber, yabber, yabber.
zh: ~z~我们俄罗斯人懂得闭嘴。美国人就知道叭叭叭个没完。

english: ~z~Stupid ~r~hoods ~s~think they can strong arm our operations.
zh: ~z~蠢货~r~混混~s~以为能对我们的生意强取豪夺。

english: ~z~Grind ~r~them ~s~to dust for their impertinence.
zh: ~z~把~r~他们~s~砸得粉碎，让他们知道放肆的代价。

english: ~z~Destroy the ~r~goods ~s~he is moving before they reach their destination.
zh: ~z~在他运到目的地之前，摧毁他正在运的~r~货~s~。

english: ~z~Vanya is burying the bodies of a stickup crew we had to get rid of.
zh: ~z~瓦尼亚正在埋掉我们不得不解决的那伙持枪劫匪的尸体。

english: ~z~We will show that peasant shit for not allowing me to buy half of his business.
zh: ~z~那个土包子不肯把一半生意卖给我，我们会让他好看的。

english: ~z~I have filled a ~b~vehicle ~s~with explosives, put it in position for me.
zh: ~z~我在一辆~b~车~s~里装满了炸药，替我把它停到位。

english: ~z~Some ~r~ugly bikers ~s~have been fucking with our crew.
zh: ~z~几个~r~丑陋的飞车党~s~一直在找我们的人的麻烦。

english: ~z~Sink these ~b~cars ~s~in water before they stink too bad.
zh: ~z~把这些~b~车~s~沉进水里，趁它们还没臭得太厉害。

english: ~z~We are lucky. They are moving ~r~Sergey ~s~from the courthouse to the jail.
zh: ~z~我们走运。他们正把~r~谢尔盖~s~从法院转往监狱。

english: ~z~My girlfriend blew her yoga instructor. Now we must blow him up.
zh: ~z~我女朋友给她的瑜伽教练口交了。现在我们必须把他炸上天。

english: ~z~We will teach this shit for his reluctance to cut us in on the ~b~cars ~s~he has stolen.
zh: ~z~这混蛋偷了~b~车~s~却不肯分我们好处，得给他点教训。

english: ~z~He is meeting with his ~r~federal government handlers. ~s~None can survive.
zh: ~z~他正在和他的~r~联邦探员上司~s~碰头。一个都不能留。

english: ~z~It is time to tax the local economy for our ~b~protection money. ~s~Go do it.
zh: ~z~是时候向本地经济征收我们的~b~保护费~s~了。去办吧。

english: ~z~Kill his ~r~dealers ~s~and bring their ~b~cars ~s~to me.
zh: ~z~杀了他的~r~毒贩~s~，把他们的~b~车~s~带来给我。

english: ~z~It is time to deliver our ~b~bribes ~s~to the dirty fat cops in the area.
zh: ~z~是时候把这片的~b~贿赂款~s~送给那些又贪又肥的黑警了。

english: ~z~Stupid ~r~punk ~s~is trying to blackmail me. Get rid of him so I don't have to pay.
zh: ~z~蠢货~r~小痞子~s~想勒索我。解决了他，我就不用付钱了。

english: ~z~I do not think it's fair to rub poor peoples' noses in it. Steal the ~b~cars ~s~and bring them to me.
zh: ~z~我不觉得这样羞辱穷人是公平的事。把~b~车~s~偷来给我。

english: ~z~I do not mind cops getting fat off my payoffs, but ~b~Officer MacHale ~s~is too greedy.
zh: ~z~我不介意条子靠我的钱养肥，但~b~麦克海尔警官~s~太贪了。

english: ~z~~b~He ~s~thinks he is meeting me, pick him up and drive him into the river.
zh: ~z~~b~他~s~以为是要来见我。接上他，然后连人带车开进河里。

english: ~z~Only we cannot afford to leave them alone. You must take ~b~cars ~s~anyway and deliver them.
zh: ~z~只是我们不能放着不管。无论如何你得把~b~车~s~弄来交付。

english: ~z~A ~b~prototype gun ~s~has arrived from the Motherland. Made of strong Russian steel.
zh: ~z~一把~b~原型枪~s~刚从祖国运到。用结实的俄罗斯钢铁造的。

english: ~z~I want you strapped to the maximum. I have left ~b~cache of weapons ~s~for just this purpose. Come and get.
zh: ~z~我要你武装到牙齿。我为此留了一批~b~藏匿武器~s~。来拿吧。

english: ~z~Vanya is so lazy. He kills everyone I ask, then he just leaves body in car.
zh: ~z~瓦尼亚太懒了。我让他杀的人他都杀了，然后把尸体就那么扔在车里。

english: ~z~Some foolish members of an ~r~American jury ~s~are not reaching the verdict I desire. Eliminate them.
zh: ~z~~r~美国陪审团~s~里几个蠢货不肯给出我要的裁决。除掉他们。

english: ~z~Urgh. I feel like death. The shitting ~r~manager ~s~at that fast food joint has poisoned me.
zh: ~z~唉。我感觉快死了。那家快餐店该死的~r~经理~s~把我毒坏了。

english: ~z~My new girlfriend is kosher. She cannot stand all these ~r~hot dog stands ~s~in the area.
zh: ~z~我的新女友守洁食戒律。她受不了这一带满地的~r~热狗摊~s~。

english: ~z~Crazy bikers are up all night on meth. They getting too fucking lazy to run their own stills even.
zh: ~z~那帮疯飞车党整夜嗑冰毒。他们他妈的懒到连自己的酿酒坊都不开了。

english: ~z~I hear about big drug deal. You go there, take the ~b~cash and the shit ~s~and you bring to me.
zh: ~z~我听说有一笔大毒品交易。你去那儿，把~b~钱和货~s~带来给我。

english: ~z~I want ~b~sexy car ~s~for myself and stupid Vanya steals whole transporter load of them.
zh: ~z~我想要辆~b~拉风的车~s~自用，蠢货瓦尼亚却偷了整整一运输车。

english: ~z~This time we will not waste energy on stealing broken vibrators. Get the ~b~trucks ~s~back here.
zh: ~z~这次我们不再浪费精力去偷坏掉的振动棒。把~b~卡车~s~开回来。

english: ~z~He is moving them out of the city. Either bring ~b~them ~s~to me or destroy them.
zh: ~z~他正在把它们往城外运。要么把~b~它们~s~带来给我，要么摧毁。

english: ~z~A careless politician does not know what is good for him, he will not give us the contracts we want.
zh: ~z~一个不识相的政客不懂得什么对自己有利，不肯把我们要的合同给我们。

english: ~z~Some freaky ~r~hitmen ~s~are in from out of town. They're trying to whack our crew. Get them first.
zh: ~z~外地来了几个变态~r~杀手~s~。他们想做了我们的人。先下手为强。

english: ~z~I knew something was wrong. Show ~r~him ~s~what death really feels like, okay? Argh.
zh: ~z~我就知道不对劲。让~r~他~s~尝尝死亡到底是什么滋味，好吗？唉。

english: ~z~Damn cops have found some of our ~r~stolen cars. ~s~They are waiting to have them collected by evidence teams.
zh: ~z~该死的条子找到了我们的一些~r~赃车。~s~他们在等取证组来拖车。

english: ~z~I have the itch. Bring me many ~b~prostitute ~s~so I can choose nice girl to scratch it.
zh: ~z~我欲火难耐。给我多带几个~b~妓女~s~来，我好挑个漂亮的降降火。

english: ~z~~r~Boris ~s~the rat has returned to Liberty City. He thinks that all has been forgotten between us.
zh: ~z~叛徒~r~鲍里斯~s~回自由城了。他以为我们之间的一切都一笔勾销了。

english: ~z~I just have problem with her screwing two bit gangsters. Take her ~r~boyfriend ~s~off the market.
zh: ~z~我只是受不了她跟三流混混上床。把她的~r~男朋友~s~从这世上抹掉。

english: ~z~It is bad enough to lose at cards, you do not want ~r~lucky bastard ~s~who wins to start bragging about it.
zh: ~z~打牌输了已经够糟了，你更不想看到赢牌的~r~走运混蛋~s~到处吹嘘。

english: ~z~My wife knows no discretion. She dirties herself with our ~r~plumber.
zh: ~z~我妻子一点分寸都没有。她跟我们家的~r~水管工~搞在一起，自甘下贱。

english: ~z~It does not matter to me what my nephew said or did to these ~r~bikers. ~s~He is family.
zh: ~z~我侄子对这些~r~飞车党~s~说过做过什么，对我来说无所谓。他是家人。

english: ~z~My ~b~daughter ~s~and her ~b~pretty friends ~s~want to go somewhere. Take them.
zh: ~z~我的~b~女儿~s~和她~b~漂亮的朋友们~s~想去个地方。送她们去。

english: ~z~Some peasant ~r~dealer and his crew ~s~think they can rip me off. Me, Kenny Petrovic!
zh: ~z~某个土包子~r~毒贩和他的团伙~s~以为能坑我。坑我，肯尼･彼得罗维奇！

english: ~z~My nephew's crew is going to steal some flat screens, but they need some ~b~vans ~s~to do it with.
zh: ~z~我侄子的人手要去偷一批平板电视，但他们需要几辆~b~货车~s~来干这活。

english: ~z~Autoeroticar is driving sexy ~b~sport cars ~s~around the area as promotion.
zh: ~z~Autoeroticar 正开着性感的~b~跑车~s~在这一带转悠做宣传。

english: ~z~My ~b~stupid nephew ~s~and his ~b~friends ~s~have screwed up a robbery they did not have permission for.
zh: ~z~我的~b~蠢货侄子~s~和他的~b~朋友们~s~搞砸了一场没人批准的抢劫。

english: ~z~~b~Armored vans ~s~are filling up ATMs around the area. Bring them and their contents to me.
zh: ~z~~b~装甲车~s~正在给这一带的 ATM 加钞。把车和里面的东西都带来给我。

english: ~z~See if they are still there when you have destroyed his ~r~campaign posters ~s~and killed his ~r~campaign manager.
zh: ~z~等你毁了他的~r~竞选海报~s~、杀了他的~r~竞选经理，再看他们还在不在。

english: ~z~There is too much money in this crack cocaine to ignore it. Take out all the ~r~dealers ~s~so we can gain control.
zh: ~z~这批快克可卡因里的钱多到不能无视。把~r~毒贩~s~全部干掉，我们就能接手。

english: ~z~A guy I pay in LCPD tells me the Feds are watching the ~b~cars ~s~we have stashed our smack in.
zh: ~z~我在 LCPD 养的人告诉我，联邦探员正盯着我们藏海洛因的那些~b~车~s~。

english: ~z~Cops are seizing our ~r~illegal booze, ~s~they will soon discover that it is mostly paint thinner.
zh: ~z~条子正在查抄我们的~r~私酿酒，~s~他们很快会发现那玩意大部分是油漆稀释剂。

english: ~z~I went to Autoeroticar dealership and he tell me that there is a waiting list for ~b~SuperGTs.
zh: ~z~我去了 Autoeroticar 车行，他告诉我~b~超级 GT 要排队等货。

english: ~z~A group of Albanian ~r~hoods ~s~think they are big enough to muscle us out of an area. Cull some of them.
zh: ~z~一帮阿尔巴尼亚~r~混混~s~自以为翅膀硬了，想把我们从地盘上挤走。削掉几个。

english: ~z~Find the ~r~shits ~s~who took my ~b~car, ~s~kill them and bring it back to me.
zh: ~z~找到那些~r~混蛋~s~，他们偷了我的~b~车，~s~杀了他们把车带回来给我。

english: ~z~That crazy ~b~stuntwoman ~s~bitch still hangs around me. Someone take her off my hands, okay?
zh: ~z~那个疯疯癫癫的~b~特技女演员~s~贱人还在我身边晃悠。谁把她从我手边弄走，好吗？

english: ~z~Show them what they need protection from. Destroy their ~r~vans ~s~and take out their ~r~employees.
zh: ~z~让他们知道他们到底需要防的是什么。摧毁他们的~r~货车~s~，干掉他们的~r~雇员。

zh: 你必须另找一辆载具把彼得罗维奇送到~Y~安全地带。~S~

zh: ~S~你的一名成员已经找到了彼得罗维奇。到~Y~安全区~S~去。

zh: 你必须保护好这个地区。只要附近有警察，彼得罗维奇 就不会离开飞机。

zh: ~z~闭上嘴想想这笔钱吧。要是这还不行，就想想我妹妹。不过话我先撂这儿，

english: ~z~More so. At least we ain't fucking hypocrites. Kate's the only decent one.
zh: ~z~可能还更坏一点。至少我们不来伪君子那套。~n~凯特是唯一一个正派的。

english: ~z~If the Ancelottis hear we've been spending it up they might finger us for this job.
zh: ~z~要是让安切洛蒂家族听说我们花钱太厉害，还不得把我们在做的活计给暴露了。

english: ~z~We did it. Top of the fucking world. Here's your share. Don't go spending it in any Italian restaurants.
zh: ~z~我们做到了，这他妈就是世界第一。这份是你的，不过别拿到意大利餐馆去花。

english: ~z~Not this shit again. I heard this speech a million times. The McRearys ran the city.
zh: ~z~别说这些狗屁了。这套话我都听了几百万回了。麦克雷里家族在城里呼风唤雨。

english: ~z~He may have a badge, but I tell you for a fact he's as crooked as the rest of us McRearys.
zh: ~z~他的确是个警察，不过我跟你讲，实际上他跟我们麦克雷里家族的其他人一样坏。

english: ~z~Shut up, Gordon. So, Niko, when Francis and Gerald was growing up, Frankie becomes an altar boy.
zh: ~z~闭嘴，戈登。听好，尼克，~n~弗朗西斯和格里还小的时候，弗兰基就成了辅祭男童。

zh: ~z~有人轻举妄动，就直接把他干了。

zh: ~z~尼克，你带我们离开这儿。走吧。

zh: ~z~我能想出一条他俩会结婚的原因。

zh: ~z~我可不想被捕，尼克。干掉这些人。

zh: ~z~这话留到我送你们到家的时候说吧。

english: ~z~Aww, you're like fucking Cleopatra...
zh: ~z~噢，你就像那个傻逼埃及艳后...

english: ~z~Was I talking to you, you inbred halfwit?
zh: ~z~我有跟你说话吗，近亲繁殖的智障？

english: ~z~I got enough PE4 here to get through anything they throw at us.
zh: ~z~我手头的PE4足以突破任何障碍。

english: ~z~Wrong time, wrong place. I'll see you around.
zh: ~z~时候不对，地方不对。我们回头见。

zh: ~z~开着警车绝不可能甩掉风头，老兄。

~z~That's government money they're carrying, don't let them get away!
zh: ~z~他们拿的是政府的钱，别让他们跑了！

zh: ~z~派奇，照顾好德里克，他出去太久了。

english: ~z~You're trapped. Lay your weapons down and surrender.
zh: ~z~你们被包围了，放下武器，举手投降。

zh: ~z~跟着我，小子们。我们要带着钱出去。

zh: ~z~我知道他喜欢干架，还是个法外狂徒。

zh: ~z~没时间再下去拿了。撤了吧，小子们。

zh: ~z~我们丢了迈克尔和德里克，这票不值。

english: ~z~No one needs to die, it's just bad luck when you do.
zh: ~z~没有人需要去死，死了只是运气太差。

zh: ~z~德里克，金库大门怎么突破你解决了吗？

zh: ~z~我们可以和平解决。你们已经被包围了。

zh: ~z~尼克，绝不能把这些条子引到家里去。甩掉他们。

english: ~z~Me and me brother will hold the pigs back. Get us a car, Niko.
zh: ~z~我和我兄弟来挡住那群猪。给我们弄辆车，尼克。

english: ~z~Never does, Patrick. The best laid plans of mice and men often go awry.
zh: ~z~从来都不一样，帕特里克。计划永远赶不上变化。

english: ~z~They don't make things easy for us, do they? Damn bridge is blocked.
zh: ~z~他们就是不让我们省心，是吧？该死的桥被封了。

english: ~z~Walk in with guns and bombs, walk out with the cash. Simple as that.
zh: ~z~带着枪和炸弹进去，揣着现金出来。就这么简单。

english: ~z~Now you've said bloody Ireland, that's gonna narrow the search ain't it?
zh: ~z~你他妈说了爱尔兰是吧，这不是又把范围缩小了？

english: ~z~That does not make it any easier to hear. And we aren't safe yet.
zh: ~z~那也没什么区别。~n~我们自己都还没安全呢。

english: ~z~Don't none of you worry about nothing. We're here for the bank's money, it's going to a greater cause.
zh: ~z~你们不用害怕，我们只要银行的钱，都是为你们好。

english: ~z~Alright, alright. Do we all know what we're doing? Once the vault door blows,
zh: ~z~行了行了。各位都搞清楚分工了吗？金库门一炸开，

english: ~z~Sure. So, Derrick, you got the charge rigged up to your phone?
zh: ~z~当然。那德里克，破门的时候是用你的手机引爆吗？

english: ~z~I wasn't just driving you two, the money was in the car as well. Remember that.
zh: ~z~我不只是替你俩开车，车里面可还有钱呢。记着点。

english: ~z~Me and Michael are on the civilians, Derrick and Niko are on employees.
zh: ~z~我和迈克尔负责平民，~n~德里克和尼克负责职员。

english: ~z~when you stop shoving half of Bolivia up your nose every Saturday night!
zh: ~z~只要你别每周六晚上都把半个玻利维亚的毒品吸到肚！

english: ~z~I'm trying to be honest with these people. We've put them through a lot today.
zh: ~z~我只是想对他们诚实点。今天给他们添了够多麻烦了。

english: ~z~You think me, me brother and the money are gonna fit in that thing? Get something bigger.
zh: ~z~你觉得这玩意够装我、我弟弟和钱吗？找辆大点的来。

english: ~z~Once the situation has been controlled, Derrick's going to rig the vault door with explosive.
zh: ~z~场面控制住之后，~n~德里克就用炸药炸开金库大门。

english: ~z~I coulda been nice to him for once in my fucking life. Kid only wanted to help.
zh: ~z~我他妈之前该对他好一点的，这小子只是想帮点忙而已。

english: ~z~-And you remember Michael? St Michael...~n~-Yeah, hey.
zh: ~z~－迈克尔你还记得吧？圣迈克尔...~n~－对，嘿。

english: ~z~Now listen people, we're your friends. Me and me brother here, we...
zh: ~z~你们都听好了，我们是你们的朋友。我和我弟弟会...

english: ~z~Fuck you, take the needle out your arm then tell me what to do.
zh: ~z~操你妈！先把你膀子上的针头拔下来，再对我发号施令。

english: ~z~All makes sense to me. If you guys can stop arguing for a few minutes then I think we might be okay.
zh: ~z~我是明白了。只要你们少吵一会儿架，我们基本就稳了。

english: ~z~He loved you, Packie. He was happy you spoke to him. Didn't matter what you was saying.
zh: ~z~他爱你，派奇。你跟他说话他就很高兴了，你说什么都行。

english: ~z~nothing personal, but don't fuck with my family, or I will fuck with yours.
zh: ~z~我不是针对你，但你别给我的家族添乱，否则我要你家好看。

english: ~z~I was just saying how I'd do what you said, Packie. No need to get abusive.
zh: ~z~我只是说一下我怎么执行而已，派奇。~n~用不着骂我吧。

english: ~z~Yeah? They said catching that pass at my high school championship football game was a "bad idea"
zh: ~z~是吗？我在高校橄榄球决赛的那次接球也被说是「坏主意」，

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. You want to leave one of us behind? Get something we're all gonna fit in.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。你是想扔下我们之一吗？找辆我们乘得下的东西。

english: ~z~Why're you tellin' them we're brothers, you idiot? That's going to make it hard for them to find us, isn't it?
zh: ~z~你丫说我们是兄弟干嘛，傻逼吗？这不是更容易让我们被抓？

english: ~z~It was meant to be easy, Niko. It was meant to be fun. Shit. See you round.
zh: ~z~明明应该很容易的，尼克。明明应该很快乐的。靠。回头见。

english: ~z~Niko, these are my two brothers, well two of my brothers, the two that count.
zh: ~z~尼克，他们是我的两个哥哥，其中两个哥哥，说得上话的两个。

english: ~z~I want Niko and Michael to go down into the vault to get the money while me and my brother handle the crowd control.
zh: ~z~尼克和迈克尔就冲进金库拿钱，~n~我和我哥负责控制人群。

english: ~z~We ain't going back to me ma's house with all this heat, man. Shake the cops.
zh: ~z~风头这么紧，我们可不能就这么回我妈家，老兄。把条子甩掉。

english: ~z~Eye on the road, Niko. We don't want you to have to break no bad news to our ma.
zh: ~z~好好看路，尼克。~n~我们可不想让你跟妈汇报什么坏消息。

english: ~z~There was no need for a brother and sister to get married, but your parents did that and now you're here.
zh: ~z~兄妹之间也用不着结婚，~n~但是你父母结了，现在才有了你。

english: ~z~This is an emotional moment, I can feel the brotherly love in the air.
zh: ~z~真是感人肺腑，我都能感受到~n~空气中弥漫着的兄弟之爱了。

english: ~z~You was gone a long time, Derrick. From what I remember, you've changed too.
zh: ~z~你走得有点久了，德里克。~n~你也和我记忆中的你改变了太多。

english: ~z~Niko is a trip, man, I met him through that Puerto Rican coke dealer...
zh: ~z~尼克是个猛男，老兄。我在波多黎各可卡因贩子那里认识他的...

english: ~z~When your kid is living the life, you gotta expect someone to come through the door and break this sorta news.
zh: ~z~既然孩子过着这种日子，~n~就该想到早晚会有人进来说这种事。

english: ~z~Me and St. Michael here are gonna handle the civilians while Niko and Derrick manage the employees.
zh: ~z~我和这位圣迈克尔控制平民，~n~尼克和德里克就负责解决职员。

english: ~z~I scored a touchdown and won the game. The world is built out of bad ideas, my friend.
zh: ~z~我触地得分赢得了比赛。世界终究是由各种坏主意构成的，我的朋友。

english: ~z~He's sitting tight now. Paid for his stupidity. Man, I'm jumpy.
zh: ~z~现在他老实了。为他的愚蠢付出了代价。~n~老弟，我有点紧张了。

english: ~z~Can't wait to see what sort of kick C4 residue is going to give me when I snort up a line of chop though one of them notes.
zh: ~z~我都忍不住想见识下~n~沾着C4的钞票卷出来的大麻烟有多爽了。

english: ~z~Alright, here's how the shit is going down. We're gonna go inside and each take down a security guard.
zh: ~z~好了，我先说下这票的安排。~n~进去以后我们一人解决一个保安。

english: ~z~You know nothing about nothing, Patrick. I'm honest about me demons.
zh: ~z~你真的是连个屁都不知道，帕特里克。~n~我的恶毒可不是开玩笑的。

english: ~z~Don't need to tell me twice, Packie. I'm ready to go. Pumped, is what I am.
zh: ~z~用不着再跟我说一次，派奇。~n~我已经准备好了。热血沸腾就是我了。

english: ~z~That's a bad omen if ever I saw one. We didn't even get to the damn bank. I'll speak to you soon, Niko.
zh: ~z~这要还不算凶兆，我就没见过凶兆。咱们连银行都没进去。回头再聊，尼克。

english: ~z~Yeah, well, now I gotta explain to his folks that their son is lying dead on the floor of a bank in Algonquin.
zh: ~z~现在我就得去跟他家里解释说~n~他儿子死在阿尔冈琴一家银行的地板上了。

english: ~z~Gerry was right about you, Mikey. Your parents must have been twins to produce a kid as dumb as you.
zh: ~z~格里说你说的是一点没错，迈基。~n~你爸妈得是龙凤胎才能生出你这么个白痴。

english: ~z~Michael didn't get lucky, did he? Fucking have-a-go-hero. What was he thinking? He shoulda sat tight.
zh: ~z~是迈克尔运气不好，是吧？去他妈的英勇就义。~n~什么傻逼路人？趴着又不会死。

english: ~z~Safe to say, what we're using is controllable enough to go through any vault door without incinerating whatever's inside.
zh: ~z~这么说吧，这种炸药可控性强，~n~能够炸穿任何金库大门，还不会损伤里面的东西。

english: ~z~We won't forget it, Niko. Here's your cut. I'll tell Gerry you did good. He might give you a call or something.
zh: ~z~我们不会忘的，尼克。这是你的那份。~n~我会告诉格里你干得很好的。改天他可能会打电话找你。

english: ~z~Screw you all!
~z~I don't like this.
~z~Motherfuckers!
~z~Niko! Cover!
~z~You ain't taking me down!
~z~Get outta the fucking way!

~z~Niko, find some cover.
~z~Find some cover, Niko.

~z~Niko, get in cover.
~z~Get in cover, Niko.

~z~Let's get down here, come on.
~z~Get in some cover, Niko.
~z~Shit, Niko. Take him down.
~z~Bring them down, Niko.

~z~Packie, get in cover now.
~z~Come on, into this car park.
~z~You're guarding the rear, Niko.

~z~There ain't no reason to get in my way.

~z~Take that guy down, Niko.
~z~Both of you shut the fuck up.
~z~Here we go, boys!
~z~Our left side is secure, people.
~z~Get that fucker, Niko.
~z~Here come some heavy hitters, people.
~z~Up, up, up. Come on, let's go.
~z~Head into this car park, people.

~z~You don't want to get in my way.
~z~Shit, Niko. Find some cover.

~z~This is making me nervous, boys.

~z~Cop car, boys! Watch it.

~z~Let us go fucking peaceful like!

~z~Can you get us some transport, Niko?
~z~Cover us while we make a run for it, Niko.
~z~Both of you shut up. You're behaving like children.

~z~Hold 'em off for a minute, boys.
~z~You don't wanna stand in our fucking way.
zh: ~z~你们最好别他妈挡我们的路。

english: ~z~Don't stand in our way because we don't want to hurt you.
~z~Hold these bastards back, boys.
~z~We're gonna head right, okay? Move it.
~z~Ain't no one coming at us from the right, people.
~z~Don't be fucking stupid, get in cover, Niko.
~z~You ain't invincible, Niko. Get in cover.
~z~Fuck, boys. I ain't doing too good over here.
~z~You ain't looking too good, Niko. Hang in there.
~z~Hurry up and shoot the fucking lock, will you?
~z~I'm gonna give myself a double dose when I get home.
zh: ~z~回了家我得给自己来双倍剂量。

english: ~z~The train's heading right for us. Watch yourselves.
zh: ~z~列车直冲着咱们来了。都留神。

english: ~z~Moment of truth, boys. Let's go!
~z~Okay, we're making a right up here. Come on.
~z~Alright, we make a move around the back. Follow me.
zh: ~z~好了，我们绕到后面去。跟我来。

english: ~z~Niko, you gotta hang in there. Don't die on us.
zh: ~z~尼克，撑住。可别死在我们前头。

english: ~z~More cops are joining in the party, boys.
zh: ~z~更多的警察加入派对了，小子们。

english: ~z~This ain't working. We need to get out of here.
zh: ~z~这样撑不住了。我们得离开这儿。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. They're all over me.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。他们全朝我扑过来了。

english: ~z~Packie, get in cover before you get yourself killed.
zh: ~z~派奇，赶紧找掩护，别把命丢了。

english: ~z~There's a fucking train coming. Watch out.
zh: ~z~有辆该死的列车开过来了。小心。

english: ~z~That's gotta be a service exit. Let's hit it.
zh: ~z~那个应该是维护出口，走那儿吧。

english: ~z~We got cops following us, boys.
zh: ~z~条子跟在咱们屁股后面，小子们。

english: ~z~Down these stairs, men. Come on.
zh: ~z~从这道楼梯下去，弟兄们。快点。

english: ~z~Fucking get rid of these guys, Niko.
zh: ~z~尼克，把这帮家伙他妈的清干净。

english: ~z~Give us some cover while we run for the subway, Niko.
zh: ~z~尼克，掩护我们，我们冲去地铁站。

english: ~z~We just made a withdrawal, what's the problem?
zh: ~z~我们不过是要撤退而已，搞什么啊？

english: ~z~They've sent in another fucking van, boys.
zh: ~z~他们又派来一辆该死的车，小子们。

english: ~z~The fucking train is running us down. Christ.
zh: ~z~该死的列车朝我们碾过来了。老天。

english: ~z~These cops is gonna fucking trap us in this tunnel. Shit!
zh: ~z~这群条子想把我们困在隧道里，操！

english: ~z~I need you to clear the area for us, Niko.
zh: ~z~尼克，把这片清干净，给我们开路。

english: ~z~Control yourself, Derrick. I got a plan.
zh: ~z~控制住自己，德里克。我有主意了。

english: ~z~That's gotta be a way outta here, boys. Come on.
zh: ~z~那边应该有路出去，小子们。来吧。

english: ~z~You're right. Let's cut around the back. Follow my lead.
zh: ~z~你说得对。我们从后面绕。跟我走。

english: ~z~Will you shoot the fucking lock already, Niko?
zh: ~z~尼克，你能不能快点把那破锁打烂？

english: ~z~That's a fucking sea of blue. Get in cover, boys!
zh: ~z~我操，全是蓝制服。找掩护，小子们！

english: ~z~Shit, just staying here ain't going to work. There are too many of them.
zh: ~z~操，光守在这儿不行。他们人太多了。

english: ~z~Okay, boys. We're outta here. Follow me round the back.
zh: ~z~好了小子们。我们撤。跟我从后面绕。

english: ~z~Great, we're free from this fucking dungeon. Let's go.
zh: ~z~太好了，总算逃出这个鬼地牢了。走。

english: ~z~Let's bring this fucker down. Empty everything we got into him.
zh: ~z~把这个狗逼打下来。射光手头的弹药。

english: ~z~You coulda mixed the explosive better couldn't ya, Derrick?
zh: ~z~炸弹你可以弄得更好点的吧，德里克？

english: ~z~Just what we needed, boys. More fucking cops.
zh: ~z~真是时候，小子们。又他妈一群条子。

english: ~z~You've been beat up good, Niko. Pull through, okay?
zh: ~z~尼克，你被打得不轻。撑下去，好吗？

english: ~z~There's light at the end of the tunnel, boys. We're nearly there.
zh: ~z~小子们，隧道尽头见光了。快出去了。

english: ~z~There ain't no way round these fucks, we're going through 'em.
zh: ~z~绕不开这些混蛋了，我们直接杀过去。

english: ~z~If this was easy then everyone would rob banks.
zh: ~z~要是这行当容易，人人都在抢银行了。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. Will you handle these boys?
zh: ~z~操，尼克。这几个家伙你应付得了吗？

english: ~z~There are too many of them, we'll die if we stay here.
zh: ~z~他们人太多了，再耗下去我们都得死。

english: ~z~Alright man, get these guys, will ya?
zh: ~z~好了兄弟，把这些家伙解决掉，好吗？

english: ~z~The cops is down here too. Check over there, boys.
zh: ~z~下面也有条子。进去小心点，小子们。

english: ~z~Another fucking truck full of 'em. They're blocking us in.
zh: ~z~又他妈一卡车他们的人。把我们围死了。

english: ~z~I got plans for this money. I ain't dropping it.
zh: ~z~我都想好这钱咋花了，我是不会放弃的。

english: ~z~We don't want another casualty on this job. Hang in there, Niko.
zh: ~z~这一单不想再多一条人命。撑住，尼克。

english: ~z~This'll all be worth it when we're back at Ma's with the cash.
zh: ~z~等我们带着钱回到妈家里，这些都值了。

english: ~z~Shit, a N.O.O.S.E. van.
~z~We got some climbing to do, boys. Hold onto your money.
zh: ~z~我们要往上爬了，小子们。把钱拿住喽。

english: ~z~Niko, make sure we're not being fucked from behind.
zh: ~z~尼克，看住后面，别让人抄了咱们后路。

english: ~z~Let's charge through these fucks, people. There ain't no time for second thoughts.
zh: ~z~冲垮这些挡路的，各位。没时间犹豫了。

english: ~z~Alright, Niko. Take us back to my ma's, will ya?
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。把我们送回我妈家，行吗？

english: ~z~Everybody get down. We don't want no one hurt who don't gotta be.
zh: ~z~所有人都趴下。能不伤的人我们不想伤。

english: ~z~We ain't doing that neither. Follow me. We'll lose them in the subway.
zh: ~z~不用这么做。跟我来，进地铁站甩掉他们。

english: ~z~We ain't got no choice, people. We gotta head onto the track.
zh: ~z~我们没别的选择了，各位。只能走铁轨了。

english: ~z~Jesus, they're blocking off the damn road. There's another truck full of those bastards.
zh: ~z~我的天，他们把路封了。又是一卡车杂种。

english: ~z~Go back home to your kids. You don't wanna die here.
zh: ~z~回家带孩子去吧。你们不会想死在这儿的。

english: ~z~Jesus, Niko. You look like death. Come on.
zh: ~z~我的天，尼克。你伤得跟死人一样。撑住。

english: ~z~Looks like we got a whole precinct worth a cops out here. Get in some cover.
zh: ~z~外面来的条子怕是有半个警局。快找掩护。

english: ~z~I ain't gonna be around much longer at this rate. Fucking help me!
zh: ~z~照这么下去我撑不了多久了。快来帮帮我！

english: ~z~They're after us, boys. Check the other platform.
zh: ~z~他们还在追我们，小子们。注意另一个站台。

english: ~z~You're doing fucking great, boys. Let's get up these stairs.
zh: ~z~你们都他妈干得很好，小子们。赶紧上楼吧。

english: ~z~Our argument's with the police, not innocent civilians. Get down.
zh: ~z~我们跟警察有过节，不关平民的事。都趴下。

english: ~z~Shit, you don't never know what you're dealing with when you're in Chinatown.
zh: ~z~操，你永远不会知道你在唐人街干的是谁的。

english: ~z~Shit, this door's locked. Shoot the lock, Niko. We got you covered.
zh: ~z~操，这门锁着。把锁打烂，尼克。我们掩护你。

english: ~z~Chinatown always smells like Chinatown no matter where you are or how much gun powder is in the air.
zh: ~z~火药打得再多，唐人街还是一股唐人街的味儿。

english: ~z~Fuck, the door's locked. Shoot the lock out, Niko. We'll cover you.
zh: ~z~妈的，门锁着。把锁打烂，尼克。我们掩护你。

english: ~z~You almost lost me and a big bag of money there, boys.
zh: ~z~你们刚才差点就要没了我和一大包钱，小子们。

english: ~z~Watch the bags, boys. We don't want holes in our notes.
zh: ~z~包当心点，小子们。大家都不想钞票上长眼儿。

english: ~z~I got told this was going to be a smooth job. Real easy, they told me. No casualties.
zh: ~z~他们跟我说这票很顺。说容易得很。不会出人命。

english: ~z~Get in cover, Packie. Ma'd be real upset if you got hit.
zh: ~z~找掩护，派奇。妈要是知道你挨了枪非得伤心死。

english: ~z~I can taste the fresh air, boys. Can't have long to go.
zh: ~z~小子们，我都尝到新鲜空气的味儿了。快到头了。

english: ~z~Niko you're the getaway driver. Will ya get us back to my ma's?
zh: ~z~尼克，你是接应司机。把我们送回我妈家，行吗？

english: ~z~This ain't my idea of fun, boys. Would ya give me a hand?
zh: ~z~要我说这可算不上寻开心，小子们。谁来搭把手？

english: ~z~Shit, they've followed us down here. They're in the subway too.
zh: ~z~操，他们跟到这儿来了，地铁站里也是他们的人。

english: ~z~How is you, me and Derrick gonna fit in there with the money?
zh: ~z~就你我还有德里克，加这一堆钱，那车怎么坐得下？

english: ~z~Shit, they sent a chopper after us. There ain't no getting away. We're done.
zh: ~z~操，他们派出直升机了。这下逃不掉了，我们完了。

english: ~z~They ain't gonna get us from behind, boys. I got it covered.
zh: ~z~他们休想从背后偷袭我们，小子们。后面有我盯着。

english: ~z~Make sure these pricks don't shoot the bags. Notes with bullet holes in 'em are gonna be mighty hard to get rid of.
zh: ~z~别让这些屌人打到包上面。有弹孔的钱可花不出去。

english: ~z~I'm gonna knock myself out for the fucking count. Try to forget about all this shit.
zh: ~z~非得把自己折腾到不省人事，好把这些破事统统忘掉。

english: ~z~A whole van fulla N.O.O.S.E., boys..
zh: ~z~一整个车的 N.O.O.S.E. 家伙，小子们。

english: ~z~You knew what this job was when you signed up. Don't pretend that you're all holier than thou.
zh: ~z~入伙的时候你就知道干的是这买卖。少装得道貌岸然。

english: ~z~Alright, boys. The only way we got to go is along the tracks. Come on.
zh: ~z~好了小子们。我们唯一的去路就是顺着轨道走了。来吧。

english: ~z~We'll be laughing about this shit tomorrow, boys, I promise ya that.
zh: ~z~明天咱们就能拿今天这些破事开涮了，小子们，我保证。

english: ~z~The can't be another truck full of them. Jesus. They're blocking the roads.
zh: ~z~不会又是一整车他们的人吧。我的天。他们把路都封了。

english: ~z~He's going to love the fact that us boys pulled off the biggest bank heist in this city's history.
zh: ~z~我们哥几个干成了本市史上最大银行劫案，他肯定乐坏了。

english: ~z~And you coulda been more careful of your boy Michael. He should be with us right now.
zh: ~z~你咋不多护着点你手下的迈克尔，~n~否则他哪会没命啊。

english: ~z~I saw your eyes light up when you thought about all the drugs you could buy with this haul.
zh: ~z~你盘算这批钱能买多少毒品的时候，我看得见你眼睛都亮了。

english: ~z~Looks like we got more N.O.O.S.E. to deal with, people.
zh: ~z~看来还得再收拾几股 N.O.O.S.E. 的人，各位。

english: ~z~Michael was unlucky. It wasn't anybody's fault what happened to him and the explosive did its job.
zh: ~z~迈克尔运气差了点。~n~他出事怪不了谁，炸弹也够好了。

english: ~z~Niko, that thing can't take all of us and this cash. Use your head, man.
zh: ~z~尼克，那破车坐不下我们几个加这一堆钱。用用脑子吧，兄弟。

english: ~z~I never shoulda come back to Liberty City. I knew Gerald would get me back into this shit.
zh: ~z~我就不该回自由城。我早知道格里会把我重新拖进这堆烂事里。

english: ~z~This is typical. A typical fucking McReary family screw up. Can't we do nothing right.
zh: ~z~真是一如既往。麦克雷里家祖传的搞砸。我们就没有做对的事吗。

english: ~z~This ain't the type of thing I agree with. I ain't in it for the money. I believe in something, you know?
zh: ~z~这种事我可不认同。我不是为了钱入的伙。我是有信仰的人，懂吗？

english: ~z~I ain't been here since Frankie threw me a farewell dinner when I was going to Ireland. That was a lifetime ago.
zh: ~z~上次来这儿还是去爱尔兰之前，弗兰基为我饯行的时候。已经是很久以前了。

english: ~z~Sure you do, you believe in the needle and its power to make the rest of the world disappear, while you dream of nonsense.
zh: ~z~是啊你当然有信仰——你信针头，信它能让你把全世界都忘掉，整天做着白日梦。

english: ~z~Jesus, Packie. Show some fucking consideration. Sorry if I'm a man of principle unlike you and Gerald.
zh: ~z~我的天，派奇。多少替人考虑考虑，行吗。对不起了，不像你和格里，我可是有原则的人。

english: ~z~Cool.
~z~Please?
~z~Okay.
~z~Where?
~z~Good for you!
~z~Excuse me?
~z~I bet they did.
~z~Be smart, friend.
~z~Damn those blackouts.
~z~Positive, that's me.
~z~I'm going to pay him back.
~z~I'm over that shit!
~z~What made you want to get clean?
~z~But I'm all sorted out now.
~z~He's gonna pay his debt.
~z~You'll be okay. Just chill out.
~z~Positive thinking is what it's all about.
~z~He doesn't want no trouble.
~z~No, sir. No way.
~z~It's good to share.
~z~I thought maybe that was another guy.
~z~You don't need to worry about those guys no more.
~z~Dry now though, dry as a bone.
~z~Good! Why are you telling me this?
~z~That's not what I meant, friend.
~z~Mel ain't nearly hit rock bottom yet.
~z~I don't wanna spend them staring into the bottom of a glass.
~z~Yeah, you're right. Just chill out.
~z~whoa, like the fucking sprinkler had gone off.
~z~Shit, I can't remember none of that.
~z~Oh - oh, I'm getting the shakes again!
~z~and... he's kind of angry.
~z~Oh, no! Wait, wait, wait!
~z~They're just off Montauk in an alley.
zh: ~z~他们在蒙托克大道的巷子里。

english: ~z~That bar... Mickey's place.
~z~Maybe I'll keep a ten spot for myself though.
zh: ~z~要么还是给我自己留十块吧。

english: ~z~Comrades!
~z~Can you take me back to where we were before?
zh: ~z~你能送我回我们碰到的地方吗？

english: ~z~You got a lot of debt to pay, Mel.
zh: ~z~你要还的可不止这么点，梅尔。

english: ~z~Mel owes me one hell of a lot now.
zh: ~z~梅尔现在欠我的可是多了去了。

english: ~z~He's in an alley off of Montauk Avenue.
zh: ~z~他在蒙托克大道的一条巷子里。

english: ~z~I been waiting to see this drunk ass loser for a long time.
zh: ~z~我等着见这个屌丝酒鬼很久了。

english: ~z~I don't think those guys are going to be calling that debt in.
zh: ~z~我想这些人再也不会来催债了。

english: ~z~I'm positive person now. Positive.
zh: ~z~我现在是个积极的人了。积极。

english: ~z~Why didn't I fucking control myself?
zh: ~z~为什么以前我他妈控制不了自己？

english: ~z~Drinking their lives away, it's not for me.
zh: ~z~把命浪费在喝酒上，我不想这样。

english: ~z~Don't worry. I'll make sure everything's cool.
zh: ~z~不用担心，我会保证一切顺利的。

english: ~z~I'm waking up before noon, for Christ's sake.
zh: ~z~我居然在中午之前就醒了，老天。

english: ~z~Maybe just one drink would calm my nerves?
zh: ~z~说不定来上一杯能让我镇定一点？

english: ~z~Here's the roll I was gonna give that loanshark.
zh: ~z~这一叠本来是要给那个高利贷的。

english: ~z~Shaking off all the negative energy and concentrating on the productive.
zh: ~z~摆脱所有负能量，专注那些有益的。

english: ~z~That stuff is what got you here in the first place.
zh: ~z~那玩意就是导致你现状的罪魁祸首。

english: ~z~You seemed to like it when I last met you?
zh: ~z~我上次见着你的时候你不就这样吗？

english: ~z~I was done with Mel's drunk ass weeks ago.
zh: ~z~几周前梅尔就用他的酒酿屁股还过了。

english: ~z~You're a saint, a real positive person.
zh: ~z~你简直是圣人啊，是个真正积极的人。

english: ~z~I don't suppose you could come along and keep him cool?
zh: ~z~你能不能陪我一起去，好让他冷静点？

english: ~z~And you shoulda seen the can after I was done with it,
zh: ~z~真该让你看看我刚戒酒那会儿的厕所。

english: ~z~Ha ha! That's about right. I was a mess, a mess!
zh: ~z~哈哈！就是这个。不堪回首啊，不堪！

english: ~z~Yes... you were the drunk guy who fell over.
zh: ~z~对...你就是那个摔了一跤的醉汉。

english: ~z~Not hanging around with losers like Sergei.
zh: ~z~不再跟谢尔盖那样的人生输家一起混。

english: ~z~I want to be someone, help people... seriously!
zh: ~z~我想做点什么，帮助别人...真的！

english: ~z~You'd be amazed by the things I've been doing since I cleaned up.
zh: ~z~你一定会对我从良后的生活大为惊奇的。

english: ~z~I'm through with problems. Now they are just opportunities.
zh: ~z~我不再畏惧问题了。现在问题都是机会。

english: ~z~Well, good luck with your opportunities. I've got to go.
zh: ~z~那行，抓住机会，祝你好运。我得走了。

english: ~z~Shit, I couldn't hold a glass of water without spilling it all over myself.
zh: ~z~操，连杯水都拿不住，全洒自己身上了。

english: ~z~How many good years have I got left, ten... fifteen? Not many.
zh: ~z~我还有几年好活...十五年？没那么久。

english: ~z~Hey man, we're here to pay back the money my friend here owed you.
zh: ~z~喂，老兄，我们是来还我朋友欠你的钱的。

english: ~z~Who knows what I'll need. So long. Be serene...
zh: ~z~谁知道我会需要什么。再见。宁静点...

english: ~z~Oh boy, that shook me up, man. The stress was too much.
zh: ~z~噢兄弟，我差点就动摇了。刚才压力太大了。

english: ~z~This is where they should be. Can you clear things up with him?
zh: ~z~他们应该在这儿了。你能和他把话说清楚吗？

english: ~z~Obviously, the DTs hit me pretty hard when I first got sober.
zh: ~z~显然，我头一回没醉的时候戒断反应很明显。

english: ~z~Didn't I see you at Comrades, pal?
~z~No more drink. No drugs... even gave up hookers. Everything.
zh: ~z~不喝酒，不吸毒...鸡都不叫了。全给戒了。

english: ~z~You think money's gonna do it? Do ya, Mel?
zh: ~z~你丫以为这事儿是钱能解决的吗？是吗，梅尔？

english: ~z~I owe a guy some money, from my drinking days...
zh: ~z~我还欠着一个人钱，还喝酒的时候欠下的...

english: ~z~Thanks, man. Can you take me back to where we were before?
zh: ~z~谢了，老兄。你能送我回来这儿前的那个地方吗？

english: ~z~Pissing all over my couch? Slumlord kicked me out on the street.
zh: ~z~把我的沙发尿得一团糟？搞得房东把我赶到大街上。

english: ~z~I know... this is a lot to ask, but I was wondering...
zh: ~z~我知道...这个要求有点过分，不过我在想...

english: ~z~ I'm sure you was one of those commie bastards used to come in there. I remember you.
zh: ~z~你肯定是那群整天来的共产混蛋中的一个。我记得你。

english: ~z~Yeah... yes, siree. I'm a new man. Not dependent on anything.
zh: ~z~对...完全就是。我重新做人，不会依赖任何东西了。

english: ~z~Can't you remember coming over to my place and throwing the TV out the window?
zh: ~z~你是不是忘了你之前来我家把我电视砸窗户外边的事情了？

english: ~z~How am I gonna cope out here? Who knows what I did when I was on the sauce?
zh: ~z~这我还怎么在这儿混啊？谁知道我喝醉的时候都干了什么？
