english: Shuts Down Public Transportation
City Overreacts

City officials gave no word as to when this siege on common sense will continue, but residents are urged to support liberal candidates in the next election so we can have our freedoms back, like the important freedom to ban smoking, profanity or anything that might upset people who recycle.
zh: 市政府官员没有透露这场对常识的围攻会持续多久，但是居民被怂恿在下一次选举中支持自由派候选人，这样我们就可以重获自由，比如禁止吸烟和脏话的重要自由，出台令垃圾分类践行者落泪的政策的重要自由。

english: The so called "War on Terror" is now a war on commuters and the poor, who don't have helicopters but instead are forced to use trains, bridges and tunnels, many of which are closed after an unsubstantiated Internet threat. Rather than broker peace talks and work to end global warming, Liberty City politicians and federal agents are flush with anti-terror cash which they stuff down the panties of defense contractors to turn this city into a war zone.
zh: 所谓的「反恐战争」却成为了一场针对通勤者和穷人的战争。他们没有直升机，只能选择城铁、桥梁和隧道，而未经证实的网络恐怖威胁封堵了他们仅剩的选择。自由城的政客和联邦探员并没有选择和平谈判，也没有尝试解决气候变暖，反倒将反恐资金塞进国防承包商的口袋，把本市变成了战区。

english: A Fresh Approach To Parenting?
New E-fridge can track your child's eating habits
zh: 可以记录你孩子饮食习惯的新款智能冰箱

english: The Panoramic e-fridge 5000 detects the user of your fridge and monitors nutritional habits. A midnight snack of frozen French fries, pizzas with mustard and fishstick bacon omelets will trigger the intelligent engine and send an email to mom and dad that their child is most likely high as shit. If the e-fridge 5000 detects that it hasn't been accessed by your daughter in a few days, an eating disorder alert will be sent. The price is planned at $6,000.
zh: 全景牌5000型智能冰箱会检测冰箱使用者的身份，并监测其营养习惯。一份速冻薯条、芥末披萨和炸鱼条培根蛋卷组成的夜宵将触发智能引擎，向父母发送一封电子邮件，告诉他们的孩子很可能在家嗨到不行了。如果5000型智能冰箱检测到你的女儿数日没有使用记录，就会发送饮食失调警告。目前产品的计划售价为$6000。

english: While most liberal-minded voters are opposed to the constant electronic monitoring of American citizens, as parents, we owe it to our children to track their every move. Whether it's the Trackify device or hiring a private investigator, it's your responsibility to make your kids safe. But it's very difficult to know if your child is using drugs. We've all dabbled in a little reefer and the occasional rail but, once you become a parent, it's time to change your tune and pretend your child won't go through the same adolescent trials and tribulations you did and get sanctimonious on them.
zh: 虽然大多数持有自由主义观念的选民反对对美国公民进行长期电子监控，但作为父母，我们有责任监视孩子的一举一动。无论是使用追踪设备还是雇佣私家侦探，保证孩子的安全都是你的责任。但想知道你的孩子是否在吸毒很难。我们都碰过大麻，偶尔还吸吸白粉，不过一旦为人父母，你就该改变你的态度，假装你的孩子不会经历你曾经历过的青春期的考验和磨难，在他们面前装作自己没有吸毒之类的陋习。

english: Gap between rich and poor widens
Drugs, Terror, and Big Business
zh: 毒品 恐怖主义 政商勾结

english: The link conservatives ignore at our peril
zh: 保守派忽视的联系会害死我们

english: BAWSAQ 100 up 12 points as the poor suffer
zh: 穷人受苦时，BAWSAQ 100指数上涨12点

english: But no, the prohibitionists believe they can control everything and everyone, legislate morality and profit from all our misery, by fabricating a link between drug dealing in Colombia and terrorism in America. There is no link. Terrorism is a direct result of our foreign policy - a policy that is so inherently ludicrous it is beyond any parody I can imagine.
zh: 但是，禁毒派认为他们可以控制任何东西和所有人，他们借口哥伦比亚的毒品交易和美国的恐怖主义之间存在联系，据此用法律规定道德，并从我们所有的苦难中获利。实际上并没有任何联系。恐怖主义是我们外交政策的直接结果——这一政策比任何讽刺作品都要荒唐。

english: So conservatives and police have been banging on about the link between drugs and terrorism - as if it is a surprise - but their equation does not quite add up. They left out one important variable: big business and, in particular, big oil. Drug money is laundered through the same patriarchal banking system as oil profits and big business. Drugs are BIG BUSINESS - supported by the same corrupt puppet governments that support both terror and the oil industry. The facts are clear - stop local communities from growing marijuana and they will gateway to opium and then very quickly to fundamentalism.
zh: 保守派和警方一直在猛烈抨击毒品和恐怖主义之间的联系，搞得跟真有这回事一样，但他们的等式并不完全成立。他们漏掉了一个重要的变量：政商勾结，尤其是石油巨头。与石油利润和政商勾结一样，毒品资金也是通过家长制的银行体系洗钱的。毒品也是政商勾结的一环——由同样支持恐怖主义和石油工业的腐败傀儡政府支持。事实很清晰——阻止当地民众种植大麻，他们就会走向鸦片，然后很快就会走向原教旨主义。

english: What does the news that the BAWSAQ 100 closed up 12 points mean to a man who can't buy a sandwich and has to degrade himself in public for money to buy cheap liquor? The stock market is nothing more than a big fat casino for rich people. Unfortunately, when they bust, we're all screwed. Conservatives think the future would be brighter if we invested all of our retirement money into oil and armaments. You should invest in sustainable crops, like marijuana. And recycle and wear hemp underwear. Please, if we don't, we'll totally die and I won't get to go to the smoldering dude festival in the desert and get cranked to the ether on peyote.
zh: 对于一个连三明治都买不起、为了买便宜酒而不得不在公共场合贬低自己的人来说，BAWSAQ 100指数收盘上涨12点的新闻意味着什么？对富人来说，股市不过是一个大赌场。不幸的是，他们一破产，我们就完了。保守派认为，如果我们把所有的退休金都投入石油和军备，前景会更光明。你应该投资可持续的农作物，比如大麻。然后回收之、制成能穿的麻内衣。拜托，如果我们不这样做，我们会死的，我可不想参加沙漠里又闷又热的爷们儿派对，也不想吸佩奥特碱吸到神志不清。

english: Conservatives Are In The Closet
Same sex marriage bill debated

It's tough being a godless liberal in a theocracy, but it's about to get even worse if Congress has its way. "Everyone should be able to get married," says Phil Kensington of the American Society of Same Sex, "I want to marry my life partner, who is a 79 year old man, but very wealthy, and I am 26 and love to club and we have a great time. If we don't marry, how can I ride this old git for a couple of years, cringing every time he slobbers on me and calls it a kiss, just so I can take his millions?"
zh: 在一个神权政体中，成为一个无神论的自由主义者很难，但如果国会执意这样行事，情况将变得更糟。「每个人都应该能够结婚，」 美国同性恋协会的菲尔･肯辛顿说「我想和我的终身伴侣结婚，他79岁了，但是很富有。而我26岁，喜欢去夜店，我们在一起很开心。要是我们不结婚，我怎么会骑这老家伙好几年、每次他管对我流口水的行为叫亲吻就巴结他，然后拿走他的百万家产呢？」

english: Big bang or hot air?

Critics are divided and have promised a symposium on the subject. One anthropologist noted, "Web 2.0 is a revelation - there's no doubt about it - or the fact is my career has gone nowhere as a serious academic so I'm now doing a paper on the internet in a bid to get some TV appearances and tenure that way. My next book will have a controversial title, and probably feature tits." The debate continues, until someone stops the funding.
zh: 批判人士意见不一，并承诺将就此问题召开研讨会。一位人类学家指出，「毋庸置疑，Web 2.0是一个启示。说实话，作为一名正经学者，我的事业已经无路可走，所以我正在写一篇关于互联网的论文，希望能借此获得上电视的机会和终身职称。我的下一本书的标题或将引起争议，不过很可能会以奶子为特色。」争论还将继续，直到有人停止资助。

english: Jingoism Act Expanded
The Death Throes of a Republic
Officials also said they are paying special attention to eastern Europeans. Great, more racial profiling.
zh: 政府还说他们会加倍留意东欧人。好，又是种族歧视。

english: Well, it's finally over. The King has won and Rome is burning. The conservatives have had their way and the constitution is in shambles. With the renewal of the Jingoism Act, EVERY SINGLE THING YOU DO will be monitored. There are 300 million people in America and a reported 300 million people will need to be hired to track the every movement of every American. These are scary times and I am so glad to be a liberal journalist who doesn't interject her personal feelings into stories. The blogosphere is the only thing that can save us from this tyranny.
zh: 好了，终于结束了。国王赢了，罗马正在燃烧。保守派成功了，宪法成了一团糟。在沙文主义法案更新后，「你所做的一切」都将受到监控。美国有3亿人，据报道需要雇佣3亿人来监视所有美国人的一举一动。坏时代要来了，幸好我是自由派记者，不必将自己的私情融入报导。博客圈是唯一能从这种暴政中拯救我们的东西。

english: Tom Goldberg found dead
Nation Mourns Left Wing Activist
zh: 举国哀悼左翼社会活动家

english: With the murder of heroic attorney, Tom Goldberg, a blow has been struck to the heart of the first amendment and freedom fighters everywhere. A moment of silence was called in the blogosphere as Mr. Goldberg stood for the freedom of speech and the rights of the little man to slander people anonymously online with no repercussions. He was in favor of immigration and proposed much tighter gun control. No wonder so few conservatives are mourning. He stood up to corporate America and the links between big business and government.
zh: 在英勇的律师汤姆･戈德堡被谋杀后，《第一修正案》和各地自由斗士的内心都受到了沉重打击。博客圈响起一阵默哀，戈德堡先生支持言论自由，为普通人在网上匿名诽谤他人而没有后果站台。他支持移民，并提议加强枪支管制。难怪如此少的保守派人士在哀悼。他坚决反对美国公司和政商勾结。

english: Green Alert?
Library crisis!
More colors that mean nothing
Computer stores and Bean machine taking over!
zh: 电脑商店与冰的咖啡掌权！

english: The increase of the terror threat level is another example of the National Office of Security Enforcement's sensationalism and willingness to limit our civil liberties. The money they have invested in putting a PR spin on public fears could have been invested in recycling and urban community composting schemes.
zh: 提升恐怖威胁等级是国安办制造恐慌和限制公民自由的又一案例。他们大可将用于制造恐慌的资金投资给垃圾回收和城市社区堆肥计划。

english: After a Freedom of Information Act request to the FIB, I found out that they had done surveillance on me and found out that I liked to visit trannies under the Broker Bridge. It is inexcusable that the government is reading my blog TranEELuvr. It is this kind of surveillance state that will bring this country down.
zh: 在向FIB提请《信息自由法案》后，我发现他们对我进行了监视，发现我喜欢在布洛克桥下见变性人。政府阅读我的博客TranEELuvr是不可原谅的。正是这种监视状态将让国家衰落。

english: The National Library Center is shutting down - as are all libraries nationwide - in a conspiracy by big chain computer stores and Bean Machine to make all information electronic so that the government can more easily read everything you do or say. With GPS devices in all mobile phones, the government can pinpoint your exact location at any time.
zh: 国家图书馆中心正在关闭，全国图书馆都是如此。这是大型连锁电脑店和冰的咖啡的阴谋，目的是将所有的信息电子化，这样政府就可以更容易地监视你的一言一行。通过所有手机都内置的GPS装置，政府可以随时获得你的准确位置。

english: Additionally, they have increased unconstitutional car inspections on the Broker Bridge. I was stopped on my way back to South Slopes after a trip to Vespucci University to pick up a pound of marijuana. Tempted to keep going, I eventually decided to stop for these fascists. What right does this fascist cop have to pull me over and inspect my trunk? Screw you, pig!
zh: 此外，他们还加强了违宪的布洛克大桥汽车检查。我去韦斯普奇大学取了一磅大麻，在回南坡的路上就给拦了下来。为了能继续前进，我还是决定为这些法西斯分子停车。这个法西斯警察有什么权利拦停我检查我的后备箱？去你妈的，猪头！

english: Monsters Under MyBed?
MyRoom is full of predators

The site, at www.myRoomOnline.net, is a favorite teen hangout. These predators have been highlighted on TV shows that entrap men who want to have sex with hot teen girls, which is essentially every man in America.
zh: MyRoom网在青少年群体中十分热门。这些「食肉动物」已经在狩猎好色之徒的电视节目上得到了关注，然而几乎所有美国男人都是好色之徒。

english: You drive your child to school and teach them that minorities are all ok (but just can't afford your neighborhood because of conservative racism) and that they should treat everyone with kindness. But what about adults who prey on our children? In a recent report, there are over 8 million registered sex offenders with MyRoom accounts.
zh: 你开车送孩子上学，告诉他们少数族裔也是好人(只是因为保守的种族主义，他们住不起你的小区)，他们应该善待每一个人。但是那些「掠食」我们孩子的成年人呢？最近的一份报告指出，有超过800万的性犯罪者注册了MyRoom账户。

english: Environment Doomed
Bridges Open
Friendship 2.0
Another Online Revolution!

We are all doomed, living in a low-lying coastal city, but while the government willfully refuses to consider outlawing cars or energy, we might as well drown ourselves. Future generations will hate us even more than we hate ourselves, and the fact is they will be right.
zh: 我们都要完蛋了，住在低洼的沿海城市，政府却仍然拒绝出台汽车或能源方面的禁令，我们自己都要被淹死了。我们的后代会比我们自身更加憎恨我们，而实际上他们憎恨得很对。

english: The bridge and tunnel crossings between Algonquin and Alderney were finally reopened yesterday as the terror threat caused by the mismanagement of the war on terror was deemed to have sufficiently reduced enough to allow us to carry on destroying the planet by the burning of fossil fuels. It's global warming stupid. It's a win - win for big business as usual. As income from the war goes down, oil revenues go up as people start increasing their carbon footprint again.
zh: 鉴于由反恐战争管理不当造成的恐怖主义威胁已经降低，连接阿尔冈琴和奥尔德尼的大桥及隧道终于于昨日重新开放，我们又可以照常燃烧化石能源破坏地球了。全球变暖诶，白痴！这次又是政界与商界的双赢。随着由战争带来的收入减少，通过石油取得的收入又一次随着民众碳排放的提高而提高。

english: Every revolution needs a name, and this one is 2.0. Web 2.0 is so amazing that what most people don't realize is that there never was a dotcom bubble. Web 2.0 is the second generation. You are probably still living in your Web 1.0 land - never even aware that everything has evolved, passed you by and left you for dead. You are old. You are becoming irrelevant. Kids look at you with disgust. You are living in an information silo while the rest of us are 26-7 Internet 2.0. When I shit, it is automatically recorded on my blog, an RSS feed is sent out, my www.grype.org buddies are notified, and it goes out to the www.myroomonline.net community. It's a revolution. I have thousands of friends I've never met. I am so alone. The darkness is closing in.
zh: 革命都得有个名号，而这次的革命就叫2.0。Web 2.0如此神奇，导致绝大多数人都没有意识到从未有什么互联网泡沫。Web 2.0已是第二世代了，你却可能还活在Web 1.0的土地上——浑然不知一切都进化了，一切都抛下了你，离你而去。你已经老了，和社会脱节了。孩子们会用厌恶的眼光看你。你活在信息孤岛上，而我们其他人都26x7地活在互联网2.0中。我一拉屎，就会自动记录在博客上，然后推送一条RSS，我在 Grype上的好友就会收到提醒，之后再流传到MyRoom网。这是一场革命。我拥有成百上千个素未谋面的朋友。我如此寂寞。黑暗已然来临。

english: Disc Jockey Tries to Get Back on That Horse

Announcing his plans at a poorly-attended press conference yesterday, he said, "This is radio 2.0, this is Lazlow 2.0, I'm back." When asked to explain what on earth this could mean, the popular shock jock said, "I don't really know - it's up to you, the listeners, to decide.' We will stay on this story in the hope this guy makes something of himself.
zh: 昨天，他在门庭冷清的记者招待会上公布了他的计划，他说：「这就是电台 2.0，这就是拉兹洛 2.0，我回来了。」当被问及所谓2.0究竟有何区别时，这名人气DJ回答道：「我也不清楚。主要还是看你们——听众们——的意见。」我们会持续跟进此事，希望他能有所成就。

english: A blast from the past today as former talk show host Lazlow is trying to get back on the airwaves. Lazlow used to host a popular show on a station called Chatterbox at the turn of the millennium, then things turned bad for him and he disappeared from our airwaves after a string of personal humiliations and bad choices, including several payola scandals, and a series of sexual shenanigans led to major credibility issues. But it appears he is back. Or trying to get back. He's been trying to raise financing for a new radio station to be launched in Liberty City in which the listener is put right into the action.
zh: 爆炸性新闻，前脱口秀主持人拉兹洛竟想重回电台。21 世纪初时，拉兹洛曾在Chatterbox电台主持一档热门节目，后来情况一落千丈。先是被曝数次受贿放歌，而后是种种性骚扰丑闻，让他的形象完全崩塌。不过他似乎又回来了，或者是想回来了。他一直在努力筹资，以在自由城成立一家听众导向的新电台。

english: Corrupt cop gets his comeuppance
Francis McReary Dead
zh: 弗朗西斯･麦克雷里死了

english: Sources within the LCPD have alleged that McReary was willing to take justice into his own hands in order to get his department's case clearance level up. In the weeks leading up to his death, this website had been attempting to get a comment from McReary on all of these accusations. He did not respond to our requests. Now, it seems, he will take the secrets of his corrupt reign of terror to his grave.
zh: LCPD内部人士声称麦克雷里本想采取一切手段提高其部门的结案率。在其死前几周，本站一直尝试从麦克雷里口中取得其对这些指控的看法，但其没有对此做出回应。看来现在，他就要将自己恐怖腐败统治的种种秘密带入坟墓了。

english: The Deputy Police Commissioner for Liberty City, Francis McReary, was gunned down in Algonquin earlier. Some were shocked that a member of the LCPD would be the victim of a gangland execution, but not those that knew what he was really like. McReary's own brother, a known associate of the Alderney mob, was recently arrested on racketeering charges. This news organization was approached by two independent sources wishing to expose photographic evidence of Francis McReary's taking bribes. Soon after they made contact, however, both men were mysteriously murdered. One of these men was lawyer Tom Goldberg.
zh: LCPD副局长，弗朗西斯･麦克雷里，早前在阿尔冈琴遭遇枪击身亡。有人对LCPD的一员竟会死于黑社会私刑感到惊诧，但知其本性的人对此并不意外。麦克雷里的哥哥是奥尔德尼一个黑帮的同伙，于近日受涉黑指控被捕。曾有两个独立情报人士愿意向本站提供弗朗西斯･麦克雷里收受贿赂的照片证据，然而在联络后不久，这两人都离奇死亡。其中一人正是律师汤姆･戈德堡。

english: Corrupt cop kills brother?
LCPD - New Scandal

This news organization was approached by two independent sources wishing to expose photographic evidence of Francis McReary's taking bribes. Soon after they made contact, however, both men were mysteriously murdered. One of these men was lawyer Tom Goldberg. Sources within the LCPD have alleged that McReary was willing to take justice into his own hands in order to get his department's case clearance level up. In the weeks leading up to his brother's death, this website had been attempting to get a comment from McReary on all of these accusations. He has so far not responded to our requests.
zh: 曾有两名独立消息人士联系本站，表示希望披露弗朗西斯･麦克雷里受贿的照片证据。然而，在他们进行联系后不久，这两人都离奇遇害。其中一人正是汤姆･戈德堡律师。LCPD内部人士声称麦克雷里本想采取一切手段提高其部门的结案率。在其兄弟死前几周，本站一直尝试从麦克雷里口中取得其对这些指控的看法，但其至今仍未对此做出回应。

english: The Deputy Police Commissioner for Liberty City, Francis McReary, stood by while his brother Derrick was shot in Algonquin earlier. Some were shocked that a brother of a senior member of the LCPD would be the victim of a gangland execution, but not those that knew what the McReary family is really like. Derrick McReary, 52, had recently returned to the US from Ireland and was himself caught up in organized crime. Some believe he may have been trying to blackmail the Deputy Commissioner who himself saw his brother as a liability. Another brother, Gerald McReary, a known associate of the Alderney mob, was recently arrested on racketeering charges.
zh: 早些时候，自由城警察局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里于他的兄弟德里克在阿尔冈琴被枪杀时袖手旁观。有些人对一名LCPD高级警员的兄弟，会成为黑社会私刑的受害者感到震惊。但那些了解麦克雷里家族真实情况的人不这么认为。52岁的德里克･麦克雷里最近刚从爱尔兰回到美国，他本人也卷入了有组织犯罪。有人认为，他可能一直在试图敲诈副局长，而副局长本人也将他的兄弟视作累赘。他的另一个兄弟，格里･麦克雷里，是奥尔德尼黑帮的知名同伙，近因涉黑指控被捕。

english: Games Causing Serious Elf Problems
zh: 导致严重精灵问题的游戏

english: Video games caused Dragonbrain massacre
zh: 电子游戏导致龙之脑大屠杀

english: A spokesperson for activist group Citizens Understand Medieval Games Undermine Loving Parents argued that video games are to blame for this crime because fantasy has melded into reality in the minds of these sickos just like in too many of the games they play. The spokesperson added that she is available for all media appearances and TV shows on the subject and is writing a book about how children should be raised.
zh: 社会活动组织中世纪游戏损害父母共识会(CUMGULP)的一名发言人主张将此次犯罪归咎于电子游戏，就像他们玩的许多将现实和幻想融为一体的游戏一样，他们自己也将两者混为一谈。发言人补充说，对于此话题，她可以接受各大媒体的采访、参加电视节目，同时她也在写一本关于如何养育孩子的书。

english: Congressional Liberals are working with activist group Citizens Understand Medieval Games Undermine Loving Parents to outlaw all video games after what is being called the Dragonbrain massacre. Police arrested Chris Ryan yesterday and charged him with the murder of a fellow moviegoer at a recent showing of the movie Dragonbrain. Police say they apprehended Ryan as he was deflowering a maiden in the privy. Ryan's lawyer argues his client lives like an elf and has no electricity.
zh: 在所谓的龙之脑大屠杀后，国会自由派们与社会活动组织中世纪游戏损害父母共识会(CUMGULP)联合，正在通过立法禁止所有电子游戏。警方已于昨日逮捕了克里斯 瑞安，并控告他在观看近期上映的电影《龙之脑》时谋杀同行的同伴。警方说他们在瑞安在厕所里奸污少女时逮捕了他。瑞安的律师则宣称他的委托人像小精灵一样生活，根本不用电。

english: Industry faces hard reality
Video games in impotence shocker
zh: 震惊 电子游戏令人阳痿

english: No - it is not the overbearing and useless state apparatus of a society gone insane, it is because of video games. This will make regulation much easier.

Obviously, video games also cause global warming and a lot of antisocial behavior, including farting, but now it turns out they also cause impotence in 90% of men, according to reports published yesterday. It makes a lot of sense - for years people put the falling birth rate down to the hopelessness of contemporary society and the terror of living in a godless world, but thankfully we have a new enemy.
zh: 众所周知，年轻人已经因游玩电子游戏毁掉了他们的人生。显然，电子游戏也导致了全球变暖和种种反社会行为，比如放屁。但根据昨天发布的报告，电子游戏也让90%的男人患上阳痿。这就说得通了，多年以来人们一直将出生率下滑归咎于对当代社会的绝望和对无神论世界的恐惧，但谢天谢地，我们现在有新的敌人了。

The tragic bias against Dr. Yahann Klietzel is nothing more than hate politics. A man who has sex with another man is fine - even if it is his underage clone.
zh: 我们已经去过月球了。我们已经发明了一种透过皮肤传递啤酒的装置。现在，人们正在与自己的克隆人发生性关系。对亚汉･克利策尔博士的悲惨偏见不过是一种仇恨政治。男人与男人发生性关系是可以的－即便另一方是他未成年的克隆人。

zh: 我们相信到时候汤姆･戈德堡先生必会将之呈上法庭。与此同时，他已经盯上了LCPD。 他这般正义的人的存在，是自由城公民和其他美国公民的福气。

english: Corrupt CEOs, politicians and police officers don't like the name Tom Goldberg. "If you are doing difficult and important work, then you can't expect everyone to like you. Kids hate going to the dentist but, you know, where would they be without him? Their teeth would be rotten. I'm like that with the city. I try to get rid of the decay." zh: 腐败的CEO、政客和警察都不喜欢汤姆･戈德堡这个名字。「如果你的工作困难而重要，就不能指望每个人都喜欢你。孩子们不喜欢去看牙医，但是，没了他们真不行啊，牙齿会烂掉的。我之于本市就是这样。我在尝试除掉腐败。」对贝塔制药等上市公司发起的团体诉讼让戈德堡先生一炮成名。

english: Let Everyone In!
We are all Americans

As the debate in Congress rages on over illegal immigration, many activists are saying that America should continue an open door policy. "People have been coming here for hundreds of years," said Immigration Reform Center President Percy Simonson, "Who are we to close the door suddenly? Everyone in the world is an American. Come join us. Come live here. Do like we do and don't pay tax! We have no traffic or congestion problems. There is room for all." zh: 随着国会就非法移民问题展开激烈辩论，许多活动家表示，美国应该继续实行开放政策。「几百年了，人们都在往这儿来，」移民改革中心主任珀西･西蒙森说「我们有突然紧闭大门的权力吗？世界上所有人都是美国公民。来加入我们，来住在这儿。像我们一样生活，还不交税！我们没有交通拥堵的问题。所有人都能有一席之地。」自由主义者在国会山举行「法律无关紧要」的集会，抗议立法者试图执行现有法律。

english: The racists and snobs who run Liberty City once sacked Martin Hawes because he was clinically insane and wore a bra to work. It is the proposal of a lunatic. It would keep the rich in, and the poor out. No wonder it is an idea people are actually discussing.

We need make a stand against the Evil Eris Empire and all the gun-touting redneck xenophobes who follow it. zh: ~z~你丫惹不起花花公子X。这是我的城市，我的城市，狗逼玩意。记住了？

zh: ~z~确实，你帮我我也给不了你几个子儿，小子。不过我会始终站在你这边。

zh: ~z~不过花花公子锦衣玉食的顶楼公寓的房产证还在我手里，房子就归你了。

zh: ~z~你杀了德维恩，尼克。我看清你的嘴脸了，我知道你老弟杀了我的导师了。

zh: ~z~你和德维恩一样，都疯了，小子。要是觉得这事你能办妥，一开始你就错了。

zh: ~z~兄弟，德维恩...他还活在1992年，最大的梦想就是根大金链子和BP机。

zh: ~z~我认识挺多人的，说不定能帮上你。

zh: ~z~至少他们要的是我的命，不是你的。

zh: ~z~现在都无所谓了，全都化为灰烬了。

zh: ~z~我们要去波汉找玛洛丽。你还有她。

zh: ~z~你还是不熟悉这里，堂弟。你不明白。

zh: ~z~很简单，我们先去公寓和车行收拾下行李。

zh: ~z~我们可以去收拾下行李，然后就离开这儿。

zh: ~z~之后我买下了公寓，你还嫌弃它烂的公寓。

zh: ~z~他们居然放火...他们居然他妈放火，尼克！

zh: ~z~自打你来了以后，发生的事情都很好，真的好。

zh: ~z~不过我不在乎。我们都这样了，就必须面对它。

zh: ~z~我很抱歉，罗曼，真的很抱歉，但我们得走了。

zh: ~z~我会把它加进你的秘密清单里的，不会泄露的。

zh: ~z~我给玛洛丽打个电话，她可能有地方能让我们躲。

zh: ~z~该好好想想未来了。在南波汉的新公寓，新的事业。

zh: ~z~和我的玛洛丽一样纯洁。在梦里我和玛洛丽结婚了。

zh: ~z~在美国就是要展现财富，要靠挥霍金钱来表现自己。

zh: ~z~很抱歉你那些世俗财产都被毁了，但是你又没那么富。

zh: ~z~现在你知道什么都完了，我们要死了，反而还很开心。

zh: ~z~你有你的生活，罗曼。现在你的生活比我的更有价值。

english: ~z~You are a sick fuck, cousin. No wonder half of Broker wants you dead.
zh: ~z~你这人哪，堂弟。难怪半个布洛克的人都想要你的命。

zh: ~z~你让我从哪开始说？算了，从你说起吧。你有毛病吗？

english: ~z~I risk my bets to win more so I can spend on the hot
zh: ~z~压上我的筹码，赢走更多筹码，这样我就可以把钱花在

zh: ~z~你来了搞的一群俄国杀手烧了我的家和车行我可真高兴。

english: ~z~Fifteen minutes ago you were cowering in fear because you didn't know what was going to happen.
zh: ~z~一刻钟之前，你还因为不知道会发生什么吓得瑟瑟发抖。

english: ~z~I've got nothing left. Not my home, not my business, nothing.
zh: ~z~我什么都没剩下了。要家没家，要事业没事业，屁都不剩。

zh: ~z~不是，还没呢。我本来是要跟她求婚了，但现在不可能了。

zh: ~z~对，你和我有了自己的一亩三分地。别人来这儿吃饭休闲。

zh: ~z~你还记得当年我们去老家的酒吧，结果发现店被夷为平地吗？

zh: ~z~－不就是群俄罗斯傻蛋吗...~n~－我会把他们一一杀掉。

zh: ~z~你来的第一天就啥都有了。~n~我花了好几个月才凑出一点钱。

english: ~z~We're here in America now and I should be thinking about my life here, my life which is ruined.
zh: ~z~我们现在在美国，我想的应该是这里的生活，已经被毁掉的生活。

english: ~z~Now, I have nothing to spend... nothing. Oh yeah, I have you. Great.
zh: ~z~现在我都没东西可以挥霍了...没了。噢，对，我还有你。真好。

zh: ~z~操他妈的，他妈着火了。整栋楼...我要进去，我要进去拿东西。

zh: ~z~你要道歉的事可多了去了。~n~自打你来了以后，我电脑给人砸了，

english: ~z~I can't have the tavern now. I have nothing to buy it with. I have, I have nothing.
zh: ~z~我现在开不了酒馆了，根本就买不起。~n~现在我、我啥都没有了。

english: ~z~We will, but I have left something important at the apartment. Something I must show you, cousin.
zh: ~z~肯定会，不过我在公寓里落了样重要的东西。你一定要看看那个，堂弟。

english: ~z~Finally I bought a cab and then another, then I got the depot...

english: ~z~I will be calm when we find Florian. See you, cousin.
zh: ~z~找到弗洛里安我才能平静。回见，老兄。

english: ~z~Follow his direction or we will never get there, cousin.
zh: ~z~听他指路，不然咱们永远到不了，老兄。

english: ~z~We aren't going to find this place if you keep messing around.
zh: ~z~你再这么瞎折腾，我们就找不着地方了。

english: ~z~Get out of here. I don't want to see you at any more tournaments either.
zh: ~z~滚出去。以后什么比赛也别让我看见你。

english: ~z~What are you doing, Talbot? You take us around in circles?
zh: ~z~你在干嘛，塔尔博特？带我们转圈圈呢？

english: ~z~Not too good either. I don't think I've seen him win a hand.
zh: ~z~牌技也不好。我好像就没见他赢过一次。

english: ~z~You trying to kill us? That traffic's heading toward us!
zh: ~z~你是想杀了我们吗？车子都在朝我们开！

english: ~z~You're a fucking loose cannon my friend.
zh: ~z~你他妈也太反复无常了点吧，我的朋友。

english: ~z~Shit, I would've chased him if I'd known you were so slow.
zh: ~z~妈的，早知道你这么慢，我自己去追了。

english: ~z~Now I am practically chopping board I have so many cuts on me.
zh: ~z~现在我已经是块砧板了，身上全是伤口。

english: ~z~You think we're stupid, Talbot? We have been here already.
zh: ~z~当我们傻的吗，塔尔博特？这里才刚来过。

english: ~z~Bryce Dawkins? But he's so into family values!
zh: ~z~布莱斯･道金斯？那他还整天讲家庭观念！

english: ~z~Come up with me Roman. I cannot do this alone.
zh: ~z~和我一起上来，罗曼。这我不能一个人去。

english: ~z~Niko, you didn't need to kill him. He brought us here.
zh: ~z~尼克，没必要杀了他的。他都把路带到了。

english: ~z~Can we stop with the fat jokes, Florian?
zh: ~z~我们能不开关于肥的玩笑了吗，弗洛里安？

english: ~z~Well screw you, Niko Bellic and fatty Roman!
zh: ~z~我可去你妈的，尼克･贝利克和肥佬罗曼！

english: ~z~Don't be stupid, man. I know you are just taking us about in circles.
zh: ~z~别犯蠢，老兄。我知道你在带我们转圈圈。

english: ~z~Is not that, I'm coming to collect you from the apartment. Wait for me there.
zh: ~z~不是那个，我来公寓接你了。在那儿等我。

english: ~z~I'm not having Talbot sit on my knee. Get a bigger car.
zh: ~z~我可不要塔尔博特坐我腿上。换辆大点的车。

english: ~z~Shit, NB, I haven't got time to sit here while you fuck about.
zh: ~z~妈的，NB，我可没时间坐在这儿看你磨蹭。

english: ~z~Niko, be calm. We will find Florian soon.
zh: ~z~尼克，冷静。我们很快就会找到弗洛里安的。

english: ~z~Easy there, man. You need to go slow if I'm gonna be able to get you there.
zh: ~z~开慢点，老兄。你不开慢我没法带你到地方。

english: ~z~This is impossible when you're going this fast. I can't see any of the turnoffs.
zh: ~z~你开这么快就找不着了，我连路口都看不见。

english: ~z~Alright, this isn't the normal route I take but keep going.
zh: ~z~好吧，这不是我平时走的那条路，但继续开。

english: ~z~Chill, cousin. If you go so fast we aren't going to find it.
zh: ~z~放松点，老兄。你开这么快，我们找不着的。

english: ~z~He got away from us, NB. We're not going to be able to find Florian now.
zh: ~z~他跑了，NB。这下我们找不着弗洛里安了。

english: ~z~Have some fucking patience, Nicky. I thought you was wanting to find this rat.
zh: ~z~有点耐心，尼克。我还以为你很想找到他的。

english: ~z~We were so close, cousin, so close. I will see you soon.
zh: ~z~我们差点就找到了，堂兄，就差一点。回头见。

english: ~z~He doesn't act well under pressure, NB. Beat him a little.
zh: ~z~一有压力他就演不下去了，NB。稍微揍一顿。

english: ~z~Now that I know it was Darko, he is all I will be able to think about.
zh: ~z~既然我知道了是达尔科，我满脑子就只有他了。

english: ~z~You know, if this fucks up, the bad shit's coming down on my head.
zh: ~z~你要知道，要是这次搞砸了，又得轮到我遭罪。

english: ~z~Can't say I'm entirely sure about this, head on though.
zh: ~z~不敢说这条路我很有把握，不过继续往前开吧。

english: ~z~Florian Cravic? I don't know what you're talking about.
zh: ~z~弗洛里安･克拉维克？我不知道你们在说什么。

english: ~z~What are you guys doing here? Why did you kick my door down?
zh: ~z~你俩来这儿做什么？为什么你们要踹开咱的门？

english: ~z~So, you're finally going to kill Florian Cravic...
zh: ~z~那，你终于要去杀弗洛里安･克拉维克了...

english: ~z~Hey, I hear you know Florian Cravic. Where is he?
zh: ~z~喂，听说你认识弗洛里安･克拉维克。他在哪儿？

english: ~z~Ummm. I really don't recognize this. I can't help you from here I'm afraid.
zh: ~z~呃，这里我真不认识。在这儿我恐怕帮不了你了。

english: ~z~Stay right there, Talbot. Don't think you can push me around.
zh: ~z~乖乖站好，塔尔博特。别想着你能从我这儿逃了。

english: ~z~Well, I'm a lifestyle coach, and I teach an aerobics class...
zh: ~z~咱现在是个养生教练，上课教有氧运动的内容...

english: ~z~We know now that it was him. I need to be alone now, Roman.
zh: ~z~现在我们知道是他干的了。我要一个人静静，罗曼。

english: ~z~I worry for you, NB. Sometimes you just got to let the hate go.
zh: ~z~我很替你担心，NB。有时候还是得放下往日仇恨。

english: ~z~You kill the wrong guy and his friends will fuck with me to get to you.
zh: ~z~你一杀错人，他的朋友就会来找我麻烦，好找到你。

english: ~z~All that has changed is that I am hunting one man instead of two...
zh: ~z~唯一的区别是，我要追的人从两个变成了一个...

english: ~z~Florian has moved on from what happened to you, you should move on too.
zh: ~z~弗洛里安已经从你的遭遇里走出来了，你也该走出来。

english: ~z~Niko, that was unfortunate. There will be some other way to find Florian.
zh: ~z~尼克，太不幸了。总会有其它能找弗洛里安的法子的。

english: ~z~This is too bad, cousin. Maybe we find Florian another day.
zh: ~z~这太糟了，堂弟。也许我们还是改天再找弗洛里安吧。

english: ~z~Who set us up. It was you or Darko. I thought it must be him.
zh: ~z~背叛我们的人，不是你就是达尔科了。我想一定是他。

english: ~z~Slowly, slowly, catchy monkey, NB. We won't find him if you are racing.
zh: ~z~心急吃不了热豆腐，NB。你开这么快咱们找不着他。

english: ~z~Cousin, I know you want to find him soon, but you must go slowly to do it.
zh: ~z~老兄，我知道你想快点找到他，但那样就必须慢慢开。

english: ~z~You think it was me... that's why you're here. You've come to kill me!
zh: ~z~你以为是咱...所以你才会来这儿。你是来杀咱的！

english: ~z~Cousin, Talbot is dead. We needed him to take us to Florian.
zh: ~z~老兄，塔尔博特死了。我们还得靠他带路找弗洛里安呢。

english: ~z~Talbot, I know him. I came up against him in a few tournaments. Small world.
zh: ~z~塔尔博特，我认识。打牌的时候对上过几次。世界真小。

english: ~z~~c~Florian! I'm here for you, asshole. Open the door!~s~
zh: ~z~~c~弗洛里安！我来找你了，混蛋。把门打开！~s~

english: ~z~but then I heard that you had joined the circus so information can be unreliable.
zh: ~z~不过咱也听说过你加入了马戏团，所以消息不一定靠谱。

english: ~z~He's moved on from what happened to you, you should've moved on too. What are you going to do?
zh: ~z~他已经走出那件事了，你也该往前走。现在你什么打算？

english: ~z~Of course they would have. Look at your gambling career. What was I thinking?
zh: ~z~当然是早晚会了。看看你的赌博事业吧，我在想什么呢？

english: ~z~There he is. Let's go talk to him. He's always at the games being held around Algonquin.
zh: ~z~那个就是。我们去跟他谈谈。他经常来阿尔冈琴的赌局。

english: ~z~So I see... well it's great to see you guys... we must do brunch.
zh: ~z~咱懂了...见到你们还是很高兴的...有空吃顿饭。

english: ~z~I couldn't find Florian. Your man, Talbot, he was annoying the shit out of me.
zh: ~z~我找不到弗洛里安。你的人塔尔博特他搞得我暴跳如雷。

english: ~z~Last thing I heard, you was itching to whack this guy? Must be some heavy shit.
zh: ~z~之前你不是还说很想干死这个人吗？那估计是个大岔子了。

english: ~z~Oh, I started working out... you know, toned up the, er...
zh: ~z~噢，咱开始健身了...你也知道，壮实了一下，呃...

english: ~z~I will find out where he is, and I will make him answer for his actions.
zh: ~z~我会查到他在哪儿，我会让他为自己的所作所为付出代价。

english: ~z~Ummm, I might be lost but keep going and I'll see if I can get there.
zh: ~z~呃，我可能迷路了，但你继续开，我看看还能不能认出来。

english: ~z~Your days of searching are over, my friend. This guy should point you in the right direction.
zh: ~z~你找人的日子结束了，我的朋友。这个人应该能给你带路。

english: ~z~I'd be rich even if you weren't here. I'm an entrepreneur. Things would have taken off for me.
zh: ~z~就算你不来我也会很富。我是个企业家，早晚都会腾飞的。

english: ~z~Shit NB, are you cranked on speed? We have to go slow to find the address.
zh: ~z~妈的 NB，你嗑了安非他明吗？得慢慢开才找得到地址。

english: ~z~I been head to head with this guy a few times, NB. I know his tells. He's lying.
zh: ~z~我和这人交手过几次，NB。我知道他的心思。他在说谎。

english: ~z~I... I... I heard he was still in Europe, or Switzerland, or somewhere...
zh: ~z~咱...咱...咱听说他还在欧洲，瑞士，或者哪里...

english: ~z~Come on, NB. You think I keep this figure by walking? Go get us a car.
zh: ~z~拜托，NB。我要是肯走路还会是这副样子吗？去弄辆车来。

english: ~z~Come on, NB. We won't ever find Florian unless you follow these directions.
zh: ~z~来吧，NB。你不按这些提示走，我们永远找不着弗洛里安。

english: ~z~Hey Nicky. You've been a decent earner for me and I appreciate that. I'm throwing you a bone.
zh: ~z~喂尼克。之前的活你都做得很棒，我很感谢。赏你一根骨头。

english: ~z~There's some fanook called Talbot, Talbot Daniels, over in the Triangle.
zh: ~z~有一个叫塔尔博特的基佬，塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯，人在三角区。

english: ~z~Oh yeah, I should probably say, you ain't gonna get those ten Gs from Talbot.
zh: ~z~哦对了，有件事我得说，那一万你没法从塔尔博特手里拿回来了。

english: ~z~I will find out where Darko Brevic is, and I will make him answer for his actions.
zh: ~z~我会找出达尔科･布雷维奇的所在，让他为自己的行为付出代价。

english: ~z~We're looking for a guy named Talbot Daniels. Hangs out in the Triangle.
zh: ~z~我们要找的是一个叫塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯的人。经常在三角区出没。

english: ~z~I think he's a bit freaked out. I guess he thought seeing you would answer some questions.
zh: ~z~我觉得他有点过于激动了，可能本来他觉得能从你这里问出更多的。

english: ~z~It's Bernie now. After I came here, I wanted a complete change. So I became Bernie Crane.
zh: ~z~现在是伯尼了。来这儿以后咱就想告别过去，所以咱成了伯尼･克兰。

english: ~z~Anything for you, cousin. Just name it. You want some women? I met this...
zh: ~z~赴汤蹈火在所不辞，堂弟。开口吧。你想找女人吗？我这儿有个...

english: ~z~So, it was Darko Brevic who betrayed you. Now you know. You should relax.
zh: ~z~这么说，背叛你的是达尔科･布雷维奇。现在你知道了。你该放下了。

english: ~z~He's into me for about ten Gs, he says he might know something about Florian Cravic.
zh: ~z~他找到我开口就要了一万，他说他可能知道弗洛里安･克拉维克的下落。

english: ~z~There is no starting again. Darko Brevic may not be here in Liberty City, but he's still out there.
zh: ~z~没有重新开始这回事。达尔科･布雷维奇也许不在自由城，但他还在外面活着。

english: ~z~Ray Boccino, the cockroach mobster, he knows a man who might know Florian Cravic.
zh: ~z~雷･博奇诺，那个狡诈的黑社会，他知道一个可能认识弗洛里安･克拉维克的人。

english: ~z~I have found Florian Cravic. There's a man called Talbot Daniels who will lead us to him.
zh: ~z~我找到弗洛里安･克拉维克了。有个叫塔尔博特･丹尼尔斯的人会带我们去找他。

english: ~z~Don't think you're going anywhere, Talbot. I'm going to go easy on you for now. But if you push me, you're in big trouble.
zh: ~z~你哪儿都别想去，塔尔博特。我现在先对你客气点，不过你要是逼我，那你麻烦就大了。

english: ~z~Alright already. There's a guy I know, likes to be called Florian Cravic at... um... certain moments.
zh: ~z~够了够了。我是认识个人，好像是叫弗洛里安･克拉维克...呃...偶尔会这么叫他。

zh: ~z~你为什么把罗曼留下，你要杀我吗？

zh: ~z~我不想你惹是生非。带我去那地方。

zh: ~z~噢，我想，如果我没弄错的话是直行。

english: ~z~I was really high when I last went to Bernie's place.
zh: ~z~我上次去伯尼他家的时候有点喝高了。

english: ~z~Why isn't Roman with us? What's going on?
zh: ~z~罗曼怎么不跟咱们在一起？怎么回事？

english: ~z~Bernie Crane. What have you gotten me into.
zh: ~z~伯尼･克兰。你都让我惹上了什么啊。

english: ~z~You better be taking us to the right place, Talbot.
zh: ~z~你最好能给我们带对地方，塔尔博特。

english: ~z~Talbot, if you screw me around you are a dead man.
zh: ~z~塔尔博特，要是敢耍我，你就死定了。

english: ~z~Alright. Bernie's place. Where was Bernie's place.
zh: ~z~好吧，伯尼的家，伯尼的家在哪儿来着。

english: ~z~I have been waiting ten years to find Florian. Get me there.
zh: ~z~我已经等着找弗洛里安十年了。带我过去。

english: ~z~Well... ummm... okay... turn right. Turn right.
~z~When I find Florian... when I find him...
zh: ~z~等我找到弗洛里安...等我找到他...

english: ~z~You know, you try to block walks of shame out of your memory.
zh: ~z~你也知道，人都会故意屏蔽羞耻之行的记忆。

english: ~z~Okay, ummm, if I'm right Bernie's place is somewhere Uptown.
zh: ~z~好的，呃，我没弄错的话伯尼就住在市郊某处。

english: ~z~When I am done with Florian, he will be begging to die.
zh: ~z~等我和弗洛里安把话说完，他就会求着去死的。

zh: ~z~就是这里。这就是伯尼的住处。你是要去杀他吗？

english: ~z~That is the most your friend can look forward to. Get out of here now. You've done your job.
zh: ~z~这是你朋友最好的下场。你快滚吧，你的任务完成了。

zh: ~z~现在不是聊这种话题的时候。

english: ~z~I had to go back to the pit where the bodies were dumped.
zh: ~z~我只能回到丢弃尸体的坑里。

english: ~z~It hardened me, it made me cold.
zh: ~z~让我变得铁石心肠、冷酷无情。

english: ~z~This is almost over. I'm going to finish it.
zh: ~z~终于要结束了，我去做个了断。

english: ~z~Leave him. He's not worth wasting your energy on.
zh: ~z~别管他，他不值得你浪费精力。

english: ~z~I don't know. I wanted it for so long.
zh: ~z~我不知道。我日思夜想的复仇。

english: ~z~I deal in death because that is all that is open to me.
zh: ~z~我做杀手是因为我只能做这个。

~z~I needed the money... I had problems.

zh: ~z~你都做了什么啊，堂弟？这可不好。会有别人找我们收更多钱的。

zh: ~z~别担心，我手头弹药充足，感觉自己像把AK。~c~没问题的。

zh: ~z~这次我是输光了，但下次再来的时候，他们一定想不到我会赢走一切。

zh: ~z~我早就让你们停手了，现在已经迟了。

zh: ~z~达尔丹再也不会来找你麻烦了，堂兄。

english: ~z~There's what we owe you, Dardan. Nothing else.
zh: ~z~欠你的都还上了，达尔丹。没别的了。

english: ~z~For now, let's just try to survive, cousin.
zh: ~z~现在，我们还是想法子活命吧，堂兄。

english: ~z~to all these pimps and loan sharks from now on.
zh: ~z~我们就要反抗那些皮条客和高利贷了。

english: ~z~Liberty City won't know what hit it, man.
zh: ~z~自由城还不知道自己会发生什么，老弟。

english: ~z~We should go out and find some ladies, get some massage oil.
zh: ~z~我们该出去找几个女人，弄两瓶按摩油。

english: ~z~Come on, my car is over there, let's get him.
zh: ~z~来吧，我的车就停在那边，一起去追他。

english: ~z~He made my life impossible. There was no avoiding him.
zh: ~z~他搞得我日子过不下去，根本躲不过他。

english: ~z~He's driving better than you with one arm. Come on, Niko.
zh: ~z~他单手开的都比你好。给点力啊，尼克。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. Bledar has me trapped again. This is all your fault.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。布莱达尔又逮着我了。都怪你。

english: ~z~It doesn't matter. Argh, I think I'm in too much pain anyway. Fuck.
zh: ~z~没关系的。啊，我想我还是太疼了点。操。

english: ~z~Ain't going to let no one push us around. Going to stand up
zh: ~z~从今往后我们不会再对任何人低声下气了。

english: ~z~Me and you, Niko, me and you are going to show them.
zh: ~z~我和你，尼克，咱们一起让他们长长见识。

english: ~z~Okay, Roman. I'm not going to let something else get in the way this time. Where are you?
zh: ~z~好了，罗曼。这次我没别的事了。你人在哪？

english: ~z~You really are American. You don't even swear in our language.
zh: ~z~你真的是个美国人了，连爆粗都不说家乡话。

english: ~z~You forgotten how to drive, cousin? He's losing us.
zh: ~z~你连车都不会开了，堂弟？他要甩掉我们了。

english: ~z~I can't think what he could possibly want or why he'd be pissed off, can you?
zh: ~z~我是不知道他想怎样和为什么生气，你知道吗？

english: ~z~You say this now, but soon even you will forget about the Old Country.
zh: ~z~现在你还能说说，以后你也会忘了故国的事的。

english: ~z~Me and you, Niko, me and you going to be in control from now on.
zh: ~z~我和你，尼克，现在马上就是我和你说了算了。

english: ~z~Did you deal with him like you did Dardan and Bledar?
zh: ~z~你是像对待达尔丹和布莱达尔那样解决了他吗？

english: ~z~Who does he think he's fucking with? Bellic Enterprises, that's who.
zh: ~z~也不想想自己他妈在招惹谁？惹上贝利克集团了。

english: ~z~These men, these shylocks like Dardan, they always try to squeeze you for everything.
zh: ~z~这些像达尔丹一样的高利贷，总是想榨干你的一切。

english: ~z~I saw bad things happen there. You do not know what it is that...
zh: ~z~我在故国目睹了坏事发生。你不知道那件事的...

english: ~z~Fucking Dardan smashing my fucking stuff. Who does he think he is?
zh: ~z~傻逼达尔丹他妈乱搞老子东西。他当自己是老几啊？

english: ~z~Vlad, Dardan, Bledar, even Mallorie push me around.
zh: ~z~弗拉德、达尔丹、布莱达尔，就连玛洛丽都使唤我。

english: ~z~If I wasn't a pacifist I'd stick it to you too.
zh: ~z~要不是因为我是和平主义者，我早就把你暴打一顿了。

english: ~z~He'll come back and trash our place if he gets away, get him, cousin.
zh: ~z~他要是跑了还不得把我们的店给砸了，追上去，堂弟。

english: ~z~Screw money I owe the Albanians, paying for the cab will be a lot harder.
zh: ~z~算上欠阿尔巴尼亚人的那些钱，我连新车都买不起了。

english: ~z~Nice one, cousin. Drive back to the depot, these bruises are starting to really hurt.
zh: ~z~干得好，堂弟。送我回车行吧，这些淤青已经开始疼了。

english: ~z~Nice one, cousin. Drive back to the depot, these bruises are starting to pain.
zh: ~z~干得好，堂弟。开车回车行吧，这些淤青已经开始疼了。

english: ~z~Go after him, finish him off. I would do it but I'm hurt, you know? Urgh.
zh: ~z~追上去，做掉他。要不是我受伤了我就自己上了。呃啊。

english: ~z~We got some of them, cousin. But not all. This is not a good thing.
zh: ~z~我们解决了一小部分人，但还不是全部。这可不是好事。

english: ~z~Don't let him get away, Niko, they are like locusts. A plague of them will come back.
zh: ~z~别让他跑了，尼克，他们就像蝗虫一样。还会卷土重来的。

english: ~z~What about Mallorie, Roman? You shouldn't stay with her if you want to have these threesomes.
zh: ~z~那玛洛丽怎么办，罗曼？你还想乱搞的话可不能和她一起。

english: ~z~I think he broke my rib. Man that hurts. Shit. I need a massage.
zh: ~z~他好像打断了我的肋骨。可真痛啊。操。我要去做个按摩。

english: ~z~They think they can fuck me around and beat me up because there are more of them. Not any longer.
zh: ~z~他们以为仗着人多就能打我、欺负我。这样的日子过去了。

english: ~z~He had too many connections for that. I had to leave. He is one of the reasons I came here.
zh: ~z~他的人脉太广了，我只能离开。也是我来这儿的原因之一。

english: ~z~Urghgh... I think it must be two ribs. Those fucking punks. What were you saying?
zh: ~z~呃啊...大概断了两根肋骨，这群狗娘养的。你刚才说啥？

english: ~z~Ever since I get to Hove Beach, Niko, ever since I arrive here I have been pushed around.
zh: ~z~自打我到了霍夫海滩，尼克，自打我到这儿，我都是任人摆布。

english: ~z~Just some fucking petty Albanian hood. If I wanted to buy a stolen TV I'd go to Dardan.
zh: ~z~不就是个阿尔巴尼亚土鳖么。想买偷来的电视，找达尔丹就对了。

english: ~z~A man in Europe, another Russian... Bulgarin. He live on the Adriatic.
zh: ~z~一个欧洲人，也是俄罗斯的...布尔加林。他住在亚得里亚海那边。

english: ~z~Niko, Bledar has me cornered in the courts under the El Train on Firefly.
zh: ~z~尼克，我被布莱达尔逼到球场的墙角了，~n~在萤火虫的轻轨下面。

english: ~z~Over on the courts under the El Train on Firefly. Bledar, buddy, you proved your point the first time...
zh: ~z~我在萤火虫的轻轨下面的球场。布莱达尔，哥们，第一次的时候你已经证明你的态度了...

english: ~z~Hey.
~z~Yeah.
~z~Good.
~z~What?
~z~Sure.
~z~Good.
~z~What?
~z~Yeah...
~z~Why not?
~z~Whatever.
~z~I know.
~z~So it's my fault?
~z~Where's Roman?
~z~The phone's ringing.
~z~Huh. Good question.
~z~Oh, hey Niko.
~z~Later, Vlad.
~z~Vlad! Shut up!
~z~Huh. About time.
~z~Get me a fucking coffee!
~z~That's a weight off my mind.
~z~So, you're not a cop?
~z~Good luck with that...
~z~This is real bad, man.
~z~They're gone. Thank you.
~z~What was this all about?
~z~Coffee? What was he thinking?
~z~Keep looking after Roman, a'ight.
~z~My conscience is troubled enough already.
~z~I didn't say that...
~z~His name is Niko. He'll be right over.
~z~I'm Niko, Roman's cousin.
~z~No, it's "Where Is My Fucking Money"?
~z~Great, we've lost them.
~z~Then we teach them a real lesson.
~z~This thing don't drive itself, get in.
~z~Masterson Street it is, Jermaine.
~z~Is that so? I'll tell you what...
~z~I had it, I had some of it...
~z~Gorgeous, this guy's a fucking creep!
~z~What're you doing? Get back in the car.
~z~Niko, yo, Roman said you were reliable.
~z~The cops are onto me. Get us out of here!
~z~Excellent! Now stop fucking staring at me.
~z~Aah, hey, Mallorie. Hey man!
~z~Yeah, I traded in the yacht for this cab.
~z~Come on... I'll get you one.
~z~He's over on Rotterdam Hill on Mohawk Avenue.
zh: ~z~他在莫霍克大道的鹿特丹山。

english: ~z~Roman is lucky to have you here, Niko.
zh: ~z~有你在这里罗曼真幸运，尼克。

english: ~z~I own a Pay 'n' Spray shop over there on Gibson Street. Take us there.
zh: ~z~我在吉布森街开了一家喷漆店。

english: ~z~I ain't going down, man. Get rid of this heat.
~z~No, I tried to join the LCPD.
~z~So, what brings you to Liberty City, Niko?
zh: ~z~你为什么会来自由城呢，尼克？

english: ~z~Okay, we're here. Thanks, man.
~z~Did you come to Liberty City to drive cabs then?
zh: ~z~你来自由城就是来开出租的吗？

english: ~z~Oh yeah, what's wrong with Roman's life?
zh: ~z~是吗，罗曼的生活有什么问题吗？

english: ~z~He appears to owe money to half of Hove Beach.
zh: ~z~他似乎欠了半个霍夫海滩的人钱。

english: ~z~Hey man, I thought you were driving me?
zh: ~z~喂，兄弟，你是来替我开车的吧？

english: ~z~Shit man, you gotta lose these cops.
zh: ~z~操，兄弟，你得把这些条子甩了。

english: ~z~Give him a break. He's new in the country.
zh: ~z~放过他吧。他还不太适应这个国家。

english: ~z~Good luck finding them. How's the hunt been going so far?
zh: ~z~祝你早日找到。现在找得怎么样了？

english: ~z~Yes he can drive. No, he's not a cop.
zh: ~z~对，他会开车。不是，他不是条子。

english: ~z~Come on, hottie, forget about the fat serf.
zh: ~z~好了，辣妹，忘了那个肥佬农奴吧。

english: ~z~Hey Roman, sorry about this, but your cab got trashed.
zh: ~z~喂，罗曼，很对不起，你的的士坏了。

english: ~z~Nice aftershave! What is that? "Sex Pest"?
zh: ~z~润肤水不错！啥牌子的？「性骚扰」？

english: ~z~I mean, I know I'm good looking and everything, but come on.
zh: ~z~我也知道我长得很帅，别盯着我看了。

english: ~z~We're trapped! Smash through that fence, man.
zh: ~z~我们被困住了！冲破那片围栏，兄弟。

english: ~z~Help man, you gotta shake these cops.
zh: ~z~拜托了兄弟，你一定要甩了这些条子。

english: ~z~Roman, I got your friend, Jermaine, where he wanted to go.
zh: ~z~罗曼，你的朋友杰梅因我已经送到了。

english: ~z~The question is, are you willing to get your hands dirty?
zh: ~z~问题在于，你愿不愿意脏了自己的手？

english: ~z~I can see that. Did you walk here from nineteen eighty five?
~z~I'm spinning out, man. Get these cops off our tails.
zh: ~z~我要晕车了，兄弟。快把这些条子甩了。

english: ~z~Ahh, he told me about you. You're Niko, right?
zh: ~z~啊，他有跟我讲过你。你就是尼克对吧？

english: ~z~What? You keep staring at me, I'll burst one of your eyeballs.
zh: ~z~咋了？再盯着我看，我就戳瞎你一只眼。

english: ~z~Vlad... Vladdy boy... what's going on?
zh: ~z~弗拉德...弗拉迪仔...这都怎么了？

english: ~z~Roman! Roman boy... you tell me what's going on.
zh: ~z~罗曼！罗曼仔...你告诉我这都怎么了。

english: ~z~Roman has had some issues with loan sharks that needed to be resolved.
zh: ~z~罗曼和高利贷之间还有一些纠纷需要解决。

english: ~z~Thanks for coming. Can you take me over to Masterson Street?
zh: ~z~谢谢你来接我。你能带我去马斯特森街吗？

english: ~z~Ha ha. That's a joke, right? A funny fucking joke.
zh: ~z~哈哈。是在开玩笑没错吧？真他妈的好笑。

english: ~z~It has not really started yet. I'm getting settled in, you know?
zh: ~z~其实还没有开始找。我还在适应环境来着。

english: ~z~That door isn't meant to be open. Wait here while I take a look.
zh: ~z~门不该是开着的。我进去看看，你在这等着。

english: ~z~Thank you, man. Tell Roman to stay out of trouble, you hear?
zh: ~z~谢谢你，兄弟。告诉罗曼避开麻烦，听见了吗？

english: ~z~while you don't pay, maybe you and Niko can do me few favors.
zh: ~z~既然你不付钱，那你和尼克就得帮我几个小忙。

english: ~z~Lose the cops, man. Lose the fucking cops. Shit.
zh: ~z~甩掉条子，兄弟。甩了这群狗娘养的条子。操。

english: ~z~You should let your cousin stick to the jokes. Making funny don't suit you.
zh: ~z~开玩笑这事还是得让你堂兄来，你不适合搞笑。

english: ~z~There's this asshole called Vlad who he owes money to as well...
zh: ~z~还有一个叫弗拉德的混蛋，也是他的债主...

english: ~z~Actually, I don't think I would have to tell you if I was a cop.
zh: ~z~实际上，如果我是个警察，我是不会告诉你的。

english: ~z~Hey, Roman ain't much better when he's behind the wheel. Sorry about that screw up.
zh: ~z~嘿，罗曼开车的时候也没好到哪去。抱歉搞砸了。

english: ~z~Hey, yokel. Your dumb cousin isn't here. Go get me a coffee.
zh: ~z~喂，乡巴佬，你的蠢堂兄不在。去给我泡杯咖啡。

english: ~z~Shit, you just shoulda told me that. Jesus. You nearly gave me a heart attack.
zh: ~z~靠，不早说。天哪。我差点连心脏病都吓出来了。

english: ~z~I wouldn't want no cop driving me to pick up a load of hot parts.
zh: ~z~我可不想让条子开车带我去拿一堆烫手的零部件。

english: ~z~Roman, I guess, and some other things. I'm looking for something.
zh: ~z~大概是罗曼吧，也有别的理由。我在寻找某样东西。

english: ~z~That's just some bullshit that cops circulate to trick people into doing deals with them.
zh: ~z~条子会四处晃悠骗别人和他们做交易纯粹是在胡扯。

english: ~z~Yeah, you gotta. I had a feeling you sounded too good to be true.
zh: ~z~确实，是这样的。我本来觉得你这人成功得有点假。

english: ~z~Good Niko, thanks, thanks... can't talk, see you soon.
zh: ~z~很好，尼克，谢了，谢了...说不来话，回头见。

english: ~z~Ok, ok. I've got to pick up some hot parts from my lockup, you down?
zh: ~z~行，行。我要去我的车库拿点烫手的零部件，你干吗？

english: ~z~I'm Roman's cousin. If you can trust him, you can trust me.
zh: ~z~我是罗曼的堂弟。要是你信得过他，就可以信得过我。

english: ~z~Alright, I don't think they know where we are. Don't attract any unnecessary attention.
zh: ~z~好了，这下他们就找不到我们了。别引起不必要的注意。

english: ~z~Niko came in looking for you and Vlad told him to get him a fucking coffee and Niko didn't want to.
zh: ~z~尼克过来找你，然后弗拉德让他去泡杯咖啡，尼克不去。

english: ~z~My hands haven't been clean for a long time. Being here in Liberty City is just making them dirtier.
zh: ~z~我的手已经脏了很久了。在自由城也只会把手弄得更脏。

english: ~z~I ain't got no problem with that. Just don't tell me if you stole this shit from a hospital or a school for sick kids.
zh: ~z~只要东西不是从医院或者福利学校偷来的，我就没有问题。

english: ~z~Shit. I thought Roman was gonna pick me up. I need someone I can trust for this run.
zh: ~z~靠，我还以为罗曼会来接我。这一趟我得找个信得过的人。

english: ~z~Hey? Yeah... okay... no, I can't do it; my cousin will do it.
zh: ~z~喂？对...好的...不行，我来不了，得让我堂弟来。

english: ~z~Roman, man, I got some bad news. Your client, Jermaine, he got hurt.
zh: ~z~罗曼，老哥，我有个坏消息。你的客户，杰梅因他受伤了。

english: ~z~But he's a serf, and you're a countess. Talking about serfs...
zh: ~z~但他只是个农奴，而你却是个女伯爵。说农奴农奴到...

english: ~z~I got rid of one group of loan sharks but this asshole, Vlad, he has his hooks into him as well.
zh: ~z~我解决了一批高利贷，但他还是被弗拉德那混蛋吃得死死的。

english: ~z~You shouldn't have said that, Jermaine. I've grounds to arrest you now.
zh: ~z~你不该说这句话的，杰梅因。我现在有充足的理由逮捕你了。

english: ~z~Cool, I think we managed to shake them. We just need to lay low for another minute.
zh: ~z~漂亮，我们好像甩掉他们了。现在只要再低调一会儿就行了。

english: ~z~I don't think they see us. Now, if we can stay outta their sights for a little longer we be all good.
zh: ~z~他们应该没看见我们。现在再在他们的视野外躲一会儿就行了。

english: ~z~then those Albanians you said you would deal with came and smashed my computer.
zh: ~z~然后你说你会解决的那群阿尔巴尼亚人就冲进来砸了我的电脑。

english: ~z~Where's Roman? Are you a cop? You've got to tell me if you're a cop. That's the law.
zh: ~z~罗曼人呢？你是条子吗？要是你是条子你就得告诉我。这是规矩。

english: ~z~Shit, Niko. He was one of my only regulars. This ain't good at all, man. Later on.
zh: ~z~操，尼克。他是我为数不多的常客。这可太糟糕了，老弟。回见。

english: ~z~That's exactly the kind of bullshit I can imagine Roman making up. You've got to give him credit for his imagination.
zh: ~z~完全就是我想象中罗曼会说的胡话。他的想象力真的是一流水准。

english: ~z~No, I didn't. Just like every other chump who gets off a boat here, I thought things might be more exciting.
zh: ~z~不是的。和别的在这儿下船的傻瓜一样，我以为这里的生活会更刺激。

english: ~z~You really got to get some practice driving on the right side of the road. Roman shouldn't have let you out of his cab.
zh: ~z~你真的该回去好好学学怎么开车了。罗曼不该让你把他的车开出来的。

english: ~z~Niko, sorry to ask, cousin... can you go pick up Jermaine, one of my regulars?
zh: ~z~尼克，很不好意思，堂弟...你能帮我去接我的一个熟客，杰梅因吗？

english: ~z~Anyway, Niko dealt with them... broke Dardan's arm, then beat up a couple more.
zh: ~z~总之呢，尼克解决了他们...打断了达尔丹的胳膊，又打倒了几个人。

english: ~z~Niko, how come you trash my cab but you never trash those tanks you drive back home?
zh: ~z~尼克，你怎么只会弄坏我的车？你开回家的那些坦克怎么就没见你弄坏过？

english: ~z~This is just the beginning. It seems I need to sort out my cousin's life before I can work on my own.
zh: ~z~现在只是前奏。我要先解决我堂兄的生活问题，然后才能开始为自己的生活奋斗。

english: ~z~The hotshot lady's man, cruising around the Mediterranean, breaking hearts and making millions?
zh: ~z~就是征服了抢手辣妹，在地中海上巡游，伤尽无数人的心，分分钟百万上下的那个？

english: ~z~One love.
~z~Go for it.
~z~Sure.
~z~Not exactly.
~z~I guess so.
~z~Where your wheels at?
~z~I don't know about that.
~z~Whatever, man.
~z~Thank you, cousin.
~z~There, I have time.
~z~I have had much experience.
~z~Inna the future, you know?
~z~I'm not going to judge you.
~z~Are you worried about this?
~z~Rhaatid, someone be inna de ground.
~z~I gotta ask ya another favor too.
~z~Yeah... like war?
~z~Come here back a' homebrew café.
~z~Likes to smoke a bit. Look after him.

~z~Capitalism is a dirty business.
~z~Shit, Niko. Get these bloodclots.
~z~Here's me number. Mek we link up soon.

~z~Shit. Fucking battery. This is chaos!

~z~Roman, I took Jacob where he wanted to go.
~z~He has been the same way since we were very young.
zh: ~z~我们还很小的时候他就这样了。

english: ~z~Alright breda, forward a Dillon street, in Schottler.
zh: ~z~好了兄弟，去舒特勒的迪隆街。

zh: ~z~屁！我给你做这么多事，你就这么报答？

english: ~z~You know what? It's cool. Get someone else, I'll see you later.
zh: ~z~那也行，爱咋咋。另请高明吧，之后见。

english: ~z~Then you give Johnny half the money, the rest you bring back to me.
zh: ~z~然后，钱分强尼一半，剩下的拿来给我。

english: ~z~and the two of you are gonna exchange the diamonds with a guy named Isaac.
zh: ~z~你们两个要跟一个叫艾萨克的人交易钻石。

english: ~z~A guarantee that you will find this man. I know he's in the city.
zh: ~z~向我保证你会找到他。我知道这个人在城里。

english: ~z~Fine. Fine you got it, you want my word, you got my word.
zh: ~z~好啊。好，算你狠。保证是吧，老子跟你保证。

zh: ~z~你的飞车党朋友还是不够硬派啊，雷。他死了。

english: ~z~Gentlemen, gentlemen, pardon the precautions. You know how things are.
zh: ~z~先生们，先生们，恕我带了保镖。这年头不安全啊。

english: ~z~So either you give me your word or go fuck yourself, I'm sick of this shit!
zh: ~z~你丫要么给个准数，要么玩蛋去吧，老子受不了了！

english: ~z~Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Since we're having a little show and tell, let's see some money.

english: ~z~Hold on. Hey, hey, hey gorgeous...

english: ~z~And what if I say I don't want to be your hitman?
zh: ~z~那我要是说我不想做你的杀手呢？

english: ~z~Please. Vlad told you to kill me, right?
zh: ~z~求你了。是弗拉德让你来杀我的吧？

english: ~z~I promised to deal with you. I don't break promises.
zh: ~z~我保证过要解决你的，我说到做到。

english: ~z~He think he's stealing some paperwork from Roman.
zh: ~z~他以为自己只是去罗曼那儿偷文件的。

english: ~z~I wasn't stealing nothing from your cousin's place!
zh: ~z~我没从你堂兄店里偷走什么东西...

english: ~z~Wanted to leave anyway, get away from all these people from back home.
zh: ~z~我早就想跑路了，刚好摆脱这些熟人。

english: ~z~Vlad ain't nobody, you going to see that.
zh: ~z~弗拉德在城里不算什么，你会见识到的。

english: ~z~So... why is Ivan going to rob my cousin?
zh: ~z~那...为什么这个伊万要抢我的堂兄？

english: ~z~I'd say... what problem has he got with my cousin?
zh: ~z~那我就说...他跟我堂兄有什么矛盾？

english: ~z~I thought everyone in this country was fat and slow.
zh: ~z~我还以为这个国家的人都是又胖又慢的。

english: ~z~no, I can't talk right now... what are you wearing?
zh: ~z~不行，现在没空聊...现在你穿的什么？

english: ~z~I tell you, is so much better if woman already have a man.
zh: ~z~我跟你讲，要是女人已经有了男人就更好了。

english: ~z~whose only friend is some fat weasel who drives a fucking cab...
zh: ~z~只有开破出租的肥猪给你撑腰的小混混...

english: ~z~No one's going to know that I'm alive. Not even my mother.
zh: ~z~没人会知道我还活着的。我亲妈都不会知道。

english: ~z~You won't be seeing your boyfriend Ivan no more. You going to miss him?
zh: ~z~你再也见不到你的男朋友伊万了。你会想他吗？

english: ~z~Thank you. You won't regret this, man. I am outta here!
zh: ~z~谢谢你，你不会后悔的，伙计。我马上就走人！

english: ~z~Then Mr. Faustin will be very angry with you... and your cousin.
zh: ~z~那福斯汀先生就会迁怒于你...还有你的堂兄。

english: ~z~Hey, Vlad. I lost your boyfriend. He got away from me.
zh: ~z~嘿，弗拉德。你男朋友我跟丢了。他从我这逃了。

english: ~z~He's angered Mikhail... Mr. Faustin. Offended him.
zh: ~z~他惹怒了米哈伊尔...福斯汀先生。得罪了他。

english: ~z~Get into the real America. You never gonna see me around here again.
zh: ~z~见识下真正的美国。你再也不会在这儿见到我了。

english: ~z~Very funny... what would you say if I told you he was going to rob your cousin?
zh: ~z~真好笑...那要是我告诉你他要抢劫你的堂兄呢？

english: ~z~I'll stay out of Hove Beach. I'll be a ghost. I promise. Please!
zh: ~z~我会远离霍夫海滩，做一个幽灵。我保证。求你了。

english: ~z~Vlad told me to go there. Let me go and I'll lay low.
zh: ~z~是弗拉德让我去那里的。放我走，我会低调做人的。

english: ~z~Fuck you. Say this to my face and I will break you.
zh: ~z~操你妈，你要是敢当我面说一次，我打爆你的狗头。

english: ~z~Fuck you. Say that to my face and I will break you.
zh: ~z~操你妈，你要是敢当我面说一次，我打爆你的狗头。

english: ~z~Ooh, that's funny. You know, for a dumb yokel, you're a very funny guy.
zh: ~z~喔，真好笑。作为一个蠢蛋乡巴佬，你还挺有趣的。

english: ~z~I knew we would understand each other, once I put it in this simple way.
zh: ~z~我就知道，只要把话说明白了，我们就能相互理解。

english: ~z~Yes, and for an annoying dick, you're really an annoying dick.
zh: ~z~对，作为一个烦人的屌人，你还真是个烦人的屌人。

english: ~z~Well, it's a real shame, then, that I'm the guy with the powerful friends, and you're the little punk
zh: ~z~那还真是有够可惜，我是有人撑腰的腕儿，你就是个

english: ~z~Hey, you and your cousin's girlfriend should get together. She likes sticky finishes as well.
zh: ~z~嘿，那你真该和你堂兄的女友聚聚，她也喜欢黏稠的。

english: ~z~I owe you my life, man. You're a good man, you're a good man, thank you.
zh: ~z~我欠你一命，兄弟。你是个好人，真的是好人，谢谢你。

english: ~z~I wasn't sure about killing you when Vlad asked. Now I'm coming around to the idea.
zh: ~z~弗拉德让我杀你的时候我还不一定能下手，现在我改主意了。

english: ~z~If Vlad wants you dead, you can't be all bad. Stay out of Hove Beach.
zh: ~z~要是弗拉德想要你死，那你应该也不会太坏。以后离霍夫海滩远点。

english: ~z~Because you don't have to deal with all their shit all day. Take Mallorie, for example...
zh: ~z~因为这样你就不用整天操心她们的破事了。就拿玛洛丽举个例子...

english: ~z~Hey gorgeous, yeah where were we? Okay now listen, let's talk about tonight...
zh: ~z~嘿，小美人，我们讲到哪儿来着？好，听我说，我们先安排下今晚...

english: ~z~No, I mean underneath it... great... listen, I'll call you back, eh? Sorry.
zh: ~z~不是，再里面点...很好...听着，我之后再打过来，啊？不好意思。

english: ~z~I should have known you would screw this up. You are born loser, just like your cousin. Come see me sometime.
zh: ~z~我就知道你会搞砸的。你天生就是个失败者，和你堂兄一样。有空再来找我。

english: The sparkle of diamonds is unmistakable - the sound is truly unbelievable. Show the world you're a real player with the tones of 5 karat rocks banging around.
zh: 钻石的闪光绝不会被听错－真的是令人难以置信的声音。用5克拉的钻石落地的声音告诉世界你的真实地位。

english: Nothing says luxury like lesbians - women who are so taken by your manliness they can't help but make out. That's power. That's what being a VIP is all about.
zh: 没什么比女同更能代表奢华的了－女人们都为你的男子气概臣服，止不住地互搞。这就是力量。作为VIP的生活就是这样。

english: The show that spawned a catchphrase "Bitch let's go!" is the #1 ringtone in the country. Show the world you are an individual by sporting the theme of the show where we get to judge women again.
zh: 全国最火铃声就是出自诞生流行语「贱人我们走！」的选秀节目的铃声。用重新审视女人的节目的主题曲，告诉人们你的与众不同。

english: What is it about the sound of champagne that says class? Not just an overpriced wine-seltzer that gives you a raging hangover, champagne can celebrate every phone call - even ones where you find out your house burnt down.
zh: 开香槟的音效是如何体现地位的？它不是只会给你留下剧烈宿醉的昂贵起泡酒，香槟能够庆祝每一次来电－通知你你家烧了的也是。

english: The sound that set the hip hop community on edge - recorded at the bedside of Trey Diggity as he died from a nasty Brazilian STD - this flatline has been sampled in over 125 top rated rap albums, which all sound the same these days anyway.
zh: 把嘻哈社群送上风口浪尖的音效－在特雷･迪吉蒂的病床边录制的，他死于某种巴西性病－该音效已经在至少125张高分Rap专辑中得到使用，搞得最近的专辑听起来都没啥区别。

english: VIP Luxury Ringtones spent months at nursing homes trying to get just the right sound. This one is a favorite. Every time you get a call people will ask, "did you hear that? It's like an old woman just broke her hip." It's comedy that never gets old.
zh: VIP奢华铃声站花费数月时间，在疗养院精挑细选得到的音效。这款音效备受青睐。每当你接到电话的时候，别人就会问「听见了吗？好像有个老太婆屁股裂了。」这个笑话永远不会过时。

english: Nothing tells the people around you that you're a player like a high priced ringtone. You're about to find out what it's like to be a celebrity. Rich people know - your ringtone defines who you are and how much money you have so take bling to the next level with audio bling. Show the world how dope you are by blaring something unique.
zh: 除了高价铃声，还有什么能向身边的人突显你的地位？马上你就会知道什么才叫名流。富人有个共识－手机铃声会体现你的身份和财力，使得铃声也进入了饰品行列。响起独特的铃声，向世人展示你的不同。

english: It's the TV show that has replicated into 18 identical TV shows set in different cities with the same plotlines and stunningly horrendous dialog. Punctuate your best Shory impression by taking your sunglasses on and off and spouting one liners like "Speed kills, and so do guns" or "Worlds collide because crime doesn't pay."
zh: 该节目被翻拍成了18个一模一样的节目，剧情没有变化，台词还是那么恶俗，只有背景城市不同。反复给你带上摘下墨镜，叨叨什么「速度能杀人，枪也能杀人」「犯罪零成本，世界会崩溃」，不断破坏你的观影体验。

english: Every time you get a call it will be like you are right in the movie! Imagine deleted scenes you wanted to see of elves fornicating with trolls, orcs ovulating, and dragons flying upside down. The Dragonbrain ringtone celebrates the movie that took America on a 4 hour journey to a land before time or sundials or basic critical faculties.
zh: 每一次响铃都是身临其境的体验！想象一下你想看的删节片段吧，精灵与侏儒通奸、兽人坐地排卵，还有倒着飞的巨龙。龙之脑铃声是对影片的赞颂，影片带美国进入了四小时的旅途，来到了没有圣光和是非观的史前大陆。

Markets Crash
More incomprehensible bad news.

english: Are You Looking At My Hose?
Dawkins asks the awkward questions

zh: 这是一个没人想过的禁忌话题：消防队有基佬。大多数人不会考虑这一问题，但据道金斯先生所说，多数消防站采用的开放式公共浴室会让男人感到尴尬。他爱国地说：「如果要改造浴室，让使用者不能大大方方地眼馋别人的生殖器的话，改造所需的开销会很大，而我更愿意将这笔钱用于保护我们城市不受恐怖袭击。」我们深表同感。谢谢你，道金斯先生，谢谢你能保持真诚。

zh: 坚定的顾家男人兼人民公仆，布莱斯･道金斯，会给我们的敌人送去恐惧，向世界展示美国何以成为全世界最伟大的国家。为什么？因为他说的都是自己的看法，而不是复读染有毒瘾的自由派精英写好的台本。昨天他明确指出是什么给了我们的敌人力量，削弱了我们应对匪夷所思状况的能力。(给消息不灵通和看不懂的读者的注释，匪夷所思的状况就是：外国人想抢在被我们杀害之前杀了我们)

Containers that originated at a false address in the Guangdong Province of China were intercepted by N.O.O.S.E operatives in charge of customs and border security. Experts reach vague conclusions on the markets today.
zh: 专家对今天的市场得出了含糊的结论。

english: In a world in which clever rich people can make money if the market goes down or up, the one thing we are told to write that we hate is the market doing nothing consistently. So come on Feds, loosen up regulations, stop trying to tell us what to do and allow unbridled capitalism to let the power brokers gain greater control for all our good.
zh: 身在这个聪明的富人无论行情好坏都能赚钱的世界中，我们很讨厌写上面布置的这种稿子：市场依然无所作为。快点啊，联邦政府，放松管制，别再教我们做事了，快让资本主义脱缰，让有权有势的人拥有更大的权力，这样对大家都好。

english: Worrying trends on the markets as the BAWSAQ refused to allow a discernible pattern to emerge. It went up and it went down and then it went nowhere. And we are not sure what to make of it; in a world in which no news is definitely bad news, especially for our ability to make money off this website. The fact is we'd like a pattern, as that would give us a story and currently we've got neither. It's a mess, and that makes it harder for people to say anything intelligent. Like when you vomit. It's not a bull, it's not a bear. It's a puddle of bile.
zh: 市场行情令人担忧，BAWSAQ大盘仍未给出明确走势。先是上涨，又是下跌，然后上下乱窜。我们不知道该怎么办，毕竟这个世界没有绝对的坏消息，而我们经营网站的目的也是为了营利。实际上我们都希望走势明确，因为这样我们还有故事能讲，但现在我们既看不清走势，又讲不出故事。实在是混乱，混乱到任何人都难以说出明智的话，就像你呕吐的时候。这不是牛市，也不是熊市，这就是一摊胆汁。

zh: 自由派宠儿惨死办公室

The firm is famous for trying to stand up for so-called civil rights, weak on terror, wooly on immigration and far too Draconian on gun control. It is a liberal establishment aiming to infect anyone who visits it with godlessness. zh: 自由城官方于昨日发出通告，宣布连接阿尔冈琴和奥尔德尼的通道即将重新开放。由于常年间歇出现的恐怖袭击警告，希基大桥和布斯隧道早先已被封锁。只有我这么想吗？我觉得这只是掌管城市的自由派左倾分子向恐怖分子低头寻求和解的又一案例。无法做到24小时的警戒和全面管制只会助长我们敌人的气焰。如果不能立刻对城里的男女老少进行全面彻底的搜身，那只能说他们活该去死。

The fact is terrorists use bridges to cross rivers and to kill innocent lives. Families will die because of this - we are at war, and when you're at war, you should suffer.

Terrorists target fuel depot

zh: 我们脆弱的富人盼来好消息

zh: 物价居高不下，地产业繁荣不停

Although the city is plagued by social problems, and has a massive shortfall of strip malls and obesity compared with rest of this great nation, at least they are keeping the economy strong.
zh: 在自由城这个诸事不顺的城市中，生活成本仍然高得令人安心，证明政府正在尽全力保护房主和家庭的利益。尽管这里社会问题繁多，小商场的缺口巨大，肥胖问题对比全国格外突出，但政府仍然保持着强大的经济实力。

english: Even more alarming, the LCPD forensic team has found a triggering device at the scene which may have been activated by a cell phone. It is more than likely that this was just the first of many planned bombings. If you see a foreigner using a cell phone, he is probably a terrorist. Act first, ask questions later. You have the safety of your fellow Americans to consider as well as your own.

english: Some strategists are saying that, "We should focus on this war, so we don't make the same mistake as the Nazis and try to fight a war on two fronts. Let's defeat fun first then focus on everything else we hate, like Europe."
zh: 某些决策者称：「我们应该专注于这场战争，不能犯下与纳粹同样的错误两线作战。我们要先干掉娱乐，再集火我们所憎恨的别的东西，比如欧洲。」

english: In an online missive that delivers a powerful blow to the heart of the liberal manifesto, Vassal poses the hard-hitting questions that most in our politically-correct society no longer dare to ask, such as, "What would you rather do? Starve or earn 10 cents an hour?"
zh: 瓦萨尔用一篇长文对自由派的主张进行了有力反击，他提出了我国被政治正确束缚的人们不敢提出的问题，比如「如果让你选，你会选择饿死还是10美分的时薪？」

english: The unfortunate truth is that tree-huggers would rather see third-world communities unemployed and homeless than working for a successful corporation. An Indonesian child is not going to thank a dreadlocked middle-class hippy for closing down her only source of income and sending her back to a life of crime, prostitution and cannibalism.
zh: 不幸的是，那些环境保护狂宁愿让第三世界的居民失业、流离失所，也不愿意让他们替一家成功企业工作。留着脏辫的中产嬉皮士断绝了一个印尼女孩唯一的收入来源，让她回到了满是犯罪、卖淫和吃人的生活，受害者可不会感谢他。

english: Thankfully, we are not complete losers. We've almost won one war - fun has almost been defeated. Nightclub-owning degenerate, Tony Prince, noted yesterday that Liberty City has been transformed into a strip mall. And not before time. The quicker we shut all of the night clubs there the better. Fun can be stopped, and we will prove it.
zh: 谢天谢地，我们还不是彻底的失败者。我们就快要打赢一场战争了——娱乐就要被击垮了。堕落的夜店老板，托尼･普林斯，于昨日表示，自由城已经变成小商场了。早该这样了。再不关掉那些夜店，我们哪有美好的未来。娱乐不是必需品，而我们会证明它。

english: For years, sneaker manufacturer Eris has been made the villain by work-shy lefties for choosing to help third world countries. Historically, Eris's visionary founder, Pete Vassal, has kept quiet, refusing to descend to the level of veggie hypocrites who are more than happy to take a welfare check from the same government that they profess to despise. However, after years of silence, Vassal has now chosen to speak out against the rants of stoned human rights activists the world over.
zh: 多年来，运动鞋制造商Eris一直被好吃懒做的左派塑造成坏人，只因为Eris在帮助第三世界国家。此前，富有远见的Eris创始人皮特･瓦萨尔始终保持沉默，拒绝把自己降低到和那些素食伪君子同样的水平，后者一边反对政府，一边巴不得政府给他发福利支票。然而在经过数年的沉默后，瓦萨尔终于发声反对了那些吸毒的人权活动家。

english: Firstly, if people are going to come over to our country they should adopt to our customs of growing obese and loving bad sitcoms. Also, learn our language, even if we haven't quite properly mastered it yet. They shouldn't go somewhere like Hove Beach which is more Russian than some parts of Moscow. If these guys are such a threat, then why don't we just close the borders to everyone? I say close the borders to these bastards. Remember, 9 in 10 terrorists are foreign too.
zh: 首先，如果有人想移民我们国家，他们应该学会适应我们的肥佬习惯、爱上垃圾情景剧。同时，还要学习我们的语言，尽管我们自己也没有完全掌握。他们不该去类似于霍夫海滩这种俄国佬比莫斯科的某些地区都多的地方。要是这些家伙是一种威胁，那我们为什么不对所有人都封锁边境呢？我是说，对所有的那些混蛋封锁边境。时刻记住，10个恐怖分子里面，有9个是外国佬。

english: Alright, so Bobby Jefferson went out of his way to praise some immigrants while he was damning others in his speech at the Civic Citadel. He argued that 99% of the people who come into this country are honest (I'd like to see the statistics to back that one up, by the way) and believe in the same things that patriotic American citizens do. He then went on to say that, besides terrorism, the biggest threat to American safety at the moment is these gangsters coming into Liberty City from Russia and Eastern Europe and setting up shop in immigrant communities like Hove Beach.
zh: 好吧，所以说博迪･杰斐逊在市政厅发表的演说可谓是煞费苦心地赞美移民，同时也毫不留情地咒骂其他人。他认为，这个国家99%的外来者都是诚实的(顺便一提，我倒想瞧瞧支持这一观点的数据)，且与我们美国的爱国者信仰相同。他还强调，除了恐怖主义，目前对美国国民安全的最大威胁，就是自由城中来自俄国和东欧的黑帮歹徒，他们还在霍夫海滩这样的移民社区里开张店铺。

english: Tragic Revelations
Bryce Dawkins Was Closet Liberal
zh: 布莱斯･道金斯是地下自由派

english: Fans of the Deputy Mayor have been devastated by new scandal
zh: 副市长的拥护者因新丑闻大受刺激

english: Why do we think this? Mr. Dawkins admitted he took pity on Mr. Crane and gave him somewhere to stay. If this isn't an awful example of people expecting state handouts, I don't know what is. Quite frankly, I think we'd all prefer it if Mr. Crane was Mr. Dawkins' lover. It is an awful example to set. Pity is for the weak.
zh: 我们为什么会这样想？道金斯先生承认自己同情克兰先生，为其提供了住所。如果这都不算指望政府救济的人的实例，我都不知道怎么样才算了。不过老实说，如果克兰先生是道金斯先生的情人的话，那我们还是喜闻乐见的。这是个坏榜样，因为同情是给弱者的。

english: Now, he's also come out as a homosexual, married with children. Well, it's scarcely surprising. He's a liberal. Wooly thinking is their watchword. Or watch words. This news organization can never be accused of wooly thinking (apart from our weird attitude to China, but let's ignore that), so we will continue to attack liberals like him, until we have driven them out of this country for good.
zh: 如今，他又作为一名同性恋出柜，而他已有妻儿。好吧，这一点都不意外。他是一个自由派。柔性思维是他们的口号。本报永远不会被说是柔性思维(我们对中国的古怪态度除外，但咱们先不管这个)，因此我们将继续攻击像他那样的自由派，直到把他们永远逐出国门。

english: Disgraced sinner, Bryce Dawkins, was hiding a terrible secret. He lived a double life. In public, he was a staunch hang 'em and flog 'em conservative, but in private, he was a filthy liberal. The fact is Mr. Dawkins was not as conservative as he made out. He even owned a passport. Most terrorists own passports, as do many drug dealers.
zh: 布莱斯･道金斯这个耻辱的罪人一直隐瞒着一个恐怖秘密。他过着双面的生活。在公众面前，他是坚定的保守派，整天叫嚷着「吊死他们，抽死他们」，但在私下，他完全是一个肮脏猥琐的自由派。事实上，道金斯先生并没有表面上那么保守。他甚至还有护照。而绝大多数恐怖分子都持有护照，许多毒贩也是如此。

english: How Could This Bee?
Toga To Be True
Swearing has entered into one of the most treasured American traditions
zh: 脏话走进了珍贵的美国传统之一

english: Foul mouthed kids ruin family entertainment
zh: 满口脏话的孩子让家庭娱乐泡了汤

english: Top economist falls for pyramid scheme
zh: 顶级经济学家因金字塔骗局跌落神坛

english: Unfortunately, what should have been an afternoon of wholesome family entertainment, ended in scandal and therapy. Parents and organizers were horrified at what is being called the "C word event" after an angry student took out frustrations on the judges whom he also called pedophiles.
zh: 不幸的是，下午档播出的合家欢节目最终毁在了丑闻和混乱中。一名愤怒的学生向他口中的恋童癖裁判发泄不满后，这一「逼字事件」震惊了观赛的父母们和裁判。

english: We at Weazel News say fair enough. In England they call each other the C word all the time. Here it is somehow held in high esteem as the argument ender - the word that is at the point of no return and makes her leave you for good. No word on if the Lip Reading Bee will continue.
zh: 我们Weazel新闻已经很客观了。在英格兰，他们一直都互称对方为「〇逼」。在美国则被视作争论的终结者——此言一出，即无回旋余地，她就会离你而去。读唇大赛是否会继续举办目前尚无定数。

english: We've all covertly mouthed something to someone, such as "Let's get out of here," or "I'm going to kill you," or "Hurry, before my husband gets back." But lip reading isn't just important for communicating quests for infidelity. It is a fundamental part of the academic process, and this year it was being celebrated at the inaugural Lip Reading Bee.
zh: 我们都悄悄地用口型跟别人说过话，比如「我们赶紧跑吧」「我要杀了你」或者「快点，我老公要回来了」。但是读唇不仅对偷情时的交流重要，在学术研究中也十分重要，今年的读唇大赛也备受人们关注。

english: Despite Wolfe's baseless allegations, the 'Roman Empire Wealth System' has been an upstanding sponsor of Weazel News and we cannot allow some cretin to sully its name. Life is full of risks and, as civilization goes down the toilet, it only means more ratings and sponsors for us.
zh: 尽管沃尔夫的指控毫无根据，「罗马帝国财富系统」一直是Weazel新闻的强力赞助商，而我们绝不容许某些白痴玷污它的清誉。生活充满风险，而且随着文明的衰落，我们的收视率只会更高，赞助商也会更多。

english: It seems that nobody is immune to the temptations of 'get rich quick' schemes on the Internet. Brilliant economist and Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Darius Wolfe, has revealed that he was persuaded into investing $20,000 into a online pyramid scheme. "As soon as I received the spam email titled 'Amazing Business Opportunity' that directed me to www.money2makemoney.com, I just had to know more," said Wolfe, "I've never been able to resist a risky investment."
zh: 似乎没人能抵抗互联网中「一夜暴富」骗局的诱惑。达里厄斯･沃尔夫，杰出经济学家兼美联储主席，于近期被曝给一个网络金字塔骗局投资$20,000。「我收到了一封题为『绝妙的赚钱良机』垃圾邮件，并将我导向 www.money2makemoney.com ，我只是觉得我得了解更多，」沃尔夫说道，「我从来都抗拒不了风险投资。」

english: Driving the Public Nuts?
Alliterative crimes rising rampantly?
LCPD heroes speak out
Meth claims new victims, headlines.
Patriotic Police Can't be Charged with Brutality
zh: 爱国警察不得被诉暴力执法

english: Gray-mouthed Granny Gets Methheads Grabbed by Cops
zh: 警方抓获冰毒成瘾的灰牙老太

english: Global warming hoax leads to increase in hybrid sales
zh: 全球变暖骗局致使混动车辆销量增长

english: Experts are theorizing that the video footage showing several women and children being thrown off the bridge by police is probably fake or touched up by a liberal activist.
zh: 专家试图证明所谓「妇女儿童被警方扔下大桥」的视频系自由派人士伪造，抑或被其动过手脚。

english: In related news, solar power has been studied in a new report which found it is too expensive and actually takes energy to make the panels. The President and Congress are working on a bill to protect industries like gas, coal and electric in the face of the solar threat.
zh: 相关新闻称，一份新的研究报告指出建造太阳能面板过于昂贵，制造时也会消耗能源。总统与国会正致力于通过法案，以保护油气、煤炭和电力等产业不受太阳能威胁。

english: Proving that hype overpowers sensibility, local residents have been flocking to hybrids such as the Karin Dilettante. Climate change is natural and has been happening since the Earth was created 6,500 years ago, say leading petroleum scientists. Volcanoes and animal flatulence create much more warming than the 3.5 billion cars burning oil each day.
zh: 本地居民纷纷购买包括Karin 半吊子在内的混动车，证明了过度炒作带来的冲动。「气候变化是自然现象，自从6500年前地球诞生就开始了」，几位顶尖石油科学家说。火山和动物放屁每天会产生比35亿辆车要多得多的热量。

english: Her teeth gray from years of meth abuse, Steinway resident Stephanie Peerson called police to rat out her fellow junkies. A mobile meth lab set up in a box truck was found and suspects taken into custody. "Meth has destroyed the lives and businesses of cocaine dealers in Vice City, and we see the same happening here," said agent Albert Thomas, "And this woman who is 22 years old looks like she's 62 because of the ravages of meth.
zh: 斯坦威居民斯蒂芬妮･皮尔森报警揭发了她的同伙，她的牙齿已因常年滥用冰毒而变灰。一个设立在厢式货车内的移动制毒设施被查封，嫌犯皆已送押。「冰毒毁掉了罪城可卡因商人的生计，而同样的事也发生在这里。」探员阿尔伯特･托马斯说，「这个看上去有62岁的女人其实才22岁，只因为她滥用冰毒。」

english:
Liberty City's Police Commissioner for Public Affairs, Tom Pireni, presented a "Wing It" slideshow presentation to the media today, clearly spelling out in simple bulletpoints how the actions of the heroes in the LCPD in, what some are calling the "Broker Bridge Incident", are not considered to be police brutality. Pireni spent 20 minutes on the first slide, using a laser pointer to underline bulletpoints that said:
* Protect
* Serve
* Freedom
He then played the Star-Spangled Banner on an acoustic guitar and ended with a chorus of reporters singing "What does freedom mean to me?" that drew tears from the audience.
zh:
今日，LCPD公共事务处处长汤姆･皮雷尼利用「Wing It」软件向媒体做了一份幻灯片报告，要点明确地表达了LCPD的英雄们在所谓「布洛克桥事件」中的行为并非暴力执法。皮雷尼把第一页讲了20分钟，用激光笔圈了半天要点：
* 保护
* 服务
* 自由
然后他用民谣吉他演奏了《星条旗之歌》(美国国歌)，最终以记者合唱「于我何为自由？」作结，观众泪如雨下。

english: Bridges closed indefinitely
No surprises in new report
Foreign Criminals taking over the city?
Terrorists Told To Eat Shit
Crime Up, Foreigners to Blame. Again
zh: 犯罪四起，都怪外国人。又是如此

english: Most criminals are foreigners and vice versa. And the sooner we all acknowledge this, the sooner we can be safe in our city, and focus on what matters, like telling foreigners how to run their countries and fighting abstract concepts.
zh: 大多数罪犯是外国人，大多数外国人是罪犯。我们越早认清这点，就能越早使城市安全，然后抓住真正的重点，例如告诉外国人如何治理自己的国家、打击某些抽象概念。

english: Only the terminally unobservant have failed to notice the remarkable rise in violent crime in Liberty City over the past few weeks and months. And only weak-minded liberals are afraid to discuss the causes of this crime wave - immigration. As usual, the liberal elite are banging on about the causes of crime - our right to bear arms, not immigration. Anyone with half a brain knows gun control should be relaxed in this city immediately so people can defend themselves from the border jumpers.
zh: 只有底层的违规者才不会注意到，在最近的数周数月中，自由城的暴力犯罪显著增加。也只有玻璃心的自由派才会惧怕提及这一犯罪浪潮背后的原因——移民。一如既往，自由主义精英抨击的犯罪原因还是持有枪支，而非移民。只要有点脑子，就能知道本市的枪支管控应当放松，这样人们才能从非法移民的手中保护自己。

english: In a bold and courageous move by city and federal officials, bridges and tunnels will be closed indefinitely while officials root out what is rumored to be a terror cell in Liberty City. While activists and other un-Americans have questioned the war on terror, to those who have died at the hands of police during protests, it is quite clear. "These terrorists want to take away our freedoms. But look, we've done it for them. Ha. We win. You lose. Eat my shit terrorists. Yeah, you like that? Do you? Daddy is in charge," said Deputy Mayor Bryce Dawkins. Income from tolls has dropped to zero, and officials say that bankruptcy is a small price to pay for safety. The stock market won't crash.
zh: 市政府和联邦官员通过大胆而有魄力的措施，无限期封闭了各个大桥和隧道，直到根除所谓的自由城中的恐怖分子才会解除。尽管社会活动家与其他非美国人已对反恐战争发起质疑，但对那些在抗议时死于警察手中的人来说，答案十分明确。「这些恐怖分子想要夺走我们的自由。但是，我们先做到了。哈，我们赢了，你输了。吔屎啦，恐怖分子。呵，你喜欢吗？中意吗？你爸爸我做主。」副市长布莱斯･道金斯说。来自收费站的收入已经降到了零，而政府官员则称「为了安全，破产不值一提。」证券市场不会崩盘。

english: Love it or Leave it
BAWSAQ Drops
A win for freedom as new laws will be enforced.
zh: 新法实施是自由的胜利

english: Freedom restored with Jingoism Act
zh: 沙文主义法案归还了自由

english: Will wealthy investors foot the bill for the war on terror?
zh: 富裕投资者会为反恐战争买单吗？

english: Otherwise, an important part of our population is going to suffer unfairly - the wealthy will be punished again as they have to pick up the tab for the government's mismanagement of the economy and the war on terror. We have said it before on Weazel: we are a nuclear power; we should blitz the economy and our enemies.
zh: 如不行动，我国人口中的重要组成部分就会受到不公平对待：富人们不仅要为政府在经济方面的失策和反恐战争买单，还要再被割一刀。之前我们在Weazel电台说过：我们是核国家，我们应当闪击经济和敌人。

english: As terrorists try to blow up our way of life and our Rusty Brown's stores, Congress took the courageous move today and passed the Jingoism Act, bringing back some much needed sanity into a country that has lost its way. Family values will be mandatory under the new law, and sodomy has been outlawed completely except in rare cases. Citizens are required to submit their email passwords to their local police to assist in tracking down those who would do harm to our country. Since the liberals desperately want the terrorists to win, this is a goose step in the right direction.
zh: 鉴于恐怖分子想要破坏我们的生活和Rusty Brown甜品店，国会今天迈出了极具魄力的一步——通过沙文主义法案，这将给我们迷途的国家带回些许亟需的理智。新法施行后，构建家庭观念将成法定义务，肛交成为违法行为(特殊情况除外)。公民需要将自己的邮箱密码交给当地警方，以协助追查可能危害国家安全的人。既然自由派这么希望恐怖分子获胜，本法案必定是向正确方向迈出的一大步。

english: It's the news our enemies love - the terrible price of freedom - the catastrophe of the falling stock market. The BAWSAQ has been in freefall the last few days, and it's the kind of news that makes terrorists rejoice and liberals wonder how they can interfere to bring prices down further. It's a natural consequence of years of over-regulation, big government and the killing of the entrepreneurial spirit that made this country the envy of foreigners everywhere. The country will enter a serious recession and be governed by a combination of Islamic terrorists, homosexuals and communists unless action is taken immediately - the government must cut the highest rate of income tax for the rich, abolish capital gains tax and liberate the rich to make investments wherever they see fit.
